dpe spun gsal bshad/rang re gangs can pa rnams la rig gnas lo rgyus/ yu la srol goms gshis sogs mi rigs gzhan la ngo gnong mi dgos par rang chas su yod pa ni bod snga rabs pha mye rnams kyis shul bzhag gi bstan bcos dag gi drin du lags/ de dag gi rgyun mi nyams gong 'phel dang nyams pa sor chud kyi las la rab tu brtson dgos pa ni rang re mi rabs rjes ma rnams kyis 'os 'gan yin phyir/ da lan si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi bod rigs spun zla lhag bsam can rnams kyis bod kyi gna' dpe 'tshol sdud dang dpe skrun gyi bya bzhag la thugs khur 'bad brtson lhod med gnang bzhin yod par snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu ba yin/skabs zhu gnas yig dkar chag 'di ni mdo khams kuḥ thog pa si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho gang des bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i nang gses sa pho rta yi lor/ khams kyi char gtogs dpal poḥthog rdo rje gdan nas dbu brtsams te/ bsil ldan sā la'i sman ljongs kyi gnas rten phal che ba dang / ma hā tsi na'i yul gyi gnas ri grags can 'ga' la gnas skor du byon pa dag gcig tu bsdus te phyi rabs gdul bya rnams kyi dgos 1

mkho'i ched du dmigs nas ngo sprod mtshams sbyor gyi tshul du bkod pa zhig lags/ de yang cung zad dbye na/ sma da mdo khams dang dbus gtsang / rgya nag dang 'jang yul sogs kyi dbon sde khag dang / dben gnas dang sgrub gnas khyad par can las/ lha khang dang gtsug lag khang yod tshad/ bzhugs su gsol ba'i rten gsum ji snyed kyi rnam grangs dang / bzo bkod/ mtho dman/ rgyu spus sogs re re bzhin zhib phra ji yod gnas yig dkar chag 'dir 'khod yod pa ni deng rabs zhib 'jug mkhan dang gnas mjal ba rnams la med du mi rung ba'i dpe dkon zhig tu grub mod/ 'on kyang 'di gar gnas yis ma phyi gcig pu tsam lag son byung ba ni/ chad lhag dang nor skyon mang zhing / yis gzugs mi gsal ba'am/ sngon rjes 'gal zlar gyur pa/ tshig sbyor gyi cha ma tshams min ci rigs mchis pa sogs kyis deb 'dir nor 'khrul rtsa ba nas med pa zhig ni yong mi srid cing / 'on te dpe rgyun 'di nub par dogs nas rang blos gang lcogs kyis klog zhu re mdzad kyang / da dung nor 'khrul gyi cha gang mang mchis srid pas rgya che'i gzigs mkhan rnams hās dag bcos 'dzem med gnang dgos pa ni deb 'di'i nying dgos sprul ming pa tshe ring bkra this nas phul/

༄7//chos rnams kun la tshad mar gyur pa'i spyan/ /dge legs mkhyen gter 'bum mnga' bcom ldan 'das/ /nges gsung srid pa'i rims nad 'jil ba'i chos /der 'dzin tshogs mchog 'dus par bcas kun mchod/ /zhing rnams kun tu rgyal sras spyod pa'i gser gyi rnga/ /snyan par brdung bas rab 'byams 'khor du grags pa'i phul/ /dpag yas rgyal ba'i yab gcig rgyal sras thu bo'i tshul/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter zhal snying dbus 'dzum pas rol/ /ris med thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gling / /don gnyis nor bu'i sgrom chen pos/ /dus 'dir phyogs kun dbul sel ba/ /ded dpon mkhyen brtse'i dbang po rgyal/ /lhun sdug 'ja' 'od 'khyil pa'i klong / /ye shes skye 'chi bral ba'i sku/ /lhun grub sangs rgyas padma skyes/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rjer 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i lag na pad mo byang chub kyi/ /spyod pa sa rab dkar bsil ba dang ldan pa/ /

gangs ljongs rnam 'dren phrin las rten gsum 'bum/ /grol ba bzhi ldan me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rab byung bco lnga pa'i nang gses sa rta lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu la/ khams dbus kyi cha dpal maḥthog rdo rje gdan nas rim par klung 'bri dam pa chos phyugs kyi chab gser ldan dga' ma po lu brag mgo zhes bya ba nas brgal/ ku se/ nyas gshis sogs ljongs du ma brgyud/ khri tsho dang / waṃ dgon zhes dpal sa skya pa dang / o rgyan smin grol gling pa'i ring lugs pa rtsi rong brag nag ces bya ba'i dgon rnams brgyud/ zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la dpal ldan 'brug pa'i ring lugs pa chen po sga nyag khams pa sgar thub bstan phun tshogs gling du phyin par gyur to/ /de'ang byang rong 'dres ma/ brag dkar spang ljongs / nags tshal du mas mdzes pa/ phyogs dang mtshams su gnas chen padma khyung rdzong dang / dkrigs rgyal/ rin po che zangs dngul gser/ rdo sma na drug cu sogs tshang ba/ col g.yu lung / tshal tsha lung rma sras/ the gru gu lha brag ko spyan ras gzigs/ mdzo rdzi sogs gnas che phra du mas bskor ba/ srid pa'i lha gnyan dpal dgyes 'dzom ra zhes pa'i mdun/ khyung 'brug glang sogs sa gzhi dpyad legs pa'i dbus/ pho brang gtsug 2

lag khang ser po'i dbu rtse nub ngos bar khang dpe mdzod g.yas na bzhugs khri/ tshe lha rnam gsum dang 'jam dkar tshe ring rnam drug bris/ g.yas dpe khri sgam/ 24g.yon/ naganas bcu nye sras/bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i sku/ bka' 'gyur cha/ 4bstan 'gyur bcas/ rgyab nas dpe khri/ 26g.yon phyogs bstan pa'i nyi mas zhal bskang dpe sgam brgyad bcas nang a pod/ 2542'bum spar gsar bzhengs dpe khri shog gcig snyan 'grel spar/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin mgur/ gzungs 'bul spar/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin thugs sgrub/ dri med bshags rgyud/ chos chung chos spyod/ khams sprul bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gu ru'i thugs tig spar bcas dbu rtse g.yas lha gsar khang / li ma byis pa tsam sle chung ma3 tsandan nye sras/ sangs rgyas rab bdun sogs sku sna tshogs nyis brgya tsam/ phyag rdor byis pa tsam 'dam/ shing gi mchod rtenan 'khor lo/ ling ga tshe bdag bzlog byang / bsang brngan gtor byang spar sogs sgam gang / g.yas mchod khang du/ sprul sku'i maṇḍal so bdun ma 'dom gang ma/ mdo sde mchod pa'i lha sku sgam gang / mchod khri rnams rtse mo yod pa brgyad sogs/ phug ngos thams cad du ston sku lha khang du chos longs maṇḍal khri bskos ri mo bris pa/ ka ba nyer brgyad ma/ rten garnyo la tsandan sangs 3

rgyas stong sku mtho gang por do ma 'di kun dga' bstan 'dzin phyag mtho'i tshad yin/ rgyab yol nang dang por sems bskyed tshul gser bris snag bcad/ 'os khri'i 'phred la skal bzang gi tshigs bcad gnyis re gser bris/ khri rtse khru gang / rgyab yol rtse khru gang pa/ phreng brgyad bka' gdams mchod khri/ gtso bo dus gsum sangs rgyas rtse khru sang lhag yab yum sras mchog zung rim gro bcas gser sku drug re/na bza' phyi nang gnyis re/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin gser sku gsung 'byon ma/ rtse g.yon bla ma'i lha khang du rten gtso au rgyan mi che tshad zangs gser/ mi pham thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gdung rten mchod sdong mi tshad/ chos kyi nyi ma/ sgrub brgyud nyi ma/ bstan pa'i nyi ma gsum rtse khru gang ba khri rgyab gdusas bcas gser zangs mchod rten mda' tshad bzhi/ yang sku lnga/ bar khang lhor mgon khang phyi nang du sku gsob/ mgon mang gi gtor ma la sogs/ 'og tu 'du khang sbug thub chen zangs gser byon legs zhal tshad mtho gsum pa khri bkod khyad 'phags bcas/ byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs mi tshad lhag pa gnyis/ g.yas kun dga' bstan 'dzin gser gdung dus 'khor ye shes mchod rten/ g.yon du sgrub brgyud nyi ma/ bstan pa'i nyi ma bcas kyi gdung rten rnam rgyal mchod sdong bcas theg pa chen po gnyis 4

phal thog gsum pa phra rgyan khyad 'phags/ chos nyi'i gdung rten g.yas phyogs su dpe med pa'i mchod rten dngul gser bkra ma 'dom gang lhagasras bstan 'dzin gser gdung khru gang pa bcas/ rgyan khang du dbang rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil thang ngo mtshar ba/ sbub sil rgya sgam thang/ 16can nang cha66 tsam/ 'du khang ka ba/ 48ka ring / 4nub tu gser gdung dang 'bag khang / lhor rgyan khang / byang du sgrub chen khang / de'i dang du / nor bu'i drwa phyed/ yol ba/ bla bre/ stong mchod sgam/ bka' brgyad pho brang / tshogs gur/ bka' brgyad mchod lha/ rig 'dzin brgyad sogs dang / dpal dgu'i phur pa dgu gnyis/ dbang phyug phur pa/ sgo ma'i phur pa/ khro bcu'i phur pa rtse khru gang dang mtho gang / zhal gsum/ phur gdan mtho gang pa bcas/sgo shub g.yas g.yon khri rgyab yol/ bdag 'jug ca ka yol ba bla gre sogs/ spug gtsang khang gi g.yas na zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang skor yod/ gser gdung khang du rje kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhal bkod kyi rgyas stod lha bzo chos bkras bris pa'i bka' brgyud gser phreng khyad 'phags zhal thang48 gnas bcu'i zhal thang grwa25 yang gnas bcu'i zhal thang20yod pa pad dkar skye phreng chos bkras bzhengs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i zhal thang grwa tshar15 kun dga' 5

bstan 'dzin skye rabs zhal thangan chos bkras bris pa'i kun dga' bstan 'dzin rnam thar 'byung gzugs chu zla'i rol gar thang shar/ 9thugs sgrub zhal thang7 thod phreng sde lnga thang shar5 bsam lhun dang sirnyi rgya mtsho'i zhal thang2 bar chad lam sel zhal thang2 rje 'bangs thang shar chos dbyings ye shes thang shar gtso khang du bzhugs pa'i zhal thang sna tshogs gras khyen rnam grangs100tsam/ rgyud sde'i zhal thang dpal spungs dpe ltar28 'brug lugs bla brgyud gser thang5 yang 'brug pa'i bla ma phal cher zhal thang 'thor bu gras 8 zangs mdos dpal ri'i zhal thang1 grub brgyan3 tsam/ rigs ldan dpal spungs ltar41mgon thang28skyes rab dpag bsam 'khri shing zhal thang27khyad du 'phags pa sogs zhal thang khyon/ 421 bar khang shar ngos rnams gzi ma chung ste/ spug gi gzim bskyil phyi ma bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i bzhugs khri can ka drug ma rgya mthongs can dbus khri'i g.yas sgrub brgyud nyi mas bzhengs pa'i gu ru'i gser sku mi tshad khri bcas/phug nas li ma kha shas/ g.yas ngos gnas brtan cha gnyis nang zangs gser can gcigabrag ri ma gcig sgrol ma nyer gcig ltung bshags/gu ru'i sku chas zhi chas cha gnyis ngo mtshar spus nam bzo bkod mdzes pa dang / rus pa mkha' 'gro mas phul bar grags pa'i rus rgyan sgros 6

dpe med can cha tshang / g.yas ngos sgrub brgyud nyi ma'i gzim bskyil sprag btsan sku gsob ni stag lung pa'i srung ma stag lung pa'i sku skye yin pas rjes su 'brang ba yin ska da dang sgam mang / g.yon sbrug ring sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gzim chung na rten khyad 'phags ston pa shar li lung bstan ma/ 'ja' tshon gter ma gu ru bye ma a krong / rdo rje phur pa dang / grub thob thang stong sogs gser sku50 tsam/ rgyal dbang lnga pas bstsal ba'i nye sras dgu thang ngo mtshar ba/ rgyan drug5sgrub brgyud nyi ma'i rnam thar20 mdzad bcu12 bka' thang25sogs mang ngo / /chos kyi nyi ma'i gzim khang rtsa ba'i shar ngos gnyer khang du song bar jag pa me len gsob bcas/ ri khrod gnyis na'ang rten gsum cung zad re yod skad do/ /dad pas byin pa'i longs spyod 'tsho ba mang / /yon gnas phal gyi drwa bar chab blugs ltar/ /dam pa de dag rgyu 'bras mkhyen pa'i rtags/ /rgyal ba'i rten mang bsod nams zhing du bsgrun/ /chos der 'brug lugs bde mchog mgon khang bla mchod/ mi 'khrugs sogs/ rnying ma'i bka' brgyad smin lugs/ dkon spyi dang bla ma gsang 'dus bsres pa/ 'brug lugs tshe bdag sogs btang7 /

grwa nyis brgya sogs nye bar snang ngo / /mthong grol mtsho skyes zla shel ni/ /snyan dga'i bsil zer spro ba can/ /gdul bya'i mkhar shar bstan pa dang / /der 'dzin ku mud dgod par snang / /de nas ljongs du ma brgal nas yid du mchis pa'i yul gru du ma dang lam mang po brgal ba las/ yon dge gter chen rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gter gnas lha thog mdzo rdzir dbus gu ru'i sgrub phugagayas mgon po ber nag dang / grub chen snang srid zil gnon kurma pakshi/ mdun ri dpal ldan lha mo'i brang rgyan me long dbus kurma pa kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i sku gsal ba/ shar ngos gro lod sku dang /mdun du gro lod gter gnas g.yu chu'i mtsho sogs ldan pa/ ri khrod bar mar sgrub grwa lnga/ rje drung gzim bskyil sgrub khang rten gsum cung zad/ tshe dpag khang sogs/ 'og dgon gyi phur khang du ratna gling pa'i phur ba'i blos bslang shing las byas pa/ tshe sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor khang na bde chen zhing bkod shing brkos can/ si tu'i phyag bzo ber nag can yod pa'i mgon khang dang / yon dge'i gzim bskyil na gro lod khang / bla brang bde chen/ sprul sku'i gzim khang gser sku brgya tsam/8

lha khang ka ba bcu drug dri gtsang khang bcas/ yo rgyan/ ston pa/ yon dge bcas 'dam sku thog so re/ ri mo spus legs/ rje drung gzim bskyis gnyis na gser sku brgya lhag zhal thang la za ma tog3 bka' brgyud gser phreng thang 130 bka' thang nyer lnga sogs kur shod thang ka brgya lhag yang gzim bskyikha gnyis na gser sku 50tsam/ bka' 'gyur chan/ kur sku dang / chags med sku/ si tu'i sku phreng sogs sman 'dam bzhugs pa'i lha khang bcas si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon pa yin la/ mda' na dam can brag 'gags bcas so/ /dang po mdzo mo 'tsho byed rdzi bo zhig /bar du las 'phro sad pa sprul pa'i sku/ /tha mar mi 'gyur rdo rjer grags pa yi/ /gdan sa'i bkod pa phyag chen rang grub mjal/ /phyogs rnams rtse mtho'i brag dkar ni/ /sna tshogs las kyis bris pa bzhin/ /yul gru du ma snang ba ni/ /chos rnams rdzun gyi rol bas bskrun/ /ra ba rab brjid nags tshal 'greng pa'i dbus/ /spangs rnams sa gzhi bzod ldan 'jam bag g.yo/ /skye rga na 'chis 'gyur ba'i dus rim la/ /lang tsho'i rtse bag 'phrul pas 'phya ba snyam/ /de yan chad tshes16la'o/ /khams pa'i dgon lag mtshan nyid dgon du thub pa 'dam sku/kun dga' bstan 'dzin sku/ bka' bstan 'gyur/ skyes rab zhaX

thang sogs zhal thang brgya skor snang /gying thang dgon du bka' 'gyur dang / zhal thang 50skor snang /zla8tshes25la gdan sa bar pa 'og min kurma'i steng gi mgon khang bkra shis gsar pa pakshi'i gzim khang / spug pakshi'i rgya nag pheb gyon a ga ru nang / chos grags rgya mtsho'i ma mgon mda' tshad gser sku/ 'gro mgon ras chen thugs dam ber/ sog dmag skabs rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i phyag bzhi mja' 'dul ma sogs 'dug rten gtso/lho gzigs byang du lha bla ma ye shes 'od thugs dam thub pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje mda' tshad ma dge 'dun sgang pa chos 'grub seng ges gnang ba/si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gdung rten mdo lugs/ dngul gyi bka' gdams gdung rten mda' tshad/ sngags mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gser sku mi tshad/ kye rdor bal li/ li ma spus dag po sna tshogs30 tsam/ maḥthog pa byams pa 'bum gyis pakhrir gnang ba'i mgon po'i gser 'bags byin rlabs phul phyin/ kurma pa dang si tu na rim phyag bris zhal thang shin tu mang / ro lang pags pas byas pa'i chos grags rgya mtsho'i phyag bzos ma mgon mgar ba'i zhal 'bags skabs rer zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ si tu ārya sa ler sprul ba'i a tsa ras phul ba'i rgya gar shar li rigs gsum mgon po mda' tshad ma/ rkarma pakshi'i chibs yob phyag 10

lcags/ gnam lcags ral gri/ yon dge'i gza' 'gyed me mda'/gnam lcags tho ba sogs mchod rdzas mang / gzi che/ phyi rol du thub pa mda' tshad sogs gser sku20 tsam/ gro lod mgon khang du yon dge'i phyag bzo gro lod 'bags dang / trasnad sku/ li ma sogs bcu tsam/ zla sprul mgon khang sogs bkur bste chung / bka' nyan ma dang /mdzod nag mgon nag sogs ni kun gyis mi mjal zhing sgo skar khung sogs phyag dam can no/ /grub thob pakshi'i gdung sa 'bum thog so gsum pa gser 'thug nyams can/ 'bras spungs mchod rten te bka' gdams mchod rten khri zur brgyad steng bzhag pa'o/ /bar der kurma'i 'bum thang lcang gling che tsam/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bro ra/rje dus mkhyen dbus g.yas ras chen/ g.yon mtshur dbang gi rdo rje rnams kyi gdung rten thog so gsum pa ste rdza gyo/ jo bo shākya mu ne rgya yul bzhugs dus kyi dbu gdugs gsum gser rnying zad 'gro ba pakshi'i klu la 'u lag bskul te slebs pa dbub pa/ bskor na bad kun mid gcus la phan/ 7pho brang gza'i g.yer mo che 'du khang ka ba56 logs bris skyes rabs rgyas/ sgar bris rnying tshugs can/ zhwa dmar nag bzhugs khri/ bka' 'gyur gser bris gcigaspar ma gcigamachod rdzas mang /phug tu gtsang khang g.yas par pakshi'i skabs bzhengs pa'i byams pa 11

dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad zhal 'dom gang ba brtsegs lnga/ byang sems gnyis/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mi tshad re/ bal bris thub sku tshugs shin tu legs pa gnyis/ spyan lnga rta shod sku/ gser 'gyur sogs dang skya bris pod stong lhag cing bshaṭa mi tshad tsam gser bris/ 7gtsang khang dbus su/ bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i thub chen zhal mtho lnga ba smin mtshams su nā lend+ra'i chos dung rngog lo blo ldan shes rab thugs dam/ sde dge dgon chen rgyab lung ma dang phyogs 'dra/ khri rgyab 'dam bzos gnas bcu bcas/ mdun rang byung rdo rje'i dgongs rdzogs si tu dge 'dun ye shes kyis bzhengs pa'i thub sku li ma dang /g.yas 'jam dbyangs blo gros seng ge'i thugs dam/ 'og si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam thub sku rnams li ma brtsegs sleb zhal ngo mtho do lhag g.yon du dus mkhyen/ ras chen/ pakhri gsum/ bka' gdams mchod rten 'dom phyed do re tsam/ gser bris bka' 'gyur/ skyes rabs brgya pa logs bris/ 7bla ma lha khang du rten gtso khyad 'phags bdun ldan dus mkhyen sku kyu ra lha chen nas bzhengs pa zi khyim li ma bkod pa phul du byung ba chos drug gsung 'byon ma/ rten 'di rgya tshan lan thang stong blugs rgyab pa red ces pa'i gtam rgyun yod pas li ma yin pa las/ rgyang mjal bltas na brdung sku yin pa 'dra/12

g.yas pakhri'i sku gser gar bu srang chen lnga brgya yod pa/ de'i g.yas rang byung rdo rje'i sku li ma 'di rten byin ldan bzhugs/ g.yon du dngul jil tshad bzhi bcu las grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje'i sku rnams 'dom phyed do re/ g.yas su ker rabs gser sku mi tshad gsum/ sman sku gnyis g.yon mgon mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku 'dzam bu chu gser ma zangs can 'dom phyed do/ gser sku gnyis/ sman sku gnyis/ bka' brgyud gser phreng mi tshad re logs bris/ 7dngul gdung khang du/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan sku gdung dngul gdung sa 'jim gyis g.yogs pa/byang chub rdo rje'i sku gdung / rgyal ba byams pa'i gser sku lha sa'i jo bo'i sku tshad/ phyag stong spyan stong sman sku/ spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'jim sku bcas/ bka' bstan gser dngul ra ma lug cha brgyad dgu tsam nyung mtha'/ 7steng du thub pa lha khang na dus mkhyen gsung 'byon ras chen gsung 'byon dbu zhwa phud pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ mi bskyod 'ja' zug thub pa dngul sku mi chung tshad/ li sku lnga bcu tsam/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud bris sku sogs logs bris/ 7zhwa dmar gzim chung ngam si tu'i gzim bskyil na/ gser sku lnga bcu tsam/ gdan sa bdag po med pas phug ron brunayang bas yid skyo ba'i yul/ 7sgo dmar khang na/ chos dbyings rdo rje'i phyag brkos tsandan 13

dkar po'i gnas brtan brag ri/ rgyud sde dgyes rdor lha dgu gsang 'dus sogs li ma chen po dgu tsam mda' tshad phul du gyur pa/ gzhan gser sku li ma 'dres pa140tsam/ kurma pa si tu gnyis kyi bzhugs khri/sbug kurma pa'i gzim chung bgres/ logs bris zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug phyag bris sa ra ha pa byin can tshugs shin tu mtshar/ rgya bris yul bkod/yon dge gter chen gzim khang rnying ma khang ngam khro bo khang na bzhugs khri yon dge'i gter bzhugs pa'i slob dpon mi tshad/ thub pa/ yon dge nyid 'dra/ kurma pa dgu pa bcas mi tshad re mi na 'dam/ traka shad sku byin ldan zhal 'bags gter ma phyag rnga/ gser gdung 'dom phyed do ba/ mar sku 'dam gsum/ li ma bzang po kha shas/ shing gi mchod sdong mang /dbu rtse khang du kurma pa theg mchog rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i slob dpon gser sku mi tshad ma gser srang bcu dang zho lnga song gsungs pa spus dgagaser sku brgya lhag sogs gnam yol gser jus 'khor lo ma sogs/kurma pakshi dang / hor se chen chibs sga sga 'thor rgyan blangs pa rang gar 'phang snang / zhal thang dpag khri cha gnyis/ bka' brgyud gser phre/ 4rgyas pa so bzhi/ bsdus pa bcu bzhi bcas cha gnyis/ rgyud sde'i

zhal thang22sogs yod/ dgon bar du/ padma badzra'i mgon khang gling dbus khe tshe lha khang grags par dus mkhyen thog mar byon dus kyi sku rgyab brten pa'i shug sdong shul klad rgyab yol brag zla gam dbyibs/ lung pa e dbyibs/ dkar 'dzong brag tu dus mkhyen sgrub phug sa dang kai rang byon spang shing kyang yod par grags/ pha ri na spam brag gdung rten bskor na srin la phan/ phu na mchog gling kurma'i gsang sngags pho brang rgyang nas mjal/ nam pa ri pa lnga brgya/ da lta re zung snang ngo / /kurma'i rgya ri ngos rkarma'i mkhan po rin chen dar rgyas gzim khang na/ ratna gling pa'i gter ma o rgyan za hor ma ri bo che'i rten gral nas 'ong ba/ thub pa li sku sogs byin can30tsam/ khang shod gser sku30tsam/ mchog gling gter chos kyi zhal thang mang / dpe cha pod30lhag mkhan po'i phyag bris bal yul/ ra lung / ti se sogs kyi gnas bkod mang tsam/ stag na sgrub khang du lha khang / bka' 'gyur/ gser sku/ ltung bshags/ gnas brtan sku/ mkhan pos btsugs pa'i sgrub grwa dpon g.yog brgyad yod do/ /mkha' 'gros mtshan gsol klo thu kurma na/ /zla gam dbang gi brag dkar nags tshal can/ /drang srong ri yi shel nags ma pham pas/ /mdzes phyir 'dul 'dzin mkhan po 'ga' re snang / /rgyal kun phrin las sar grags sku 15

gsung thugs/ /byin rlabs ras chen sprul pa'i phreng ba yi/ /rten gsum lhun po byin rlabs 'od ldan kyang / /gdul bya'i yul gyi bkur ste chung la skyo/ /kurma lha steng ri mtho brag spang shing sgang shin tu brjid chags nyams dga' bar gtsug lag khang ka ring gnyis ka ba16 zung 'jug brgyud rim logs bris sgar bris rnying tshugs shin tu legs/ kurma mi bskyod rdo rje gser sku li ma dang / thub sku bkra shis 'od 'bar mda' tshad rang byung rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i gser 'bum pod 16ma dang / 12ma/gser dngul gyi bka' 'gyur/ zhwa dmar nag bzhugs khri/ sde dge'i bka' 'gyur gcig spyan ras gzigs dang / kurma pa rang byung dbon ldong ston gzhon nu 'bum gyi sku/ kurma pa chos dbyings rdo rje/ si tu chos 'byung rnams 'dam sku mi tshad re/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsung dang / chu mgo'i kha gnon mchod rten/ zhug tu byams khang ka bzhi ma'i dbus/ stong nag sprul skus bzhengs pa'i byams chen 'dam sku thog so mthon po/ nar rab brgyad 'dam sku nang gsung 'byon gsum/ rang byung rdo rje'i gser sku mi tshad nga 'dra ma/ logs bris sangs rgyas stong / jo bo me rdugs chu rdugs te dgon rnying zhig pa'i gser sku mi tshad gnyis/ g.yas su li ma khang na sku 'dra li ma brgya 16

skor/ mchod rten mang / rang byung rdo rje'i rlung ras ras gzan la grub chen brgyad cu phyag bris li tshugs/ g.yon du mgon khang na sprul sku mgon po yon dge'i chos bdag gi phyag bzo phyag drug pa/ ber nag can/ phyag bzhi pa rnams/ rang byung rdo rje'i phyag bzo tsandan mgon sku sogs kurma pa'i dam 'byar/ sgam gcig nang dam can ra 'ba' ma grags pa/ 7bar khang du rang byung rdo rje'i sgrub khang na/ dwa khri/ rten gser bris sogs bka' 'gyur skor pod stong tsam/ zhwa dmar nag gzim bskyis na rigs lnga li ma sogs/ 7steng gi jo bo khang dbus/rkarma pa rang byung rdo rje'i dbon ldang ston gzhon nu 'bum gyis bzhengs/ lha bzo sprul pa'i lha bzos mdzad/ rang byung rdo rjes gser spar mo gang gnang / gser mdog gang dang yang mi 'dra ba'i li ma jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku tshad/ thugs rten gser dang bye ma bsres nas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten cha brgyad mda' tshad ma mi 'dra ba'i bzo khyad byin can/ si tu mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha'i gter mdung gnyis/g.yas kyi lha khang na sku brgya tsam/ g.yon gyi lha khang na li ma mi tshad gsum/yang li ma mda' tshad bzhi/ skar sku sman 'dam byin can mang /li ma 'thor bu20tsam/ 7jo khang ni lha khang nyams spro ba byin rlabs kyi gzi 'bar bar snang / lha khang steng nas g.yon zur na gnas bcu 17

drug gi thang shing 16yang rang byung rdo rje'i dbu sku'i nags/ mdun du klu mtsho sogs nyams mtshar sa skyid po snang / lha khang g.yas si tu ri mgo pa'i sa 'bum/ 7ri khrod 'ja' mo sku skye'i gzim khang na/ dhi sa ru lha smyon mas snga sor bris pa tshugs phul du gyur pa tshon mdog yul bkod sogs ngo mtshar ba'i bka' brgyud gser phreng thang ga16 dpag khri21 rten sgam na yon dge'i gri rlung mdud/ gnam lcags rdo rje khru gang / yon dges gru gu lha brag nas bzhings pa'i gter gri/ 'ja' mo phrin las bstan gsal la spa gro stag tshang nas kurma pas gnang ba'i kurma pa chos dbyings rdo rjes shang khrag gis gos ya sha la phyag bris gser bcad gnang ba'i zhing skyong 'khor bcas/ zhal sprin gyis khro gnyer dod pa'i ber can 'khor bcas/ dam can mgar nag 'khor bcas/ rnam sras skya brgyad/ sog ma me klu sngags bdag rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bcas bdun thang mjal/ chos 'byung phyag bris phyag drugagur/ lha mo/ ma ning / gro lod sman gsar zhal tshugs byas pa bcas thang ka lnga/ kurma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i phyag bris nyid kyi thang ga zha dmar dpal chen chos kyi don 'grub phyag bris zhing skyong thang ku yang phyag bris thang ka gsum/ theg mchog rdo rje'i phyag bris kha sarsha ṇi/zur mang dpa' dar sprul sku'i phyag bris 'chad cod rtsom gsum la klu 18

sgrub dpa' bo chos grags sku gsum/ khams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin phyag bris gu ru mtshan brgyad chos kyi nyi ma'i sgrub rten zhib cha can sman rnying tshugs ldan dbang phyug rdo rje'i phyag bzos ber can sku/mchod khang na gser sku yang mang / gnas bcu sogs shing sku brkos mtshar/ 'ja' mo'i gong du gdung bcas/ sa 'dzin shel dkar lta bu'i spor/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i mdangs lta bur/ /rab mdzes dgas dbus dben pa'i gnas/ /rang byung rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs/ /ye shes zla shel dwangs pa'i me long du/ /chos kun ma 'dres gzigs pa'i mngon rtogs can/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar/ /kun tu bzang pos lung du bstan par grub/'di nas yol khra leb la brgal nas ngom phyogs su chas pa na/ ne re dgon du rje btsun mi la'i sgom thag bzhugs pa'i 'bum pa yod pare grags kyang ma slob/ ngom gnas mdo dgon du chags med sku phreng lnga pa'i sku che'i sked la dgon rnying mes 'jig pa na mchog gyur gling pa'i lung bzhin dgon pa spos pas/ dgon par gtsug lag khang ka ba20pa/ byams khang ka ba bzhi pa na sa gdung zhig tu gnam chos gter dpe las phab pa der bzhugs skad/ mgon khang na chags med rin po che nga 'dra ma me rdugs sman sku khru tshad lhag shin tu byin ldan/19

spyir bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur/ ri bo che yang dgon pas gnang ba skyes rabs dpag 'khri si tu'i bkod pa por bris bzang nges/ gong sham la'ang rdel tshad bcu gsum song zhes spus shin tu dag pa sogs/chags med sprul sku drug pa 'di'i gzim khang na nang rten rten sgam du bzhugs pa ni/ rā ga a su'i phyag dpe me rdugs ma'i zhi khro/ sku chos/ rig 'dzin chos rje gling pa'i gter ma/ gsang bdag dregs 'dul li ser/ gu ru chos dbang thugs sras padma gar dbang zhes bris snang yang padma dbang chen 'dra/ dbu thod ser po rang byon mang can dgongs 'dus nor sgrub tsakra bcas/ nyang ral gter byon gnam lcags rdo rje rtse lnga dang / yang rtse dgu khyad can gnyis mtho gang ba re o rgyan rin po che'i mgul phur stod zi khyim smad seng lding rus rgyan can mtho gang / stag shod bu mo padma mtsho'i chab gser gyis bris pa'i mdo sdud pa/ skarma pa chos dbyings rdo rjes ba sor phyas brkos jo bo lo ki shwa ra khyung rgyab yol rtser yod pa mkhyid gang / gu ru snyan chung gis spyi 'byams nas gter drangs pa'i gnam lcags phur pa mkhyed gang / sku tshab nyer lnga gras li nag las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kha sarsha ṇi/sangs rgyas 'od srung tshem las byon pa'i dung dkar gu ru chos dbang gter ma/ rā ga a gyes lo bdun phyogs med gdul bya byon dus chibs 20

rgan rngog 'bes chem las byon pa'i ring bsrel/ rata gling gter sgrom dkar po rkyang gi glud rdo 'dra ba kham rlon tsam la slob dpon phyag theb dmar po can ngo mtshar/ chags med rin po che'i gdung zhun thig las byon pa'i spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho khyad 'phags sor gang /stag sham rdo rje'i gsol khag lcags las grub par der mdud pa rgyab pa/ bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gter sgrom phra med gzi yi ga'u ni snying thig tshe g.yang phur gsum snod/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal rus rgyan phreng ba tshangs skud cha shas cung ma tshang ba/ gu gu shel ga'ur lho nang chen rgyal po a nyog ces pas rā ga a gyes la phul ba/ rgya mtsho'i sbu ba rang grub tu byung ba'i thub sku/ stag mgo can sangs rgyas ring bsrel brgya phrag lhag tu yod pa dngul gyi stegs bcas/ chags med mgul phur me 'bar ma/ stag sham gter ma stong nyid rdo rjer grags pa'i zi khyim sor gsum pa/ smar khams nas chags med rin po che la klu mi mgon dkar pos phul ba'i yid bzhin nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung dkar sngo lcid can/ nor bu'i ri mo yod pa/ rgyu ni gang du'ang dpe 'jogs ma shes pa/ tsha ba'i brtan mas phul ba'i g.yu yi padma 'dab brgyad/ rkarma pa yab sras phyag bris zhal thang bdun/ chags med phyag bris zhi khro'i chos nyid bar do'i shog khra/ chags med phyag bris rata phur zhal thang li 21

tshugs ma/ rgyu nag me 'bar zhal thang bcas/ dgon nas ri sna gnyis phyin pa na/ ngom gnas mdo zangs mdog dpal ri'i chags tshul dgon rnying mes 'jigs skabs chags med sgrub khang me rdugs mar/gra khri/ mdun bang rim can mnan pa mchod rten yod pa'i nang kur brgyud gtsos bstan pa'i gegs chag dam sri mnan pa mchog gling gis kha gsos pa/ gur drag sogs sa sku mang / mun khang gnam mthong can/ de nas bgrod dka' ba'i phred la cung phyin pas chags med sku nye chos dbang kun bzang gdan sa ril bu bum sgrub khang na lha khang gog po ka bzhi ma phyi nang gnyis na/ chags med rin po che'i dus nas ratna'i thugs chen gsang 'dus bum sgrub da bar rgyun ma chad par/ bum pa'i nang ril bu 'phel bzhin pa/ sngags srung ma'i zhal thang sus kyang reg par dka' ba sogs yod do/ /thugs rje che dngos a rā ga /chos nyid lhug par mnyam bzhag pas/ /chos can 'khor ba mi lam ltar/ /gzigs pas gdan sa bya btang gi /ngang tshul kho nas spros med pa'i/ /gzim bskyil bkod pa 'dir ltos la/ /bdag 'dra deng gi chos pa rnams/ /dgos rgyu mang bas zhe re khrel/ /de nas chags med yab gzhis gnas mdo sde pa'i khyim brgyud/kurma pa mthong ba don ldan sku 'khrungs pa'i gnas gsal chen bya ba 22

nas/ gru brgal te rma la gnyis nas hor zla9pa'i tshes5la rgyal ba stag lung mar thang gi gdan sa dpyi shod dpal gyi ri bo cher phyin par gyur to/ /der spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul rje sangs rgyas dbon por grags pa de nyid dgung lo nyer drug bzhes par phyogs 'dir phebs nas/ yang dgon chos kyi pho brang chags btab/ de'i dbon o rgyan mgon po dgung lo nyer brgyad bzhes pa sprel lor bzhengs pa/ phyi ltar rgya gar zangs gling / nang du dpal ldan dus 'khor/ gsang ba bde chen zhing gi bkod par gsungs pa/ 'og khang dgyes rdor zhal gsum ltar 'gro mgon 'phags pas tshon phul ba'i lha khang khra bo sku yi 'khor lo mi 'greng bdun pa/ bar khang dmar po gsung gi 'khor lo mi 'greng lnga ba/ thog khang dkar po thugs kyi 'khor lo mi 'greng lnga pa rnams la lha khang khra 'jigs mar grags pa'i phyi ngos log rer 'dom gcig brgya so gsum/ lha khang 'og ka ba drug cu/ dkyil du rdo gcal chu dong yod pa/ seng ge mang po yod pa'i rgya mthongs/ ka ba dbus ma rnams 'dom 'khor dos mi 'khyud pa/ bar thag shin tu ring ba lung pa lta bu'o/ /'di nyid du bzhugs pa'i rten yas rim nas/ 'phags mchog rin po che bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i rnam 'dren lnga pa'i snang brnyan bdud dpung zil gnon bstan 'gro'i dpal bskyed 23

sman sku shing khri brkos spus dag 'khor nye sras bdun pad 'byung sman rku gser zhun ljib byug mkhar drung bsod nams bkra shis kyis bzhengs pa'i thub chen bdud dpung zil gnon gser sku 'dom do lhod tsam/rgyab yol la sangs rgyas kyi phreng ba sum brgya tsam res mdzes pa rtse zhabs dge ba'i dbang po'i thugs dam phyag stong spyan stong sman sku/ o rgyan sman sku/ kun spangs mgon po ye shes kyis bzhings pa'i thub chen 'dom do gser sku rgyab yol la sangs rgyas stong sku shing brkos cung mi tshang ngam/ khri rgyan gnas brtan bcu drug chos skyong bcu tshar bzhugs pa/ tshe dpag med sde pa dbang drag rdo rje'i thugs dam gser sku mi tshad tsam/ rig 'dzin mkhar drung gis mtha' dmag gi gnyen por bzhengs pa gur drag gser sku mi tsam byin ldan sde brgyad kyi khri la bzhugs pa/ bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam byang chub chen po'i dngul gdung phra rgyan khyad thon/ snang mtha'i sman sku/ lha babs mchod rten bcas rje drung grags pa legs grub kyis bzhengs pa/ ri rtsa grags pa bkra shis kyi nang rten rje grags pa'i mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i thub pa mi tsam gser sku khri rgyab can/ chos je rgyal ba'i mtshan gyi phyi rten du grags pa'i mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i thub chen g.yul las rnam rgyal gser sku 'dom pa mi nyams/ mdun gyi bar chod 24

la mkhan chen chos dpal bzang po dang / drung blo rin pa'i zugs dam ston pa'i snang brnyan byis pa lo bco lnga pa'i tshad gser sku/ rten rnying kha shas/ mchod sgrom nang gi dngul gdung zhabs drung ngag gi dbang phyug gi gdung rten bzo khyad phra bkod phul byung / bkra shis dpal grub kyi 'dra zhal sman 'dam/ rje drung grags pa legs grub kyi snang brnyan/nang ngos lho phyogs sbug gi gser gdung 'di chos rje rgyal ba'i mtshan gyi zhal dkyil bzhugs pa ratna kā ras bzhengs/ de dag gi mdun du rje kun dga'i mtshan gyi phyi rten du rje drung phrin las byams pa 'byung gnas kyis bzhings pa'i gser gdung / thub chen mthong ba don ldan chos sku o rgyan mgon po'i phyi rten du spyan snga bas bzhengs pa/ dngul dkar blugs las byon pa'i sangs rgyas yar byon gyi gdung rten bka' gdams mchod rten 'dom gang tsam sangs rgyas dbon rin po ches bzhengs pa/ sangs rgyas yar byon gyi dngul sku 'dzam gling rgyan zhes pa sku tshad las lhag dbon po dpal gyis bzhengs pa/ 'di dag gi mdun du sku gzugs rnying pa che phra du ma bzhugs/ 'og khang 'dir thub sku shas che ba rgya dkar nag bal bod li ma bde dgyes gsang gsum sogs rtse khru gang tsam pa brgya lhag nges par bzhugs/ rten gtso thub dbang dgung lo nyer lnga'i sku tshad ma hā bo dhi dang mnyam pa sangs rgyas dbon gyi 25

thugs dam rten dngul gar blugs lta bu'i li dkar/ 'di bzhings pa'i tshe ri pa rgya gar zhes nye gnas zhig thig tshad len par rgya gar rdo rje gdan du mngags nas/ phyir 'byor ba dang sku grub pa dus mnyam mdzad de thig tshad rang 'grigs byung ba'i ngo mtshar can sku ru rnyi kṣi dkar po las byon pa nang bzhugs nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul phyag bris bka' 'gyur gser bris bzhugs pa/ mdun g.yas g.yon du tsandan ka ba dgu bsgril rgyal po har gyis phul bar grags pa/ mkhar drung rin po che'i thugs dam rten gu ru rin po che'i snang brnyan gser sku mi tshad byon legs/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi sku bkra shis dpal grub kyi thugs dam sman sku/ g.yon gyi rten gtso sangs rgyas dpon gyi snang brnyan gser sku gsung 'byon ma/ ston pa'i g.yas su sangs rgyas yar byon gyi snang brnyan dngul dkar blugs las byon pa mi tshad/ de'i g.yas su bka' gdams mchod rten sangs rgyas yar byon gyi gdung rten dngul dkar blugs 'dom gang pa/ ston pa'i g.yon du bzhugs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa dpal gyi sku brnyan sman 'dam gsung lan mang byon pa/ 'di'i bzhugs pad du chos sku o rgyan mgon po'i phyag bzos phyag bzhi ba'i gser sku/ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs dam mgon po'i gser sku bcas rtse khru gang pa/ lho rta shod kyi bu mo padma mtshos rdzu 26

'phrul gyis nyin gcig gis 'thag pa'i sga slos rta 'jag ma zhes ngo mtshar can/ de'i g.yon gyi dngul gyi gdung rten bka' gdams mchod rten 'di sangs rgyas dbon gyi phyi rten du yorgyan mgon pos bzhengs pa 'dom gang / de'i g.yon du bzhugs pa'i chos sku 6rgyan mgon po'i sku brnyan rin chen gnyis pa dkar blugs las byon pa gsung byon ma mi tshad/ mdun gsham thub dbang lhun po'i bzo phud ston pa/ bcom ldan rdo rje dbyings kyi dngul sku legs/ rdo rje can bde mchog gser sku bcas rten rnying khyad 'phags mang ngo / /dbon rin po che'i gdung rten o rgyan mgon pos bzhengs pa'i dngul gyi mchod sdong / torgyan mgon po'i dngul sku/ yang dngul dkar blugs kyi mchod rten 'di gnyis rgyal ba'i mtshan can gyis bzhengs shing mdun du phyag rnga yang yod/gnas brtan sman sku mi tshad rgya nag ma rnying pa dang / zhabs drung tshang rgyas gter skabs khyung po lha bzos bzhings pa 'dam sku legs pa mi tshad/ stag lung bla rabs mang po'i sku mi tshad mang du snang ngo / /mchod pa'i rdzas la bla bre nam mkha' kun khyab/ gdugs nag rin chen spungs pa/ phye phur rgya mcho'i gnyer ma/ rin chen me tog gi rgyal mtshan/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can sogs gnam rgyan dang / tha la mchod bshams mdzes par bstar ba'o/ /byang rgyab sman bla'i dar sku/ 'phags pa'i 27

gnas bstan bcu drug dar sku yang bzhugs/ 'du khang g.yon dang /sgo g.yog bcas chos brtsegs chen mo 'di'i nang nai tso'i g.yu 'bum/mkha' 'gro gsang 'bum kyang yod cing / bla ma gong mas rdzu 'phrul gyis 'du mdzad pa'i gsung rten pod khri tsho yar brgal te drwa mig lnga re gyen 'greng du yod pa'i shog chen nyer bdun/ drwa mig re re'i nang gser dngul gyi chos chen gyen mthur so brgyad re/ phan tshun bcu gsum re brtsis pas khri tsho gcig dang stong gsum/ steng khang stong gnyis bsdoms pas khri phyed gnyis nges par 'dug shar 'khyams dngul gyi gdung 'bum thog so rje drung rin chen shes rab kyi gdung rten 'phags mchog rin po ches bzhengs/ rgyal ba byams pa mgon po'i snang brnyan sman sku shin tu sgros ldan khri rgyab la garnyo la'i tshul can sangs rgyas sku mang po yod pa rje kun spangs pa'i phyi rten du chos rje 'jig rten dbang phyug gis bzhengs/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gdung rten dngul gyi mchod sdong thog so gnyis/ bla ma bkra shis dpal grub kyi thugs dam rten ston pa lha chen 'dom phyed gsum gser sku byon legs/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che mthing shog la rin chen khu bas bris pa shin tu spus dag dam pa de nyid kyi gdung dngul gyi mchod sdong thog so gnyis pa/ phyag stong spyan stong 'dam sku/ spyan gzigs/ dbyen zlum mchod 28

rten kyang bzhugs/ mdun gyi ka chen dang por phyag bzhi pa'i bris sku/ka chen gnyis par dge bsnyen rdo rje kun skyong gi zhal 'bags/ ka chen gsum par dmag dpon dbyi rgyal zhal 'bags/ rje drung phyag gri bstan dgra tshar gcod/ rten rdzas spyan gzigs grangs mang / sgo 'gram ka chen la gling ge sar gyi dbu zhwa 'brog pa'i rdzi bo'i phying zhwa 'dra ba snang / khro thung gi ral gri sga rje dpon gyi lha khrab/ gdong lha rgod rgyal gyi mda' gzhu sogs spyan gzigs ming can mang po dang / seng ldeng sgo mo rang grags zhes seng ldeng dam dum bsgrigs pa'i sgo chen mo dang / sgo 'khyams g.yas su gur mgon g.yon du phyag bzhi pa'i sku gnyis thog so gsum pa can la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten mdos kyi ba gam gnam du 'phyang ba/ dpal mgon dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu/stobs chen mi thub kun 'dul bcas kyi nges bris bzhugs/bar khang gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar ngos na rgyal ba'i dgongs 'grel bstan 'gyur gser bris ma/ bzhugs sgrom nang du tsandan dkar dmar las byon pa'i rgyud sde'i lha tshogs nyi shu tsam rtse khru gang ba 'phags mchog bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam rten/ dpal ldan 'dod khams lha mo'i ldeb bris/ dud sel ma/ gu ru mtshan brgyad/thod phreng sde lnga bcas kyi snang brnyan sman 'dam mi tshad ma 'phags 29

mchog ngag dbang grags pas bzhengs pa/ rje drung grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi ston pa lha chen gser sku mi tshad/ slob dpon thun khang pas bzhengs pa'i thub sku mda' tshad ma gser sku/ rig 'dzin bsod nams bkra shis kyis bzhengs pa'i gu ru bdud dpung zil gnon 'dam/ dbon gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam rten bka' 'gyur gser bris/ gdong bskos can 'di dag rje ratna kwa ra'i thugs dam bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'bum pod gnyis brgya tsam/ dbus kyi rten gtso rje mi g.yo mgon po'i thugs dam thub pa byang chub chen po gser sku 'dom do ba/ g.yas ngos rdo rje 'chang nas bla rabs rim byon bka' brgyud gser phreng mi tshad tsam bco lnga/ logs bris bal bris khyad 'phags mdun 'dam sku de 'dra ba re/ thun khang mdzo ra ba'i 'dra zhal 'gram pa gtugs na so'i srin nad la phan pa'i bar/ mdun gyi ka gdong du lha byang chub dpal gyis bzhengs pa'i shākya mu de'i sku tshad gser sku mi tshad/ g.yas g.yon thub sku gnyis gser sku/ de 'og lha btsun thugs dam ston pa dbu rgyan ma bcas/ mi sdod pa tsam/ g.yas su sku zhang rinapo che'i gser gdung thog so gcig g.yon du pad spungs dngul gyi nyi zla can 'dom gang ba/ spyan gzigs phyag stong spyan stong sman sku thog sor slebs pa/ 'khor yum sras lcam dang chos rgyal/ rje 30

mi la/ tshe ring rnam drug bcas rje drung rin po ches bzhengs/ rten gtso'i g.yon du dbon lha ru ku'i gser sku/ mi g.yo sku dngul mi tshad/ 'gro mgon phag spu'i sman sku thugs ka dang mkhur tshos sha mtshan rang byon/ rje nā ro nas bka' brgyud gser phreng / stag lung gdan rabs bla sku bco lnga/ byang phyogs sku zhang rin po che'i bka' 'gyur gser bris gtsos mdo sngags kyi glegs bam grangs mang / bka' 'gyur cha gcig rje drung mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs dam thub pa rnam gnyis gser sku mi tshad/ rdo rje 'chang rab gnas ma/ bka' gdams mchod rten lnga bcu tsam sogs li nyob ma zhes li ma brgya lhag tsam gyi sku brnyan mang du bzhugs/ mdor na 'khor sa ka ba ro'i gdong la thub pa gser sku mda' tshad tsam blugs sku khri rgyab yol can re snang bas ka ba zhe gnyis tsam mo/ /ston pa/ 'khor 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drugatshangs dang brgya byin bcas kyi sku brnyan khyad 'phags ngag dbang grags pa'i thugs dam rten sman sku mi tshad bcas bzhugs so/ /dbu rtse thugs kyi 'khor lor/ zi khang bzhugs sgrom du sangs rgyas dbon gyi thugs dam rten rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur stag shod bu mo padma mtsho'i chab gser gyis bris pa gur mgon mngon sum thim pa'i bka' gnyen can/ slob dpon mdzo ra'i thugs dam rten rdo rje 'chang 31

dngul sku mi tshad ma/ chos sku o rgyan mgon po'i sman sku phyag nas ma thugs kur byis drod tsam yod pa/ bzhugs sgrom lcags drwa nang 'gro mgon phag gru dang grub chen sangs rgyas yer ba'i sku yel phug nas drangs pa/ rgya dkar nag bod yul gyi li rigs mi 'dra ba du ma'i snang brnyan lnga bcu tsam khyad 'phags mang po bzhugs/ sangs rgyas dbon sku chu gzigs ma/ byang ngos bka' 'gyur gser bris rol ba'i rdo rje'i tshe sgrub kyi lha gser 'dam sku/ dbus kyi rten gtso stag lung mdo khams dbu sig dgon gyi nang rten gsung 'byon ma sangs rgyas dbon gyi sman sku lte thag ma/ sangs rgyas yar byon gyi dar thang / slob dpon rin po che'i gser sku mda' tshad/ bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'dra zhal/ drung chen ka drug pa'i phyag bris/ rnam sras/ gur mgon bcas kyi snang brnyan gser gyi ri mor bris pa khyad par du 'phags pa li tshugs ma/ mdangs khyad 'phags/ bal yul nas bris pa'i sangs rgyas stong sku dang / sgyud sde mang po'i zhal thang / dkyil thang sogs dang / bal bris kyi gnas brtan/ bka' rgyud gser phreng bcas kyi ka 'phan mang po snang ngo / /mchog gling zab bdun phur ba'i mchod cha dang gter sgrom bcas bzhugs pa lags so/ /steng du gser g.yab thad du 'dom brgyad re med tsam gser 'phru chen po can/ ka bzhir 32

gser 'phan bzhi/ bar du gser gyi rgyal mtshan bzhi bcas so/ /zhabs drung bla brang steng du gzim bskyil lhor/ mgon khang 'og tu tshogs khang ka ba bcu drug can gser gyi rgyal mtshan yod pa rgya mis stong par byas pa dang / gsar ma grwa tshang gser g.yab can sgrub grwa ba bcu/ mgon khang byin ldan nang / mgon po phyag bzhi pa dpal chen sga lo'i thugs dam khru gang 'jigs zil byin che ba'i gser sku li ma khru gang lhag tsā na'i thugs dam bde dgyes gnyis/ chos sku tshergyan mgon po'i phyag ṭar/ sga lo'i gnas nas bde mchog dung bdun gsungs pa'i ri chos bla ma zhig gis rnyed pa'i bya rog gdong ma'i sku li gser las grub pa/ rgya gar grub thob tsā na shri'i rus pa'i sku rgyan/ o rgyan mgon po'i thugs dam rten sogs dang / li ma dang gser sku brgya lhag bka' 'gyur bcas 'du khang ka ba nyi shu can nang gi rten gsum lhag ma bod dmag gis bcom pa/ yang dgon bla brang rdza gyo gser tog can/ mgon po ma ning khang / gzim bskyil mang / 'du khang ka ba bcu drug pa'i nang gser sku mi tshad gsum bzhi dang / 'dam sku de 'dra cha shas las lhag mar ma lus pa bod dmag gis stong par byas pa bcas yid shin tu skyo ba'i yul snang / bar der ratna ā ka ra/ chos sku o rgyan mgon po sangs rgyas dbon rin po che bcas pa'i gdung rten 33

thog so gsum pa gser ljib byugs pa thig pas hral bar snang / dang po gnyis la rkun bu zhugs shing / rtser zangs gser gyi gdugs la lha sku mang po yod pa khyad thon yod kyang thog gi rdza gyo gib par 'dugasangs rgyas dbon gdung 'bum du ston pa thub dbang gi tshem gsum pa ka ling rgyal po'i rten skal gyi phyed yod par grags/ rnying ma grwa tshang yang bod dmag gis cher bcom pa las sku rten brgya skor/ bka' 'gyur/ ratna'i ma ṇi bum sgrub kyi lha khang du/ 'khor lo chen po bzhi/bum khang shing brkos khang bzang chen po/ nang rten naḥthog rig 'dzin chen pos gnang ba dam pa bder gshegs thugs dam rten tsandan shing gi phur pa zhal gsum phyag drug khru gang ba/ ratna gling pa'i phur pa gter sku zhal gsum phyag drug gsang ba'i dbal phur can/ rje drung 'di'i gter byon gu ru'i sku tshab/ sangs gling gter sku thugs rje chen po sogs mang du snang ngo / /mgon po ma ning khang / gtsug lag ka ba so lnga pa gser g.yab bcas/ stag lung grwa tshang 'di dmag gis kyang ma gnod pas/ gser g.yab can gyi gtsug lag khang ka ba sum cu pa srus dag bkra shis dpal grub sku dang / thub pa'i gser sku mi tshad/ngag dbang rnam rgyal sku 'dra/ gdung 'bum/ bka' 'gyur gser bris/ bstan 'gyur/ gser sku dang li ma sogs nyis brgya lhag /tshe 34

ring mched lnga'i mgon khang sogs snang ngo / /sngar bla brang khag gnyis/ grwa tshang khag gsum bcas par gser sku stong phrag gsum tsam/ zhal thang shin tu spus legs grangs mang / dpe cha mang po nges par yod par gda' yang dmag gis gtor bas yid pham mo/ /'ja' tshon thugs rje chen po'i bum sgrub khang dang sgrub grwa ba dgu tsam yod do/ /stag lung mar thang rten gsum ri ltar brtsegs/ /sngon gyi dam pa sar gnas 'phags pa ma/ /dad dang da lta'i dus kyi rgud pa la/ /bsam nas skyo ba phan tshun 'gran par 'gyur/ /lung 'di'i phur ston pa sangs rgyas kyi zhabs rjes kyang mjal/'di nas zla10pa'i tshesan4bar rgya tshugs kyi lam dmar ris nas brtsams te byang lha ri mgo bar/ de nas byang me gzhung dbus kyi chu mgo nas 'bri gung ma sleb bar du sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde du ma bzhugs pa las/ rgya tshugs dmar ril nye bar rnying ma pa yod tho/ rdo shul phyogs su stag shams gter chen gnyer pa bar sha o rgyan dpal 'byor gdan sa bar sha ri khrod nor bu bsam 'phel gling grwa 70stag shams phrin las sprul pa rig 'dzin phrin las gdan sa rgyal chen ri khrod u rgyan rnam grol gling grwa 50 chos srid dar rgyas gling ste tha ma ri khrod grwa 50 phug sngon ri khrod rdo shul mkha' 'gro 35

yod sa bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling grwa 30 tsha ba dpal shod ri pa ri khrod bla ma dpa' bo rdo rjes btab pa bkra shis chos gling dgon che ba grwa120rgyal chen ri khrod grwa30 g.yang khri ri khrod grwa30 bcas dang /khyung po ka ru smad na seng ge ri khrod grwa30 rā ga ri khrod grwa 30 tsam bcas na stag sham dang / chos gling pa dar che/ ngom chu na ri bo che'i rnying ma grwa tshang du gtogs pa stag lam ri khrod grwa30 g.yas ru gsar ma grwa tshang gi sba mgo ri khrod grwa nyi shu tsam bcas yod/rgya tshugs dmar ril zer ba na ska gtsang bka' brgyud kyi rnag dgon zhes yul pa rnams kyis 'bod/ ming dngos nam dngos grub gling zer/ der lung rigs smra ba'i nyi ma zhes chags med rin po che'i bla ma yin pa de'i gdan sa/ dgon ba'i g.yon ngos brag ri dmar po de zangs mdog dpal ri yin pas gnas yig chags med rin po che'i gsung yod zer/ dge ri sangs rgyas rdo rje nas/ yul de rnams kyis dmar mchod kho nas gzhi bdag mchod dgos pa la/ lha 'dre la springs yig gnang nas dmar mchod kyi rgyun chad/ springs yig bka' shog rma pha ba dud dmar tshang zer ba na yod skad/ sangs rgyas rdo rjes phur pa brag rked la gdab pa deng seng yang yod cing yul 'di'i smi ru'i sha ba ra mgo'i kha gnon yin/ stag shams rdo rje byon nas gter bzhes 36

par/ yul der sa bcud nyams par dogs nas wa zhabs sde ba zer bas rten 'brel 'khyugs pa'i la nye byas pas gter bzhes ma grub pa/phyis khyung po rtse drug nas bon sangs rgyas gling pa byon nas brag tshe bum nas/ bee ro'i gong khug ma tshe sgrub lha gcig bum gcig zer ba'i zab chos bzhes pa/ da lta bon dgon pa kho khra rgan sogs su dbang lung gi rgyun bzhugs shing dar cha che/ sangs gling sprul brgyud tsha ba rong drag po rdzong na deng sang bar yod zer/ dus phyis mchog gling phebs nas gnas ngo sprod gnang / chags med mchog sprul lnga pas gnas yig bskor tshad bcas gnang ba yod zer/rgyal mo'i dngul chu'i g.yas ngos der/ tshe leb shel bum mchod rten zer ba yo rgyan rin po che'i phyag zhabs rjes dang / shel bum mchod rten sngar chung bar yod kyang skye 'phri byed pa yod zer/ de'i mdun ngos der o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub phug na sku rjes shin tu gsal bar yod pas yul skad la/ lho phyogs mon kha'i brag la sku rjes bzhag zer ba de yin par grags/zhabs g.yas zam pa ni/ gza pa dgu pa'i zhabs lham g.yas chu khar chags par dge zam btsugs pa/ sgang nas gzigs pas/ nga'i 'di dge zam bsam pa yin te khrims zam du 'gro bar 'dug ces phyis 37

nas zam gla chen po za bar lung bstan par grags/chab mdo'i dgon lag lho rdzong 'og gzhi 'gram dgon zer ba/kurma pa rang byung zhabs zer te kurma pa'i sku rabs kyi yon bdag sdengs gzhi rtsa ba'i rdzong nang gi rten rnams tshur spos pa dang byams khang satsos lha khang lnga tsam/ grwa brgya lhagate dkar gzhung yar brgal nas rdo rje brag pa lho spang leb tu sku tshab gter rnying bye ma a krong / phur cha legs nges dang / mtshan brgyad si rgya mtsho'i spar/ gzhan rten mang tsam yod kyang padma bkod du khyer/ der rgya dmag slebs nas gtor/dzi tho dgon du/ jo bo byin rlabs che nges/ chos brtsigs puste stong tsam/ dgon nyin srib la lha khang khag cha shas/ grwa sum brgya tsam/ sngar de mo tshang dgon pa yin/ dzi the'i phu na do 'du zer ba grwa brgya lhag yod pa'i chab mdo'i dgon kyang yod/chos tu byams gling du byams pa gser zangs zhal mtho gsum pa/chos bcigs pon lnga brgya tsam/ zhi 'phags gzim khang gnyis/ grwa sum cu tsam/shwa pa mdor/ byams pa thog so re yod pa'i gser zangs ba/// chos brtsigs pod nyis stong tsam/ ri bo che nas g.yar 'phrog

gi dha shod bu mo padma mtshos chab gser gyis bris pa'i 'bum sogs dang /sde dge bka' 'gyur ma dpe yang yod/ spyir sku gsung thugs khang /gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ kun rig bcas lha khang khag bcu gnyis /sdu/ zhal thang spus dag dang / gser sku mang / grwa sum brgya puste dgon du lha khang khag lnga tsam/ byams sku gtsos rten mang nges/ dha tshags rje drung shes rab dbang po'i gdung dang 'dra zhal sogs/ grwa sum cu tsam/ phyi ma 'di gnyis kun bde gling pa dha tshags tshang dgon pa/ shwa pa mdo sngar smar gtsang bka' brgyud gdan sa da lta dge ldan du song ba yin/lha rtse dgon na/ byams sku sman sku/ bka' 'gyur sogs/ grwa sum cu tsam/ lha rtse'i brag la a nu yo ga sbas zer ba de yin skad brag ri nyams mtshar/ lha rtse gnyis pa yod/ dngos ni gtsang la yod par //sa/ 'di dang nye bar rdza khol dgon zer ba 'bri gung dgon pa zhig lha rtse nas dpal 'bar la phyin/ dpal 'bar lung phur dpal 'bar sprul sku'i ri khrod chos sgar skya btsun sogs mang skad/ gnas gangs ri zhig dang mtsho sogs yod/ lha rtse lung ba'i phu/ tis nang 39

dang shis nang gnas/ mtsho/ sgrub phug/g.ya' khang sogs mang /ba re zal mo sgang phu spu bo ske bo/ yul gong sogs phu gangs rer thug spyir chab mdo'i dgon lag rngod rgya mtsho gling grwa70tsam/rngod a ro dgon grwa70tsam/ lcags ra dgon/ rta mda' ste bar ba gzhu dgon/ lcags ra'i chu gzhug brag dmar dgon/ lha rtse'i dgon bcas bdun dang / chos ru dgon/ nge 'du dbon bcas so/ /gzhung gi dgon pa dpal 'bar na/ bla brang 'du khang cug 'jigs byed sku sogs sku rten che bdun tsam/ gzim khang 'ga' re yod zer/ sgo rgyab snang / g.yas lha khang nang thub pa gser sku/ rje'i sman sku/ bka' 'gyur bris ma/ steng na gser gdung gsum/ byams pa gser sku thog gnyis byon legs/ rdo rje 'chang gser sku mi tshad/byams pa mi tshad bal sku rnying pa/ u rgyan gser zangs mi tshad gnyis/ bla sku mi tshad sogs rten bzang mang tsam/ dgon ltag na khyams chen bal bris rnying ma'i nges bris sangs rgyas stong / nye sras sogs/ jo khang du rgya gar shar li jo bo mi tshad shin tu legs pa/gser sku mang / bka' chos sogs gser skya bris ma pod sum brgya tsam/ bde mchog grwa tshang lha khang dang / grwa mang lha khang bcas grwa tshang khag gnyis bsdoms nyis brgya tsam yod zer/ bla ma sngags par song 40

rkyen da lta rnying ma'ang phran bu dar zer/ nar dgon nam grub mtha' gzhan dgon dge ldan du song ba yin snyam/lcags ra na/ byams sku gser zangs thog so/ lha khang gzim khang gzhan na rten phran bu/ lha khang gsum/ grwa lnga bcu tsam/u rgyan dha mda' grong nag zhig tu u rgyan sku byin ldan gtso 'khor gsum/ chab mdo kun rdor sprul sku'i sku sogs yod/shar gang la brgal/ tsha ra rong mthar/ sngar kur dgon sogs skabs grong par song bar rnam rgyal dgon pa'i g.yon tsam lu phu nas dpal 'bar lung g.yon phur 'og lam la cung bde mo yod zer/ de rgyab spru bo bra gad la zhes 'jigs rung gzhi bdag na bre bra lha rtse zhes pa'i gangs ri'i rgyab phyogs gyang ra smug po'i phu gyang phu zhes pa gu ru'i sgrub phug rang byon mang / dbyar zla drug pa'i nang gnas bskor phyin pas bskal bzang la lha stong phrag mang po mjal/ grib can gyis kyang re zung mjal ba'i nyams mtshar yod zer/rngod grogs skad na sa nyams mtshar po kha shas yod/a la mdo nas a la kha pa'am 'gags sa shin tu ngan/ rong chen lcags sgang be ri zer ba'i gzhi bdag yod/ lcags sgang na rgya mtsho gling pa'i ri khrod yod pa sa de nas cung yar 'gro/ re mdo zer ba'i yar 41

ngos lung par nyi grags cha ru dgon nas spu bo gra gad phyogs mang du 'gro bar klong rong gter ston ri khrod bkra shis gling / re mdo sa cha legs/ a rong rdo thog nas nub gangs la lhag pa rgyas/ ri khrod lung pa de'i rgyab ngos be dkar phyogs bon po mang / chu byang la babs/nub gangs la tshur rgyab nyi grags chos cung dar/de nas byang lha ri mgo na dge ldan dgon pa chung ngu yod/ rten chen po med/ de'i phu na lha ri mgo pa yin pas nyi grags chos mang du dar ba'i ru ba brgya tsam/ lha ri mgo'i sprul sku de ni chu mjug na dgon pa'am lha khang chung ngu bzhengs/ de na yod rab snang / de sogs lam kha 'dir yang chos sde rten gsum can mang du snang yang grags pa'i rjes 'brang gis gnas bskor phal gyis gal chung byed pa dang / lam gyi ngal bas dub pa dang / dgon de dag gi dge 'dun gyi sde dag gis kyang thag ring gi mgron po la 'jigs pas nyen pa dbugs dbyung ba'i rgyal byed tshal du ye mi mdzad cing / lha gnyer dang / mgron po gnyis ka phal cher dag mjal bar mi byed pas re zhig 'dir zhib par ma bris so/ /rtse mtho'i ri bo khongs pa'i rdza ri bsnyil/ /gor mo'i rdo ba las kyi gnod byed bzhin/ /brag gi ba gam brjid kyang khur po ches/ /non pa'i rkang gnyis rkang bzhi yi ga skyo /res 'ga' nags tshal rkang 'thung 42

tshogs/ /mgron po'i mi la skyob pa bzhin/ /thang dang rtsa yi myu gu ni/ /zhi ba'i gdong mdzes dgod pa ltar/ /kye ma 'di ci bsod nams dpal mdzes pas/ /'chi med lha yi yul las blang ba snyam/ /bkod stong gis 'phags ljongs dang yul gru mang / /'di na sna tshogs gar mkhan bzhin du mthong / /zla9pa'i tshes24nas spyir rong ma 'brog gi sa/ thang che ba dang rdza 'gags kyang yod pa/ shugs spa mas ri bo gzig gyi thig le lta bu/glang ma/ sur dkar/ se ba sogs ru sogs shing dang yang ldan pa/gzho lha bu sogs gzhi bdag mang pos srung ba/ yul dbus kyi chu mgo 'phen po/ klung shod/ 'bri gung gsum du yod pa'i me kug sgom ring gi srang khang du/ skyobs pa rin po che bzhugs nas phyag btab pa/dbu ru shar 'bri gung thel gyi yar ri bo'i ngos la gtsug lag khang bkra shis sgo mang du/ ka ba bco brgyad pal thog gnyis/ dbus su skyobs pa dar len ma'am dar sku la tshul khrims dri bro ba mi tshad grwa khri bcas/sbug tu 'bri gung thil nas gdan drangs pa thub pa me thugs ma mi tshad/ li ma phul gyur/ g.yas su thub chen mi tshad li ma drug phyi nyis stong nyis brgya/ nang stong dang brgya pa ste lha sum stong sum brgya pa'i mchod rten dag pa shel ri'i chags tshul lnga yi dbu thog phyed gnyis/43

bka' gdams mchod rten gyi dang po dag pa shel ri'i chags tshul/ de nas rje nyer gnyis pa/ bcu gnyis pa rdo rje rin chen/ nyer brgyad rdo rje rgyal po/ rgyal sras kun dga' rin chen bcas pa'i gdung ni gser zangs li nyams can/ nam mkha' la bde mchog lha lnga/ drug cu ma/phag mo/ spyan ras gzigs bcas kyi gser gdugs rgyu nam bzo spros rgyan rnams phul gyur snang / phag mo rin chen rnam rgyal dngul gdung byang chub mchod rten thog tshad/ chos brtsegs pod lnga brgya brgal ba/rdo rje 'chang thel nas me rdugs ma dag pa shel ri'i chags tshul la mar pa'i yum bdag med ma'i dpral g.yu sogs ha las/ mchod rdzas phra rgyan legs/ khams ri bo che nas drangs pa thub sku li ma mi tshad bcas lha khang gcig 'bri gung skyobs pa'i gzim bskyis ka dgu ma 'bri gung gser khang du skyobs pa nga 'dra ma chung gcig che li ma bzhugs khang sgros ldan/ lho dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal gser dngul gdung dang 'dra zhal/ kun dga' rin chen gser dngul bkra ma'i gdung dang 'dra zhal/ mdun du nyer spyad mang / byang bla brgyud gsung 'bum sogs chos brtsegs mchod pa'i bkod pa phul gyur/ skyes rab pad khri tsandan brkos ma yul bkod brag ri ma/ zhabs drung bzhugs khri bcas lha khang gnyis/ 'du khang gser khang mdor tshogs khang ka ba bcu drug 44

pa'i dbus/ rdo rje 'chang sle'u chung ma mi tshad/ rje rin po ches dga' ldan bzo phud byams pa thog so gcig zangs gser u rgyan gser sku mi tshad/ thub pa gnyis/ skyobs pa/ phag spu rdo rje rgyal po bcas mi tshad/ bka' 'gyur dang li ma sogs sku brgya tsam gyi lha khang gsum/skyobs pa rin po che'i gdung rten 'dzam gling rgyan du dbu thugs ljags gsum la bde mchog lha bcu gnyis rang byon can dang / rgyal po 'od zer go chas bzhengs pa'i 'od srung dang thub pa'i ring bsrel snyim pa gang re yod/ bi kra ma shrī lar bzhugs pa jo bo a ti shas bsnams 'ong ba ra sgrengs nas phag grur blangs te skyobs pa rin po che'i phyag tu phebs/ gling mes 'jigs skabs yar drangs pa'i mchod rten nang bzhugs byas pas byin rlabs phul gyur thog so gsum pa dang / g.yas su sa ra ha'i rnam 'phrul bcu gnyis rdo rje rin chen gyi thugs dam rgya gar nas rdzu 'phrul gyis blangs pa'i a ru ra rlon pa yod cing rten khyad par can mang bas 'di 'bri gung pa'i rten rtsa ba che shos yin pa'i mchod rten sa 'bum thog so gsum pa dang / lho dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal gyi gser g.yab gnyis mda' yab bcas lha khang bzhi/ bskor lam na gdung 'bum gnyis yod/ yang gong du rgyal sras rdo rje rin chen sa yi gdung 'bum thog gnyis pa gser byugs pa lha khang lnga/ chos rgyal 45

rin chen phun tshogs kyis btsugs pa'i sgrub grwa nub pho brang gtsug lag khang gi gzhi khyams ka brgyad/ khrug bka' bstan 'gyur/ sgrub dpon bla ma chos skyabs 'dra zhal mi tshad/ gser gdung / sgrub dbon nges don gser gdung / bka' brgyud gser phreng / zab mo lta ba/ rgya chen spyod pa/ nyams len byin rlabs li ma 'dod lha gser sku sna tshogs gsar rnying nyis brgya tsam/ mtshams pa sum cu yod zer/ je kun dga' rin chen gyis btab pa sgrub grwa shar lha khang ka ba bcu gnyis/thub pa li ma mda' tshad gnyis/ shar li khrims log gcig bka' 'gyur spar ma/ rten rag sku li ma sogs lnga bcu tsam/ mtshams pa sum cu/ lha khang ka ba bdun/ kun dga' rin chen gyis phyag btab pa'i gtsug lag sgrub sder/ bstan 'gyur dang thub sku sgrol ma gsung 'byon sogs lha khang brgyad/ 'bri gung skyobs pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi sgrub phug dkar chung ma/ tshem shing 'dzug pa'i tsha ru shing chen por gyur pa na nga nyid phyir 'ong gsungs pa rje kun 'ga' rin chen yin/ rje rin po che tsong kha pas smon lam thog mtha' ma gnas pa'i gnas so/ /'di nas sgo byi ba 'dzul khung lta bu nas song bas skyobs pa'i zhabs rjes mjal rgyu snang ngo / /rje nyer brgyad pas bzhengs pa'i phyag bzhi pa dang / don grub rgyal po'i gdan sa nas drangs pa'i phyag 46

bzhi pa'i sku mi tshad chen po'i sman sku dang / sku mdun ratnas bzhings pa'i a phyi'i mgon khang 'jigs zil can bcas lha khang dgu/ gsar ma khang dbu rtse byang ma zhes dngul gdung khang ka drug mar/ dbus su rig 'dzin chos grags gzim mal sku 'dra mi tshad zangs gser/g.yas dkon mchog phrin las don grub dngul gdung sgo mang / don 'grub chos rgyal dngul gdung lha babs/ phrin las bzang po'i thugs dam dang gdung rten chos 'khor sgo mang / dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i gdung chos 'khor mchod rten/ bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gdung lha babs bcas/ gser dngul bkra ma'i mchod rten thog tshad gnyis re/ gser gar bu'i sku sogs dang phra rgyan bkod pa sgros gtsang mchod rdzas phul byung / dbu thog na zangs gser gdugs la bde mchog tshe dpag sogs kyi dkyil 'khor re/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gser bris bcas lha khang bcu/ rnying ma khang ka dgu mar rje ratna shrī'i gzim mal sku zangs gser/ dngul gdung gser ma thog gnyis mi 'khrugs dkyil 'khor zangs gser gdugs bcas/ thugs dam gser gdung de 'dra ba bcas lha khang bcu gcig rig 'dzin chos grags gzim chung dam dbyar bcas lha khang bcu gnyis/ gzho stod gter sgrom nas rin chen phun tshogs gter ma'i tshogs zangs/47

mtshams brgyad dgu thang / bka' brgyud gser phreng / gnas brtan/ dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs zhal thang mang du yod pa rnams/ gos gser phun sum tshogs pa sman gsar rnying las sman rnying cung 'dra bar snang / gdung rten khang ka drug mar/ chos kyi blo gros gdung tshe dpag med lha dgu'i gdugs/ thugs kyi nyi ma gdung bde mchog lha lnga'i gdugs/ rje bstan 'dzin padma rgyal mtshan gdung /bde mchog gdugs/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan gdung 'chi med rnga sgra'i gdugs/ chos nyid nor bu'i gdung 'chi med rnga sgra'i gser gdugs bcas gser dngul bkra ma'i gdung thog so gnyis pa phra bzo bkod sogs legs pa/ thugs kyi nyi ma'i yum gdung / bka' 'gyur gsor dngul bkra ma bcas lha khang bcu gsum/ khang sar na rin chen phun tshogs gdung / chos rgyal phun tshogs gdung rig 'dzin chos grags thugs dam rten dang / gdung rten bcas/ bkra shis phun tshogs gdung / rten 'bri rwa chen mo a phyi'i dkor mdzod bcas lha khang bcu bzhi/ 'di'i steng gser g.yab chung bcas/ 'di thams cad la gnam rgyan/ ka 'phan sogs hor gos can legs/ tsā ri dag pa shel ri'i chags tshul lha nyis stong phal cher ngo ya ma'i 'bur ma la mi g.yo ba/ bde mchog sogs rgyud sde gong 'og gi lha mang po/ sangs rgyas 48

byang sems li ma brgya re tsam snang ba sku khang bzo bkod can nang bzhugs/ mdun du rgyal chen bzhi byis pa lo lnga pa tsam bcas phra rgyan shin tu zhib bo/ /li ma shin tu mtshar/ 'di'i dkyil 'khor gser gdugs rnams gzhal yas khang ri mo dkyil thang ltar 'bur du byas/dbus gtso bo re zung lha/ gtso bo 'ga' re dang 'khor ladzi sa bon du byas mthar phur ma la lalnga'i gzungs sngags 'bur ma yin no/ /'bri gung bla mchod/ kun rig bde mchog phag mo/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab/ bka' brgyad khro rol gtor bzlogatshe bdag gtor bzlogapad gling drag dmar/ chos spyod/ bskang gso sogs dar/ bka' brgyad bder 'dus bsgral 'cham legs po yod par snang / dgongs gcig dang / bstan rnying spar pod chen gnyis yod par 'bri gung bla brang phyag dam can no/ /thel dngos ri'i gsham na ka ba brgya dang bcu pa'i lha khang rgyal mtshan bzhi dang sde dge dgon chen rgyab lung ma'i thub sku gcig ste de 'dra bco brgyad/ pod khri sogs yod pa dang / hor dmag gling log gis me la bsregs shul shin tu ring mo'i brtsigs ra dang / thang chen dbus chos khri pha bong tsam/ lnga khri lnga stong tsā ri/ lnga khri lnga stong la phyi/lnga khri lnga stong gangs rir bkyes te skyobs pas slob ma khri bco brgyad la 49

chos gsungs pa'i shul yod do/ /da lta'i sgrub chen tshe mtshams pa tshe brtan zhes pas skyil tshad bcu gsum gos kyis skyobs pa'i gdung la na bza' phul bar snang ngo / /grwa brgya lhag sgrub grwa ba sogs thams cad nyis brgyar nye ba'o/ /klu sgrub snying po rin chen dpal/ /chos dbyings stod pas yong dge dang / /thog gcig dgongs pa gcig pa ru/ /phye ba'i lam dang ston pa la/ /ngo mtshar ngo mtshar kye ma'o/ /ri po'i ngos gzar la 'dzegs shing / /rten gsum phreng ba mang mjal yang / /lung rtogs snying po dkon pa'i skabs/ /gzho stod gter sgrom nang du mda' na ma ṇi'i chu 'khor khyad mtshar/ de nas chu tshan cu gang dang / si ra las grub pa dro grangs gnyis/ si ra'i chu mig de nas a ṇi dgon chen yod pa'i 'og na 'bri gung zhabs drung chu gzim rdo ra sgo thel 'byar rgyal mtshan can/ltag na bdud 'dul phug dang gsang phug de nas gzho phu gter sgrom brag dkar sngon 'dres pa g.yas zangs mdog dpal ri'i chags tshul/g.yon bka' brgyud bla ma dang bde mchog 'khor lo'i brag ri/ phug 'brang ngur sum mdo lo lnga mtshams 'bri gung 'pho ba'am bka' chos tshugs sar/ 'og mchod rten seng khri 'dra ba'i rin chen phun tshogs gzim khang na 'dra zhal dang / bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul 'dra zhal sman 50

'dam sku/ g.yas mtshan brgyad lha khang phur pa'i 'dam sku yod pa/g.yas kyi brag g.yang thar dka'i rtser skas them bcu bdun pa dang /brgyad pa brgal bas gu ru'i sku rjes stong dang / 'og tshogs bdag glang sna rang byon yod pa/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gsungs pa'i gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen mo/ gu ru lo bdun bzhugs pa'i gnas/ tshe ring mched lnga'i brag lnga/ lung sked na mkha' 'gro'i dbu klad ri bo rtse'i dkar po rgya mtsho'i gting gi dmar po ste/ bsngags lta bu'i dam rdzas len rgyu yod pa rta mgrin phug dang bcas/ phyir log nas g.yas ngos grogs ri rin chen spungs pa kun gzigs shes rab 'od zer gter gnas bcas zhag gcig gis 'khor tsam yod do/ /rab dkar dngul zhun ltar gsal brag /lha yi gzugs brjid gnas kyi dbus/ /shin tu zhi ba'i dga' ba dang / /gu ru'i sgrub phug mjal du yod/ /'di 'drar mi tsher don yod phyir/ /phyag rdzogs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgoms/ /'od gsal rdo rje'i snying po la/ /brtson pas grub mtha' bslong na snyams/ /mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba yin mod kyi/ /btsun mas btsun phrug ngoms pa 'dis/ /bud med 'khor dang sha rul gyi/ /sbrang ma 'dra gsungs bden snyams byed/ /'jang yul 'khrungs sa don 'grub chos rgyal gyis btab pa yang ri 51

sgar dang / nang 'du khang spug ka bzhi pa'i gtsug lag khang steng shod drug dbu rtse bcas kyi bar khang thog ma nas gnas brtan khang / g.yas su tsandan gyi gnas brtan brag ri ma sgrom shel sgo gser g.yab can/bde chen zhing khams/ bka' 'gyur sde spar bcas/'og min khang dbus man tsandan las brkos pa'i sku gser yul bkod tshon byas pa'i skyes rab nyer gnyis/ gtad rabs bdun/ nye bar 'khor rab 'byor/ ltung bshags/ cho 'phrul bco lnga/ mdzad bcu/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur sde spar bcas/g.yon dbus mngon dga' khang du tsandan las brkos gser sku bcas lū yi lugs bde mchog drug cu pa'i blos bslang cher ba so'i phra rgyan mang / sbug tu li ma nyis brgya cung lhag med tsam spus shin tu dgadabus dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal/ g.yas skyobs pa rin po che/g.yon gu ru rgya gar ma gsum 'dod spar zangs gsor sku byis pa lo bcu pa'i tshad/ gshin rje tshe bdag gi tsandan ba so las brkos pa rtsa ba'i lha shin tu legs/ rdo rje gro lod sku bcas/de'i rtser da lta'i skyabs mgon dkon mchog bstan 'dzin zhi ba'i blo gros gsar bzhengs thub sku nyis brgya tsam/ stong sku thugs bzhed re/ sbyar/

'du khang lhun grub rdo rje'i gdan sbug tu dri gtsang khang gsum gyi g.yas mar/ gser dngul bkra ma'i bder gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad thog tshad/ mtho ri phra rgyan phyug pa/ dpag bsam 'khri shing spar ma zhal thang bcas/mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan gyi zhug dbus mar thub pa khams gsum zil gnon rgyab yol rgyan drug thog gnyis ma zangs gser/ khri la gser gar blugs phyag bzhi khru gang / dbu thog zangs gser gdugs bde mchog dkyil 'khor/ g.yas su tshe dpag med/ g.yon du mgon po kun tu gzigs dngul gyi utpal ral glegs can thog so mtho nges gser mdog phul gyur/ gser dngul gdung rten thog tshad ma gsum/ gser 'brug gi rkang gsum che ba'i thog gser dngul bkra ma'i maṇḍal 'dom gang ma tshom bu so bdun ma/ 'di'i mgar ba rnams mchod rten rdung mkhan dang ri mo shin tu mtshar/ lha sku dngos spyir legs/ li tshugs 'dra la gos ris legs/ sku tshugs ni chab mdo'i gza' sku ngo mas cung legs snyams/ gnam yol bkras 'thags mang /gzhan rgyan bzhi gos gser jus yol ba chen po'ang rgyab 'dug ba so'i mche ba 'dom gang / gu gul shel dam 'be rgyab ya sogs snang / lha khang gsum na gser 'bum cha gsum tsam/ sde dge'i bka' 'gyur la 53

gos chen lag ras rgyab 'dugachos 'khor rdo rje'i jig tu jo rje 'chang / te lo/ nā ro/ mar mi dwags po/ phag gru/ skyobs pa sogs bka' brgyud gser phreng zangs gser mi tshad bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ gos chen gser jus zhwa khra dang /chos gos na bza' bcas/ gtso bo rje phrin las bzang po'i dngul sku/ba so'i phyag ḍal/ gu gul shel dang / g.yu ring dngul stegs can bcu tsam/ phyag bzhi pa dang / a phyi'i gser sku/ bka' bstan 'gyur/ chos kyi nyi ma'i thugs dam gser dngul bkra ma'i rgyu las grub pa bde mchog lha lnga'i blos bslang khyad 'phags khru gang lhag 'phrul lta bu shel sgo'i nang gda'/ sgrub pa'i dus kyi rgyab dang / zhal thang sogs mang / rigs lnga sogs bdag 'jug chas dang / rdor dril bkye rgyu/sbub sil mtshar po mang po snang /'du khang ka ba zhe brgyad pa'i spug sangs rgyas so lnga gser sku khru gang lhag pa/ bka' 'gyur dbus spar gu ru rgya gar ma mi tshad gser dngul bkra ma/ bde mchog sogs gser sku rtse khru gang pa lnga/ li sku lnga tsam/ thub pa mi tshad zangs gser/ rgya mthong nang bcu gcig zhal mi tshad lhag gser sku gos na bza' phul byung / 'bri gung skyabs mgon bzhugs khri/ yang rgya mthong nang rje padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi tshe dpag med 54

dngul sku thog tshad mtho nges don 'grub chos rgyal/ 'jig rten mgon po/ chos kyi nyi ma rnams mi tshad che gser dngul spus ldan/ 'di thams cad gos chen na bza' can/ dngul gdung mi tshad gsum/phrin las bzang po'i dngul sku gsung 'byon/ li 'thor sum cu tsam/u rgyan sku rnying / a phyi'i dkor mdzod na sku dang / mchod khrir li ma spus dag nyi shu tsam/ gos sku mtshan brgyad thog so gsum pa snang /yang mgon khang bcas/ thog khar gser gyi rgyal mtshan bzhi/ gser tog chung / grwa shags/ bla brang bkod legs/ ngos ris ye mi mtshar ba'i bkod pa mang / grwa nyis brgya nye ba/ bde mchog gtsug dgu/mi 'khrugs/ bka' brgyad/ zhi khro/ tshe bdag sogs tshogs zer/spar gsar bskos skyobs pa'i bka' 'bum sogs pod lnga yod/ 'don cha pod gsum tsam yod do/ /sgo phyogs sprul sku 'bras spungs su phebs nas sa rta lor dbyar gnas tshugs snang / lha khang 'dir sgo nub ras khri'i gnam yol tshogs khang du gral gdan shog bcu/ yang ri'i lha khang gi skar khung thad gos chen gnam yol rlung gis zad dogs kyis gos chen gnam yol thad ras kyi gnam yol rgyab snang / 'bri gung skyabs mgon da lta'i lha khang ka bar mo bin rag ṭa ma mang po'i 'phan sogs snang / lha khang 'dir rab gnas mkhan si tu chos 'byung yin ces 55

dkar chag na bris snang / yang ri'i bka' brgyud gser phreng lha khang du thang sgam bco lnga nang 'bri gung lugs sngon gyi lha bzo phul gyur tshon mdangs de 'dra 'ong dka' ba'i gras/ rin chen phun tshogs 'khrungs rabs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ma zhal thang bcu gsum/ gnas bcu lnga tshar/ bka' brgyad thang nag tshon rdzogs gser ma bcu gcig bde mchog thang chen/ gong las lha bzo cung zhan 'khrungs rabs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ma dang / yang bka' brgyad cha gcig dpag bsam 'khri shing zhib cha che nges nyer lnga/ 'bri gung skyobs pa rin po che'i skyes rabs e bris nyi shu/ 'bri lugs bka' brgyud gser phreng nyi shu/sangs rgyas stong sku bcu/ tshe dpag stong sku bcu/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab thang ka bdun/ 'dzam gling rgyan drug gos khyad 'phags las lhan drub bzang nges bcu/ gshin rje sogs shin tu mang ngo / /de nas mar 'gro lam med tsam la phyin pas/ dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang ni/ sngar ldang ma lhun rgyal gyis rgyud bcu bdun 'grel pa bcas gter nas bzhes pa'i gnas/ bar skabs jo gdan pas bzung / de nas 'bri gung pa dang / mthar deng sang se ra byes pas dge slong dgu dge tshul gcig bcas bcus dbyar gnas gso sbyong dgag dbye/ yi dam yang gsang khros pa/ klong chen snying thig ma mgon lcam dral/ g.yu 56

sgron bcas bton pa'i gnas/ kun mkhyen chen po'i gcigs kyi yi ge las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar/ shar ri hor sogs khros pa/ lho glang chen g.yul zhugs/ nub bdud dpung / nub byang hom khung gtad pa/byang stag seng 'thab pa 'dra ba'i/ byang ri'i chu rgyud pha ri ral gri/mda' phur ba'i dbal/ gnam sa chos 'byung / lte ba lpags rlon brgyangs pa 'dra ba/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i sa byi lor rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho rgya gar bzhugs skabs bkas bskul te rdo rje brag chu bzang sprul pa'i skus zhig gsos mkhan mdzad de/ dbu rtse steng khang gnas bcu lha khang du thub pa mi tshad/ 'khor mda' tshad re/ lcags khra'i nang du rtso khrim las grub pa'i jo bo shākya mu de'i bzo phud thub pa sogs li sku bco brgyad tsam gyi gtso bo lung ba'i phu bya mi mtsho nas nyang ban gter nas bton pa'i thub sku ljang khu phyas na bsnams pa'i ched gzhung gi dam 'byar can/ shar phyogs sgo'i ngos byang shar na yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed mgon khang du rgyal ba klong chen pa bzhengs skad kyi rdo rje gur gtor sgrom na gru gang pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyal ba lnga pa'i ring bzhings pa thog so gcig rnam sras/ dud sol ma/ phyag drug pa/phyag bzhi bcas rtse khru re/ 'og na rā hu la dang dam can rnying ma thog so mtho nges zhal lta dka' ba/ sngags srung nges bris gsung 'byon rnying 57

ma/ g.yu sgron nges bris gsar pa/ ma mo thog so mtho nges gsar bzhengs/ mdun du nas/ chu/ mar khu/ snum rnams gzhung gi rgyal khams legs nyes brtags tshad can/ lo gnyis re'i mtshams drung ser skya btang nas sgo 'byed pa/ 7lha khang gtso bo nub sgug nas gtsang khang du glo 'bur dbus na tshe dpag med rma bya dang seng be'i khri la bzhugs pa 'dom phyed do tsam/ g.yas su nye sras bzhi/ g.yon du bzhi ste brgyad rnams snga mo'i mi tshad che ba re/ gzas su kiṅka ra/g.yon du kiṅka ra ste stobs po che dang / bgegs mthar byed mi g.yo ba khro bo mi gzugs dmar po gnyis rdo rje dang phur bu 'dzin pa re/bskor khang nang sangs rgyas stong rgyal ba yab yum sogs bdun stong dang / lho ngos 'jam dpal zhing bkod/ nub kyi blo 'bur g.yas rdo rje rnam 'joms gsung 'byon dang / phyag stong spyan stong / dbus su bde ba can/ g.yon du mtshan brjod dang 'jam dkar/ yi ge 'di tsho'i nang rgyal ba klong chen pa'i phyag bris kyang yod nges/ byang ngos su mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod/ 'di rnams phal cher nges bris rnying pa maḥthog lha chen khang gi ri mo ji lta ba'o/ /lha khang glo 'bur lhor g.yas su slob dpon rin po che 'dom phyed do tsam/ chos rgyal/ 'bri gung chos grags/ bai ro/ nyang ban phyag mnyam bzhag phrug gos/ sog lham lta 58

bu dang gzan gsol ba/ zhwa dmar po lha gnyer bas snod du bcug pa/ ser po gsol ba bcas mi tshad/ glo 'bur byang g.yon ngos su thub pa bcom ldan 'das 'dom phyed do pa/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal sras 'jam dbyangs gsang bdag gnyis/ tshangs pa brgya byin bcas mi tshad/ dbus su phra mchod rten/ steng g.yon na rje tsong kha dang rgyal ba lnga pa/ mgon khang rgyab tu klong chen pa sogs dang / glo 'bur lho byang gi sgo shub na phal po che dang / 'bum gleng gzhi sogs/ 'di phyogs ri mo rnams gsar bris/ sgo rgyab tu dam can gyis pha ri'i ri gshogs te ra la bkal 'ong ba'i rdo ring ya rtse la rdo'i gardzi ra yod pa'i gyen thur 'dom bzhi/ zhing mtho bzhi/ srab 'thug mtho do mkhyid gang / ya rtse tshogs pa pha ri la yod par grags so/ /mgon khang du dam can gyi lcags kyi tho ba gnyis/ chibs sga sogs rnying pa yin zer/ gsung rten yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum tsam yod/ lho'i mchod rten du gsung rabs mang po/ bka' 'gyur sogs bcug ces zer/ dam can gyis nyang ting 'dzin bzang por 'bru rnga mang rgyab lnga brgyas bkang nas phul ba'i zhwa 'di na yod par grags/ chu pha ri na zangs yag brag ces gu ru'i sgrub gnas sgrub phug shin tu mtshar po dang / lung phu na skyid kyi gyo ma lung ngam/ dkar po brag ces slob dpon gyis khyung du 59

sprul te brag srin mo 'dul ba'i sgrub phub tu khyung dang / dung dkar rang byon sogs yod pa'i nub phug dang / shar du ka pa lar sgrub chu sman dri bro ba rgyun mi chad pa yod kyang nyin gcig la yar sleb tsam yin zer/ cho ga sangs rgyas bstan pa ru/ /brtsi ba tsam las rnam bzhag rnams/ /phal cher nyams pa'i dus mtha' 'dir/ /bslab gsum rin chen gser bas dkon/ /la las grub thob gong ma'i shul lam der/ /rtog ge'i gnad gsang ma rnyed rtog ge 'dra'i/ kha g.yam rgyug snya ma byed kyang blo gros kyi/ /rtsal shugs phyung na'ang 'pho ba'i rgyu ru zad/ /kun mkhyen chos rje nyang ban gyis/ /mtha' 'dul gtsug lag bgres pa la/ /gso ba'i cho ga bskrun pa las/ /dus bzhin rgyal khams bde ba'i rgyu/ /kun mkhyen zla 'od zer gyis phyes pa'i bzhin/ /byin rlabs ku mud dkar po'i 'dzum phreng gis/ /phun tshogs bsil ba'i ngad bzang dar ba las/ /gnas 'dir 'chi med grong khyer las kyang lhag /'on kyang da lta se ra ba'i/ /dge slong bgres po re 'ga' tsam/ /gsol /rdo chen po bzed bzhin las/ /snga 'gyur ring lugs 'dzin pa brag ri shugs pa'i nags can gyi gsham na mang ra dgon ni dge bshes bya yul bas phyag btab/ da lta 'bras srungs yongs 'dzin gling 60

rin po ches bdag 'dzin mdzad/ dbu rtse'i dri gtsang khang du rten gtso jo bo li ma thog gnyis ma khyad 'phags/ sngon gyi mi tshad bde gshegs sman bla mched brgyad rgya gar shar li/ bya yul ba dang / spyan snga ba'i gdung rten bka' gdams pad spungs mi 'greng re/ khams lung pa'i gdung rten li ma thog phyed gnyis ma/ 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal klu sgrub thugs dam rten dang / kha san ṇi li ma thog tshad ma/ byams pa gser sku che nges/ dam can rdor legs kyis mgar ba'i lcags kyi rkang gsum mtshar/ bka' gdams gdung rten sku 'dra sogs brgya phragagaser gyi bka' 'gyur/ 'bum cha bcu gnyis sogs chos brtsegs pod stong phrag brgal ba/grwa khang ngam tshogs khang ka ba bco brgyad nang byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs li ma/ rnam snang / mi bskyod/ mi g.yo ba/ rin 'byung sogs li ma dang / rtso kṣe las grub pa brgya phrag mgon khang rdo rje rab brtan du/ gri gug bing dmar/ phyag bzhi bcas/ bya yul ba'i gzim bskyil du/ sgrub phug dam 'byar na mi la'i phyag mkhar sogs yod/ spyan snga ba chos 'chad mnyam bzhag bya yul pa sa gnon mnyam bzhag can sku 'dra gnyis/ lcags rwa nang a ti sha bod du lung bstan gyi sgrol ma li ma khru gang sa la yongs 'dzin rin po ches gser rgyan mang 61

du phul snang / 'khor bya yul bas bzhengs pa'i sman sku nyer gcig de nag la rdo dkar gyis kha sarsha ṇi rang byon ngo mtshar/ bka' gdams gdung rten nyis brgya lhag li ma sna tshogs brgyar nye ba/ rje btsun ras chung ba dkon gnyer bas sgo bar bcar skabs bka' gdams btsun pa rdo ril mgo sa na na gsungs nas sgo them shing la zhabs rjes byung ba'i sgo them rnying pa zhabs rjes can/steng du rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtshos bzhengs pa'i gnas bcu lha khang / g.yon dpe khri zhig na shin tu yig rnying pod bcu lhag mda' tshad ma 'dug sgo khar bya yul ba'i dbu skra'i shugs pa chen po/ dgon gsham du bya yul ba sogs bka' gdams dge bshes mtshan mi shes pa'i gdung rten lnga bcas bzhugs/'di nas phyir log ste lcags zam las don te 'bri gung rdzong du gzim bskyil rnams yod/ ri mgo rnams spang dang / rdza shal sogs 'dres ma/ sa khog che zhing glang ma dang / se ba/ tsha ru dang / skyer pa mang po can/ lcang ra'i gseb tu grong dkar gcig ge ba mang pos gang ba/ klung shod mda' de nas chu pha rir thang skya dgon/ dbu ru dpal 'dzin dgon/ sa gas shul bcas yod snang / klung shod chu pha ri bka' gdams pa wu na pa'i gdan sa wu dgon dang / de'i yar 62

ngos su rgyud stod pa'i dgon lag byams pa gling dgon rnams su lcags zam rgas pas gtsang po las ma thar/'bri gung pa'i rtse gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i pho brang na/ rgyal bu don 'grub bcom ldan 'das dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad/ lha sa'i jo bo'i bzo phud yin zer te don du rgya gar li ma rtsa chen/ jo bo a ṭī sha li ma rtse khru gang / u rgyan dngul sku/ 'bri gung pa'i 'dra zhal kha shas/ bka' 'gyur gser chos/ bstan 'gyur sde spar/ gter sgrom nas gter ma'i sku zer rgyu'i rdo rje 'jigs byed khru gang / don dngos ni sle'u chung yin 'dra/ thang rgyal sku khyad mtshar li ma/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po'i thugs dam rgya nag zim na rten khyad 'phags bcu shas/ skyes rabs dpag khri zhal thang 'bri bris rnying pa shin tu mtshar ba/ o rgyan skye rabs sogs zhal thang mang / gdung rten mang tsam bcas yod/ grwa sum cu tsam/ bka' brgyad tshe bdag sogs 'tshogs rgyu yod/khra ba kha ni kham bu a les btab pa/ ser khyim dgon nyab nyob yin cing / de'i rgyab ri mthon po la che tsam gyi mgul du ri khrod na/khams bu a les bzhengs pa'i khros nag dang / lab sgron 'jim sku mjal rgyu yod do/ / 63

'bras srungs 'ba' tsag dgon dang / lam ltag shug ri zhig 'gram dge dgon chung ngu dpal 'bar dgon dang / lung phur shug ri'i 'gram 'bras spungs dgon lag mkhan po dmar ston gdan sa sngar bka' gdams pa gtar ka pa'i dgon da lta rwa sgreng mtshams pa bcu gcig tsam yod pa/ mchod rten dgon dag kyang yod de chu pha rir stag lung pa'i sprug btsan dang / de'i 'khor jag me gnyis gcig char dmar po la yul 'dir g.ya' ma ri zhes pa'i chos skyong ri dang khang pa gda'/de nas klu shod kyi phu gyen du ded nas phyin pa las/ gdan sa chen po rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas dam pa ni 'bri gung rgyab phyogs klung shod chu rgyud phyogs mtshams bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang ba/ shar na shel ldan/ lho na gser ldan/ nub na zangs ldan/ byang na g.yu ldan sogs ming chen brgya/ ming yod shug pa khri gnyis/ chu mig brgyas bskor ba/ lha shing shug pas ljon bzang ra bas dkrigs pa'i dga' tshal chen por/ g.yas su khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi sprul pa'i sku rim par byon pa'i bzhi sde bla brang gzim chung khyad 'phags gnyis/gcig na u rgyan gyi yul nas byung ba'i spyan ras gzigs thang sku/gaX/ du rgyal ba 'brom ston pas thog mar bzhengs/ rwa sgrong mkhan

rab rim pa dang / gzhung sa chen pos bskyangs shing / khyad par kun gzigs lnga pas zhig gsos gnang ba'i mchod khang chen mo la/ khyams sgo phug ka ba bcu gcig phar tshur dgu/ khyon brgya tham pa la sman rnying bka' gdams bla brgyud/ pha chos/ bu chos sogs logs bris chen po mang du bris pa/ dbus gnam mthong ba'i bar thams cad gos chen gnam yol bklub pa/ rgyal ba rin po che/ rwa bsgreng khri chen khri dbus rdo gcal can/ sgo g.yas su ma ṇi'i 'khor chen lha khang na bcu gcig zhal sman sku che tsam/ lho stod na mi g.yo ba dang / bang dmar/ gri gug pa dang / 'bying dkar can gyi mgon khang phyi nang / mchod khang g.yas la gsung rab nub ma bya bar rgyal ba byams pa thog so mtho nges gnyis/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / sman bla mched brgyad/ sku gdung dngul gdung chen po gnyis/ byams pa zangs gser thog gnyis can/ byams pa 'jim sku gnyis/ chos brtsegs re mig re re'i nang bka' 'gyur re tsam pa 'phred bdun/ gyen du bcu gcig tsam gyen bzhi re sa sgo g.yas g.yon bcu drug lho byang na bcu drug re/ nub na nyi shu khyon pusti stong phrag lnga snag mtshal gser dngul sna tshogs kyis bris pa/ de nas mchod khang gsung rab dbus ma'i nang du/ khri chen bstan pa rab rgyas dmar gdung dang / rwa bsgring khri sprul tshul khrims rgya 65
