mtsho'i sku 'dra bzhugs khang bcas mi tshad rgya nag ma/ chos brtsegs gong dang 'dra/ 'brom gyis bzhengs pa'i sa yi mchod rten bkra shes 'od 'bar dang / gser gdung chen po gcig sa gdung gcig yang mchod khang g.yon ma gsung rabs shar ma na/ zangs gser thub chen mi tshad/ mchod rten chen po gnyis/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi thugs dam lo ki shwa ra byin can mi tshad sogs li ma drug chos brtsegs gong 'dra/ khyon 'di yan pod khri tsho phyed gnyis yod snyam byed/ lha khang 'di ga re rer ka ba drug drug yod/ mdun du lcags drwa can/ lha khang na khri chen bstan pa rab rgyas dngul gdung khyad 'phags/ dbu rtse dngos ka gnyis mar/ 'brom thog mar phebs skabs dre'u nyal ba'i sar lha khang bzhengs sa'i g.yas su shel sgo na jo bo 'jing yon ma phyag g.yon pusti bsnams pa dang / gong du jo bo thim thim pa'i zhal thang bcas zhal thang gnyis/ khri ngag dbang mchog ldan dngul gdung dang mkhan rabs gser gdung gsum/ sbug zangs gser gyi bzhugs khang du mar me mdzad kyi thugs dam khams bzo pos li ma byas pa'i gsang 'dus jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje khru gang lhag rdo rje 'chang gis grong bskyed du byin gyis brlabs par mdzad pa zhes don du lha kṣi dmar po'i li ma la gser ljang brdung ba'i rgyan du ma phul ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa/66

g.yas g.yon a ti sha nyid kyi 'bral med thugs dam rten bka' gdams mchod rten gnyis po li dkar khru gang lhag re/ thugs dam sgrol ma li ma khyad 'phags/ jo 'brom gnyis li ma re/ 'jam rdor sku tshab gcig dbu thog tu nā ro/ me rmi/ gser gling pa gsum gyi gdung rten dang mchod rten bka' gdams lugs mtho gang lhag gsum/bka' gdams pha chos rtsom gzhi shog dril dam 'byar/ mchod rdzas gser skong / dngul skong / mchod pa dang phyag bdar shin tu legs/ sgo ngos lho nub ma'i mgon khang bshu bkab mi phod pa na mgon po dang / mi g.yo ba thog so re 'jim sku/g.yon ngos lha khang rgyal ba 'brom gyi gzim phug lha khang gis g.yogs pa nang / 'brom gyi phyag nas mar bshad kyang phyis bzhengs snyams pa'i jo 'brom sman sku mi tshad bzhugs khri can byin rlabs 'od 'bar ba dang / 'brom gyi sgrub phug dang / 'brom gyi thugs dam brgyad stong / gnas brtan brag ri ma dang / thig le bcu drug gi bla brgyud sman sku/ rdo gcal 'og bdud rtsi'i chu mig ring mo/ 'brom gyi bla shing / mgon po gri gug dmar nag gi rten shing lcang ma gnyis bcas/ lho ngos na bskor lam du rgyal ba 'brom gyi sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i sa'i mchod rten dmar po gser tog can/ bka' 67

gdams lha bzhi'i lha khang / shing skam pa gtsang paṇa chen rin po ches bden tshig brjod de gsos pa dang / spyir dgon pa'i bskor lam na sa'i mchod rten che chung drug cu rtsa drug dang shin tu chung ngu mang ngo / /dgon pa'i ltag brag seng ge'i zhol du yang dgon ri khrod gong 'og na/rje tsong kha pas lam rim brtsams pa'i bzhugs khrir byams sku thog tshad ma/ thub pa gser zangs mi tshad/ ltung bshags gnas brtan sogs dang / rje bkra shis rdo kha ma sku sna tshogs brgya tsam/ bya btang chen po'i thugs dam li ma thub sku khyad 'phags/ sgrub pa bcu gnyis nas gsang 'dus gsung / rje yi gsung 'bum/ gser 'bum cha gsum/ ko kham ya gcig g.yas su lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang gi gzim phug na/ stag sprul pa'i gzim khang du rje gzigs pa lnga ldan 'dam sku che legs/ zhal thang legs po bla ma mchod pa sogs dang / pusti sna tshogs brgya tsam/ li sku sogs 'thor bu nyi shu tsam/ ltag na rje re mda' ba'i gzim bskyil du red mda' ba dbu zhwa dmar po paṇa zhu/chos 'chad mnyam bzhag can/ ri khrod lo lnga res brje ba'i dge slong bcu gcig dge tshul gcig bcas ri khrod 'od 'bar bar snang /dgon pa'i ltag shug pa g.yu ldan 'gram na rgyal ba 'brom gyi chos khri rdo khri/ dgon pa'i mgor lha khang ka ba bcu drug can na shel sgo nang rwa 68

bsgring gong ma'i bde gsang 'jigs gsum blos bslang shing brkos rgyan can rten gyi gtso bo thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gnyis jo bo'i thugs dam li ma bzhengs sku gcig dang bzhugs sku/ 'bum nag chu'i zil pa can/ bla ma gser gling pa'i thugs dam bzo phud gdung rten thub sku li ma khyad 'phags khru gang / gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa li ma/ bcu gcig zhal li ma khru gang sogs dang / rigs lnga li ma sogs li ma sna tshogs sum cu tsam/ thub dbang li ma mi tshad/ sman bla mched brgyad/ rigs gsum/ tshe lha rnam gsum sman sku mi tshad/ gnas brtan brag ri mi tshad tsam/ rje bla ma tsong kha pa 'jim sku mi tshad/dpal ldan dgon pa ba'i gyang ris dge slong bgres po mnyam bzhag can mi tshad/ byang sems rwa bsgreng ba ag tsam dkar/ paṇa zhu ser po mnyam bzhag can dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas mi tshad 'jim sku/chos bcigs gser ma pod nyis brgya tsam/ 'brom gyi sku 'dra stag lung bzhugs pa'i ya 'jim sku mi tshad/ stag lung bzhusas pa'i bcu gcig zhal ya rdo la yig drug rang byon/ de dang nye bar dam can mgar ba khang / bla shing bcas/ bya btang rin chen bzang pos gnas brtan zhal gzigs nas gnas brtan dang gso sbyong lhan du mdzad de gnas brtan sku bzhengs pa 'di la thim zer ba'i gnas brtan lha khang du/69

gnas brtan brag ri ma 'jim sku/ rin chen bzang po'i sku/ gtsang paṇa chen rin po che'i chibs pa'i rjes/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis sgrol dkar zhal gzigs pa'i dpe bris sogs dang / lnga ba'i bla sman blo bzang chos grags mchod rten/ sman rgyal g.yu thog pa'i sku bcas 'di skor la gos kyi rgyan kyang bzang tsam re snang / rdo bcal thams cad snum 'phyis mer ba'o/ /khyon lha khang bcu gcig yod/dgon pa'i mdor thang stong mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi pho brang /bde mchog gi sngags bzlas nas g.yon bskor byas na skye ba phyi mar nub u rgyan yul du skye ba/ pha waṃ steng shug pa skyes pa dang / pha waṃ stag seng khri'i gzugs 'dra ba mang / rgyab na 'brom rgyal bu dad pa brtan po'i skabs srin yul gyi 'phrang srung ba/ skabs 'dir jo bo 'bying dkar can du gyur pa'i yul lhas skyong ba'o/ /lha sar bzhi sde bla brang bod sa rwa bsgreng bla brang la/ lha sde mar me'i rten 'brog dud sum brgya/ jo bo 'jam rdor la 'bri stong phrag gcig shi med drung mar khal gsum/ yar mar gnyis re len rgyu lnga pas bzhag rong sde bcas stong lhag yod/dgon 'dir grwa sum brgya drug cu grwa tshang yin/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor zla ba bzhi par 'brom ston 'das mchod gtsor gyur/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum mi 'khrugs sogs sngags dge ldan lugs cho ga gtong rgyu 70

mang / dge slong 'gres po zhi dul can re 'ga' snang / lung mkhas pa dkon 'dra/ thig le bcu drug gsung / mchod khang rnams su mar me rgyun spar shin tu bzang ngo / /mchod khang gsung rab dbus ma'i steng gser g.yab chung / dbu rtse'i steng gser g.yab che/ khyams mdun gser zangs rgyal mtshan zur bzhi logs brgyad can gnyis/ rta bzhir gser tog bzhi/ spen rgyan legs po kha shas/ 'brom gzim sbug dang /dgon pa'i steng gser rtog re/ khri chen pho brang steng zangs gser rgyal mtshan gnyis/ gser tog gnyis/ 'brom gdung rten gser zangs zar tshags/ gnas brtan khang steng dang yang dgon steng ras kyi rgyal mtshan gser tog can bcas so/ /rgyal bka' gdams sar 'char ba'i mgon/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'brom rje yi/ /gsang gsum byin rlabs 'od 'bar gnas/ /nyams skyid ljon pa'i tshal du snang / /dpal stag lung pa sangs rgyas yar byon gyi bzhugs gnas so gling rgod tshang ni ri sked brag chen po'i steng rdo skas mthon po'i pho brang chen po/ zhig gsos ma rin po ches gnang ba gzim chung mang po yod pa'i dbus lha khang ka brgyad mtho legs nang / g.yas rwa lo'i sprul pa chos rje rnam rgyal phun tshogs gser gdung / ka ba mgor 'jigs byed zhal 'bags/ gter sgrom/ rasga'i phyag phreng / khe na lcags zam nas 71

gter sku 'jam dbyangs li ma mda' tshad/ li 'thor bzhi bcu tsam/sangs rgyas yar byon gzim mal sku 'dra sman sku mi tshad/ tshong dpon nor bu bzang po'i mda' 'dom gang / bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal sku/thub dbang nyan thos brgyad/ mi 'khrugs longs sku/ nye sras sma na 'dam mda' tshad yang li 'thor bzhi bcu/ gser skya chos pod nyis brgya/ dge slong ngag dbang dpal 'byor dmar gdung yod pa'i shing gdung / chos skyong khang gnyis su phyag bzhi/ dud sol sprag btsan sogs dang / steng gi ngos brag las bse ru'i rwa skyes pa mi mi thar ba'i brag la yod pas ma 'ongs pa'i dus brag las bse ru kha tshang don rgyu red zer/ thang pa rin po che'i sgrub phug sbug na/ thang pa nyid kyi 'dra zhal byin can mda' gang / g.yas su bde gshegs phag mo grub pa li ma khru gang / g.yon du ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang / bkra shis dpal grub khru gang pa'i 'jim sku/ thang pa rin po ches slob ma lnga brgyar chos gsung pa shong pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan gnas/ brag la bcu gcig zhal rang byung dang bcu gcig zhal thugs dam sman sku/ mtshams tho phyi nang pha waṃ gong 'og steng gi brag bi mi lhung ba'i mchod rten mda' gang tsam brag sked rgyang nas mjal ba rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhag pa bcas/ bya rgod mang po'i tshang bcas pa'i brag ri mtho brjid can/ sgrub pa ba bzhi sde 7 2

bcas so/ /de nas yar lung pa phur cung zad phyin pas 'phan po chags lar 'gro ba'i lung pa'i gong / rgyab ri rdza ri nyil ba la glang ma mang po skyes pa/ mdun spang ri yin cing shug pa kha shas yod pa/ lung pa'i phu stod lung la zug pa'i sked na dpal stag lung thang du/ gtsug lag khang g.yas brgyud pa grwa tshang rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal bas btab/ khyams ka ba nyer lnga/ dri gtsang khang du thub dbang thog sdugs ma thog gnyis ma 'dam sku spus dag nyan thos mchog brgyad bzhengs pa mi tshad 'dam sku legs/ sangs rgyas stong log bris/ chos brtsegs pod bzhi brgya tsam/ dpag bsam 'khri shing zhal thang legs/ stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gzim khang bla ma lha khang du dbu rtse ka gnyis mar/ nyid dang /bkra shis dpal grub sku khru gang tsam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ thub dbang / sgrol ma sogs hor li dang shar li bltar lnga la nyis brgya tsam/ rje mar pa lcam pe ta'i phyag bzos stag lung thang pa/ phag gru sogs li sku dang / zhal thang mang / dpal zhal gyi mgon khang /steng gser g.yab che chung gnyis/ gser gyi rgyal mtshan gnyis/ 'phyi bdar srus dag 7dar rgyas khang gsar dri gtsang khang ka ba lnga na/byams pa thog gnyis/ chos brtsigs pod nyis brgya tsam/ rdo rje 'chang 73

chos 'phags chem bzhugs pa/ rtse rgyal gong ma'i lha sku li gser zangs sogs nyis brgya lhag rtse sprul dngul gdung thog gnyis ma/ khuljos ka ba nyi shu pa phebs gyom/ bzhugs khri gnyis/ rtser gser g.yab chung bcas/ gdung 'bum rnam gsum las/ thang pa rin po che'i 'bum pa sa 'jim nang mdog mi 'dra ba'i yig drug rang byon can thog lnga pa sa gdung mdun gser snyib byugs 'od 'bar ba/ spyan ras gzigs dang bla sku kha shas bal bris che/ skyes mchog sku yal ba'i gdung sa 'bum dbus ma dkar po/ 'di nang ka ling rgyal po'i rten skal tshem mche ba phyed bzhugs/ chos sku sangs rgyas yar byon sa 'bum g.yas dkar po/ dbu la zangs gser gdugs lañtsa can re che chung gsum ka 'dra/ma rin po ches zhig gsos gnang ba/ bskor lam du dge ldan pa skya klong snying stag lung pa bcas pa'i bla brgyud logs bris/ rtser gser g.yab chen po bcas/thang pa'i sgrub phug zhal ras lha khang du gnas brtan bcu drug sman sku dang / thang pa'i 'dra zhal bug sgo nas yar rgyang mjal can/ ma sprul phyag dpe pod nyis brgya tsam/bla brang rtser byams khang du byams pa sman sku mi tshad/ bka' bstan 'gyur/ rin chen gter mdzod cha gsum/ ma sprul gzim chung 74

rten sna tshogs can/ rtser gser g.yab chung bcas/dgon pa'i dbus phun tshogs khang par rtser gser g.yab chung /dri gtsang khang ka ba bzhi/ dbus bde mchog dkyil 'khor chen po shing las brkos pa/ phug tu bla sku kha shas/ mdor tshogs khang ka ba nyi shu sdud/ grwa khang chen po sum cu tsam/ dgon mthar tsheng ma'i mgon khang mchod khang dmar po'i lo rgyus gnad bshad chen mo las bsdu na/snying rje pad dkar du gnas 'di lung bstan/ gu ru rin po che'i zhabs bcags/ thugs gsung sku'i rang byon gsum sprul/ phag mo grub pas zhabs bcags/ stag lung thang pa bkra shes dpal rang gi sgrub phug tu bzhugs/ dbon skyes mchog sku yal ba rin chen mgon pos gtsug lag khang srid zhi'i dpal 'bar ka chen brgyad cu pa bzhengs/ de nas chos sku sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ bkra shis bla ma sogs kyis sku gsung thugs rten 'phel rgyas mdzad kyang / gdan rab bcu bdun pa rnam rgyal bkra shis sku dus me 'bar ba'i skabs/ thang pa chen po'i sku dang / gdung rten bkra shis dpal 'bar/ mgon khang gnyis buste dang / sku 'dra mang tsam me thub tu phebs pa slar gsar bzhengs mdzad/ da lta lha khang yas mar 'dom nyi shu/ phan tshun bcu 75

bdun pa/ 'og khang gyen thur 'dom bdun pa'i nang sangs rgyas stong dang / bka' brgyud gser phreng sogs sman rnying logs bris chen po sha stag gis gang ba'i gtsag lag khang lho rgyud nas/ thub dbang srid zhi'i dpal mgon rgyug mtho nyer gcig sman sku grangs gser srang bdun byugs pa'i brag ri ma bstan pa'i nyi mas bzhengs/ 'khor nyan thos gnyis/ sman bla bdun/ slob dpon/ tshe lha gsum/ sman bla'i blos bslang bcas/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal bzhengs pa thub chen/ bkra shis dpal lhun 'dzam gling rgyan rgyab mtho so bdun/ gser zho bdun brgya skud pa'i gser zangs sde dges dbu rgyan gsol ba/ rgyab yol stong sku lhag ma zangs gser sku dmar/ kun dga' bkra shis thub chen mthong ba don ldan rgyab mtho bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ gser zho dgu brgya'i zangs gser/ brgyad stong tshar brgya'i gzungs can/ chos brtsegs me thub sogs glegs bam khri yod ces dkar chags su snang ba hang rtsis sto nga bdun tsam las med 'dra'ang rim pa gnyis gsum tsam yod par snang bas yod nges/ sprag btsan mda' bcas/ rnam rgyal bkra shis thub chen stong gsum zil gnon/ bris sku chu lon ma nang rten bzhugs pa zangs gser thog sleb/ sngar 'di 'dra bcu gsum yod par grags/gong rgyab mtho zhe lnga pa las cung sbom/ dngul srang stong phrag gi gdung 76

rten bkra shis 'od 'bar/ thang pa'i dbu skra ring bsrel/ thugs ljags spyan gsum dang / smin ma'i steng sme ba 'khor lo/ phyag g.yon srin lag ma nyams pa bcas bzhugs pa dang / sku yal ba'i tshems bzhugs shing / sgo gang thub pa'i gser sku gser srang lnga brgya'i gar blugs ma bcas thog so tsam/ bar skabs dgon pa gzhung 'dzin skabs mkhan po byang gling pas bzhengs pa lnga pa'i sman sku tshad/ rtse sprul bzhi pa bkra shis dge legs bzang po'i thugs dam jo bo rje sogs/thang pa'i 'dzam gling rgyan sku sha dngul/ sku 'gags zangs/ sku ber rag sra mo/ sku yal ba sku tshad ma me gnod dus bla g.yel rdo gcal du phebs pa zangs gser khri rgyab yol la thang pa'i gser sku brgya rtsa brgyad dang yi dam chos skyong bzhugs pa/ yab dngul dang yum zangs las grub pa'i sangs rgyas ring bsrel nyer gcig thang pa'i ring bsrel brgya/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gdung / bkra shis dpal brtsegs thugs/ sangs rgyas dbon gyi a ru rnam rgyal rdzu 'phrul gyis blangs pa sogs yod pa'i bde mchog nag po'i lugs mi lang las cung mtho ba/thub dbang gnas bcu/ mtshan brgyad sogs gos sku lha khang srid thog can lnga/ bdud dpung pham byed thub sku rgyab mtho nyer lnga gser srang lnga bcu'i skud pa gser zangs rnam rgyal phun tshogs bzhengs pa mchod rten 77

bkra shis sgo mang sa gdung dang / rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang khri rgyab yol bcas ngag dbang bkra shis chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas bzhengs pa'i 'jim sku thog sleb/ u rgyan mi tshad/ bde mchog sga lo lugs lhan skyes/ngag dbang phrin las bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal 'dra sku/ hor dpal ldan 'gyur med gdung sa 'bum/ byams pa thog sleb sman sku/ 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/ thub pa grong khyer ma/ lo ki shwa ra rnams mi tshad re/ lha babs mchod rten dngul srang stong phrag las bzhengs pa bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gdung rtse pa sprul sku bkra shis dge ba'i dbang pos bzhengs pa/ dngul gdung srang bzhi brgya las grub pa gwa zi tshe ring dbang rgyal gdung / srang sum brgya pa'i dngul gdung ga zi dbang phyug bkra shis dge 'phel gdung / dung g.yas 'khyil/ sung dgu brgya'i dngul gdung bkra shis grags pa ye shes rten/ thub dbang bdud bzhi g.yul rgyal rgyab mtho nyi shu gser zho bdun brgya'i zangs gser/ srang dgu brgya drug cu'i dngul gdung gser srang nyer lnga'i skud can dge legs bzang po'i rten/ dkar chags nang ma phog pa gsar bzhengs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dngul gdung gser rgyan can dang / stag lung zhabs drung ra ga shāg sku ngo gsar pa'i rten dang / ma sprul da lta gshegs pa 'di'i rten bcas/ dngul gdung gser rgyan thog sor sleb 78

par nye ba ches khyad 'phags/ bum sgor dwags lha sgam po'i rten klu sgrub phyag bzo klu 'jim mdzad bcu sogs dang / phyi ma gnyis la dngul srang don lnga ri ba'i dung g.yas 'khyil gnyis/ padma rā ga sogs phra rgyan ches khyad 'phags/ ma sprul 'dra zhal/ zhabs drung 'brum bus gshegs pa'i dmar gdung / rgyal ba dang / stag lung bla ma rnams kyi bzhugs khri re/ mgon khang rnying mar dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa'i sku thog tshad gtso 'khor bcu gsum/ rnam sras yab yum rta bdag brgyad bcas/mnga' bdag khri ral bse khrab sogs khrab nyis brgya bzhi bcu sogs rje ratna gu nus bzhengs/ mi pham bkra shis bla mas lha chen sgo rnying nang du mgon po legs ldan dang / lha mo thog tshad ma mes 'jigs skabs bong skad bton pa/ traklud ngag dbang bstan nyis bzhengs pa/ shing khra'i nang sprag btsan sogs sku sob bcu gcig lho sgor sprag btsan sku mdos rten sogs bcas/bar khang thog so mtho nges 'dom do lhag pa 'od 'phro grub pa'i pho brang du/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal dngul gdung cha/chod rten pad srungs thog slebs mar gser zangs kyi bum sgo'i nang du thang pa'i zhabs rjes sogs/ bka' gdams mchod rten phyogs bzhir bzhi/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil can/ chos sku o rgyan mgon pos phyag brkos tsandan phyag 79

bzhi mgon po'i sku/ rnam rgyal bkra shis bzhengs pa bka' brgyud gser phreng sman sku mi tshad gos na bza' can bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ tsandan dmar po'i byang chub mchod rten 'dom gang / bkra shis dge ba'i dbang po'i dngul gdung che ba 'dom phyed do tsam/ tsandan bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad 'dom gang mang / de'i gras las pad spungs tsan dan can gyi bum sgor shel sgo'i nang sgrol ma gci la rgyal li ma/ byang chub mchod rten thub sku li ma/ bkra shis sgo mang rje mar pa'i thugs dam dgyes rdor bum sku li ma/ cho 'phrul mchod rten/ rje mi la'i tshems ring bsrel ma ngo mtshar ba/ dbyen zlum/ phyag rdor shel can shar li/ lha babs/ sangs rgyas dbon thugs dam bde mchog lhan skyes li ma/ rnam rgyal mchod rten/ rje dwags po'i tshems/ myang 'das/ sgrol ma li ma can/ dngul gdung che chung gnyis/ jo 'brom zhal thang me thub sogs/ khang steng shod du bal bris dkyil thang /thang rnying shin tu mang ba bzhugs/gzim shag lhor bka' rgyud sgrub sde'i pho brang du/ dngul shing srang nyag lnga brgyas 'gro mgon phag gru'i sku 'dzam gling rgyan khyad par can/nang bzhugs ring bsrel brgya bcu drug sga lo'i tshems bzhugs pa/phyag bzhi'i sku sogs yod pa dang / shing srang bdun brgya nyag lnga bcu 80

las stag lung pa'i dngul sku mthong ba don ldan bcas 'di dag ni rnam rgyal bkra shis nas bzhengs/ bkra shis 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sman sku mi tshad/ dngul srang nyis brgya'i gdung kun dga' rnam rgyal mchod rten/ ga zi bsod nams dbang rgyal gdung rten dngul 'gyur/dngul srang sum brgya/ gser srang bco lnga'i skud can mchod rten mi rje ga zi sher dbang bsod nams dbang phyug gis bzhengs/ngag dbang rnam rgyal gdung rten dngul srang stong phrag gsum/gser zho stong dang lnga/ zangs nyag lnga brgya can phra rgyan bkod mtshar/thub sku jo tshad drung gsang ston thugs dam/ rje kun dga' bkra shis gdung dngul srang stong gnyis dang lnga brgya gser zho lnga brgya'i skud gser can dmar gdung bzhugs pa/ bkra shis dpal grub gdung rten dngul srang nyis stong las grub pa/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal legs grub gdung rten dngul srang nyis brgya gser zho phyed gnyis las grub pa/ṭīka' 'gyur rgya nag mtshar spar 'jang yul nas sgam bcas spyan drangs gzim shag byang mar/ rgyal dbang rnam rgyal bkra shis gdung /sku dmar gdung la bu ston gyi rus rgyan gsol ba/ gser zho bzhi brgya dang/ dngul srang lnga brgya lnga bcu las grub pa'i nang du gser gar 81

blugs thang pa'i 'dra sku tshon gang ba nyer gcig yod/ bla sku mi tshad nyer gnyis/ phyag rdor ras chung ma sku khyad 'phags bcas 'jim sku/chos bris pod brgya tsam/ dbu rtse rdul bral pho brang nang / rgyal ba 'brom dbu spa skyes pa gsung 'byon ma dang / a ti sha bcas mda' tshad ma ka bcu lha khang nas kun dga' bkra shis kyis drangs pa/ stag lung ma da lta 'di pa'i dmar gdung la o rgyan pad zhwa gsol ba/dngul srang nyis brgya/ gser zho sum brgya las dngul gdung dpal ldan legs grub gdung bkra shis chos rgyal tsandan gdung rten/ thang pa'i thugs dam phag gru/ thub sku stag li gnyis/ zhabs drung 'dod 'jo bkra shis chos rgyal gdung rten chung / sangs rgyas dbon thugs dam thang pa'i stag li sman 'dam bka' brgyud gser phreng mtho gang ba lnga bcu tsam/ glang dpal seng thugs dam rdo rje gzhon nu li ma/ rnam rgyal mchod rten/ gnas bcu brag ri ma ngo mtshar ba bcas rtser gser g.yab 'bring / zangs gser rgyal mtshan lnga bcas bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal bzhengs/pad spungs lha khang du dge bshes pu to ba'i thugs bzhugs pa'i bka' gdams gdung rten mda' tshad/ dam pa dga' ston/ rdor dbye ba/ khu ston/ rin chen rgyal mtshan rnams bka' gdams gdung 82

rten de 'dra re 'khor pad spungs sum brgya skor/lcags khra lha khang du lha khri thub dbang chos 'khor ma/ lung ston ma/ lha yul ma sogs rgya gar shar dbus lho nub/ rgya nag tā ming /bka' gdams/ chos rgyal/ bal li/ kum sogs kyi li ma bzhi brgya lhag klu sgrub phyag bzo ka ma rū pa'i ga la/ rdo rje gdan gyi lha kṣiṃ mchod rten thog gnyis ma khru gang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan mkhan po kha che ma ye sgom nag gis thang pa'i 'dra sku rdo rje gdan du bzhengs pa chu bo gaṅgā las rdzu 'phrul gyis byon pa/ thang pas kho bo mi 'dra khyod rang 'dra gsungs pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor li ma khru gang lhag pa/gzim chung thang lha mdzod du chos rgyal li ma shas che thub dbang /rigs lnga/ nye sras sogs sku brgya nyi shu'i skor/ bkra shis dpal grub 'dra sku sku tshad sangs rgyas yar byon thugs bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung shel 'ja' tshon ma'i ka ba can/ thang pa'i dngul sku bzo khyad khyad 'phags khri rgyab yol bcas chos rje na rim bcu gsum thugs dam 'bral spangs/ phag gru'i 'dra zhal rang gi phyag nas ma/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal dngul sku bkra shis dpal grub thugs dam/shing khra lha khang du jo shāka gnyis sku tshad thub sku bal li re/ byis pa lo brgyad tsam pa'i li ma thub sku gcig brkyang khru gang pa gsum/83

gzhan de las che tsam li ma thub sku bcu bzhi/gzim chung bla ma lha khang du/ 'brom gyis rdo nag kha phye rwa sgreng bzhugs pa'i ya bcu gcig zhal rang byon phyed sku stod shin tu gsal ba/ grub mtha' ris med bla sku sna tshogs li ma/ sman 'dam/ rdo shing /gser sku sogs bdun brgya tsam/ kun dga' bkra shes thugs dam thub pa gnas brten 'khor bcas nyer gsum brkyang khru gang pa 'phags mchog kun dga' bkra shis kyis bzhings/ byang nas phyag nas 'dir babs rab gnas rdzu 'phrul ma/ thub sku li ma mi tshad dang / byams pa sogs/ gser zangs li ma sna tshogs bzhi brgya tsam/ ngag dbang grags pa'i sku dbyar char 'bebs/ dgun kha ba bkag par grags pa 'bri gung gling log skabs 'phur 'ong ba'i bde mchog li ma/ sga lo/sangs rgyas dbon/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal rnams kyi rdo la zhabs rjes re/ spyan gzigs me thub ma/ dpe cha sna tshogs pod sum stong lhag dkar chag na snang yang pod 'thor lnga brgya tsam nang gsar rnying gi yig rnying mang /bar mgon khang du phag mo bden gnyis zhal zangs gser legs/ bde mchog lhan skyes a lha'i lugs mi tshad chung / dngul srang stong las phyag bzhi ba'i sku/ gser zho bzhi brgya'i rgyan can/ yang sman 84

'dam phyag bzhi mi tshad zil can chos rdzong rnam rgyal rab brtan mgon khang nas drangs pa/ sangs rgyas dbon thugs dam gur mgon/ gri gug tsā na lugs sku/ las mkhan gzi ldan dbang phyug bram gzugs/bya rog gdong yum dpal ldan lha mo/ gshin rje ljang nag chos pod stong lhag bcas bzhugs zhes ngag bstan nyi'i gsung las bsdus/mtshan brgyad lha khang du gu ru bdud dpung zil gnon gtso 'khor gsum dang / mtshan brgyad mi tshad/ e sa'i 'jim bzo tshon ris dper sgros nyams can khyad 'phags ngag dbang bstan 'dzin bzhengs par ma sprul 'di pas mkhan slob chos gsum kha skong ba bcas/ dgon pa'i phyogs bzhir khang brtsegs chen po bzhi/ ltag na sprag btsan lha tho yod/ sngar grwa lnga brgya'i tshad yin kyang da lta sum brgya lhag bde mchog nag po lugs drug cu pa/ dgyes rdor dzñā na lugs/ dus 'khor bu lugs stag lung yig cha/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ 'jigs byed/mi 'khrugs/ kun rig sman bla'i mdo chog ras chung phyag rdor/ tshe dpag med/ rnam rgyal ma/ rnam 'joms khro nag rata gling phur pa/stag lung thugs sgrub/ rtsa gsum/ rnam sras sogs sgrub khag nyi shu'i sgrub mchod yod pa'i gtor bzo legs tsam snang / dpe cha gzhung rig gnas shes pa dang / nyams len rtogs pa'i gling mo sogs ma mjal 85

lo/ /'on kyang bla ma rnams sku gshegs pas deng seng stagalung yar mar thang du phra nyag gi skabs so/ /de nas rdza dkar la brgal nas stod lung g.yon lung na zhwa ser gyi lugs chu bzang dgon grwa bdun cu tsam/ lding ka grwa bzhi bcu tsam/rgyud smad pa'i dbyar gnas lha khang / khrab gnas dgon grwa lnga bcu tsam/ lusba dgon grwa su ma cu tsam sogs su rten sum cung zad snang ngo //de nas zla10tshes24la mtshur mod bo lung gi gtsug lag khang du phyin nas re zhig ngal gsos te rnam par 'dren pa rgyal dbang garma pa'i sku drung du bag pheb par gnas so/ /tshes27la rten mjal the re ba byas pa'i/ri khrod du rje kurma pakhri dang rang byung rdo rje'i sgrub phug padma khyung rdzong du/ mun mtshams bzhugs pa'i brag phug karma pakshi rgya yul byon skabs gsung 'byon pa'i pakshi'i 'dra zhal gtsos marma pakhri'i 'dra zhal mi tshad gsum sman sku/ rang byung rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i u rgyan mi tshad sman sku byin che ba sogs/ rje btsun mi la rtsa ris ma mi tsam/ thang sku mang tsam/ mdor na seng gdong ma'i gnas bragakurma pa'i gzim khang du chos dbyings rdo rje'i phyag bris mdzad bcu rgya bris ma thang ka bcu/ 'og gzim khang jig dbang phyug rdo rje'i 86

zhabs rjes rdo la byon pa dang / zung 'jug brgyud rim thang chung /chos drug sgrub grwa ba brgyad/ de'i lha khang bcas/ yang g.yas su sgrub khang gnyis tsam/ de nas dgon du mar kurma pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i sras rgyal tshab/ nor bu bzang po'i dus nam pas sras la gnang bas rgyal tshab pho brang mchod khang gong bya ba/ steng na rga shrī sprul sku rgyal tshab pa'i gzim khang / 'og tu 'du khang khyams ka ba bcu drug zhug g.yas rgyal tshab sku phreng drug 'dom sku mi tshad/ g.yon du thub sku mi tshad gser zangs gsum/ gser gdung thog sleb/ gtsang khang ka ba drug pa na/ dbus su dgu pa dbang byug rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i sman sku thub chen thog phyed gsum pa/ mchog zung dang / kurma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis bcas/ bka' 'gyur/ bka' gdams mchod rten li ma mda' tshad/ nor bu'i drwa phyed drag rgyan dang / 'phan rgyal mtshan/gos chen sngo ṭa ka che can yod pa sogs bkod legs rgyu bzang /bsgrigs rnga mang / ngos bris sgar bris rnying pa tshugs legs/'du khang de'i g.yon mchod rten seng khri 'dra ba'i mun nag sbug na yang dgon sbug ces pa 'dir dus mkhyen dgung lo don lnga nas gya bzhi'i bar bzhugs pa'i gzim khang du/ rje nyid kyi gdung thal rus las grub pa'i sku thel gzugs dngos slob sgang lo tsā ba'i phyag bzo/87

de'i g.yas su dus mkhyen thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa dngos slob sgom chen ras pas bzhings pa/ ston pa'i sku li ma mda' tshad bzhi ni nam mkha' 'od sogs nye gnas 'od bzhis bzhengs pa/g.yon du dngos slob gdan sa ba phya ba gangs dkar ba rin chen 'od zer sku/ bla sku chung ba skyer sgom pa dang / dus mkhyen slob ma dka' thub bcud len gyi mtshan grub thob chu sgom ma/ gtso sku'i g.yon kha che'i paṇa chen gnas 'dir phebs pa na stsal te me yi kha gnon du gnang ba'i paṇa chen bris sku/ thugs dam rten rgya gar li ma sna tshogs sum bcu tsam/ sbug g.yas grub thob snye mo mdze sgom sku gdung sas g.yog pa'i 'dra sku yul 'dir mdze nad gtan mi 'byung ba'i byin rlabs can dang /dus mkhyen gyis ma mgon sku bzhugs pa'i mgon khang bka' gnyan bcas/ rje dus mkhyen ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan rnam rol/ ma byon pa drug pa seng ge/ da lta 'od dpag med yin par grags so/ /de nas gser gdung chen mo'i lha khang ni/ gser g.yab ser po'i 'og gi lha khang ka ba bcu drug thog so mtho nges gsum pa ru dkar chag bsdu na/ phug g.yas su/ rje dus mkhyen gyi zhal chem ltar/ slob ma rdzu 'a/sdu thob pa lnga brgyas gser zho sum khri lhag pa dang sman 'jim bsres

pa'i sa 'bum chos dbyings lhun grub dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten sgo thog gnyis pa bka' gdams mchod rten dbyibs/ nang du dus mkhyen sku zhugs la phul ba'i ring bsrel sa ra ha'i dug sbrul sgom thag dwags po lha rje'i thugs dang / rnam sbyar/ gsol lhung sogs/bum sger 'dra sku bcas/ dbus su dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i gdung mthong grol rnam rgyal lhun po rnam rgyal mchod rten thog so gsum pa dngul rkyang dang / bum pa/ bum sgo bcas pa gser ljang brdung /dngul srang khri dang lnga stong / gser srang stong dang lnga brgya las grub pa/ li ma sum brgya lhag bka' gdams mchod rten brgya dang brgyad/ gsung rab pod brgyad brgyar nye ba nang du yod ces snang /bum sgor 'dra skur rtser nyi dkyil la kurma pa longs sku/ zla bar mchod lha/ char kheb bre srog la rgyal ba rigs lnga/ gdugs rim la gtsug tor sde lnga'i gzungs lañtsa/ bre la rgya gar grub chen brgyad/ bang rim la kerma pa'i rnam thar 'bur ma/ seng khrir rgyal chen bzhi/ sa gdan la 'dod yon lha mo rdzas rtags sna bdun sogs/ bum sgor srong btsan sgom po'i mgul g.yu sgron ma rang byon sogs g.yu ming chen bcu gsum sogs rin po che du ma'i phra rgyan can/ g.yon zhug grub chen kurma pakshi'i gdung bkra shis dpal 'bar/ sman dang bye ma gser gsum bsres 89

pa'i sa 'bum 'bras spungs mchod rten dbyibs/ mdun g.yas su rkarma pa bcu gcig ye shes rdo rje'i dngul gdung mthong grol yid nor dngul srang stong lnga/ gser srang sum brgya'i bum sgo can/ mdun du 'jim sku chos drug rdo rje'i tshig lan bdun gsungs pa'i dus mkhyen 'dra sku chos drug ma mtshur phu'i rtsa ba che shos rten/ de'i g.yon dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i 'dra sku li 'dra sku dang stan bar drod bzhugs pa bcas sku 'dra li 'thor khru gang ma sum cu tsam/ gu shel dam 'be rgyab ya la/ tā ming spos phor chen po sogs mchod rdzas rgya nag rnying ba mang / kurma pa'i gos sku gcig bsgrags rnga mang / lha khang gzhan zhig 'jigs skabs gdan drangs pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs gser zangs 'jim sku mi tshad brgyad/ rje btsun mi la'i sku rtsa ris ma/ gser chos pod brgya //sa/mu tig 'phan dang / sngon gyi hor gos las mchod rdzas gya rnam de nas lhor dngul gdung chen mo rnying pa rab brtan pho brang ka ba bcu drug dbus su zhwa dmar drug pa mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug gi dngul gdung thog so gsum pa 'dzam gling rgyan lha babs rgya gar ma'i mchod rten dbyibs/ chos dbyings rdo rje'i phyag bzo ka ma rū pa'i rdo'i sa 'dzin/ rtses thang thub pa gser gling ma'i khra'i bkod pa bya ri dwags 90

gcan gzan mchod lha sogs kyis btegs pa/ gser gyi ngang pa gnyis/ spos shel ngang pa gnyis/ g.yu yi rna tso gnyis sogs rgyan can khri zangs gser/ nang na sgar chen rten bzhugs phal che ba dang / mi bskyod rdo rje'i bka' 'gyur gser bris ma sogs pod stong nye/ rgya gar li ma'i mchod rten brgya sogs/ 'od srung ring bsrel ngang sgong tsam pa bzhugs/ rgyan la bum sgor khri srong lde'u btsan mgul g.yu sha ba skya ring sogs dang / nyi zla'i rtser khyung gi sgong nga yod/ sgo khang du kha sarsha ṇi'i rdo sku/ de 'og chos dbyings rdo rje'i dngul gdung chen mo mthong grol 'od zer padma'i snying po/ kurma pa'i zhun thig spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi yig drug do rje rtse dgu rnams rang byon can/ bum sgor 'dra sku bcas/ de 'og zhwa dmar ye shes snying po'i gdung rten bkra shis lhun grub dngul can/ mdun rig 'dzin dpa' bo gtsug lag rgya mcho'i dngul gdung / mdun du rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dngul sku mi tshad lhag tsam gtsos/ dus gsum mkhyen pa nas/ bcu gcig bar ye shes rdo rje'i bar 'dra sku shing khri bkod pa mi 'dra ba dag dang bcas zangs gser mi tshad tsam pa zhwa nag gos gser bcas spus dag sha stag rje dus mkhyen gyi tshal gung thang rab gnas yon 'bul thub pa bdud dpung zil gnon li ma mi tshad lhag bcas/91

'du khang zhug lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan ni/ grub thob kurma pakshis thub chen 'dom bcu pa'i zhal gzigs nas 'di 'dra bsgrub na sangs rgyas bstan pa dar/ bdud kyi cho 'phrul zhi zhes thub pas lung bstan pa ltar rgya yul nas nye gnas 'dan sgom la/ lha bzo 'phan yul pakshi bos/ sku rgyu ram pa zangs khung nas thon gsungs ltar bzhings par bskul/ de nas lo brgyad nas hor yul nas yar byon rab gnas mdzad gsungs pa'i dbus su thub chen li ma skra mtshams nas kol ko bar zhal ras 'dom rgyang gang dang lag ya gang snang bas 'dom bdun khri bcas 'dom bcu yin 'dra ba khri sog dmag skabs sa nang mar song ba gser sku li ma thog so mtho nges gsum lhag sleb par snang / g.yas su byams pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba rigs lnga bcas li ma thog so mtho nges re/ khyon lha chen dgu/ dbus mar sangs rgyas ring bsrel bre gang / dwags po'i thugs/ sangs rgyas chos dung / mi la'i gsol zhal/ dgra bcom nyi ma gung pa'i tshems/shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal bu'i lhung bzed/ mkhar bsil/ snam sbyar bcas yod/ lha chen g.yon du yol ba rlung bum chen gyis bsrangs/rab gnas/ mchod bshams/ chos gsungs pa'i sku'i bkod pa gsum dus gcig sprul pa'i rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa'o/ /g.yas su bkra shis 'od 92

'bar dus mkhyen dang / g.yon du bkra shis lhun grub kurma pakshi'i gdung rten bka' gdams mchod rten li ma thog so gnyis pa re/g.yas phyogs su kurma pa byang chub rdo rje'i dngul gdung / de 'og bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gser gdung bum sgo gser sung lnga bcu can/ g.yon phyogs zhwa dmar dpal chen chos kyi don 'grub dngul gdung thog gnyis ma/ g.yas su rgyal ba g.yung gi phyag bzo kurma pakshi'i sman 'dam/ byang chub rdo rje'i 'dra zhal/ mi tshad chung chung li ma lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan bzo phud/ bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / theg mchog rdo rje'i gser sku mi tshad/ kurma pakshi'i rdor dril/ grub thob khams pa mi gsum thab rdor phyag rjes can/ dpal ldan lha mo'i sku 'bags 'jing yon ma/ pakṣi'i rab gnas can/ gser dngul skya bris chos brtsigs pod stong brgal/ dri gtsang khang ka ba ring nges bcu drug ma'o/ /mtshur phu'i lha khang de'i phyi ngos khyams ni ka ba bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa/ dbus su mchog gling lung bstan ltar kurma pa theg mchog rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i gu ru zangs gser mi tshad lhag la god ldem gu ru'i sku tshab dang / ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs phur pa nang gzhug can/mkha' 'gro gnyis bcas/ yang g.yas su gsang bdag rdo rje be con/tshe dpag med sku tshad zangs gser phra rgyan bzang po can/ rten khrir 93

nam pakshi'i 'dra sku gtsos li ma nyi shu tsam/ g.yon du bcu bzhi theg mchog rdo rje'i gser gdung lha babs mchod rten thog so mtho nges/bum sgor mtsho rgyal mgul g.yu phur pa rang byon ma sogs rgyan ldan/dbang phyug rdo rjer rgya nag gong mas phul ba'i gos sku 'dzam gling rgyan/phan tshun 'dom khyams sbug kurma pa'i bzhugs khri/ khyams la zung 'jug brgyud rim/ thub dbang gnas brtan/ 'khrungs rabs brgya pa rnams dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i skya bris lha bzo mang pos tshon btang ba sgar bris rnying pa mtshar/ rgyal ba g.yung gi phyag bzo ma mgon mgar ba'i 'tshams sku/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha bzo sprul pa kurma pa srid bral phyag bzo 'chams sku gsar pa/ sgo 'gram mgon sku pakhris bzhengs pa/ nges bris shin tu legs/ g.yon 'dod khams ma kurma srid bral gyis bsgrun pa/ rgyal chen bzhi de gas bzos/ sgo thod paṇa mi bskyod rdo rjer rgya gong mas phul ba/steng mgon khang na ma mo/ mgon po'i sgrom dam 'byar/ rgyal tshab gong mas bzhengs pa ma mgon mgar gsum sogs lha khang ka bzhi ma/rtser bla ma lha khang na rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dngul sku mi tshad gtsos gar rab rim byon zangs gser mi tshad bcu gcig mdzad bcu thang ka legs/ gser g.yab klu la 'u lag btang bas nag por song ba/94

gser gyi rgyal mtshan tog sogs bcu/ gsha'i rgyal mtshan gnyis/mda' yab nag po'i 'og na lha khang ka drug mar zhug tu thub dbang dang sman bla li ma mi tshad re/ bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i thugs dam spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal li ma rgyan phul gyur mi tshad cung chung ba dang / zangs gser bcu gcig zhal/ li sku sna tshogs/ zangs gser sku brgya tsam/ sangs rgyas gling pa/ pad gling bdud 'dul rnams zer te sangs rgyas gling pa yin snyams/ gang yin kyang dam pas gter ston gyi ngan sngags dang / phur pa gdeng 'khyil la/ sems can la gnod na mi rung zhes bka' bkyon pas slar sbas su bcug pas o rgyan rin po che zhal gzigs nas/ khyod snying rje can/khong ngan sems yin nam/ dus mthar khyed rang kur bstan 'jigs 'ong zhes lung bstan skabs bzod gsol du bzhengs pa'i slob dpon zangs gser mi tshad dbu zhwa kur zhwa lta bu nag por gsol ba/ kurma pa de bzhin gshegs par gong ma tā ming rgyal pos phul ba'i bka' 'gyur rgya nag mtshal spar pod brgya dang lnga/ glegs shing tsandan la rgya nag pho brang gi lha pas tshon btang ba/ dpe chab zi khyim ser po/ na bza' rkarma bum gdan dmar ser rtags brgyad ma 'phyar ba tsam re yod pa'i dril tshas dang bcas pa'i dril tshas phyi nang gsum pa/ skal bzang khar 95

tā ming gis sangs rgyas gsung la bstod pa brtsam pa rnams dang / sde dge'i rnying rgyud spar ma/ kurma na rim gsung 'bum sogs yig rnying pod brgya lhag tsam/ dbus su chu skam shul mkhar nag pho brang /gser dngul bris pa'i bka' 'gyur dang / rnying rgyud gser chos bcas rang byung rdo rje'i thugs dam rten sogs yod/dngul gdung bkra shis gsar mar/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i dngul gdung chos dbyings lhun po'i nang na gdung spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong rang byon can/ li ma sogs sku 'dra stong lhag pusti stong lhag yod gsungs zer/ srog la rgyal ba rigs lnga/ gdugs la bla brgyud mtshan dang rgyud sde'i snying po lañtsa/ bre la rgya gar grub chen brgyad/bang rim la rnam thar/ nyi mar rkarma pa/ zla bar mchod lha bcas 'phrul bzo byon gtsang dang / sgo khyim la srong btsan sgam po'i mgul g.yu mon mo mig pa sogs yod pa thog gnyis/ g.yas su ston pa'i tshems dang / ring bsrel bya skung tsam bzhugs pa kurma pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngul gdung dpe med lhun grub ma/ g.yon du gser btso ma lta bu'i ring bsrel lhung bzed gang bzhugs pa'i kurma pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i mchod sdong mthong grol nyi ma dngul gdung / de 'og rgyal tshab grags pa don grub dngul gdung lha babs mchod rten mdzad bcu 96

sogs 'phrul brdung / de 'og rgyal tshab nor bu bzang po'i dngul gdung / de 'og rgyal tshab dkon mchog 'od zer dngul gdung /g.yas phyogs rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs dngul gdung nang dbu thod phag mo rang byon can/ de 'og dpa' bo gtsug lag don grub dang /de 'og dpa' bo gtsug dga' ba'i dngul gdung / rten gtso'i g.yas rgyab mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs don grub 'od zer sa 'bum/ g.yon rgyab bla ma rin chen bzang po'i 'bum pa/ rten khrir bla ma zhang sku gsung 'byon dang / 'bri gung skyobs pa'i sku gsungs 'byon sogs li ma bzhi bcu tsam/ bzhir mkhar nag gis phul ba'i mgo dgu/ mgo lnga sogs bzhugs/ chos grags rgya mtsho'i gdung ma mjal yod zer/gzim chung 'chi med bde ldan 'od gsal 'khyil par/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje'i rdo sku/ 'di mdun ril nag dril/ li ma dang zangs gser sogs brgya tsam/ dpe cha rtsa chen pon lnga bcu tsam/ chos dbyings rdo rje phyag brkos tsandan zung 'jug brgyud pa mtho gang tsam pa legs pa khri rgyab yol bcas/ theg mchog rdo rje'i bzhugs khri/ mchod rdzas legs/rgya thab ser po'i 'og gzim chung kun khyab pho brang / zhug dpe mdzod/ bka' 'gyur gser bris spus dag mi bskyod rdo rje/ zhwa //ra

//sa kyi gsung 'bum/ 'brug rgyal pos phul ba'i 6rgyan gser sku mi gzim chung sngags khang du tā ming rgyal po'i tsandan sgrol ma/ pakshi'i sor 'brang khro spar/ rgya thang nas glang mcher mdzad bcu brkos pa 'dom gang / rten sgam mang / rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i 'dra zhal/ tā ming gnas rten/ kur rab rgya sku sogs yod/gzim chung zhal ras lha khang ka dgu mar/ li rag zangs gser sku brgya nye/ thang ka sgom chen lnga/ sgam 'bring brgyad/ 'brug pas phul ba'i gos sku legs po thog so gcig thor god dpon mos phul ba'i ma mgon gos sku bcas/gzim chung chos dbyings pho brang na/ rol mo sil snyan sgam brgyad/ li rag sku brgya tsam/ gsang snying zhi sku/ bzhugs khri bcas/gzim chung shar na/ padma nyin byed sku thang / phag gru gsung 'byon ma/ li sku sogs lnga bcu tsam/ bdud 'dul rdo rje'i bzhugs gdan bcas/gzim chung bkra shis khang gsar na/ garma pa bco lnga pa rang gi thugs dam rten mang /gzim chung mgon khang na/ chos dbyings rdo rjes bse ru'i rwa la 98

brkos pa'i ma mgon mgar ba sogs yod/gzim chung mdo spar khang ka ba nyi shu'i sa na rin chen gter mdzod pod drug cu re gsum/ kurma pa bco lnga'i gsung rtsom pod bcu gcig tsam yod/mchod rdzas rgyan gos chen 'chams chas sogs gzhung sa nas kyang mig ser mdzad dgos tsam du bzang /mchod khang gong na rten gsum mang po dang / dpe cha mang /mtshan brgyad dgu thang kur bris/ bka' brgyud gser phreng zhwa dmar chos 'grub rgya mtshos bzhings pa yangs pa can gyi lha rten thang shar so lnga pa khyad 'phags dang / kurma pa'i zhal ras lha khang nas rigs ldan zhal thang so dgu pa dang / 'du khang nas bla ma mchod pa la shom rgyu bka' rgyud gser phreng khyad 'phags shar bzhi bcu pa/ ri khrod du kurma rab mkhyen bris legs pa lnga thang / sgrub khang nas zung 'jug brgyud rim thang ka sum cu can tshon mdog 'ja' shar ba lta bu dang / garma mchog gyur bris kur rab thang ka brgyad can dang / chos dbyings rdo rje'i phyag bris yer pa rwa ba ma'i gnas brten nyis phrug dkar por rgya yi rdo tshon rnying pas bris pa'i dpe bcad pa dgon chen sde dge'i thang rnying spom kha dge bshes la yod pas de'i ma dpe nyer gsum/ gzhan chos dbyings 99

rdo rje'i phyag bris phyag rdor/ gnas brtan lnga thang mi 'dra ba cha gnyis/ tshem sku 'gran bral thub dbang / nyid sku sogs lnga tsam/mkhyen bris mkhas ba kong se a bo bas lo bzhi zla ba bdun bris pa thub dbang gnas brtan rgya gar ma 'gran bral gaḥthog dam gtsang byams gsum skyes rabs de'i dbyibs 'dra ba nyer gsum dang mkhyen bris pa 'brug stod nor bu'i chos rgyal phan bde'i 'byung gnas dad rten dge 'dun zur ri ba'i yol thang rgya nag lha bzo rnying pa nged rang gi lcags la'i gnas bcu yol thang bri mkhan de 'dra ba la yul bkod snang ba 'gyur ba nyer gsum/ thon thi gser gzhi 'gran bral gyis mtha' shan mtshan brgyad dgu thang / kurma mchog gyur pa'i sgar chen yol thang zung 'jug brgyud rim ches ngo mtshar ba sogs zhal thang skor spus dag pa/bris bzang ba/ kur bris/ mkhyen bris/ sman bris/ chos dbyings rdo rje'i phyag bris can bcas grangs lnga brgya tsam pa 'gran bral dang sna tshogs sum brgya tsam/ khyon stong du long tsam pa yod do/ /mtshur phu shar nub dpe mdzod gnyis na dpe pod stong gnyis lhag yod/ dkar chag las nyer mkho zur du bris yod/rgyal dbang skam pa'i mdun nas mtshur phu'i nang rten mjal ba la/ bdag cag gis ston pas rab gnas mdzad thub pa zangs thang 100

ma1 'phags pa klu sgrub phyag bzos byang chub shing la steng na dus gsum sangs rgyas/ 'og na sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ khro bo gnyis bcas bzhi pa rol rdor la mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sprul pa a tsa ras phul ba2 'phags pa klu'i phyag bzo mdzad bcu klu 'jim ljang gu klu sgrub phyag bzo klu 'jim dkar po'i jo bo dbu rgyan can longs sku rgyab na nā ga ra'i ye rnyarma yod pa/ byang chub shing drung g.yas su lha bu dgu/g.yon du dgus bskor ba sogs4jo bo a ti sha'i thugs dam dbus li thub pa me ru shi ṣa/ khri rgyab yol nor 'dzin ma da lta'i 'dod dpal sku'i dpe/ 5chos rje gling pas byang chub rdo rje la phul ba'i klu 'jim gu ru bde ba chen po 'bral spang ma gser gyi ga'u bcas6nyang rin po che'i gter ma bu ram gor mo lta bu'i u rgyan 'go thod pa yod pa/ srin thod zhabs bkag can) stag sham gu ru yid bzhin nor bu mkhar li mtho gang paṇa zhu phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kur g.yon tshe bum can rtsi dmaranakerma pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i dus ratna gling pa'i sku tshab lha kṣi e ka ho tu ste rin po che sna tshogs dbyings gcig pa paṇa zhwa rdo rje tshe bum pus mo g.yon mgor bsnams pa/ nged rang gi tshe mtha' yas pa dang nor 'gro ba9 gter chen mchog gling gter byon gu ru bdud 'dul rgyal po 'dod dpal li ma lta bu dbu paṇa zhwa mar 'bebs pa bar mtshams 101

bdud rtsi 'bebs 'dug gsungs10 mchog gling bdud rtsi sman sku yab yum rdo rje dril bu thugs kur bsnol ba 'bum rdzong gter ma/ mgar ba dngos grub kyi bzhugs khang11 gu ru che mchog thod phreng rdo rje dang dung khrag yum bhan dmar/ zhabs srin po mnan pa1na sangs rgyas gling pa'i phur pa thugs rnying li ser sor bzhi g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon phur pa dpal spungs rten 'khyar khang sar gnyer pa las nyos gsungs pa13rngog chos sku rdo rje'i thugs dam mar pa li ser tshem bzhugs pa sgar chen rten14 rje btsun mi la chos dbyings rdo rjes tsandan dkar por phyag brkos rtsa ris ma'i phug15 dus mkhyen chos drug ma li dmar ser dkar gsum 'dres pa mtho gang16 dus mkhyen li ser tshems bzhugs nyid kyis rab gnas ma17 dus mkhyen tshems bzhugs li ser sme ba can18 zhang li ser sen rjes ma19rang byung rdo rje hor sku rab gnas ma20 chos rgyal srong btsan thugs dam spyan ras gzigs kha san ṇi dbu gdugs can li gar bu21 dbang phyug rdo rjes snye thang nas bzhengs pa jo bo a ti sha bod du lung bstan/ sgrol ma li ser khyad 'phags22 theg mchog rdo rjes phyag mgar dngul gyi sgrol dkar23sras dar ma mdo sde'i zhun thig las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma24bcu bzhi'i phyag blugs tshe dpag med25mi tri pa'i thugs dam rdo nag phag mo26102

gling pa'i gter byon lha lcam mande bzang mo'i dbu thod66 ga ston chos kyi sems dpa'i dbu thod dum gcig67 lha btsun gsol thod gling bzhi ma68 sa shod bu mo padma mtsho'i dbu thod mkha' 'gro sde lnga sogs rang byon can69 sa ra ha'i gsol thod rkarma pa theg mchog rdo rjes gser ljang brdung gis shan pa/ de nang mchog si ra'i me long ma byid pa70 spyan ras gzigs gsung sprul bram ze dri med snying po'i dbu thod gu ru'i phyag thod chos gling gter byon71 ma skyes dgra'i rten skal thub pa'i ring bsrel a ma mya ngan med kyis sbas/ gu ru rin po ches chos bston mchod rten padma can du lha sras kyis gter sbas pa slar nam pakhri'i bton pa gser snod bcas72 rje mi bskyod rdo rje'i phyag bcang rdo dkar73 stag sham gter byon de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung ring bsrel bya ngang sgong tsam74smra ti'i phyag pā675 rje rin po che'i phyag tshwa a dam76bram ze sgra gcan zin dbu klad ches ngo mtshar77bal mo shākya de wa'i dbu thod urang byon can72 zur mang rol rdor gter ma phur ser79 gu ru chos dbang mgul phur the'u brang mgar ba lta bu80chos dbyings rdo rje'i phyag bzos lcags li bsres pa'i phur pa81gter bdag gling pa'i gter byon gnam lcags phur pa82 rgod ldem gter byon zur chos dbyings rang grol mgul phur83 stag sham gter 105

byon mgul phur chung ba dha dbu ma84 gu ru chos dbang sgrub phur shing can85khams ston shes rab me 'bar gter byon phur pa dbu gcigasku stod phyogs gsum zhal gsum steng khyung yod pa/ de nas dbu gsum/ dbu bzhi zhal gcig86 kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i mgul phur li smug zhal gsum thugs rjes rjes 'dzin can smin gling nang rten87 sangs rgyas gling pa'i phur pa zi khyim dmar po khyad 'phags mthong ma myong ba lta bu dgongs 'dus zhal gsum rta dbu can/ rdo rje rtse dgu/ lte ba padma kha sbyor/ chu srin/ sbrul chun dang gtsang phag can88mnga' bdag nyang gter phur pa zi khyim rta dbu dbu gsum rdo rje rtse lnga dbal mchin smug can89 karma pakshi'i mgon po ber nag rgya nag ma90 'jam mgon bla ma rnam gnyis dbu zhwa gzan91 dzambha la theg mchog rdo rje'i phyag mgar dngul92 ga mngon gter ma dzambha la dmar po'i sku zhal gsum phyag drug khyad 'phags li dmar 93 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang 'dra zhal tshem can94 chos rje gling pas sbas yul padma bkod gnas rdo tshe dpag med rang byon rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rjer phul ba95 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che la rdzong shod du gter srung gis phul ba'i gnam lcags rdo rje96 rje mkhyen brtse rin po che'i mdun zab bu lung gter srung gis phul ba'i sna kṣiṃ dang gnam lcags 106

'dres pa dmar smug me 'od 'phro ba'i gnam lcags rdo rje97 khams sgar nang rten nas byon pa'i mnyam med dwags po'i 'dra zhal ngo mtshar ba92 zur po che'i thugs dam rdo rje gzhon nu shangs mda' dpal chen po'i zhal ngo 'dra ba zhal gsum phyag drug ral pa la thod skam phreng ba sum brtsegs/ mdun zhabs g.yas brkyang / g.yon bskum rgyab gnyis bskum pa'am gar stabs/ 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dril bu thogs pa li dkar90 stag sham gter ma gu ru bye ma a krong srin thod ma100kurma pakshi'i 'dra zhal 'gram la wartu'i trīḥrnam bcad can rang byon101kurma pa rang byung ba'i sku rtsib a rang byon can102 stag sham gter byon gnam lcags phur pa chos gling gis byang chub rdo rjer phul ba103che mchog bdud rtsi'i thod tshal slob dpon rin po ches gter sbas rgya nag par bu me tog dbus104sgrul sku snying thig shog ser105 theg mchog rdo rje'i phyag blugs ber nag sku/ 106 jo bo a ti sha'i phyag tsha la ye rnyarma lañtsa can107 karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i phyag blugs lha kṣi rgyu bzang phyag rdor phyag g.yas khra thogs shing ba stong bzhugs pa108grub chen nam pakshi'i kurma pa sku phreng lung bstan sku 'dra dang / gser gyi mtshan bcas sman bris lta bur phyag bris gnang ba'i nang mkha' khyab/ rdo rje'i bar dang / de nas bde ba'i rdo rje/ khyab bdag rdo 107

rje/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ mtha' yas rdo rje bcas sku mtshan thams cad rang gi phyag bris109 bla ma rngog pa'i dbu rgyan shing la rnam snang /snang mtha' gnyis bcas110karma pakshi'i sku sked chab ma111 dpal sprul rin po che'i na bza' chen po bla ma bkra shis kyis phul ba112lcags rdor rtse dgu gu ru'i phyag mtshan113 theg mchog rdo rje'i phyag rjes114 chos kyi 'byung gnas115zhwa dmar ye shes snying po116byang chub rdo rje117 chos dbyings rdo rje118 dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhabs rjes che119 mi bskyod rdo rje120 chos grags rgya mtsho121kurma pakhri123 rje dus mkhyen bcas kyi zhabs rjes124rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti bar ma'i thugs dam sgrol ma'i sku li ma padma rā ga'i phra rgyan can125mi la'i yon bdag gshan gdol mo'i dbu thod gser mdog can 'bru gsum rang byon yod pa126 chos rje gling pa'i dbu can gser ljang brdung ma rigs lnga'i sa bon 'bur dod/ mu tig shing lo pa tra dang me tog yod pa127 dgon gyi gzim khang nas kurma pa chos dbyings rdo rje'i dkar yol la blugs pa dam pa rgya gar nag po128nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag bzos lho brag mkhar chu'i nang rten gu ru'i sku tshab a krong padma sa 129pakshi'i thugs dam sgrol ma tsan dkar130bcas ngo mtshar ba mang po mjal to/ /ma byon sangs rgyas drug pa seng 108

ge'i mtshan/ /gtad med 'khrul pa zhig pa'i phyag rjes su/ /gzhu mtshur dbus gtsang gong ma'i gdan sa cher/ gza par grags phrin las ri ltar spungs/ /lam khar par phu dgon chu pha rir yod/ zhig gling gzim khang snang rtse gzhis ku rta rna ri khrod rnams dang skyer mo lung du tshe dpag med zangs gser li nyams thog so gnyis pa 'du khang drug na yod/ li ma byin can sum cu tsam sogs yod/gzhong pa lha chur dgun yang nya mang po yod pa'i o rgyan phyag mkhar gseg shing 'dzugs pa'i chab rka mgo bdun pa zhes chu chen po rked nub tsam shing sdong chen po'i 'og nas babs pa/ nang du nya chen po rtse khru gang pa nas/ mtho gang sa'i bar dang / 'dzub gang bar shin tu mang po yod/ yorgyan mtshan brgyad lha khang mjal/stod lung chu tshur thon nas/ stod lung mchod khang khang sar dmar po'i nang jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje zhag gcig bzhugs/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs sa yin/ rgyal ba'i sku dang / sa 'bum chen po sogs bla sku mi tshad pa mang po yod/ de nas zla11tshes4la lha gdan du brdol nas gzim shag kun bzang rtser ngal gsos so/ /bsil ldan ri bo'i dbus 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan/ /dag pa'i snang 109

bar thugs rje chen po'i zhing / /ma dag 'gro ngor rigs drug tshogs pa'i sa/ /bod kyi lte ba ras 'phrul snang sleb/ /gtsug lag khang 'phrul snang gi dkar chag zhib par kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po'i gsung du shes/seng ldeng sgo mo'i g.yas g.yon jo mdzod yod/ klu khang dzambha la/ 'dzin sa lag mang / dga' ldan lha dzang gi sgo thad du rgyal ba rigs lnga dbu la gser byugs pa chos rgyal phyag nas ma/ phyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang nang du rje yab sras gsum dang / dge ldan bla sku brgyad tsam mi tshad 'jim sku/ phyir 'ang sa paṇa gyis bzhengs brtags pa mchod rten chos rgyal phyag tshwa nang du bzhugs pa sa 'bum sku dkar byugs pa/ lo chen rin bzang / 'ba' ra ba/ phag gru/ sman bla /nga du bde gshegs mched brgyad phyis bzhengs 'jim sku/ phyi ngos chos rgyal phyag bris yig drug gser byugs pa/ phyir mnga' ris pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rje btsun mi la/ bla ma zhang g.yu brag pa/ zhig po bdud rtse/ thub pa'i sku/ ma lo chung skor dpon byang chub sems dpa' bcas/ lcags khra'i nang du rgyal ba skal bzang / paṇa chen bsod grags/ thugs rje chen po'i lha khang sgo thog gi sku 'di rgyal ba klong chen pa'i sku/ bsod nams rgya mtsho rigs gsum mgon po/1/0

gtsang 'ong byang ma thugs rje chen po'i lha khang du/ g.yas nub phyogs zla ba tshal gyi lha srin bgegs 'dul gyi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ dbyangs can ma/ khro gnyer can/ 'jig rten dbang phyug rnams dang / dbus su rang byon lnga ldan ni nang bzhugs 'phags pa'i sku dang / rtsa ba'i sku rang byung dang / chos rgyal yab yum gsum sku rang byon du phebs pa/so ṭa la dmar po nas 'di bar gtso 'khor dgu zhabs thang la phebs pas zhabs gdan mi bzhugs shing / rtsa zhal dang a mi dhe wa ma gtogs khro zhal nyams can/ de'i g.yon du kha sarsha ṇi/ sgrol ma/'od zer can/ 'dre 'dul rta mgrin zhal gsum dbu rta mgo can zhabs g.yas yo ba'i 'og nas ma ṇi bka' 'bum bston pa dang / gang du tshal pa khri dpon gyi 'jam dbyangs dang / phyag rdor bcas/ phyir 'ongs pa na thang stong rgyal po/ dam pa rgya gar/ grub thob birlu pa/kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sgo khang steng dus gsum sangs rgyas bcas/chos rgyal yab yum gyi khrus rdo pad srungs ma/ chos rgyal yab yum gyi khrus sa las zangs dkar lo tsās bzhengs pa'i byams pa khrus mdzad lha khorngo / dang na chos rgyal phyag bris yig drug sku pang na tsandan gyi 'jam dbyangs/ gser gling pa'i thugs dam li dkar tshe dpag med 'jam 111

dbyangs / phyag rdor/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi/ rje tsong kha pa/dkon gnyer legs pa'i shes rab gdung sas g.yogs pa/ sgrol ma'i sku/ che ru rtse'i sdig bshags 'bum/ mnga' ris pa brtson 'grus snying po'i gdung / rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i dus kyi rdo skong bkra shis 'od 'bar/ phyi nas padma gling pas bzhengs pa'i mkhan po bho dhi sa twa/ u rgyan rin po che/ ka ma la shī la/ nee chung ri pa'i sman bla bcas/ tsong kha lha /nga na/ lcags drwa nang sngar slob dpon sku li ma glang dar skabs lcags po ri'i rgyab chu la 'phang pa/ phyis sku stod don pa de mo tshang gis 'don par brtsams pa na chur nub shor te ma don pa'i shul phyis rje tsong kha pa'i sku rje rang gi phyag nas ma/ sa skya theg chen chos rje bcas/ lo chen byang ces bzhengs pa'i kun mkhyen bu ston/ rgyal sras dngul chu thogs med/ sa skya dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ lus srad rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rje kurma pa rang byung rdo rje/ phyag rdor drag po'i sku 'di glang dar skabs gtsug lag 'jig mkhan kha nas khrag skyugs pa'i gnyan po yin/ 'od dpag lha snang na/ 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha dbus su sangs rgyas snang mtha'/ 'khor spyan ras gzigs/ sa snying /sgrib sel/ nam snying / kun bzang / 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/112

byams pa rnams dang / de nas phyir 'ong ba'i khyams na 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha khro bo smi ba brtsegs pa rgya dmag bzlog pa'i byin can/ tshal pa khri dpon gyis bzhengs pa'i rgya lugs kyi chos rgyal yab yum gsum/sangs rgyas mthong ba don yod/ de nas gtsang khang shar jo 'ong dngos kyi sgo la sleb bo/ bsam yas sa phud rgyal chen bzhi/ shing phud ka ba gnyis/ sgo steng rje mi la'i rdzu 'phrul snod g.yag ru/ de nas jo bo shākya mu ne sangs rgyas dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad/ bzhugs khang 'di dwags po sgom tshul gyis bzhings/ g.yas g.yon li las grub pa'i byams pa 'jam dbyangs/ sku rgyab tu sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ spug zangs dkar lo tsās bzhengs pa thub pa gangs chen mtsho/ g.yas g.yon sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis/ khro bo gang ging / phyis gling phyag drug dpon pos bzhengs pa byams pa dang / 'jam dbyangs/rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i sku/ bskor dbon byang chub sems dpa'i gdung /gser kong bcu/ dngul kong chen po nyi shu/ kong chen brgyad sogs/mchod khri rdo chen a mo li ka rje tsong kha pas rag nas bton pa/ gtsang kha nas phyir 'ongs nas/ thub dbang / a ti sha/ 'brom ston/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ rje btsun sgrol ma dar len ma bskor dbon byang chub 113

sems dpa'i sku/ de nas gtsang khang du byams pa chos 'khor deng du li dmar rgyal ba byams pa'i sku rgyal po kṛ kris bzhengs pa bal po'i rten khri btsun bod la phebs skabs lam nas chu brag 'thab par zhabs thang byon pa 'od zer 'phros pa'i rten/ chos rgyal gyis bzhengs pa sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs dang / spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso/ sgo 'gram du khri ral gyis 'u shang phud tshangs pa brgya byin gnyis phyi 'khyams rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ jo nang kun mkhyen dol po/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ seng ge sgra'i lha khong du thub dbang /g.yas su seng ge sgra/ spyan gzigs phyag bzhi pa bcas par 'dir bar khang gsang sgo yod/ u rgyan lha 61 du gtsang dmag dus gzhung pas bzhengs pa'i o rgyan rin po che'i sku gnyis dang / chos rgyal khri srong /nges bris sman rgyal 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha/ 'jim sku dus gsum sangs rgyas/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ dar mo lha 64 sgo lan gnam yol na stag mo lus sbyin pags pa/ dar mo lha khang du/ tshe dpag med la rigs lnga yab yum gyis bskor ba/ tshal pa khri dpon pas bzhengs pa'i chos rgyal yab yum 114

gsum/ mon bza' khri lcam/ sras gung ri gung btsan/ thu mi sasto ṭa/ mgar dam pa zhang blon sna chen po bcas/ yang dngul gyi byams pa chos 'chad lha 6rngo gtsang khang lho ma na/ pasnyi ta tshul khrims nor gyis dngul gar blugs byams pa/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i thugs dam 'jam dbyangs li ma che/ klu mes kyis bzhengs pa kha sarsha ṇi/ sangs rgyas 'od sung phyag nas bcu gcig zhal/ chos rgyal dus bzhengs rdor sems/ stong chen rab 'byams sor 'brang gshin rje mthar byed/padma mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed/ dzam ser/ dzam nag bcas/ ra ma rgya mo dkor gnyer pas dngul len pa/ gnub kyi lha rje dge ba 'bum/ lha khang phyi 'khyams su/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i phyag tsha bzhugs pa'i mchod rten padma spungs pa/ birlu pa/ sa chen kun dga' snying po bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/lho sgo me long can lha 6/ du bsgyur ba phyis bzhengs tshe dpag lha dgu 'jim mi tshad/ logs bris la 'jam dbyangs nga gzur gsung 'byon ma/ rje btsun sa paṇa/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/ sa skya'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yang sbug lha 6nge du sangs rgyas rab bdun dngul sku/ ngos bris na po ta la chags 115

tshul sogs yod/ khug der 'od zer 'phros payi lha sems nyid ngal bso/ 'khor tshe dpag lha dgu/ thugs smon lha 6rji du chos rgyal mes dbon gsum/ rgya bza'/ bal bza'/ sras gnyis/ blon po mgar/ thu mi bcas/ rgyun du mi btang ba'i klu khang lho byang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ klu dga' bo/ nyer dga'/ gnod sbyin ku bee ra/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/ ma hā ka la/ srin po ling ka mgrin bcu rnams dang / seng ldeng sgo phyi ma'i nang lho byang du ge re lha pas bzhengs pa'i byang na trag shad dang / phyag rdor/ lho na drel zhon dang / rta mgrin bzhugs/ jo bo rin po che nyid da lta nub bal por gzigs/rang byon lnga ldan zhal lhor gzigs/dkyil 'khor lding du ba bzhi byams pa dang / mi dbang byams pa gser zangs chen po thog so gsum pa gnyis/ gser zangs kyikhang /li ma lha khang / lho na sman bla'i lha khang / nag po skor gsum/ se ra sngags pa tshogs pa'i khang stong kha shas/ nub khyams ri'i bzhugs khri g.yas/ chos rgyal gsol thab khro sogs/jo khang bar khang shar byams pa chos 'khor dbu thog khel bar u rgyan rin po che gu ru mtshan bcad/ sgo khar 'od zer 'phros pa'i dpal 116

lha mo/ dus 'khor lha khang gi rsha/ dpal lha spyogs gsang sgo 'dir yod/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra la sku sna tshogs can lha seng / thub dbang nye sras brgyad lha khaji / sman bla bde gshegs brgyad lha /nga /rta mgrin yang gsang sku 'dom shin tu legs pa sgo 'gram 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha sgrol dkar/ kurma pa'i thub chen chos sde nas drangs pa'i li sku thub pa thog so gcig ka bar bya khri spyan gcig rgyal po/ de nas rdo rje brag sa mgon blar sdod pa'i sku lnga'i rgyal blang / thang rgyal slob ma bla ma dung dkar 'brug grags kyis bzhengs pa'i chos rgyal yab yum/sras gung ri gung btsan sonas rgyal srid sna bdun/ chos rgyal lha khang (/sangs rgyas rab bdun chos rgyal phyag nas ma/ chos rgyal li sku/ chos rgyal 'khrungs bem ste chang dam ri dwags can dngul snod yer pa bar sgo nas gter bzhes pa/ sgo 'gram 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha rta mgrin/gtso bor spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ma 'khor thub drug gis bskor ba nyang gi 'gro 'dul lha 6pa / dpal lha cog tu 'gro ba dang /khang 'go 117

'gro ba'i gsang sgo 'dir yod/ rgyun du mi 'gro ba'i bla sku lha /pri na/sgo 'gram chos rgyal phyag btab mchod rten dkar po brgya rtsa/ ma ṇi 'khor lo la chos rgyal phyag 'khor yod zer/ byang ngos rgyun du mi 'byed pa'i li ma lha 64 dang / yang lha ṇi/ gtis/ shar na rje yab sras gsum sku/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sku sogs yod pa chos rgyal gsam sgrug phyi khyams na them spangs yi ge chos pod mang po yod/ jo bo'i dbu thog thog so gsum par stong pa'o/ /thog khang byang la lha khang gsum yod de mi ru bas bca' ga bcug pas ma thar/ shar na dkyil 'khor blos bslong lha khang na rgya bza'i zhabs chags/ stag mo lus sbyin pags pa/ 'od srung ce'igs sogs nang rten/ dngul sbyin dgos/ dbus su jo bo'i rgya pheb dbu rtse/ mi ru bas 'cham khang lha khang / dpal lha cog tu chos rgyal phyag bzos dpal lha zhi ba dang / dang du drag mo lho na lha khang gsum rgyun du zhal mi 'byed/ nub na lha khang gser sku sna tshogs pa gcig dang / gnas bcu brag ri/ blos bslang khang / thugs rje chen po'i gser tog 'og tshal pa'i gnyer bkra shis kyi shāka thub/ sman bla mched brgyad/ jo bo'i dbu thog nye bar dpon dbang btsan gyi rgyal ba rigs lnga/ mi 'gro 118

gsung 'byon/ 'khor sems dpa' brgyad bcas/ dkon gnyer 'bras spungs sngags pa/ rmi ru ba/ bzhi sde ba bcas khyon sum cu tsam/ thog khar lho nub rkarma pa bco lngas gsar btsugs mtshur phu ba'i tshe ring mgon khang / gser g.yab lnga/ gser zangs mda' yab bcas so/ /'og na skyabs mgon rin po che'i gzim chung sogs yod/seng ldeng sgo rgyab rdo chen a mo li ka/ jo bo'i dbu skra ljon shing / rje tsong kha pa'i lcags drwa can/ 'og gsang sgo khang pa zhig nas mtsho rdzas 'phen sa yod skad/ lho sgo ni g.yas 'phen po lang zhal gzigs byams khang 'di sa dpyad la gnod ces gter ston 'ga'i gter lung du gsal/ de nas ka ni sgo bzhi thugs chen yang snying 'dus pa'i 'dzum grol dharma seng gis bzhengs/ ma ṇi dung 'khor lha khang gnyis na tshe dpag dang / slob dpon sku bcas/ra mo che na sgo khar rdo gcal steng shing paṇa rten mkhar sgo khar rgyal chen sde bzhi che/ lho na mgon po seng gdong ma/ gri gug phyag bzhi pa/ byang ngos g.yu sgron ma/ rgyun stod pa'i 'du khang chen mor rgyud pa lnga brgya gding ba lhung bzed bcas/ sbug tu gtsang khang sgor rgyal chen bzhi/ gtsug lag dngos na dbus ston pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad chos rgyal dus bzhengs 1/9

pa/ sgo g.yas g.yon phyag rdor dang dbyug sngon can/ tsandan sgrol ma/rje tsong kha pa'i 'dra sku phyag nas ma/ mchog zung gi gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bcas/ thog khar gser g.yab mdog legs/po ta lar jo bo lo gi shwa ra/ rje btsun grags pa mdze thod ma/ kha che paṇa chen rdza sku/ manda ra ba'i thugs dam phyag bzo'i gu ru'i sku/gung thang la kha'i zhabs rjes ya/ rgyal ba lnga pa'i 'dra zhal sogs lha dzang / 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i gser gdung seng / lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i gser gdung 7nga / gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig ni thog bzhi pa'i rin chen gser gyi mchod sdong gzi 'od 'bar dri/ tshom chen sbug tu kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po'i sku dus kyi mtshan brgyad lha ḍang /gsang bde 'jigs gsum blos bslang khang gsum brtsis shes/ dus 'khor blos bzhing / sman bla'i pho rbersha / skyabs mgon 'di pas bzhengs pa'i bcu gcig zhal lha khang bkyus/ las zhib par ma mjal lo/ /bstan rgyas gling pa'i shul yang mi mngon/ kun bde gling dha tshags pho brang dang / tshe smon gling dang / rwa bsgreng gi bzhi sde bla brang 120

dang / mi ru gsar rnying bcas ma bkod pa 'og tu bri/lcags po rir lha khang phyi nang steng 'og bzhi/ grub chen gyi gser dngul byi ru dung sogs kyi sku thams cad dang / sman bla'i pho brang gser dngul las byas pa sogs zhib par mjal/ gzhung gi sman grwa/zhang blon dang / dam can mgon khang bcas/nyang ban 'ja' lus grub pa'i brag lha klu spug tu sgo se ra pa zhig snang / phug tu song nas tshogs phul/se ra theg chen gling / smad pa'i 'du khang / sngags pa'i sngags khang / se ra byes rta mgrin khang / 'dar 'phyar phur pa bcas/tshogs chen 'du khang / rtser li khar shing 'phel gyi dge slong dpal mo'i thugs chen bcu gcig zhal mi tshad li ma sogs dang / byams chen dang /a rig grub thob khang bcas/ se rar gser g.yab bzhi/ rgyal mtshan gser tog drug cu tsam yod/'bras spungs nas sgo mang 'du khang ka ba brgya pa gsar bzhengs/sog sku zangs gser sgrol ma nyer gcig mi tshad/ rje rin po che mtho gang stong sku gsar bzhengs sogs mjal/ gtsug lag nges legs/spus dag blo gsal gling 'du khang gsar pa ka ba brgya pa tshon brkos zhal ba shin tu spus dag dga' ldan pho brang du sgrol ma khang / tshogs 121

chen ka ba brgya pa'i 'du khang / thog khar lha khang khag thams cad/khyad par dpe cha lcags khra'i nang / dpe rnying mang po'i gdong mjal/rnying ma'i yig rnying mang po snang / bka' 'gyur ba so'i gdong can dang rnying rgyud mang / 'jam dbyangs lha khang / sngags khang ra lo'i gdung mes bzhus shul gsar bzhengs nyag re khang tshan/ har sdong / bsam blo rnams su rten 'ga' re/ bde yang gi 'du khang rten gsum sogs mjal/ 'bras spungs gser g.yab gsum/ rgyal mtshan gser tog drug cu tsam yod/ zhib par phur lcogs byams pa'i dkar chag ltar ra 'phrod pas zhib par ma bris/ gnas chung sgrol ma nyer gnyis gcig cha gnyis sde srid dang / phun rab pa'i spus ka can gnyis sogs yod/lha lung ri khrod kyi dpal rdor phug tu rje 'bangs nyer lnga brag ri ma/ nyang bran se ra pha bong khar 'og na chos rgyal gzim phug na chos rgyal yab yum/ thub sku/ g.yu sgron sogs/ rtser lha khang du rdo sku yid bzhin nor bu rigs gsum gcig 'dus/ thub sku li ma/ chos rgyal sku sogs dang li ma mang / mgon khang sbug na 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i sku/ dpal 'byor lhun grub dmar gdung lnga pa'i sku sogs/ phyag drug pa byin ldan/ gong du lcogs ser po'i nang gzigs pa lnga ldan lha khang /gu ru mtshan brgyad/ srong btsan sku sogs/ steng gi brag dbu la 122

gdugs kyi tshul lo/ /rgya 'bum sgang du zhi khro'i lha khang gsar bzhengs na/ rje mkhyen kong gnyis/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa/ zhi drag seng gsum/ dam pa rig brgya'i 'dam sku legs/ bla ma dharma seng ge'i phrin las las byung ba'o//brag ler pa na/ bla ma lha khang du rje tsong khar pa yab sras gsum sku yod pa der sdod/ ltag na yer pa ku ma ra budhe'i gdung rus mchod rten snang / yer pa bla brang lha khang ka ba nyi shu sar/ rjo po'i 'dra sku 'jim yon dang / 'brom rngog jo bo'i thugs dam sgrol ma li ma khyad 'phags mtho gang lhag ma ṇi ril bu'i zhu yul spyan gzigs li ma phyag bzhi pa/ nang du nor bu chu shel yod pa rkun mas bcom pas 'dir drangs 'dug bka' 'gyur cha gcig jo bo'i gsol lder gla gor zho sha yin zer kyang shing rdzab 'dra ba rkang gsum pa khru gang tsam pa'i nang 'dra zhal phyag bris ma/ khang steng du skyabs mgon gzim khang na li ma chen po nyi shu tsam pa/ de'i phyi rol du jo po'i thugs dam li ma chen po bcu tsam dang / 'jim sku che ba bcu tsam/ bka' gdams gdung rten chen po bzhi tsam/ yang gdung byin rlabs can/ 'og tu 'jigs byed/phyag drug pa thang dmar sogs mgon khang / de nas yar gyen la 'dzegs te yer pa sgrol ma'i sku dbyibs yod pa'i nu ma g.yas kyi thad/123

jo bo a ti sha'i gzim phug rten 'brel phug ces nyams dga' bar jo 'brog rngog gsum gyi 'jim sku byin ldan/ bar 'dir phug pa 'ga' 'dug kyang mtshams pa 'gas bzung ba tho ma bkral/ yer pa'i grub thob brgyad cu lhan bzhugs par khams dmar ston gyis bzhengs/ yer pa'i byams khang na byams pa thog so mtho gnyis/ 'khor nye sras brgyad dang / sgo srung khro bo gnyis/ dmar ston rang gi 'dra zhal/ de nas srong btsan sgrub phug tu brag gi nang nas par phyin pas dbus su srong btsan gyis bzhengs thub sku mi tshad ltag bskor lam bcas/ phug tu dha dbu rang byon/ rigs gsum rang byon/ zhabs brtan tshe chog gsung mkhan grwa bzhi sde/ phug sa'i nang sbug tu srong btsan sgam po'i sku shin tu byin ldan de'i 'og tu lha lung dpal rdor gyis bzhengs dpal lha cog tu mdor ma gcig dpal lha/ gnam lcags phur pa chen po dang 'jim sku mang / thag tu dus gsum sangs rgyas/ u rgyan padma/ dpal rdor rang sogs dpal rdor dus kyi bzo rnying / de'i 'og tu spe'u dmar ser na 'jim sku mang tsam sde pa stag rtse bas bzhengs/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i nu ma g.yon ngos mtshams brag gi them skas mthon por brtsigs pa'i steng nas yar 'dzegs pas u rgyan rin po che'i sgrub phug zla ba phugabrag u rgyan rin po che'i kha ṭwāṃ gyis rjes rnam thar sgo gsum/ nang du u /24

rgyan sku rnying / u rgyan sku rjes brag la yod/ phyag mdzub kyis phug pa'i sgo btod pa/ phug tu u rgyan sku mi tshad shin tu byin che ba/ gsar bzhings drag seng gnyis mi tshad tshugs legs/ mdor na mar gzhung gis phyis bzhengs gu ru mtshan brgyad mi tshad 'jim sku sgros ldan/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs/ dge lugs pa 'gas dkon spyi'i tshogs lam tsam btang 'dug ka ba drug can lha khang nyams skyid nges/ de nas rdo rje dang / dril bu phug rnams 'dug rtser u rgyan rin po che'i padma phug brag g.yang bgrod dka'i nges yod pa dang / mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gsang phug dag tu 'gro ma nus/ rgyang nas mjal/ yer bar da lta phug pa brgyad cu las lhag pa snang / de nas mar ring tsam phyin par klu mes 'brom chung gis rgya nag nas gdan drangs pa'i zhal thang nang gzhug yer pa'i gnas bcu khang du/ dbus su thub dbang thog so mtho nges gcig sngon gyi bzo rnying gnas bcu rgya nag ma bag dro mi tshad re/ rgyal chen ha tar bcas/ mdor dam can mgon khang / de nas yer ba'i lha ri de'u 'bur sgrol ma'i zhabs g.yon nyams dga' skor dur khrod nas tshur 'ong / jo bo yab sras bzhugs khri dang / lha khang na bka' 'gyur gser bris mthor ma dang / jo 'brom sogs 'jim sku che tsam nyi shu tsam/ de nas tshur 'ong / jo bo'i gzim khang dngos na a ti 125

sha shin tu byin ldan/ de'i phar tsam ltag na ba rang lha khang klu mes slob ma dzog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis bzhengs tshe dpag la nye sras brgyad/ khro bo sgo srung gnyis bcas bum thang rtsis lha khang dang 'dra zer ba thog so mthon po rer sleb pa'i lha khang byin che ba/ 'og tu yig drug lha khang na/ rdo sngon la rdo dkar gyis yig drug rang byon shin tu mtshar ba/ chos rgyal yab yum sras blon po rnams bcas sku re/ bar 'dir rje btsun ma'i gsang gnas gyi bdud rtsi yin pa'i 'bab chu/phar tshur rgyud smad grwa tshang gis gsang bde 'jigs gsum thig sbyang ba'i rdo ra 'ga'/ de phar rje btsun sgrol ma'i bus g.yas mgor phyin pas rgyal ba rin po che'i 'khrungs rab lha khang 'jim sku nyi shu tsam mda' gang ba/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i 'dra zhal kyang yod/ rgyud pa'i 'du khang lte ba sngon gyi dur khrod rnying pa yin zer/ ka ba nyi shu pa/nang gnas bcu nges bris/ gsang bde'i thig tshad re mchod dpon pas bris 'dug kyang ngo tsha'o/ /sbug tu jo 'brom rnam gsum rje yab sras sogs shel sgo na'o/ /jo bo'i bzod sgom rten gyi a tsa ra'i spur 'jim pas g.yogs pa red kyang zer/ 'dra zhal red kyang zer ba mi tshad tsam/ chos ra/ khang tshan drug rnams yod/ byams khang thog gser g.yab mdog legs 'di sogs jun gar gyis smin gling gtor 126

dus kyi smin gling gser g.yab red zer/ mar ring du phabs pas yer/ sa gtsug rum 'bar ba'i dgas shing se ba'i gling / thag tu bee ro tsa nas btsun mo dmar rgyan la mdze btang ba'i phug brag g.yang bgrod dka'i dbus na yod/ dkar chag rgyas par zur du gsal lo/yer pa nas mar phyin pas g.yas na mchod rten ser po kha shas yod pa'i thad de'i lung phur grub thob 'dar 'phyar gyis rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa gter nas bzhes pa'i se ba lung yod do/ /gtsang po'i tshu rir tshal gung thang du sleb pas/ bla ma zhang gi gdan sa tshal pa bka' brgyud rim par byon/ tshal pa khri dpon gyi shul bar skabs stong ste zur chos dbyings rang grol gyi bdag 'dzin mdzad/ gzhung gi mkhan po'ang brkos/ da lta sa lugs dgon chung grwa nyi shu tsam/ zhang tshal pa'i bka' brgyud dge ldan 'dres pa grwa nyi shu tsam gnyis bcas/ lte ba'i bla brang bka' blon kun bzang rtses bdag 'dzin byed/ bla brang khyams chen ka ba so lnga pa/ sgo thab g.yas g.yon rnam sras thog gnyis pa'i mgon khang / de nas tshal pa si tus bzhengs pa'i tshe dpag med li ma thog so mtho nges gnyis pa/ mar mi/ dwags po/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs 'jim sku mi tshad bcu bdun/ bka' 'gyur gser chos/ bstan 'gyur spar ma/ zur chen 127

chos dbyings rang grol dngul gdung chen po bcas lha khang gcig de'i gong tu bla ma zhang nga 'dra ma sku tshad li ma bag dro hur chags pa li dkar bzhugs khang bcas/ g.yas g.yon bka' brgyud gser phreng mi tshad bdun tsam 'jim sku can lha khang gnyis/ sbrug tu tshal pa khri dpon gyi thub chen 'jim sku thog gsum pa la/ mar me mdzad byams pa gnyis dang / nye ba'i sras brgyad thog sleb mtho nges res bskor ba/ sgo srung khro bo gnyis bcas/ g.yon sbug lha khang na me rdugs rje btsun sgrol ma rgya gar shar li mi tshad/ thub sku li ma mi tshad che/ yang mda' gang tsam sa gsum/ dbus su bla ma zhang gi gdung rten bka' gdams li ma sas g.yogs pa thog sleb/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs 'dam sku mi tshad re brag ri ma/ spug tu phyag stong spyan stong thog so gcig pa dang /lū yi pa'i lugs bde mchog gi sku thog so ma/de nas mar lha khang gcig tu/ byams pa thog gnyis ma 'jim/sman bla bde gshegs mched brgyad/ rgyal ba rin po che'i sku phreng kha shas/ rta mgrin yang gsang sgrub/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum mi tshad 'dam sku bcas/ sgo g.yon phyag bzhi pa thog gnyis/ las mgon bya rog gdong can bcas pa'i mgon khang / khyams la sangs rgyas stong nges bris/ rtser skyabs mgon dang / bod rgyal po'i gzim chung du li 128

ma mang tsam re/ yang gzim chung gsum na'ang rten sna tshogs/grong gsham 'og tu zhang gi gzim phug tu zhang gi sku byin can sogs sku kha shas/ bder gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ rta mgrin mchod rten/ sri gcod 'bum pa/ mchod rten ser po'i nang phyogs bzhir lha khang bzhi la/ shar du thub dbang li ma thog so mtho nges lho nub byang du rigs bzhi gzhan rnams 'jim sku/ 'khor kun rigs rtsa lha so bdun mi tshad re 'jim sku/ rtser bskal pa'i mar me zer te nor bu shel tog las dbyar zla ba drug par me 'bar ba ltar 'byung zer/de nas mar 'ong bas grib tshe mchog gling / dgon pa'i bzod bkod spus shin tu dag rtser yongs 'dzin gzim chung nang mar klong brdol bla ma'i thugs dam sgrol ma gsung 'byon/ mdor lcang skyas phul ba'i rgya rag zi ma 'ga' sogs mdo drug gsum/ dpe cha mang tsam/'du khang ka ba nyi shu pa spus dag rgyan bkod pa bcas/ gtsang khang du zul phu zhig pa'i thub sku li ma bzang po thog so mtho nges gsum/bka' gdams mchod rten thog so gnyis/ rtser zhal ras lha khang gnas bcu byin rlabs can dang li sku sum cu tsam/ dpe cha mang ye shes rgyal mtshan dmar gdung 'jim g.yogs ma sogs/ dbang khang na rgyas bcom shul li ma brgya lhag tsam/ bka' chos lha khang du bka' 129

'gyur/ lo gi shwa ra sogs lha sku li ma kha yar/ gnas bcu lha khang du gnas bcu mi tshad 'dam sku spus dag thang ka ker gsum pa spus dgartser gser tog che chung gsum/ gser gyi rgyal mtshan rnying pa gnyis/sog po rgyal mtshan gsar pa bzhi/ chos rwa dkyil du ka chen gdung rten yin zer ba'i rdo'i mchod rten gser mdog can zhig kyang snang /gsung 'bum pod bcu drug spar yod/de nas brgal 'ong ba na grong pa zhig nang zhing nang nas thon pa'i rdo sku spyan ras gzigs rang byon/ chos rgyal srong btsan gyis byin gyis rlobs pa'i khyad 'phags/ de nas lung pa ring po zhig gi phur phyin pas gsang phu ne'u thog 'og na ba/ steng spang gdong zhig sngar dgon chen da lta grong nag par song ba/ phug 'brog pa sdod pa'i yu la/ dbus rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku dus khyams ka ba so lnga pa zhig gsos gsar mdzad nges bris/ phyed rnying phyed gsar mdor khyams chen/ zhug na ka ba bcu gnyis pa'i lha khang dbus su mchod khris bskor ba bya lo ba'i dbus rngog lo'i sku/ jo bo 'brom gyi sku phywa pa chos seng / sa paṇa sogs bla sku bcu lhag mi tshad 'jim sku/ 'jam dbyangs rtsod rgyal rgya gar li ma mi tshad/ mdun du sgrol ma rtsod rgyal khru gang pa li ma khyad 'phags/yu la wa rā ṇa si nas gdan drangs pa'i thub sku byams pa lo brgyad pa'i 130

tshad dang / bcu gnyis pa'i tshad khyon bcu bdun/ dge phyogs bla ma 'ga'i gdung rten dngul gdung chen po sogs gdung 'dra zhal kha shas rngog lo'i zhabs chags/ g.yas su bse khrab pa'i mgon khang / de nas yar rgyab ngos su rngog lo'i thugs dam them spangs mar grags pa'i bka' chos gser ma pod rgyab ya ma brgya dang sum cu tsam snang / zhug tu gtsang khang ka ba brgyad ma thub pa dngul sna ma zer te rgya gar li ma thog so gcig thub sku tshul khrims ma rgya gar li ma thog so gcigabaka' gdams gdung rten li ma thog so ma bzhi/ mi tshad tsam pa drug yang gdung rten kha shas/ chos brtsigs pod sum brgyar nye ba/ bskor lam bcas rtser rgyal po'i mgon khang / rgyal ba'i gzim chung mdo spug gsar pa/ bstan 'gyur khang phug na thang chen rnying pa bcas/ gling stod pa 'dogs pa'i ra ba zhig nas steng bar khang phug kun mkhyen rong ston sku 'dra mi tshad/ yang tshur ngos su ra ba ba glang khang 'dra ba'i sgrug g.yas pa'i gzim phug 'dra zhal bcas/ dga' ldan byang rtse nyi thang /rnam rgyal gser khang ba sogs sa dge'i bla khag bcu'i grwa mang na stong /nyung na lnga brgya tsam tshogs nas dbyar chos rtags gsal zla ba bzhin tshugs zer/ dus rgyun grong pa ngan pa zhig snang / sngon mkhas pa mang po tshogs pa'i gling / da lta grong pa tha chad du song ba yid skyo/ dgon 131

gsham der blo ldan shes rab kyi gdung rten dang / de nas rgyang ring gsang mdar phyin nas/ lha khang g.yu jo can du rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi gdung rten sa 'bum chen po zhig kyang snang ngo / /de nas ring du phyin te la la 'dzegs pas/ thog mar la sked snyi phu shug gseb tu 'u shang rten gtso thub sku li ma thog so mtho nges /bka' gdams gdung rten li ma thog so sleb pa gnyis/ bka' chos tshang ba gcig dang ma tshang ba gser bris/ sku li ma gzungs gzhug nyams pa kha shas/ phag gru'i slob ma gyer sgom chos seng sku/ 'di dngos ni bka' gdams pa rgya ma dbon ston gyer sgom pa de'o/ /rigs 'dus dang / yum ma'i sku mi tshad sems nyid stobs ldan dang a ṇi lo chen gyis bzhengs pa/ steng du rta khyung 'bar ba dang / rgyal ba klong chen pa'i sku/ sgrub khang mang tsam/ shus pa gnyis bcas snang ngo / /de nas yar ring tsam 'dzigs te phyin pas/ ri mgor spang dang shug pa spa ma/de mtshams glang tsher skyes pa/se ba sogs kyis brgyan cing /sma na sna tshogs skyes ba/ pha ri na sur dkar skye ba/ gangs ri thod dkar te/ deng sang gi dgun yang la rtser kha ba cher mi snang ba/ da lta rgya gar mi yi rjes la tshad pa bod du sleb rab zer bas la na/ sgang stod la ri rdo rje phag mo'i dbyibs yod zer/ lha khang ka bzhi mar spug tu kun 13 2

mkhyen 'dra zhal ldan sgom bzod pas bzhengs pa phyag nas ma mda' gang / u rgyan rin po che'i sku kun mkhyen gyis bzhengs zer yang phyis kyi sku nyams can byin chags/ g.yon du bka' brgyud phag gru yin zer yang shug gseb gyer sgom mam u rgyan pa 'dra yang gong na rigs gsum mgon po/ g.yas gter bdag gling pa paṇa zhu can/ khang pa 'di phyis rtse drung byams pa zer bas zhig gsos byas zer/ smin gling bla grwa bcus tshe sgrub yang snying kun 'dus sha stag btang / 'og tu gza' dang sngags srung g.yu sgron gnas pa'i shug sdong gnyis/ bya wang nag po mang pos tshang bca'/ sbug kun tu bzang po'i khang bzang zla ba chu shel phug yin pa'i gzim phug nyams skyed por gnas chung phrin las zer bas/'chos skad khang pa'ang snang / g.yas ngos me long phug ces pa/ me long rdo rje'i gzim phug red kyang zer/ yin pa kun mkhyen rang gi gzim phug skyid po zhig kyang snang / yang lung pa phug pha gi'i ri'i ngos su shar gzim phug pa'ang yod par snang ste bgrod dka' bas ma sleb bo/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i gang zag rnams/ /nye bar zhi ba'i ri ngogs su/ /lhag pa'i bde ba 'di 'dra ba/ /lha yul dag na'ang med dam snyam/ /dben pa'i ri ngogs bsam gtan rang babs su/ /'khrungs pa'i gnas bzang nyams dga' 'byor pa can/ /ci 'di sngon chad 133

'khor ba'i nags klung na/ /rgyu ba sus kyang ma mthong e ma mtshar /kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsang gsum byin rlabs khur/ /lhun sdug rdzogs ldan sprin gyis ba gam nas/ /zhi bsil byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i do shal gyis/ /skal ldan mgul pa mdzes par bcings 'di rmad/ /de nas mtsho sna gzhis ka brgyud tshe smon gling pa'i rdzong gi gong tsam nas chu pha rir don nas snye thang du slebs pas/ gong du sgrol ma lha khang ka ring brgyad pa na lcags khra'i nang / mnyam med jo bo'i thugs dam 'bras spungs gdung rten/ gser gling pa'i thugs dam thub sku red zer kyang rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam yin 'dra ba dang / jo bo'i thugs dam sgrol ma li ma mkhyid gang tsam sogs rten byin can 'ga' gzhung gi dam 'byar/ jo bo'i mkhar bsil lhung bzed snam sbyar sogs nang gzhug tu yod pa'i bka' gdams mchod rten li ma mi tshad gsum/ ston pa thub dbang li ma shin tu bzang po mi tshad gcig sog lha bzang gis bzhengs/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo gtsos sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig zangs gser mi tshad che nges spus dag go/ /bka' 'gyur dang / 'bum sogs gser chos skya bris ma tshang ba pod nyis brgya tsam/ de'i rgyab logs ka brgyad ma'i lha khang du thub dbang nye sras brgyad/ sgo srung khro bo gnyis bcas mi tshad 'jim sku/ sngon gyi tshugs 134
