rnying / dbus su jo bo chen po'i 'dra sku mi tshad bcas/ maṇḍal bzhi chog gsungs pa'i grwa bzhi sde 'og tu lha khang ser po'i nang / dbus su jo bo 'byom rngog thub sku bcas 'jim bzo/ g.yas su sa 'bum ser po sgo mang mchod rten rtsis med pa lta bu de jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i gdung 'bum/ g.yon gyi dkar po chen po de sa skya dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i gdung 'bum mo/ /'dzin bdag sa skya pa'i dgon chung ra smad dgon lag zhig gis byed pa yin/de nas chu tshur don nas slar yang phyin pas 'u shang rdor sleb/sngon gyi logs re la 'dom lnga brgya re yod pa/ rtse dgu thog yin cing /bye 'bur gyi ri de dang mnyam pa lha sa bsam yas gnyis las lhag pa lta bu yod pa glang dar gyis 'jig shul da lta sde pa gzhung gis rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho 'di'i sku ring nyams gsos gnang ba/ lha khang ka brgyad/ dbus thub dbang li ma shin tu nyams mtshar thog so mtho nges zhal ras legs pa la dpe med pa li dkar/ rgyal ba bcu gsum pa'i yab gzhis yum gyi rgyan kha tshang gis dbu brgyan phul ba red zer ba dbu rgyan mu tig dang g.yu bzang can gsol 'dug 'khor thog so mtho nges re'i tshad dus gsum sangs rgyas/ nye sras brgyad/ sgo srung khro bo gnyis bcas/ mdor dga' ldan byang rtse ba sman bla'i mdo chog gsung mkhan 135

dang / shel grong gsang sngags gling grwa bzhi sde res zla ba bzhir sman bla gsungs/ gser g.yab rdza gyo 'dres ma dang / mthar rdo ring /mchod rten bcas/de nas bod kyi ri bo rtse lnga chos nor gyi gter kha du mas brgyan pa zangs yag nams mkha' brag lag sor bkram 'dra bar gsungs pa'i rgyab ngos kyi brag them ring po zhig brgal te/ 'og na gu ru'i sgrub phug dbus 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal sman 'jim mdun du ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sku/ de'i g.yas su rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sku/g.yon du phyis shel grong sa skya'i bla ma zhig gi sku bcas mi tshad re/ sbug stegs la gu ru jo tse sku tshab bye ma a grong can thugs mar shel sgo nang bzhugs pa'i gu ru'i sku mi tshad byin rlabs phul gyur mda' gang pa/ gu ru mtshan brgyad rtse khru gang pa re'i 'jim sku/ steng mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi gzim phug tu slob dpon chen po sku li ma khru gang pa dang /mtsho rgyal sku de tsam/ rgyab ngos gu ru jo tse'i sgrub phug tu gu ru'i sku snang srid zil gnon tshad cung ma lang ba gsum/ bdud dpung zil gnon gcig mtsho rgyal/ manda ra khru gang pa gnyis/ rigs byed ma mda' gang /mchod rten gnyis bcas/ spyir brag nges la gter rtags/gter sgo mang tsam/ jo rtses las phur brgya rtsa drangs pa'i shul sgrub phug tu yod zer/136

gnas 'di 'brug yongs 'dzin gyis gnas bdag mdzad/ bag dro byin chags kyang a no mang bas mi skyid/ chu gtsang po nas len dgos pas shin tu thag ring / ri 'di'i rtse ya tshad na da dung gu ru'i sgrub phug khyad 'phags yod par snang yang ma sleb/de nas shel grong gsang sngags gling dgon chung paṇa chen gtsug tor zer ba'i shug ri'i gsham na nyams skyid par snang /bar zhag gcig skyid par byung / de'i 'khris der kun mkhyen she'u rong pa'i mchod khang zer ba'i grong pa nang lha khang dus gsum sangs rgyas/byang sems brgyad/sgo srung gnyis bcas/kur gyi mgon khang yod par snang /de nas chu brgal te zla12tshes20la dpal chu bo ri'i lcags zam bla brang phyin par gyur to/ /'og tu thang stong rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i lcags zam/ zam khang nang lcags thag dpung pa tsam bzhi thel/ rdo yi byang chung mchod rten thog so lnga ba'i seng khrir rgyal chen sde bzhi mi tshad sa sku re/ shar nas skas them bcu bdun brgal/bum pa nang grub thob smug po nga 'dra ma phyag bzos khru gang / steng grub thob gter ma bye ma a krong gu ru paṇa zhu rdo rje/ bharnya can mtho gang lhag thub pa/ jo bo/ phyis 'dod bar gyi u rgyan/grub thob bcas gser zangs/ spyan ras gzigs mi tshad dang /grub thob mi tshad 'dam/mtshal la gser bris kyi grub thob 137

brgya/ 'du khang sbug gtsang khang ka bzhi mar/ grub thob rang bzhengs li ma dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dom gang re/ gtso bo lha sa'i jo bo la dpe blangs pa 'dra nges bzhugs khang rgya gar ga la/sa'i nye sras brgyad dang /sgo srung gnyis mi tshad re/padma sa / g.yas bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub sku dge slong sa zhu mnab pa rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i gser dngul bkra ma'i gdung / blo bzang chos ldan gong ma'i gdung gser zangs/g.yon nas bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po'i gdung bum pa dngul/ gzhan gser zangs/ kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug dngul gdung 'di rnams mi langs tshad/ ka bar grub thob thang rgyal/ sa ra habarlu pa gnyis 'drar bzhengs pa khru gang pa re/kṣe tra pa la'i rten thuga'adu khang ka dgu ma'i sbug g.yas mnga' ris rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rjes bzhengs pa zangs gser thub sku 'dom gang lhag g.yon du thang rgyal sku mi 'gyur ma sku tshad/rdo rje 'chang mi tshad/bka' 'gyur gser bris grub thob rang dus rnying rgyud pod gsum dang mang tsam spus shin tu dag bka' 'gyur skya bris g.yas ngos grub thob thang stong zangs gser mi tshad/ thub sku li ma khru gang / chos 'phags li ma khru gang / bde mchog li ma khru gang sogs sku 'thor nyi shu tsam/ yang slob dpon 'jim sku mi tshad tsam bcas/ gtsang khang bskor lam yod/138

byang du grub thob kyis bzhengs lha khang ka ba bzhi mar/ rten ge la sa yis byas pa'i nang / dbus su dpal mo lugs bcu gcig zhal mi lang tshad li ma yan lag phyag so brgyad bcas/g.yas su rgyal po lugs/g.yon du klu sgrub lugs/lo ki shwa ra/bcu gcig zhal yan lag phyag so brgyad pa gnyis 'jim sku de 'dra ba re/grub thob kyi byams khang ka bzhi mar/ byams pa sa nang mar btsud pa'i sku thog so mtho nges gcigabyams pa phyag rdor 'dom phyed do pa re/gcod yul ma lab sgron sogs ris med bla ma brgyud pa mda' tshad nyer lnga snang mtha' mi tshad bcas 'jim sku/ bka' 'gyur bris ma cha gcigathang rgyal rang sku mi 'dra ba/grub thob rin po che'i dbang khang ka ba bcu gnyis mar/ khri rgyab yol bcas pa'i gu ru'i srog zhu rgyal po'i chas can mda' tshad gtso 'khor gsum/ thugs sras bstan 'dzin rin po che'i sku phreng dgu'i 'dra zhal bzhugs khri bcas mda' gang re/zhug shang pa rin chen bdun dang /ni gu ma/ grub thob sogs bla sku bcu gcig 'dam sku shin tu sgros rtse khru gang pa/brag ri sangs rgyas dgu bcas/mgon khang phyag drug pa'i mgon sku/gur/zhal sogs bdun/rgyal chen sku lnga sogs/g.yon du de mtshungs sku bcu gnyis brag ri sangs rgyas dgu bcas/shang chos kyi gser phreng u 139

rgyan spyan gsum pa khams gsum zil gnon/phag gru khri bcas/grub thob kyi sku khri bcas/tshe dpag med bcas/bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub tshom ka gnyis mar/grub thob gser zangs sku rtse khru gang pa/ phag mo sle'u chung ba rtse khru gang pa gnyis/ bde mchog sku de 'dra gnyis/bum sku gcig li ma sogs sku 'dra dang /bka' gdams mchod rten drug cu skor/ rgyas re zung khyer 'phros so/ rgyal ba skal bzang dang /bstan 'dzin mkhyen rab mthu stobs gnyis kyi sku re/phyi rol du khyams ka bzhi ma/sbug tu dpe mdzod nang bla ma dgongs 'dus/byang gter/ shang chos sogs dpe pod nyis brgya tsam/ grub thob skye phreng zhal thang bdun pa cha gnyis/le'u bdun sogs mang tsam/rnal 'byor ma dang /bde mchog thang ka khyad 'phags gnyis/shod du gzim khang sku li gter sna tshogs pa yod pa tsho gsum khyad par thang stong rgyal po'i tshem ring bsrel gyi phung po/ thang stong rgyal po'i gter ma rdo nag la a dkar dang /ma ṇi yig drug bcas/ri'i rtse mor gu ru'i sgrub phug nam mkha' lding na gu ru gtso 'khor gsum 'dam sku cha gnyis/ bde chen chos 'khor bas bdag yin kyang da lta khang pa 'jig 'gro bar snang / shing sdong kha shas/ sa dwangs/ lha sa'i phyogs/bsam yas phyogs/ gtsang jo mo kha rag phyogs thams cad mthong 140

bas skye shod/ngom shod/gtsang phyogs te g.yung drung do khug gi lte ba lta bu g.yel che ba'o//tshe chu sgrub sde ni/ ri las thur du cher babs pas ri gsham thang dang nye ba na/kha shar bstan brag phug gu ru'i sgrub gnas bgrod dka'/lung pa nang bgrod dka' bar brag thog tu gu ru'i zhabs rjes/ tshe chu/pha tshad na smin gling gis da lta 'dzin bdag grwa dpon sleb bcu gnyis/lha khang gi nang spug tu khra tshang sman lung blo mchog rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i thub sku thog sleb/nye sras sgo srung bcas/phyi rol khri steng blo mchog rdo rje'i sku/gu ru'i sgrub phug nas jun gar dus gsung 'byon ma gdan drangs pa'i mtsho rgyal sku/ 'bum cha shas/nyang gter bang zhon mgon khang / thog kha ngos su mtshan brgyad lha khang na mtshan brgyad 'jim sku mda' tshad khri can/gter bdag gling pa'i 'dra zhal shin tu ngo mtshar ba/rab 'byams chos grags/yang lnga pa chen po bcas/chu pha rir drang srong srin po rir grong nag na bde mchog lhan skyes sku byin can mi tshad bal po'i mi'i ngo dbyibs sprul pa'i a tsa ras bzhengs nas der thim pa zhabs sa la mi reg par bar snang du yod pa/g.yas su kha che paṇa chen rdza sku mi tshad/rgyab tu thub sku li ma mi tshad gsum/bka' gdams mchod rten mi tshad gnyis/ yang mda' tshad gci/ /nga

rtse khru gang / phyi nang gnyis char yi ge pod stong phrag tsam/bskur ste chung /thog khar lam 'bras bla brgyud lha khang / rdo rje 'chang li ma sle'u chung /dgyes rdor blos bslang bcas/chu phar ka gangs dkar rdo rje gdan du phyin pas/ 'du khang ka ba drug cu re bzhi/ sgo khar rgyal chen sde bzhi thog so mtho nges phyed gnyis 'dam sku/ g.yas su gur lha bcu gnyis pa'i mgon khang ka ba brgyad ma na mkhyen brtse chen mo'i phyag bzos 'bur sku 'jigs rung nyams mtshar 'dom phyed tsam re/ 'du khang la dpag bsam 'khri shing legs bris/mkhyen brtse chen mo'i phyag bris khyad mtshar/ hor zla dang por khel bas/gur rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor gtso bo/ g.yas su kye rdor birlu lugs man ngag bdag 'jug mtsho skyes/nag po/ḍombi/bdag med ma/gza' yum/kun rigs/rdo rje sgrol ma/gur gyi sgrol ma/rigs gsum/tshe dpag med lha dgu ji ta ri'i lugs rnams 'joms 'thar lugs/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa lha lnga/gshin rje dgra nag gdong drug gshed dmar lha lnga/ gshed dmar bcu gsum/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod/ 'jam rdor/bde mchog lū hi/dag po/dril bu/rdo rje 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma/ ro lang brgyad skor/bcu gsum ma/ rdo rje gdan gzhi/ ma hā ma ya bcas dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad rnams grwa brgya lhag zhig gis tshogs snang / grwa brgya 142

drug cu tsam/ jig tu ka bzhi na ga ya rta ra'i dbu thod bzhugs pa'i thub chen shin tu khyad mtshar thog so gsum pa/nye sras 'dom gsum pa brgyad/mkhyen brtse chen mos bal li'i dbyibs grung so sku tshugs khyad 'phags gos chen ri mo pad sprin rnams 'bul dang / gos 'khyud nyams mtshar/nyan thos mchog zung ma 'gags pa/ kun dga' bo bcas 'dom do re/rgyal po zas gtsang /yum sgyu 'phrul/lha tshangs pa/brgya byin/sgo srung phyag rdor dang / mi g.yo ba bcas/ 'du khang rgya mthong ka ring bcu gnyis/bskor lam yod/ sgo 'gram g.yas su gu ru gtso 'khor gsum mi tshad//shā/ du rdo rje gdan sa kun dga' rnam rgyal khong rang sku tshad 'dra sku 'du khang g.yon du lha khang ka gnyis mar/dkar bdud lcam dral/phur pa thog sor sleb pa/ 'jigs byed pal thog gsum pa/ rdo rje shug chen po/las gshin/tsa du'i bcas/thog khar phyin pas/ kye rdor khang ka bzhi na/ kye rdor mi tshad sle'u chung ma shin tu ngo mtshar can/ g.yas su kye rdor/bde mchog dus 'khor mda' tshad tsam pa/ 'di nang rgyud sde thams cad legs bris mkhyen brtse'i phyag bris shin tu mtshar/ sku rabs gsum pa ngag dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan sku gdung zangs gser/143

g.yon du lam 'bras khang ka bzhi mar/ rten gtso 'jam dbyangs mda' tshad zangs gser/ byams pa bzhengs sku mda' tshad gnyis sle'u chung khyad mtshar/'khor lam 'bras gser zangs khyad 'phags/bka' 'gyur khang na bka' 'gyur rdo je gdan pas ljags lung gsung gzhi dang /yang cha gcig bcas bris ma/bstan 'gyur cha gcigade gong bar khang rdor dbyings khang ka brgyad mar/ gtso rigs lnga 'khor lha so bdun mi tshad che 'bur sku shin tu khyad mtshar dkyil 'khor ltar bkod/de'i dbu rtse bla ma lha khang ka ba bcu drug mar/ dbus su rdo rje gdan pa'i mchod sdong dngul thog grang gser gsol ba shin tu mtshar ba thog gcigasbug tu rdo rje 'chang /lam 'bras bla brgyud/bdag med ma/birlu pa/zlo pa/ḍā ma rū pa/shar phyogs nag po pa/ga ya dha ra/'brog mi/se mkhar chung ba/zhang dgon pa ba/ gong ma rnam lnga/phyag na/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ brag thog pa/ rdo rje gdan pa'i bar mi tshad che nges/ khri bkod brkos legs/ gos chen 'bol/ ber zla sam gos chen can nang mkhyen brtse chen mo'i phyag bzos yid 'phrog nus shing snang ba 'gyur nus pa/khyad par birlu pa/ sa chen/grags pa/brag thog pa sogs bla ༵ /ngos yin snang skye ba/sra rtsi legs po snum nas bton ma thag pa lta

bu sha stag nges bris bde gsang dus gsum bla brgyud/ rten sham li ma kha yar/thub dbang gos sku thog gsum mtho nges/zla ba gsum pa nang /rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor yod zer ba'i tho ni/ dpal dus 'khor/rdor dbyings dpal mchog rtse mo/ sa ṭa/ rnam snang mngon byang sogs dang /zla ba dgu pa nang sa phur sgrub mchod mthar gter bzlog sogs dang / rdo rje gdan pa'i 'jigs byed sogs yod/sngar grwa stong phrag da lta brgya dang drug cu yin/ lha sar tshogs mchod ser bam la'ang de 'gro zer/ gtsug lag khang rdor dbyings dkyil 'khor blos bslang ltar bkod pa red kyang gser tog rgyal mtshan 'dra re zung las mi snang /bka' 'gyur khang na bka' bstan 'gyur/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan sku/ de 'og phyag dpe khang na dpe cha sna tshogs pod sum brgya tsam/ rnying ma'i dpe cha rnying pa yang cung zad tshol rgyu yod par snang / rdo rje gdan sa rang gi gzim bskyis du sku 'dra li ma gal chen lnga bcu tsam dang 'dra zhal bcas/ sa paṇa dbu thod kha sarsha ṇi rang byon can skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dam 'byar rten gtsor yod pa rin chen khang / shākya shrī rdza sku nang rten yod pa'i kun bzang rtse/kun snang / 'bras srungs te khang tshan bzhi/ grwa khang bar shing tshal chen po snang /mtha' grong nag yod pas mi skyid par byas/145

de'i phu nas gyen du rgyang tsam phyin nas la cung zad 'dzegs pas 'brug bde chen chos 'khor na grwa brgyad cu tsam/ 'brug luṭa bde mchog bla mchod/ mi 'khrugs sogs dang / tshes bcu dang 'tshams chas rgyas/phur pa sgrub mchod sogs rnying ma mang / yongs 'dzin 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i lha khang ka drug dbus/ bde mchog lhan skyes mi tshad/ sgrol dkar dngul sku g.yu phra khyad 'phags mi tshad/ 'od dpag med mi tshad rnams chab mdo'i zangs gser/mdun mtshal thog gser gyi bde dgyes dus gsum ri mor bris pa/ g.yas su mtshan brgyad 'dam sku khyad 'phags rtse khru gang pa dang / bka' brgyud gser phreng rtse khru gang pa nyer brgyad/ sgrol ma nyer gcig zhi sbas lugs rtse khru gang yongs 'dzin 'jam dpal dpa' bo/ 'jam dpal ye shes grub pa/chos mabon zhig dang /'jam dpal rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin ngag dbang bzang po mi pham mtshan can bcas gser dngul bkra ma'i gdung thog sleb tsam phra rgyan khyad 'phags/ tsandan dmar po'i thub pa grong khyer ma nye sras bcas mda' gang pa re/ gnam rgyan khyad 'phags bcas/ tsandan dmar po'i byang mchod spus ldan mi tshad bcas/phyi khyams ka ba bcu drug par/ sangs rgyas stong sku mtshal thog gser bris byas pa legs/ bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i blos bslang 146

gser dngul bkra ma spus legs/rdo rje 'chang sku mi tshad che zangs gser/rta ra mdo pa'i bka' 'gyur lha khang ka gnyis/ bka' 'gyur bris ma rgyab ya ma spus dag dang / sde dge'i bstan 'gyur gcigasku gdung khang lha khang du/ chos mgon bshad sgrub chos kyi nyin byed sku gdung /rgyal ba dpag bsam dbang po dang /mi pham mthu stobs kun bzang dang / shes bya kun rgyas bcas gdung 'dom gang pa re gser dngul bkra ma phra rgyan gang cing spus dag ngag dbang po'i sa 'bum/'du khang chen po ka ba so drug /sangs rgyas stong sku gser bris ma'i g.yas su rdo rje 'chang lha khang ka bzhi na/ngag dbang bzang po'i dgongs rdzogs la bzhengs pa'i rdo rje 'chang thog so li 'dra zangs gser/ chu bzang sprul sku dang / kun dga' bstan 'dzin sa 'bum/ ngag dbang bzang po'i sa 'bum/ kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba'i zangs gser mchod rten mi tshad dang /stag tshang /ras pa'i mchod sdong zangs gser/chos rgyal lhun grub rgya mtsho'i dngul gdung thog mtho nges/ 'brug pa'i bla mchod gser zangs dkyil 'khor bla bre 'bul ba/dri gtsang khang ka gnyis mar thub chen thog mtho nges gnyis/ bcu gcig zhal mi tshad gnyis/nye sras brgyad mi tshad/ g.yas su rta phag yab yum/ g.yon du gur drag thog gnyis ma bcas 'jim sku g.yas g.yon 147

'chams chas dang rgyan khang shar nub gnyis/ shar du mgon khang ka gnyis mar gtor tshogs yo byad rgya che ba bcas/'du khang g.yon du yongs 'dzin 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i bka' 'gyur gser bris/ bka' 'gyur snar thang spar ma/spar khang du sri mnan mchod rten/bka' 'gyur bris ma cha gnyis/spar shing la kun dga' lhun grub dang / mi pham blo gros/ ngag dbang bzang bo'i rnam thar bcas pod bzhi lnga/dbu rtser bla ma lha khang ka ba drug par/ gnam rgyan 'phen sogs/hor gos rgyu bzang legs pa sha stag dang /gos chen legs pa'i 'bol/khri sogs bkod mtshar/ zangs gser dang 'jim sku shin tu legs pa'i bka' brgyud gser phreng mi tshad che nas mda' tshad bar nyi shu rtsa brgyad sdu/dī brgyud gser phreng thog drangs ris med kyi bla brgyud gser bris gser g.yab 'og theg chen pho brang ka bzhi mar sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo/bla sku mi tshad chung gsum thub sku dar sku/ yongs 'dzin phyag nas brgya rtsa ma'i sku/ mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug dge legs bzhad pa/lhun grub rgya mtsho bcas zangs gser mi tshad bzo spus legs pa khri rgyan can/ u rgyan shin tu legs pa dang / bla sku gsum/ bka' brgyud gser 148

phreng gser bris sha stag gso bzang po'i bla bre yod/dbu rtsegs gnas bcu lha khang ka ba bcu gnyis ma thub sku li ma mi tshad/spyan ras gzigs mi tshad zangs gser/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ rdo rje /sdus dpa' 'am/ gnas bcu ha dhar rgyal chen bzhi bcas mi cung med bde mchog lha khang na/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos bzhengs pa'i bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis byin can/ rdo la zhabs rjes legs/ rgya dkar nag bal li/tshon rdo dar gsum/ rag sku sogs sna tshogs nyis brgya tsam/zhal ras lha khang du li ma sna tshogs brgya lhag rdo rje 'chang /bka' gdams gdung rten mang /ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po'i sku/gser gyi rgyal mtshani bzhi sogs yod/gangs dkar nas phyi logs su phyin pas/ deng sang rnam rab lung pa zer ba gzhu sprel zhing mda' der/rje mi la'i sgrub phug rngog gi sku dang /jo bo byin can yod pa'i sgrub phug lha khang bcas ri ngos su yod/de nas lung pa'i phur rgyang rang nges song nas/ dwags po grwa tshang sa lugs dgon chung zhig gi thad/la la 'dzegs ste rgyang tsam phyin pas rngog gi gdan sa ltag na lha khang ser po ka bzhi mar/ dbus su thub sdo / ma

mi tshad che/ g.yas g.yon de las chung gnyis/ rje mi la'i na bza' bzhugs zhes pa'i bka' gdams mchod rten thog sleb gcig yang 'dom gang tsam gnyis/ rngog gis bzhengs pa'i rdo rje 'chang sku 'jim mi tshad tsam/rngog gi gdung brgyud li ma/ bka' brgyud gong ma skor mi tshad tsam dang / de las che chung ci rigs bco brgyad tsam/ u rgyan rin po che mi tshad tsam pa za hor ma gnyis/ 'bum bka' 'gyur sogs ma tshang ba pod sum brgya tsam/ thog khar dud sol ma'i mgon khang bcas grong dag dbus yin/ de 'og thog khar rngog gi sku mi tsam dang / phyag bzos lha mo dud sol ma khru gang tsam/ ltag tu lho brag yar pa'i dbu thod sogs bzhugs zer ba'i gdung 'bum dmar po mtshal byugs pa/ thog so gnyis pa/ de 'og tu lha khang thig pas 'jigs bzhin pa rngog lo mi la thog mar mjal par rdo rje 'chang sku/ rngog gi gdung rab sku bdun tsam mi tshad/ mar pa mi la sogs 'jim sku dang / dud sol ma mi tshad tsam snang yang zhabs tog med pas yid skyo'o/ /lhag par sa dwangs skyid/ rtswa dang shing tshal cung skyes pa/ pha rir rngog mkha' spyod du gshegs pa yin skad pa'i gzim khang rtsigs ral song ba snang ngo / /thog tu lung pa'i nang mi las ser ba sgrub pa'i phug pa yod zer/ lung pa de'i mda' ma tshad na sa lugs gdung phud chos 'khor dang /ra ba smad pa'i dgon chung snang /150

dol nang du gnyag dbon bsod nams bzang po'i gdan sa dol gsung rab gling na gnyag dbon gsung mang du yod par grags/ dum shu sdu/ma mig dkar mo dol mdar rgyal chen shugs ldan gnas pa'i sa de de nas zla1 tshes11la rdo rje brag tu gru don nas lha khang mjal tho ni 'du khang ka ba nyi shu mar/ dbus su rig 'dzin chen po padma phrin las kyi bzhugs khri/g.yon ngos rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur/ ldeb bris gsar rnying la gnas bcu/ mtshan brgyad/ byang gter bla ma yi dam chos srung skor 'dug zhug tu dri gtsang khang na/ston pa mchog zung / nye sras brgyad/ sgo srung rta phyag bcas 'jim sku dang / slob dpon rin po che'i sku pad phrin phyag bzos byin ldan bcas bzhugs/g.yon ngos mgon khang na/ dbus su rdo rje gzhon nu sman sku/ phyag tha ma'i phur pa rgod ldem gter ma khru gang yod pa bsnams pa'i byin ldan/g.yas g.yon bstan srung yongs rdzogs rten dang sku/spyan gzigs mchod rdzas sogs bkod legs 'dug 'du khang rgya mthong khang na dga' rab rdo rje lta bu zhig bris 'dug pa ni rgya rong bstan grags yin par snang /chos dbyings pho brang na/ gser zangs las byas pa'i tshe lha rnam gsum mi tshad phra rgyan spus legs/ bka' gdams mchod rten che chung 151

bcu drugali ma dang / zangs gser sna tshogs sku che chung nyis brgya lhag tsam grwa mig bcas bkod legs/theg mchog pho brang ka brgyad ma na/ dbus na slob dpon mi tshad gser zangs/ mkha' 'gro gnyis bcas/ khams gsum zil gnon 'dra zhal sku tshad la dbu rgyan rigs lnga phra rgyan can gsung lan mang 'byon pa yin zer/ li ma che chung sna tshogs brgya lhag kur sku mang / sku phreng rim byon bzhugs khri gos mu tig gi rgyan can gyi g.yas ngos spug tu gsang ba'i mgon khang / bstan srung yongs rdzogs sman sku rkang gang pa re/ sman 'dam/stobs ldan drag shul dbang po/ nyi ma gzhon nu/ srog gi spu gri/g.yu mgon rnams kyi sku mda' tshad na bza' bcas pa/ spyan gzigs sna tshogs 'dug g.yon du gsang ba'i gzim chung nyi 'od yod/dngul gdung khang ka bzhi na/ skal bzang padma dbang phyug khams gsum zil gnon/ ngag dbang 'jam dpal gyi dngul gdung thog sleb ma byang chub mchod rten phra rgyan khyad mtshar/ ba so la brkos pa'i mtshan brgyad bzhugs snod khang bzang / thugs rje chen po lo ki shwa ri bzhengs sku mda' tshad ma gnyis la bzhugs snod khang bzang gdung bzhugs bla ma gsum gyi 'dra sku sman 'dam/bka' 'gyur cha gsum/bstan 'gyur cha gcig g.yon ngos srog gi spu gri'i rten/ mdun ngos gser kong /dngul 15 2

gyi maṇḍal sogs mchod rdzas kha shas dngos gtsang /dngul gdung gsar pa khang ka bzhi ma/ padma dbang rgyal sku gdung thog sleb phra rgyan spus ldan/ g.yon ngos smin gling gter chen/ padma phrin las/ rgyal dbang lnga pa bcas kyi 'dra sku sman 'dam mda' tshad/ g.yon ngos ngag dbang 'jam dpal sku 'dra li 'dra gnyis/ bka' 'gyur cha gnyis/rnying rgyud spar bris cha gnyis bcas dang / chu bzang rin po ches bzhengs pa'i thub pa mda' tshad khri rgyab yol/mchog zung gnyis/tshangs pa brgya byin/bcu gcig zhal bcas zangs gser sgros gtsang bzhugs/rig 'dzin lha khang na/ bka' brgyad che mchog dpal dgu mda' tshad sman 'dam las byon pa bzhugs/bla ma lha khang / gu ru mtshan brgyad brag ri ma bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i phyag mtshan rgod ldem gter ma gnam lcags rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes mda' tshad/ mi la ras pa 'jim sku bcas/phun tshogs 'od 'khyil na/ mkhan rnam rgyal dngul gdung mda' tshad ma/ de'i 'dra zhal/spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma slob dpon bcas kyi sman sku drwa mig shel sgo can na bzhugs pa bcos/bstan srung yongs rdzogs khang na/ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol lha tshogs gtso 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi sku dang /sgrol ma dang /bcu 153

gcig zhal gnyis mda' tshad ma lhag pa bcas bzhugs/ gtsug lag khang rnams na gser gyi rgyal mtshan drug gser tog lnga bsres song /'du khang 'og tu khams rdzogs chen pa yon tan bzang gis bzhengs pa'i dung 'khor dang / rig 'dzin chen po'i gzim chung /dregs pa'i mgon sogs g.yon ngos su bzhugs par 'duga'adi'i g.yon ngos su phreng po lung pa na/ gling ras gdan sa snang phu chos lung / 'phreng po gter chen 'khrungs sa sogs yin par 'dug cing sngar bde chen chos 'khor bdag po deng song chu bo ri'i nam mkha' lding dang gnyis rdo rje brag pa dang brjes pa'o/ /da lta rgya rong bla ma rgan po'i bste gnas so/ /chu pha ka dol mda' mar rgyab dud sprang gnyis yod sa der lo ras 'khrungs sa yin/grwa thang na 'du khang chen mo ka ba nyi shu'i sbug tu dri gtsang khang ka ba dgu mal rgya nag lugs/ dbus su thub pa byang chub chen pa dang /nye sras brgyad bzhengs sku/ gnas bcu/ rdo rje 'chang gser sku mi tshad/bka' gdams mchod rten mi tshad can lnga/mda' tshad gnyis/ rnam snang mi tshad las lhag pa/ rgyal ba lnga pa sogs bla sku gsum/ sgo srung skang rang gnyis/bskor khang nang ma logs ris phyi nang du lta ba bcas dang / 'du khang na bka' 'gyur cha gnyis/ bstan 'gyur cha gcig slob dpon sku/154

logs bris sngon gyi rnying pa bal bris spus legs dang / rgyan bskad sogs mang /bar khang bal bo'i lugs ltar/bzo dbyibs rgya nag lugs su byas pa'i dbus rnam snang gangs can mtsho dang / mar me mdzad/ byams pa bcas thog slebs/ 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad bzhengs sku/dge bsnyen dri ma med pa dang / byang sems dga' ba'i dpal/ khro bo zhing dang gnyis bcas 'jim sku/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i gdung rten dngul gdung phra rgyan can/ lo chen thugs dam rten dus kyi 'khor lo mda' tshad lhag pa gser zangs sle'u chung ma shin tu khyad mtshar/zhwa lu chos skyong bzang po/dbon blo gros pad dkar gnyis kyi sku 'dra/rdo rje 'chang dngul sku dang /lam 'bras bla rgyud gser sku mi tshad tsam/'jim sku bzhi/bka' gdams mchod rten chung ngu bzhi/bskor khang phyi nang du blta sar mdzad bcu dang /mdo sde sprin chen brgyud ris bcas ri mo bal rnying khyad mtshar bzhugs/steng khang rgya gar lugs rten gtso rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sprod/phyogs bzhi rigs bzhi/ yum bzhi/ sems dpa' bcu drug sogs dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/sgo srung khro bo gnyis bcas bzhugs/ 'khor sa nang mar lho'i glo 'bur na bka' gdams bla ma bzhugs pa'i lha khang nub na sa phud rdo phud las bzhengs pa'i sgrol ma gtso 'khor lnga/ dus 'khor lha 156

khang / byang la jo bo bcu gcig zhal gtso 'khor lnga/ rgyal ba rigs lnga bcas kyi 'jim sku bzhugs pa'i lha khang rnams bzhugs so/ /lha'i mgon khang na rdo rje gling pa'i phug bzos gu ru rin po che'i 'dra sku byin ldan/thod pa smug po pho brang bsam 'grub gzhis ku'i dam 'byar/zhang blon/gur zhal bcas kyi sku dang gter sgrom spyan gzigs sogs 'dugadagyes rdor/dus 'khor/kun rigs/mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/'jigs byed/tshe dpag lha dgu/ nā ro mkha' spyod bcas kyi dkyil 'khor bdun yod zer/ rdo rje gur gyi 'cham 'dra ba zhig kyang snang / dbyar ka zla ba drug par tshes bcu'i 'tshams zhig kyang yod zer/yar rgyab paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal gdan sa byams pa gling bla ma lha khang ka bzhi na/ kun rigs mi tshad/ jo bo sogs gser sku nyi shu /sdu/ 'jim sku bla sku mda' tshad drug 'od dpag med sku li ma mi tshad gtsug lag khang ka ba so drug pa/ sgrug g.yas rdo rje 'jigs byed dang phyag drug pa'i mgon khang / dbus su dus gsum sangs rgyas/ nye sras brgyad ge la/ zhang blon/sgo srung khro bo gnyis bcas bal bzos byams gling bsod rgyal bas bzhengs pa thog so mtho nges sman 'dam/ phyi rol bka' 'gyur cha gsum/ bstan 'gyur/ sgrol ma gsung 'byon/ byang 156

chub mchod rten/rje yi sku 'ga' bcas/bla brang gi thog khar/ byams pa gling pa'i 'dra zhal zangs gser/dbu thog tu tshe dpag lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor zangs gser 'bur ma/g.yas su paṇa chen byams pa gling pa rang gi dngul gdung / g.yon du lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dngul gdung thog slebs li ma brgya lhagabaka' gdams mchod rten lnga bcu lhag bcas lcags rwa nang bzhugs/gser gyi rgyal mtshan bzhi/ gsar tog gnyis/ gser g.yab nag po chung gcig grwa brgya sum cu tsam/ dus 'khor sogs sgrub mchod mang / 'di tshang la byams gling pa rang lugs kyang cung mang /byams gling pa'i gsung spar pod lnga/'bras spungs su gtogs/mchod rten chen po'i 'khris/ byams khang chen po ka ba nyer bzhi thog gsum pa nang byams pa zangs gser 'dom brgyad pa/ byang sems 'dom gsum pa gnyis/ rdo rje 'chang dngul sku mi tshad/ rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad dang / rje dang / 'dzam gling mdzes rgyan sogs bla sku zangs gser sum cu lhag gnas brtan bcu drug ha rtar rgyal chen bcas zangs gser mi tshad nyer gnyis/ mar me mdzad dang / thub dbang thog so gnyis pa/ snang bshags nges bris mi tshad re/ gos sku thog gsum pa/dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten nges bris/gser 'bum bcu gnyis 157

'dom gang pa re/mchod rten rtse nas rtsa bar 'dom nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ thog so mtho nges bcu pa/ seng khri nang du dga' ldan byams pa gser zangs li ma thog lnga ma/ tshad med gsum pa nang /phyogs bzhir lha khang bzhi nang /sku 'dra li ma dang /bka' gdams gdung rten sna tshogs brgya lhag re/ thog so lnga pa bum steng nam bum smad na nang phyogs bzhir lha khang bzhi'i nub na dus gsum sangs rgyas gser zangs thog sleb re/ gzhan lho ngos na li ma mi tshad/shar na bde mchog bal li mi tshad phra rgyan khyad 'phags/ byang na 'jigs byed dpa' gcig bdud las rnam rgyal nges bris/ bum ldir stod ma'i nub na tshe dpag med 'jim sku mi tshad/ shar du dngul gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten thog sleb gong 'og gnyis spyir lha khang brgyad cu tshad med ngos re na skar khung nyi shu re/ skyes rab dpag khri phyogs skyong / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/ rgya mtsho/ snar thang brgya rtsa/ sangs rgyas stong sku/mdzad bcu/rdo rje phreng ba zhe lnga/ rigs ldan so drug sum stod dus 'khor sku gsung thugs rdzogs dkyil bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i lha rnams nges bris mtshal gser mthing stobs che ba lha tshugs phul du gyur pa/ mkhyen brtse chen mo'i phyag bris kyang snang /rtser chos 'khor rim pa bcu gsum dang /zar tshags zangs gser 'dom gang pa dbus phyogs 'dir mchod rten 158

'di che shos yin/ 'di dang nye bar phug pa ba'i khang pa ser po da lta bsam 'grub pho brang gi bdag po byed/gyang gling tshogs pa tshogs khang ka ba nyer lnga pa/ bka' 'gyur cha gsum/ bstan 'gyur gcig gdugs dkar/ tshe dpag med/ rdor sems rnams 'dams mi tshad/ lnga pa'i mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab mkhan rab so bzhi pa'i sku rigs gsum sku/ mkhan thog gnyis pa dgra bcom gtsang ma dbang phyug gi thugs dam rnam 'joms gser sku dang / khrus bum/rnam sras mdung dmar/gur can sogs mgon khang /sku li ma khru tshad sna tshogs sum brgya/ gtsang khang nang yar rgyab pas bzhengs pa thub dbang thog gsum pa 'jim sku legs pa'i tshad/ mchog zung gnyis/ gu ru mtshan brgyad jun gar bas brlag shul sangs rgyas rab bdun sku/ rje'i sku mi tshad lnga/ u rgyan sku chen gling sprul rin po che'i slob ma slob dpon dpa' bos bzhengs pa kha che paṇa chen dngul sku byin can/mkhan thog so brgyad kyi sku gdung / li ma bka' gdams gdung rten sogs/ gnyag dbon bsod nams bzang por rnam sras sprul pa rgan mos gser srang drug cu ri ba'i dung phul nas mi snang ba'i chos dung /nang rten la/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i rdza sku/byang chub dpal ba dang / rdo rje dpal btsan 'dam/ nā ro pa'i chos dung / mkhan chen shākya ri dbang 159

tshem ring bsrel can dngul gdung chung / yar rgyab pa'i gser gyi rnam rgyal mchod sdong / tsandan gyi ze'u na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bcu/ dpal ldan bla ma bsod rgyal ba'i dung g.yas 'khyil/ rje btsun grags pa'i ring bsrel sogs/ rdo dkar 'jam dbyangs rang byon/mkhan thog bcu pa shes rab rin chen zhal kor rigs gsu ma mgon po rang byon/ kā ma rū pa'i dzam lha/thub pa byon yag ma li ma/dgra bcom gtsang ma dbang phyug rdza sku/ lha mo nor rgyun ma tshul khrims dri ldan mkhyid gang /zangs gser tog gcigazangs gser rgyal mtshan cha gcig thog khar gnas bcu mi tshad ma long tsam/ brag ri ma/gnas brtan re la sbrul re yod pa gsar bzos byas pa'i lha khang ka drug ma snang / grwa brgyad bcu tsam/ dgon pa 'di kha che pan chen pa'i slob ma byang chub dpal ba'i grwa tshang sgar pa/ jo gdan tshogs pa ste phyi dus su gtsang gi kha rag gi tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa grwa rgyal chen gling du chags pa yin pas rgyal po'i pho brang dgon par song ba yin zer/ gnyags dbon mtshal min bsod nams bzang po'i lugs dus 'khor sgrub mchod yod zer/ sman bla/ rnam 'joms sogs bton/rnying ma'ang cung 'dres/'di nas yar ri bo rnam rgyal zer ba 'bras srungs dbon pa chung ngu snang / de dang nye bar yang dgon pa'i gdan sa 'jig shul/ de nas 160

yar ri snar skyes bu ye shes rdo rje'i 'khrungs sa yin/ grwa nang skyes chen bcu gsum zhes/ grwa pa mngon shes/ gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rog bde gshegs chen po/snye mod kun dga' dpal/ rgyal ting nge 'dzin/skyes bu ye shes rdo rje/ rgyal ba klong chen/ yar rje u rgyan gling pa/ rdo rje gling pa/phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho/paṇa chen byams pa gling bsod nams rnam rgyal/phug pa dpal mgon phrin las kyang byung / gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub/gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje/sngar sog po dpal ye/gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra'i 'khrungs yul gdan sa yin ces so//pha rir la la 'dzegs nas grwa g.yu sgang brag tu phyin/ u rgyan rin po che zla ba gcig bzhugs pa'i gnas yin/ brag phu na u rgyan sku gter bdag gling pa'i phyag bzhengs yin zer byin can/snang mtha'/spyan ras gzigs bcas khru gang lhag re dang / gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje/skyabs mgon skal bzang rgya mtsho rnams/sgrub khang gsum/grwa lding po ches skyid/mdun na thang mthar cog pu bcu dgu/grwa chung bsgrigs 'grim rgyug la 'phrod pa thams cad lo nyer lnga man der sdod/shugs sdong che ngos bzhi/ rdo gcal sbug g.yas su cog grwa rin po che sku phreng bdun pa 'di sa mi pham ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bzhengs pa'i lha khang ka bzhir/ jo bo rin po che'i sku tshad zangs gser 161

spus dag rdil tshad sum cu tsam song gsung / nye sras brgyad chung ngu re dang / g.yas su 'jam dbyangs/ g.yon du byams pa 'dom gang re/ de 'dra'i g.yas tshe dpag med/ g.yon kha sarsha ṇi bcas 'dam sku/ gser kong /dngul rdil tshad bdun gyi bdun tshar sogs/skung bshags mi tshad ri por bris/ 'du khang brtsigs pa/zhal ba arga sogs thams cad spus dag so/ /'du khang phyi rol bskor lam rdo gcal spus dag bskor khang rdo sku spus dag phreng / mdun du 'khor phreng bcas/sgo nub g.yas cog grwa snyan grags bzang po'i dgongs rdzogs lha khang ka ba bzhi dbus snyan grags bzang po'i dbu thod dbu klad bcas nang gzhug rgyal ba byams pa'i sku 'dom gang lhag zangs gser/ g.yas su shākya seng ge dang / g.yon du 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rdza 'dag spus dag dang po dngul 'dul steng gser 'dul/de steng kha che dri bzang / de steng sra rtsi srab mos mnan pas shin tu spus dag pa mi tshad lhag pa gnyis/g.yas su cog grwa gong ma bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / g.yon du cung yangs pa blo bde bcas pa'i dngul gdung mi tshad che nges/ldeb bris cog grwa sku thog gsum pa phyag na pad dkar zhes rarna'i gter lung las gsal chos rje gling pa'i chos bdag de'i phyag bris mtshar/par ngos gzim chung gcig na 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras zhabs 162

ngar las byon pa'i kha sarsha ṇi/mdo sbug tu gser sku brgya tsam/sgo nub g.yon du lha khang ka bzhi ma dang / cog grwa sku thog bzhi pa mi pham rnam rgyal bzhengs pa rgyal ba mar me mdzad 'dom gang lhag zangs gser/ g.yas su cog grwa bzhi pa skal bzang mi pham rnam rgyal dngul gdung / g.yon du phyag na pad dkar gyi dngul gdung 'dom gang lhag re/dkyil du sku bzhi pa mi pham rnam rgyal gyis bzhengs gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gyi nang rgya ras rgal tshig spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal sogs bzhugs pa/ nang rten 'ga' sde pa gzhung gi 'phrog song bas/'phros nang rten rtsa chen thams cad gzhug pa'i dngul gyi byang chub mchod rten bre nang shel sgo las phag mo grub pa'i chem sogs/ g.yas su cung dang po 'chi med bstan 'dzin dngul gdung / g.yon du gcung gnyis pa mi pham kun dga' dpal bzang dngul gdung /rten li ma brgya tsam/ bka' gdams gdung rten lnga bcu tsam/ cog grwa gnyis pa snyan grags bzang po'i phyag bzo sangs rgyas stong / rdza 'dag mer bsregs 'og tu gsha'/ de steng zangs 'dul kha che sha skam gyis bsgyur/ sku sha gser byugs pas shin tu spus dag pa gser sku zhig dang khyad med pa/bka' bstan 'gyur bcas/ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos 'du khang bde mchog dkyil 163

'khor ltar bzhengs/ ka ba sum cu pa g.yas su bka' 'gyur/ kun gzigs chos snang mi tshad/ 'od dpag med/ sgrol ljang bcas mi tshad zangs gser/ cog grwa sku phreng lnga pa bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dngul gdung 'dom gang phra rgyan legs/ g.yon du tshe dpag med dang / rnam rgyal ma zangs gser 'dom gang lhag re/ dbus sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo si tu chos 'byung phyag bris lugs thig dang bstun pa'i sku tshugs shin tu legs shing khyad par/ zhal ngo 'gran bral gyi dngul sku/ dbu rgyan gser ljang brdung phra g.yu mu tig pad rag sogs can/ tshogs khang ngos bris mdzad brgya sogs phul du gyur pa/ka gzhu la snya na grags bzang po'i thub sku re/nang gi lañdza thams cad la/ lha yi zhal byang snyan grags bzang po'i gsung rtsom phyag bris shin tu legs/ snyan grags bzang po 'di smin gling gter chen dang tsha zhang yin/dri gtsang khang ka gnyis/ dbus su sems dpa' rin chen dpal bzang thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa sprul sku chos ldan pad dkar gyis bzhengs thub chen 'doms do pa byin can/ g.yas su kun mkhyen pad dkar gyi dngos slob dang bla ma gnyis ka yin pa rdor 'dzin chos kyi mgon po'i thugs phyag bzhi pa rang byon phebs pa nang bzhugs rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gser sku 'dom gang pa/ byams pa 'jam dbyangs dang tshe 164

dpag med sman sku 'dom gang pa/ bka' 'gyur sde dge'i mtshal par/yang bka' 'gyur gcig bcas/steng shar ngos gzim chung ka drug ma spro por rten ci rigs/ g.yas su mgon khang ka dgu/ yang sbug bcas nyams skyed/ sbug tu zhal ras lha khang / sangs rgyas stong sku rdza sku dang / bka' brgyud gser phreng sma na 'dam/rtser bla ma lha khang na dbu mdzad chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i phyag bris kyi grub chen brgyad cu 'gran bral/ sprul sku zhe ra ba'i phyag bzos rigs ldan padma dkar po sogs 'brug pa'i skyes rabs dang / bka' brgyud gser phreng mi tshad sum cu lhag 'jim sku yin kyang 'dam sku yid 'phrog pa mkhyen brtse'i phyag bzo las kyang mtshar tsam/g.yas su gcung rin po che'i gzim bskyil mdo zhugagayon du lha mo dud sol ma'i mgon khang / sku li ma 'thor bu brgya lhag bzhugs pa phyi nang gnyis dam rdzas spar khu 'dam shing li sogs las gzhan yang bla ma gong ma'i phyag bzos shin tu mang ba dang / rten gtso padma dkar po'i 'dra sku rje nyid kyi phyag bzo/ gu ru'i sku 'ja' tshon gter ma/ thub pa khri ral zangs thang ma bcas/bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i de nyid 'dus pa'i lcags sgyug nang 'dzud 'dra zhal byin can thod 'bur pad dkar phyag bzo li ma sogs/dpe cha 'brug pa gtso gyur 165

pod nyis brgya tsam/ rol sil legs pa sum cu dang / bka' brgyud gser phreng mkhyen brtse chen mo'i phyag bris rgyu tshon bkod phul gyur 'ja' shar ba 'dra ba thog sleb ma snang ba 'gyur thub pa gsum/ gnas brtan sman rnying tshon gser gos 'gran bral ma nyer gsum thog sleb ma sogs thang ka shin tu mang / grwa brgyad cu tsam/ bde mchog bla mchod mi 'khrugs/ rnam rgyal/ phag mo sogs dang / nyang gter brag dmar/ tshe bdag gur drag tī la ya/ tshes bcu 'cham gos bzang shing ltas mo phul gyur yod zer/ lha 'dre bka' thang du/ yar chen tshes bcu sa g.yos lung du bstan//ces pa yin gsungs/dar rgyas chos lding shod der yar chen zhes pa'i grong du o rgyan gling pa'i 'khrungs gzhis mi tshang gcig de'i pha tshad mchod khang ser po ka gnyis ma na u rgyan gling pa sku spyan che ba/ u rgyan pad zhu 'dab sgo me tog med pa zhig bzhes/ 'gan sbyar ser ber sngon zla gam bzhes/ phyag sems nyid ngal gso'i rgya mdzad pa mi tshad 'dam sku/ u rgyan gling pa'i phyag bzos yin pa'i gu ru za hor ma mi tshad/ 'khor mkha' 'gro khru gang pa/ snang mtha'/ spyan gzigs kha skong ba bcas/ri la 'dzegs pas dar rgyas chos lding dbu rtse bla ma lha khang ka gnyis mar dbus su dgon btab pa po sna tshogs rang grol gdung 166

zangs gser 'dom do/ g.yas su gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub gdung zangs gser/ dngul jun gar bsdus pas gangs la gsha' gto 'dom gang pa/ mdun du spa gro ba chos dbang lhun grub gdung zangs gser khru gang pa/ gu ru chos rgyal mkhan po bho snyi sa twa/ mtsho rgyal/mtshan brgyad bcas su lo bcu drug pa'i tshad/ rig 'dzin brgyad mtho gang ba bcas sman lha sgros ldan/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i yum gyis bzhengs/lo chen rin po che dang / gcung bstan pa'i nyi ma'i phyag bris dor sems/ 'jam dpal/ dga' rab/shrī sedha /gu ru rin po che/ mtsho rgyal/tshul khrims rdo rje/ phrin las lhun grub/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin bcas mi tshad/'phros gsar pas kha skong /dbang khang ka bzhi mar li ma sogs gser sku bzhi bcu tsam/gter bdag gling pa bsgres gzhon spar sku nyi shu re tsam/ tshe dpag med gser sku dang /slob dpon spar sku mang /phrin las lhun grub sku mi tshad/rnying rgyud bris ma pod bcu dgu/ snga mo zhig gis gnas brtan rgya lugs bal bris rgya bris 'dres ma lta bu nyer gcig ma dang / mtshan brgyad zhal thang dgu/dar rgyas chos lding dri gtsang khang du/ 'od dpag med thog so gnyis pa gtso 'khor gsum/ g.yas su u rgyan rin po che/ sna tshogs rang 167

grol/ lnga pa chen po/ g.yon nas rgyal ba klong chen pa phrug zhwa can/phrin las lhun grub/ gter bdag gling pa sku gzhon sngags pa thor tshugs can bcas mi tshad/ khyams ka ba bcu drug gter bdag gling pa bgres pa ther snam dbu zhwa can/ gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub bcas mi tshad/yu ma dbyangs can sgrol mas bzhengs pa'i mi tshad gu ru gtso 'khor gsum zangs gser/ sna tshogs rang grol zangs gser khru gang / lo chen rin po che padma 'gyur med rgya mtsho/ rin chen rnam rgyal rnams phrug zhwa can mi tshad chung re/ yang u rgyan gser sku/ 'khor du siddha rgya mtsho brag ri ma sogs/ 'bum cha gcig steng na gzim khang bsam gtan sbug dam 'byar gnyis bcas/ smin gling khri chen gdung brgyud rim can gyi bla shing shug pa'i sdong po bcu gsum/de nas chu phar ka ring du song bas/ dbu ru grwa phu stod grong na rgyal ba klong chen pa'i 'khrungs khyim cig hral/ de'i tshur logs su shing tshal/phug der a ṇi dgon ma'i ltag na kun mkhyen chos khri dang / mar phyogs na da ltar gnas nang dpa' bos 'dzin pa'i lha khang shug sdong can ka bzhi ma ru spa gro chos dbang lhun grub pas bzhengs pa'i kun bzang yab yum mi tshad/ bla sku bcu phrag mi tshad can lha khang skyid po yod/ sgo nub g.yas na sngags srung mgon khang /g.yon du ber nas can mgon khang //68

de nas dkyil rshar grwa pa mngon shes can 'khrungs khyim/ gsol thabs bcas/ zhang blon dam can bdun thog mtho nges 'jim sku'i mgon khang smin gling 'dzin bdag can/sgang gzhis ga'i mda' der rog gi gdung brgyud rnams 'khrungs khyim da lta rtsig hral du song / de nas snye mdo lung pa'i nang lha khang ka brgyad mar/ thub pa li ma byis pa lo bcu drug gi tshad tsam pa/rdor sems li ma/rdo rje phag mo li ma khru gang pa gcig bka' gdams mchod rten mda' gang pa dang / khru gang pa lnga/ gter bdag gling pa/ snye mdo kun dga' dpal dge slong paṇa zhu chos 'chad rgya/pha dam pa/birlu pa/ mi la/so ston ye shes dbang phyug rog bde gshegs chen po'i sku zur pa'i gangs zhu'am rig 'dzin spyi zhu sa gnon mnyam bzhag can/ snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa'i zangs gser mchod sdong 'dom gang / rog shes rab 'od/ rog mi bskyod rdo rje sngags pa sgra thor cog sa gnon mnyam bzhag can/yang rog gi gdung brgyud gnyis bcas sa sku bu lo bcu drug pa'i tshad tsam/bka' 'gyur bris ma cha 'thor/ rgyal chen rnam sras sa sku thog sleb ser khyim nyi shu tsam 'dug pas rog phur tshogs/ da lta smin // nas 'dzin bdag byed/ rten gang bzang smin gling du badzra sā ma dzaḥ169

yang ra ba 'dra ba'i lha khang phur sangs rgyas chu gos mnab cing sa nang nub pa/der mtsho yod zer/ thog khar snye mdo chos skyong khang na rog gi phur cha cha tshang thol can sgros ye med pa yod do//sa lugs zla2tshes23la mkhan slob chos rgyal gyi gdan sa chos 'khor chen po dpal gyi bsam yas su brdol nas/ thog mar dbu rtse rigs gsum 'og khang rgya nag bar khang rgya gar/ steng khang li yi lugs sam rgya gar lugs/ 'og khang la 'dom bde mo gsum re la thog re byas pa'i thog mtho ngos gnyis/ bar khang la gnyis/ steng khang la gnyis/gcir mda' yab bcas la khyon thog brgyad/phal thog bcu pa/ mdun shar rab byung grwa tshang 'du khang / sgo g.yas su lha khang dang / g.yon mgon khang sgo shub bcas glo 'bur gyi rnam pa shar du yod/ mthar rab byung ba'i rtsog dang / lho nas nub byang bar bskor khang thog dma' ba gnyis/lha khang sgor bskor lam/ma ṇi'i 'khor lo phreng /bar du rdo gcal can/phyogs bzhir glo 'bur bzhi tshang ba las lho nub byang bskor lam glo 'bur dod pa/ spyir bsam yas 'di phyi mngon pa'i lugs 'jig rten khams ri rab gling bzhi gling phran gyi bkod pa/ nang theg chen sangs rgyas zhing / gsang sa gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor ltar yod ces grags/dbu rtse 'di mes 'jigs skabs gzhung gis zhig gsos gnang ba/170

bsam yas la phyag rjes de mo dang / kun bde gling che las ka nyams deng gzhung byon bshad pa che/ 'on kyang bzo khyad sngon dang mi mthun pa'i bcos ma 'ga' yod par grags/ 'di las jo bo byang chub chen po dang /nye sras rnams bzhi tsam gyi sku sngon gyi rnying pa me las phebs pa/ gzhan rten byin mang gsar bzhengs/ dbus su khri mkhyen mthur 'dom gang cung med pa phar tshur 'dom bzhi lhag pa'i steng tsandan dkar dmar gyi g.yung drung ri mo yod pa/ ka ba zangs gser can/ khang bzang gser g.yab shing la bskos pa'i nang rgyab yol rgyan drug bcas/ jo bo byang chub chen po nang bsam yas has po ri nas rdo las grub pa gter du bzhes pa la/ gser phye bre bco brgyad dang / sman 'dam dar zab sna tshogs pas g.yogs pa'i byang chub chen po'i 'dam bzhi pa shin tu mdzes par/ dbu rgyan mgul rgyan gser ljang brdung phyis gsar du gsol ba/ khri steng nas bskor ba bya tshogs pa'i ka gdung g.yon du mkhan po lha rnyi sa tā dbu thod ya 'gal thang po che nas sngar drangs pa phyis rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshos ma 'gal yang rtse thang nas yar drangs skabs 'ja' shar ba sogs ltas legs byung ba/ g.yas su bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcom skabs lha sras mu tig btsan por gnang du thob pa'i g.yu'i thub pa grong khyer ma mtho gang pa so sor bzhugs khang bcas/171

gung g.yon bsam yas tshes bcu'i u rgyan sku gseb zangs gser/mdun du dil tshad rta mig ma res bdun tshar re/ del tshad bzhis maṇḍal 'dom 'khor ma zangs gser sna bdun khru tshad ma/ gser kong brgyad sogs/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' bzhi/ g.yon du bzhi bcas 'dom gsum pa bzhengs sku la gos chen padma ris thams cad 'bur dod chu gos gsol ba'i bde mi'i ngo / rgya gos lta bus khro bo mang king gnyis bcas/sku rgyab tu 'dam sku sangs rgyas thog sleb gnyis/ sbug tu bka' 'gyur gser bris/ gnam gdung la g.yu phra/sprin gseb 'brug sogs bzo khyad bcu gsum po tshang ba thog phub dkyil 'khor bla bre drug bris par/ phur pa/bde mchog dgyes rdor/ 'jigs byed sogs bris snang / rgyal ba'i bzhugs khri'ang yod/nang gi bskor khang phyi nang la mdo ris dang / mdzad bcu sogs/ de nas phyi rol 'du khang mthon po ka ba bco brgyad pa'i sbug sgo g.yas ngos drwa mig chen po'i dbus rgyal sras mu tig btsad pos bzhengs par grags pa'i gu ru byin can me rdugs su phebs pa mi che tshad rgyan bzang bdud dpung zil gnon/ g.yas su phyis sman gsar lugs 'dra ba'i e pa'i bzo can mkhan chen tshems gcig pa shin tu nyams dod dang /g.yon du chos rgyal khri srong /bai ro tsa na shin tu mdzes pa g.yas/ srong btsan sgam po g.yon bcas 'jim mi tshad che 172

nges re/ de nas bar bskor khang du 'gro ba'i g.yas sgo dang / 'ong ba'i g.yon sgo gnyis/ngos g.yas su/paṇa chen bi ma la/g.yu sgra snying po/ka ma lathi la/ chos rgyal mu khri btsad po/ mnga' bdag khri ral/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ thang stong rgyal po rnams dang / g.yon ngos sbug dang logs su/ jo 'brom rngog gsum/ rje yab sras gsum/ rgyal ba lnga ba skal bzang rgya mtsho/ mar mi dwags gsum/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho bcas sman 'jim sku mi tshad che tsam/ bka' bstan 'gyur glegs bam legs/gser rnga tshon rnga mang tsam yod/rgyan bkod legs/sgo shub phyi ngos/ rdo gcal mthar rab byung grwa tshang gshag skor yod/de'ang stong grwa khang 'og bskor khang / 'khor sa phyi ma ste ngos bris/ spus dag yod pa/ ngos rer ka ba nyer gcig can la 'khor chung sum brgya nga brgyad/sgo g.yas g.yon thog sleb pa yi rgyal chen chen po bzhi yod/'du khang sgo g.yas su/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter mdzod khang na/ leb 'byar phyag stong spyan stong rgyal po lugs gnub nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag bzo yin/skal pa sngar gyi de mos bzhes de'i tshab 'jim sku/ngos bris sogs rten mang tsam/sgo khang g.yon du/ gur zhal mgon khang rdo rje gur mgon thog tshad shin tu mtho ba/ de'i ma mo e ka dza ṭi bum pa can 'tshams sku chen po 173

'ga' dang /spyan gzigs mang /phyo rol shar sgo'i rdo gcal du rdo padma can na klu mal gro gzi can gnas zer/'du khang gsang sgo g.yas nas phyin pas u rgyan stong sku mas zangs gser mdzub gang tsam pa drug brgya lhag 'phros bzhengs rgyu lus sam py-i // a krong gu ru'i sku dang / yang zangs gser/ bal li/ za hor li ma lho mdzod rmug 'dzin 'dod rgu 'khyil par/rta bdag brgyad nor lha/dro snam rnazlo gsum/dzam ser/nor rgyun/ srong btsan sgam po bcas mi tshad dpal chen rang byon phun tshogs bkod par gu ru mtshan brgyad byis pa tsam re/ sa skya dkar po rnam gsum/ rnam 'joms/ phyag rdor bcas mi tshad 'jim sku/rgyab ngos rdo rje chos rab lha khang na/ rdor sems/ khyung po rnal 'byor/bo dong 'jigs bral/phyag drug mgon po bcas 'jim mi tshad/bde chen chos mdzod gsung rab lha khang na/ 'od dpag med/ klu bye/nga rgyal po don yod grub pa rnams 'jim mi tshad tsam/ bka' 'gyur 174

rigs gsum byin rlabs thugs rje bkod par/ rigs gsum mgon po/las gshin bcas mi tsam 'jim/byang mkhan slob chos rgyal byin 'dus lha khang du/ mkhan slob chos gsum dang /mu khri btsad po mi tshad re'i 'jim/byang ngos byang mdzod sgra dbyangs dpal 'byor 'khyil par/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra/'jam dbyangs 'od zer can/rnam sras rnams mi tshad 'jim/rten gsum mi 'gyur rtag brtan lha khang na/ tshe lha rnam gsum 'jim sku mi tshad bcas/bar khang du/ gung du tshe dpag med lta bu thub pa mnyam bzhag ma li ma 'dom do tsam pa/g.yas su mchims phur zur sprul dngul gdung mi tshad/ g.yon du gser dngul bkra ma'i mchod sdong mda' tshad/ mar me mdzad gser zangs mi tshad che/ byams pa de mtshungs/ mkhan slob chos gsum 'jim mi tshad/sa bcu'i byang sems bcu/ sgo srung khro bo gnyis bcas mi tshad las lhag pa sman 'dam rgya nag gi bzo khyad dang 'dra/bar khang shar khyams na rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs gnas bcu khang /sman 'dam las grub pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug ha dhar rgyal chen bcas mi tshad legs/ bskor khang ngos bris/ gsang sgo nas brgyud de 175

phyin pas/ lho'i glo 'bur bde gshegs dpa' bo rab bdun lha khang na sangs rgyas de rnams mda' tshad las che tsam/nub na rin chen yongs grub li ma lha khang / lcags drwa na/ bka' gdams gdung rten rtse khru gang nas mtho mdzub bar dang / thub dbang li ma rtse khru gang /u rgyan li ma rtse khru gang pa sogs nas/mtho mdzub bar sngar bsam yas rten rnying me tshig dang ma tshig lnga brgya skor/byang na dug lnga'i nad sel sman bla khang bde gshegs bdun 'jim sku mi tshad re bzhugs/bar khang bskor khang shar rab gsal na skas ring la 'dzegs nas phyin pas dbu rtse'i bya 'dab nang bee ro tsa na sped pa'i rgyal po'i bsro khang shul de nang bai ro'i sku dang rgyal po'i 'jim sku mi tshad/steng khang du 'dzegs nas phyin pas/dbus na rnam par snang mdzad mi bzhi rgyab sprod thog sor sleb pa/ nye sras brgyad/ phyogs bcu'i sems dpa' nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ sgo srung brgyad de bzhi bcu rtsa gcig mi che tshad/dpal rtse/rdor dbyings kyi ri mo shin tu rgyas pa/bskor khang sgo bzhi sogs/ gdung ma la la sogs/ rtser srog shing tsandan ka ba/ gardzi ra 'od 'bar dang / gser g.yab thos gsum che/legs sku mang po gser tog can/ sta bzhir seng ge bcas/ mda' yab 176

sogs ngo mtshar che/ sgo rgyab shar ngos g.yas lha sa'i rgyal ba'i gzim chung dam 'byar/g.yon ngos rgyal po shing bya can mgon khang /sgrol ma nyer gcig lha khang du sgrol sku de dag mi che tshad legs/ri mo sngar yod padma bka' thang du gsal ba'i rgyud ris rnams bris/shar ngos rgyal ba'i gzim chung mdor rgyal ba rin po che mdzes po sogs bris/rtser dkar chags kyang mang / 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i gsung mtshan brgyad kun 'khor bris mtshan bsam yas rab byung grwa pas/rgya rong mi rgan bstan grags phyogs lhung yin rlom rdo brdung byas pa sogs shes med blun po'i phyogs res kyi nang cha'ang mjal to/ /gzhan steng khang /bar khang /'og khang bcas bskor sa phyi mar/skar gling zhi khro/lhung bshags/gnas bcu/mdzad bcu/dpag 'khri/bka' thang /lo paṇa thams cad/ grub mtha' ris med bla ma bka' gdams/ sa skya/ bka' brgyud rnying ma'i gter ston brgya rtsa phal cher/ tsong kha brgyad cu/ rgyal ba rin po che'i 'khrungs rab sogs kyang bkod snang ngo //de nas phyi rol du phyin pas/ shud pu dpal seng ges bzhengs pa'i mchod rten dkar po che zhing ser khri shing drwa skar khung 'dra cung yod pa/thog bdun tsam/dbu rtser zangs gser rgyal mtshan/seng ge bzhi bcas/177

bskor khang kha nang bstan la thub pa gnas bstan 'khor bcas/ bla sku sna tshogs rdo sku legs po li rnying ris yod/shar ngos gnas bcu lha khang du/ thub pa gnas bcu 'khor bcas mi tshad sman 'dam/rdo sku dang / byang chub mchod rten/gu ru rin po che'i chib rjes yin zer ba gnyis/yasga gong nyi ma lha khang du/ sangs rgyas nyi ma'i snying po 'dom lhagabyang chub sems dpa' bzhi mi tshad/khro bo gnyis dbu rtse rim gsum dpe shing las byas pa snga thog dang por dbu rtse'i 'char gzhi yin skad pa/bka' 'gyur cha gcig tshes bcu/ mdo sde mchod pa dang / phur pa'i 'tshams kyi zhal 'bags legs po yod/nub yasga 'og zla ba khang na rten gtso sangs rgyas zla ba'i snying po 'dom gang lhagabyang sems bzhi/khro bo gnyis/tshes bcu'i 'chams dang mdo sde mchod pa'i dus ston gyi zhal 'bags bzo legs/rdo rje sprel chung gis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten sngo ljang thog lnga tsam/g.yu rtsi legs/ lha khang bcu drug gis brgyan pa'i seng khri zur bzhi glo 'bur bzhi/ glo 'bur la nang 'bur/ phyi yi them nyag re bcas lho rin 'byung li tshugs ma/'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsum/sman bla bcas lha khang gsum/nub na sgrol ma mi tshad ma/de nas ka ma shī la/ sba ye shes 178

dbang po dang /zhang lha bzang bcas/byams pa 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs bcas yod pa gsum/byang ngos su mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho yod pa dang /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad bzhugs pa dang / don yod grub pa bzhugs pa bcas lha khang gsum/shar ngos su tshe dpag med bzhugs pa dang / rnam par snang mdzad la byang chub sems dpa' gnyis kyis bskor ba/rdo rje sems dpa' yod pa'i lha khang bcas/ sku rten gtso bo phal cher mi tshad sngon gyi li rnying tshugs mtshar/seng khri gong ma'i nang / lho ngos rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub ngos su de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad/ byang ngos su rnam rgyal ma/shar ngos su thub sku zhal dbyib sangs rgyas la chu zheng gab sa'i lha khang bcas khyon lha khang 'dom gang tsam pa nyams mtshar/ 'di'i bskor lam 'khor du sdig pa ra tsa don zer/skar me khang tshan na/thab ka khro zangs sogs legs/ shing sdong chen po yod/steng du phyin g.yon lha khang g.yas mgon khang gnyis lha khang na/tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil pa mi tshad 'khor yongs rdzogs/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin/legs ldan rdo rje bcas 'jim sku/rigs gsum mgon po mi tshad 179

dang / rta mgrin dang phag mo yab yum/ gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad bcas mda' tshad lhag bzo legs/sku lnga'i mgon khang /spyan gzigs sogs legs/gling bzhi gling phra brgyad/ bar gyi lha khang bcas las shar stod rnam dag khrims khang gling na/ chogatso bo sngon gyi bzo rnying byang chub chen po 'jim thog cung ma sleb tsam/ g.yas g.yon byang sems mi tsam bzhi bzhengs stabs/mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho shin tu bag dro/lo chen bee ro shin tu mdzes/ sgo srung khro bo gnyis mi tshad tsam/ chos sku yum chen/ sgrol dkar yang mi tsam/bka' 'gyur bcas/byang shar mtshams 'dir kun mkhyen 'jigs gling pas bzhengs pa'i rdzogs chen lha khang na/ slob dpon gtso 'khor byin rlabs can bzo legs pa mi tshad lhag yang slob dpon rgya gar ma/ mkhan po chos rgyal bcas chabazos mi tsam/dga' rab/'jam dpal/ shrī seng / bi ma/ tsā na su tra/klong chen pa bcas 'jim sku mi tshad bzo legs/shar dbus drang por 'jam dpal gling na/ thog khang bar ma na/rten gtso 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' mi tshad li tshugs byin chags/mkhan slob chos gsum/rngog lo tsā/mi tshad byang chub sems dpa' bzhi/khro bo king rkang gnyis/ de yi thog khang steng mar bde chen zhing bkod 180

ngos bris/ bka' 'gyur/rten 'jam dpal smra seng / rgyal ba lnga pa skal bzang rgya mtsho/ rje rin po che/ rwa sgreng khri chen bcas 'jim sku mi tshad/de'i 'og khang na dung 'khor che legs bcas/shar smad brda sbyor tshang mang gling na/ rten gtso jo bo shākya mu ni/byang chub sems dpa' bzhi/khro bo gnyis/dzam lha ser po/khyad par dzam nag mar khu nas bton ma thag pa lta bu'i 'jim sku rnams mi tshad re'o/ /bka' 'gyur bris ma cha/sangs rgyas rab bdun ngos bris/bod rgyal de mos bod bde thabs lung babs la bzhengs pa ngo mtshar thub chen gling /ston pa gser zangs 'dom phyed do pa spus legs/mchog zung /zas gtsang sgyu 'phrul yab yum gnyis/nye sras brgyad/khro bo gnyis/tshangs ba/brgya byin bcas 'jam sku sgros gtsang mi tshad re/lho ston bdud 'dul sngags pa gling na/ thub chen/kun rigs rnam snang mi 'khrugs pa bcas thog cung ma sleb pa/ sems dpa' bzhi mi tshad bcas bzo rnying rgyal ba rigs lnga/ 'dod rgyal/ tshogs bdag glang /ci/snang gdong /rigs byed ma bcas 'jim sku mi tshad/bka' 'gyur cha lho dbus drangs por arya pā lo'i gling / gser g.yab can 'du khang bcas pa'i/gtsang khang dbus/chos rgyal la dpe blangs pa'i thugs 181

chen sems nyid ngal gso/ gser gyi dbu rgyan can shin tu byin chags pa 'di khri srong gi rten rnying las lha sa'i 'dam sku dang sku tshugs sogs 'dra bas rtsa chen/ rgyud lugs rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug blon po rnams kyi 'dod pa dang bsnun pa'i rta ra klu gong 'dra ba yin zer ba'i gsung lan mang 'byon pa/ sgrol ljang mi tshad tsam pa zhal ras btsun mo dmar rgyan 'dra ba yin zer ba'i lo rgyus 'duga'aphags pa lo ki shwa ra/spyan gzigs phyag bzhi pa bcu gcig zhal 'od zer can sogs sman 'dam byon legs dbu rgyan gser zangs can/ chos rgyal khri srong gi thugs ril por bzhugs par grags pa'i byang chub mchod rten tshig rgyan gser las byas pa mda' tshad las cung lhag g.yas ngos rgyud kyi bka' brgyad khro mkhar sman 'dam gyis bzhings sgros gtsang bzhugs kyang phyag cha sogs nyams bsgros che/ rgyud kyi rta mgrin yang de 'dra bzhugs/ 'di gnyis gle lung bzhad rdor gyis bzhengs pa yin/ dkyil 'khor blos bslang 'thor bu/ rta mgrin sku mda' tshad dang / rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas yum gyi dgongs rdzogs la bzhengs pa'i snang srid zil gnon gser zangs mda' tshad lhag tshe dpag med/ rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho bcas 'jim sku dang /de nas g.yas ngos spug gcig tu/thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso/ rigs gsum mgon po bcas 182

sman 'dam/ chos rgyal rim byon phal cher gyi dgongs rdzogs las bzhengs par grags pa'i 'bum cha kha shas yod 'dra/ g.yon ngos gtsang spug gcig tu/ thugs chen seng ge sgra dbu rgyan gser zangs/ sku rgyab nas mdze la phan zer ba'i sa khams sa dang / gu ru mtshan brgyad mda' tshad tsam/sems dpa' bzhi/sgrol dkar bcas sman 'dam yin/lho smad sgra bsgyur rgya gar gling na/ thog so gnyis pa can gyi 'og khang la/thub dbang li ma mi tshad tsam la dbu rgyan gser zangs byin ldan/sems dpa' bzhi/ khro bo gnyis bcas sman 'dam rnying legs bar rnying ka ma shī la/ dam pa rgya gar bcas dang / steng khang dbus mar/ thub dbang mi tshad/ g.yas ngos su rgya gar paṇḍi ta'i sku bcu gcig gdan la kha byang yod pa/ g.yon ngos lo tsā ba bcu gcig zhal byang can mi tshad tsam pa 'jim sku sgros gtsang / mdun du bza' shing khams sngon che chung gnyis/ sgyug ma phung po gnyis/me tog sogs nyams dga'i bkod pa can 'dugakhams lha rtse bla ma ri shul yon tan dpal bzang gis bzhengs pa'i ma ṇi dung 'khor dang /phyi nang gi bkod pa ldeb bris gsar pa can/nub stod lung bstan bee tsā gling na/ rnam par snang mdzad sman 'dam mi tshad las lhag g.yas g.yon la mar me mdzad dang / bya/sdu pa

mi tshad/gu ru mtshan brgyad mda' tshad lhag sgrol ma/nor rgyun ma bcas sman 'dam byon gtsang bzhugs/zhang rgya tsha lhas snam gyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten dmar po padma stong gis brgyan pa/ phyogs bzhir lcags thag bzhis 'then pa bcas/bod rgyal de mos bzhings pa'i dpal yon tan mchod rten/ bum par sgo bzhi la/kun rig rnam snang bzhi yum bzhi bcas sman 'dam bzhugs/nub dbus dga' ldan byams pa gling rten gtso byams pa thog tshad ma dbu rgyan gser zangs bzhengs sku sems dpa' bzhi khro bo gnyis dang / gsar nyams can gyi snang srid zil gnon/ srong btsan/ khri srong /khri ral bcas mda' tshad lhagathub dbang rdor gdan li ma 'dom gang tsam pa dang / byams bzhugs can gyi gser zangs byams pa mda' tshad ma bcas/ gtsang drugs phyi ngos rnam sras mgon khang / g.yon ngos mgon po gri gug can gyi mgon khang dang / slob dpon stong sku spar ma mtho gang pa can yod/nub smad mi g.yo bsam gtan gling du rnam snang rdo sku mi tshad dbu rgyan gser zangs/ rigs bzhi/ sems dpa' bzhi/sems ma bzhi/khro bo gnyis bcas sman sku/ phyi yi khyams la sangs rgyas stong sku sdo la brkos pa sgros gtsang khru gang tsam pa/184

bod rgyal de mo rin po che ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshos bzhengs pa/ mi pham chos 'dzin gling rten gtso byams pa thog slebs gser zangs rin po che'i phra rgyan mang po dang /yab yum gnyis/sems dpa' bzhi/ sems ma bzhi 'jim sku/ maṇḍal sogs mchod rdzas mang po 'dugayang de mo rin po ches bzhengs pa'i chos longs sprul sku'i dung pa// gsum/ lha khang so sor logs bris de mtshungs sgros gtsang can byang stod rin chen sna tshogs gling na/ gtso bo dus gsum sangs rgyas thog slebs med tsam/ sems dpa' bzhi bcas 'jim sku/ thub dbang rdor gdan mi tshad tsam pa li ma/chos rgyal mes dpon rnam gsum bcas so/ /ngam rta ra klu gong gis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten nag po sku gdung gis rgyan pa/ phyogs bzhir lcags thag bzhi/ gdugs rtog sogs zangs gser can/byang dbus byang chub sems bskyed gling na rten gtso/sangs rgyas ma chags padma can pad sdong rtser bzhugs thog tshad/ thub dbang li ma mi tshad tsam/ rgyab ngos byams pa thog slebs/ kun rigs lha so bdun 'jim sku pad gdan bcas kyi phyi nang bskor ba/ mkhan slob chos sdu/ma

mda' tshad lhag/ jo bo rje yab sras/sgo srung ging kung gnyis bcas byin can/'di na mchod rdzas kha shas bzhugs/byang smad dpe dkar dkor mdzod gling / steng 'og gnyis las/steng khang du gtso bo chos rgyal sku tshab/ mgul rgyan la chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan mgul gab 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag de nang slob dpon chen po'i dbu sngon 'ja' tshon ma nyag ma bdun yod zer ba'i gser gab dam 'byar/bse 'bag skug chung / tsi dmar kong btsun de mo/ sku lnga bcas so so'i sku tshob rgyan ldan/rten mdos/ gri mdung / dar ras/lpags shun sogs kyi spyan gzigs khyad mtshar 'khyams chen na grwa sum cu tsam gyi skong gso btang mkhan 'dug 'og khang 'khyams chen g.yas ngos sbug gcig tu/sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal thog sleb/sku rgyab ngos rgya dpe yod rab/sems dpa' bzhi/ sems ma bzhi/slob dpon rin po che bcas sman sku/g.yon ngos drug dam 'byar mdun/dbugs sgro che chung bdun brgyad dang / zhag pa dang /g.yag spre'u sogs kyi spyan zigs lhags brgyangs dang / dbugs khang gsing la bsnam na bshugs dri yod zer/ de rnams ni lcags ri gcig gi nang khong dus yod la/ lcags ri'i steng mchod rten stong rtsa ni mda' tshad lhag tsam rdza gyo yin/lcags ri'i rgyab lho phyogs na tshe spang gza' 'am dmar rgyan mas 186

bzhengs pa'i khams gsum zangs khang gling bkod pa dbu rtse dang 'dra zhing /rdo bzo dang /shing chas sogs dbu rtse las lhag par gsung bzhin ka gdung la g.yu byer rin po che sogs kyi phra rgyan/ gser dngul gyi tshig brgyan sogs mang / thog gsum gyi 'go khang na rten gtso byang chub chen po thog sleb pad sdong khar bzhugs pa/ jo bo byang chub chen po thog sleb pa/ nye sras brgyad bzhengs sku/ khro bo gnyis bcas rgyu dngos 'jim sku la rin po che'i phra rgyan shin tu mang /bar khang du rten gtso sangs rgyas ma chags padma can thog slebs pad sdong khar bzhugs pa/sems dpa' bzhi/ sems ma bzhi/ sgo srung zhing nang gnyis bcas sman 'dam la phra rgyan zangs gser las byas mang gter ston grwa pa mngon shes can gyi 'dra sku mi tshad tsam la thugs kur tshem las byon pa'i tshe dpag med shel sgo nas mjal ba dang /bskor khang phyi nang du bltas bar zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i logs bris bal rnying khyad mtshar/steng khang dbu rtse gtso bo rnam snang mi bzhi rgyab sprod/sems dpa'/ sems ma/khro bo gnyis bcas rdor dbyings dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/phra rgyan sogs khyad mtshar snang /mgon khang dang /'og gi bskor khang phyi nang du blta bar bka' thang nas gsal ba bzhin legs bris rnams bal bris/rtse g.yu 'bebs sogs nyams gud med/187

nub na 'byo bza' byang chub ma yis bzhengs pa'i dge rgyas li ma gling thog gcig mar/rten gtso li ma thub dbang mi tshad phyed gnyis tsam phran rgyan phu tshogs dang / nye ba'i sras brgyad rgyu li dmar mi tshad chung tsam pa bzhengs sku dang /khro bo gnyis bcas shar li khyad mtshar/sgo phyi'i g.yas g.yon du sman bla dang / mar me mdzad gnyis li ma mda' tshad dang / sgo g.yas ngos su bka' brgyad bder 'dus dkyil 'khor dang /g.yon ngos bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs dkyil 'khor logs bris bsgres so/ /bskor khang dang g.yu 'bebs sogs gtsang dgabyang ngos su pho gyang bzas bzhings pa'i dbu tshal gser khang gling thog gnyis ma/ 'og khang ka bzhi mar/ rten gtso mi bskyod pa thog slebs/ paṇḍi ta tha ma las phyag mdzad pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis rgyal po 'khor bcas yid ches skye bar mdzad pa de yin/ g.yas ngos rin chen 'byung ldan/g.yon ngos snang mtha' gnyis 'jim thog sleb/ dbu rgyan gser zangs phra rgyan sogs khyad mtshar/ de gsum gyi rgyab ngos/ rdor sems/don yod grub pa gnyis logs bris mi tshad tsam/'khor nye sras brgyad/khro bo zhing kung gnyis bcas mi tshad lhag pa sman sku/ thub dbang li dkar mda' tshad/bka' gdams mchod sdong mda' tshad tsam pa gsum dang /sgo gla gor zho sha sgo rgyan la gser gyi byi'u chung /phra rgyan che legs/188

mdo 'khyams ka ba bcu drug bskor sa phyi dang du lta bar mdo sde logs bris dang /mdzad pa bcu gnyis logs bris nges 'bur sku dang / mdo sde ldeb bris bal rnying ngo mtshar gsar bzos ma phog pa/ steng khang du grwa sgrub sde byang chub gling nas spyan drangs pa'i thub dbang li ma thog slebs/mchog zung gnyis mi tshad tsam dang / 'khor nye sras brgyad dang / thub dbang grong khyer ma bcas mda' tshad tsam pa/ rgyu tsandan dkar dmar las bzos pa/ ston pa'i phyag gi lhung bzed de shā ri'i bus lhung bzed dngos dang / gnam ngos chos gos dmar ser de shā ri'i bu'i sku chos yin pa'i lo rgyus 'dug kyang the tshom ste mi drag 'dras bcom nas tshab byas min nam/ kun rigs rigs bzhi yum bcas 'jim bzo bkod pa phul byung sngon yod la/ gzhan rnams de mo rin po ches bzhugs par gnang zhes bshad/bskor khang phyi nang du lta bar mchod lha dang mdo ris rnams bka' thang du gsal ba bzhin/ g.yu 'bebs dang / shar ngos chu srin kha nas khrus chu 'babs pa dang / 'og tu rdo rus sbal 'dra ba'i thog rdo gzhong can/ o rgyan gling pas lha 'dre bka' thang gter tu bzhes sa de yin/ shug sdong / bza' shing / rgya lcang sogs yid spro ba'i gnas su snang yang / de ngos kyi gling tshal deng dus kyis grub rdzus pas cung nyams pa can du byas snang ngo / /bsam yas shar lhor chos rgyal mes ag tshom 189

gyis bzhengs pa'i ka chu lha khang dang / nub ngos mtsho mo mgul du mtsho mig dang /rten bkod shing tshal/ khor yug lcags ris bskor ba/phyis bod rgyal de mos bsam yas phyogs bzhir lha khang bzhi/ mtshams bzhir mchod rten bzhi bcas gsar bzhings sgos gtsang can bzhugs so//lcags ri'i rgyab byang ngos su bsam yas rdzong gi mchod khang sbug na/mnga' bdag nyang rin po che'i gter byon phyi dbyibs byang chub mchod rten/ chos 'khor yan chod blangs chog ma rgyu li dmar gser cung zad yod pa'i bum pa'i ngos nas chu blugs pas mchod sdong je cher byung ba bum khar slob dus pad 'dab bzhi kha bye ba'i dbus gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje tshod do tsam pa ngo mtshar can de dang / gung thang la kha'i zhabs rjes 'jim la rgyab pa lta bu dang / slob dpon rin po che bai ro gnyis kyi phyag mkhar shing sha ba yin zer ba'i tshig 'jor mang zhing ngos la ri mo sna tshogs yod pa rtse mjug can gnyis dang / mchod khang der li ma sna tshogs mang po 'dug kyang rdzong dpon gyis mkhan rnams la za sgo 'tshol ba don du gnyer ba las dngos bshams mchod pa yid skyo bar snang ngo //has po ri rtser lha bsang khang /bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du gu ru rin po che'i gzim phug tu/ bee ro tsa na dang mtha' mi mgon brtson gyis phyag bzos 190

gu ru za hor ma bye ma a krong khru gang pa dang /mkha' 'gro gnyis bcas/kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i phyag bzos gu ru bdud dpung zil gnon rgya gar ma gsungs byon nas/ nga'i gdul bya bsam yas mchims phu'o zhes byung bas gdan drangs pa/kong nga phod nas gdan drangs pa'i gu ru snang srid zil gnon gsung 'byon ma gnyis po khru gang pa/ rdza yi kha non tu bzhengs pa'i slob dpon bdud dpung zil gnon rgya gar ma chos rgyal mos lag tsam thugs dam rten sku rgyu rnyikhri las grub pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje gdong drug khru gang pa/ chos rgyal khri srong gi thugs dam li ser las grub pa'i sangs rgyas ma chags padma can/ lha sras mu khri btsan po'i thugs dam rgya gar shar li sgrol ma g.yu'i go khrab tu grags pa/ gzhung nas bsam yas mchod rten dkar po zhig dus bzhengs pa'i gu ru snang srid zil gnon 'jim sku mda' tshad lhag yang pad 'byung zangs gser khru gang pa/ rgyal ba byams pa gsor zangs khru gang pa/ sman lha bzhengs sku li ser gnyis/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i 'dra sku rgyu li ser bzo bkod phul byung pho brang dmar po nas 'dir drangs dus me tog gi char 'bebs/ khong chos 'khor rgyal la pheb zhor 'dir phebs/ ma grub pas sku tshab gnang ba yin par grags/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ tshul khrims rgya mtsho gsum zangs gser mda' tshad ma/191

kun mkhyen klong chen pa chos 'khor can 'jim sku/ zur mkhar gter ston bde chen gling pa'i dgung lo brgyad pa'i zhabs rjes/ phug sgor steng ngos dpal chen sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor rang byon dang /che mchog dpal dgu'i sku/'jam dpal dbyangs sogs gsal po/oṃ lhasarghaṃ gsum brtsegs ma sogs rang byon mang / g.yon ngos sha za mkha' 'gro'i sku tshob rten bcas snang / de rgyab tshogs khang sbug tu/ kun bzang bde chen rgyal po'i dngul gdung mda' tshad lhag 'gro mgon dbang sdud snying po'i phyag bzos gu ru snang srid zil gnon khru gang pa/ bsam yas kyi sa phud las bzhengs pa'i gu ru gtso 'khor gsum mi tshad/ dbu rtses me bzhes rgyab bzo phud las phul ba'i gu ru bdud dpung zil gnon mi tshad tsam pa/ sku rgyab mkhan po kun bzang chos grags kyis bsam yas zhig gsos gnong dus kyi bzo phud gu ru snang srid zil gnon rgya gar ma mi tshad lhag karma pa rang byung rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i thub pa gser zangs mi tshad lhag gsar bzhengs chos longs sprul gsum gu ru sku tshab bzhi/ yum ka bde chen rgyal mo bcas 'jim sku mda' tshad/dzam dmar mi tshad tsam pa 'dag chos rgyal thugs dam rten 'bum sha sgrol ma pod bzhi gzhung nas dam 'byar gnang ba/ sa skya'i bka' 'bum sogs sa skya pod nyi shu tsam/ 'bum sde spar kun mkhyen 192

'jigs gling la spar phud phul ba bcas bzhugs/g.yas ngos rdo skas la 'dzegs nas bee ro'i gzim phug tu/ bee ro'i 'dra sku/ gu ru snang srid zil gnon sku tshab gsum 'jim sku mda' tshad tsam/ tshogs khang dkyil du chos rgyal mes ag tshomi kyis bzhengs pa'i mchims phu nags ri'i gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso kha sarsha ṇi mda' tshad lhag phug sgor lha lcam padma gsal gyi gdung bzhag sa'i dbu zhabs rjes can gyi rdo gcal bzhugs so//de 'og mtsho rgyal gzim phug tu/ zhabs rjes gsal po slob dpon gtso 'khor gsum 'dam sku khru gang pa re/ de 'og rma thog rin chen gyis rdo pha waṃ zan ltar gsol ba'i phyag rjes sor rjes/ lha lcam padma gsal gyi sgrib sbyong du slob dpon chen pos bzhengs pa'i rdo sku brgya/yig drug brgya/mchod rten brgya bcas phyag mdzub kyis bris pa/ brag ngos der gu ru'i zhabs rjes 'dom do tsam pa/ de'i rgyab ngos su bla ma dgongs 'dus gsungs pa'i bzhugs sa'i bzhugs khri rdo chen rdzu 'phrul brtsigs pa/'og padma gsal gyi sku rjes gter sbas rdo/dgongs 'dus phug par rdo sku rang byon/ nyang phug gong mar gu ru'i zhabs rjes khru gang / oṃ mi phyag mdzub kyis bris pa/ de 'og nyang phug 'og mar grags pa gsang chen me tog phug na gu ru'i zhabs rjes 'dom gang pa/gu ru'i gzim phug g.yon 193

ngos tshe sgrub khang du rten gtso gu ru snang srid zil gnon gtso 'khor gsum thog phyed gnyis ma gzhung gis dmag bzlog la bzhengs dus las 'brel rtsal zer ba'i bla ma'i phyag bzos dang / rab gnas kun mkhyen 'jigs gling dang / zur mkhar gter ston dri med gling pa gnyis kyis mdzad dus sku khru gang 'phar ba yin zer/ gu ru bdud dpung zil gnon mi tshad lhag sman 'dam sku rnying zhal ras rdul mi bzhes pa byin can dang / skam pa rang byung rdo rje'i sku gdung thog slebs zangs gser rnying /bka' gdams mchod rten thog slebs/dpal ri bla ma rig 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal 'dra sku/ de'i gdung rten sa 'bum/'chi med rdo rje'i srog sgrub sku zangs gser mda' tshad/ rdor sems zangs gser mda' tshad bcas bzhugs/ de 'og zur sprul rin po che'i gzim khang du zur mkhar gter ston gyi gu ru'i gter sku khyad 'phags/ khams nyi grags gter ma gu ru za hor ma/ de 'og kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i gdung 'bum mchod sdong / de'i gong na kun mkhyen phyag bzos yin zer ba'i gur drag sku dang / sa 'bum mchod sdong / kun mkhyen gdung 'bum 'og na rdo'i mchod sdong kurma pas bzhengs pa/ de 'og gu ru rin po che'i klu 'dul khyung chen phug pa sa dong nas mar 'dzul par yod/ ltag na hūṃ rang byon/ de'i g.yon ngos brag tshe bum dang / tshe chu/ shug sdong bcas de 194

'og rdza mo rgyu 'dra'i lung par gu ru'i zhabs bro'i zhabs rjes brgya rtsa rdo pha waṃ chen po'i steng na yod/ de ngos rdza mo hūṃ 'dra yin/mchims phu'i ri ngos brag rtser gu ru'i sgrub phug dang / rje 'bangs rnams kyi sgrub phug so sor yod/ri'i dbu rtser blon chen gur dkar phugarje 'bangs rnams kyi sgrub phug phal che ba yod/gdong phar rgyab mtsho rgyal /zim phug dang / klong chen chos ra shar gzim phug rnams la 'gro ma dbon rtsar rgyal ba mchog dbyangs gzim phug na/byams sku dang /rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa'i sku 'dom gang tsam/ sngar mchims phu nags ri'i gtsug lag khang phyis bsam yas zhig gsos skabs bzo bcos phog pa'i lha khang so sor thub dbang gnas brtan brag ri ma dang /rje 'bangs nyer lnga brag ri ma bcas sku nyams legs pa lha bzo mkhas po/mchims phu me tog mchod pa zhes tshos bcu'i mtshams/ a ma rig 'dzin ma phab rgyu yod/bsam yas lung pa'i phur g.ya' ma lung gu ru'i gzim phug tu/ sku tshab bye ma a krong thugs kur ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs par grags pa'i bee ro'i phyag bzos slob dpon bdud dpung zil gnon rgya gar ma mi tshad tsam sman 'dam/ klong chen pa'i phyag bzos slob dpon 195

snang srid zil gnon rgya gar lugs/ gsar bzhengs slob dpon gtso 'khor gsum/ smin gling nas gdan drangs pa'i gter chen sku/ brag la gu ru'i zhabs rjes phyag rjes phur pa sgrol ma/ gro lod bcas kyi sku rang byon dang /ha yig yig sogs rang byon mang / g.yas ngos tshe bum/kha rgyan shug sdong can nas babs pa'i tshe chu ngo mtshar ba dang / de ngos brag cog rgyal mtshan btsugs sa nas smin gling gter chen gyis tshe sgrub yang snying kun 'dus gter bzhes pa'i gter gnas su 'dug go /brag dmar mgrin bzang chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan 'khrungs pa'i lha khang du/ ston pa mi tshad tsam pa/ gu ru rin po che mi tshad tsam pa dang / chos rgyal mes dbon bsam yas nas drangs pa'i sgrol ma/ mes ag tshom bcas zur rje gling pas bzhings pa/ de 'og lha khang chung ngu zhig tu chos rgyal bla shing da lta sgrom g.yung drung can du bzhugs pa mjal/bsgrags mda' dpal 'byung lha khang du kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i 'dra zhal rang gi phyag bzos byin ldan dang /phyis zur khang nas bzhengs pa'i kun mkhyen 'jigs gling / thugs chen sdug bsngal rang grol/ padma gling pa'i sku dang / yang ti'i bla brgyud/ sangs rgyas ras pa'i gdung 'bum sa'i mchod sdong /bsgrags mda' mtsho rgyal bla mtshor/ bla mtsho gru bzhi dang / shing gi 196

skyed tshal/ gong du lha khang ka bzhi mar/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa mi tshad/yum ka bde chen rgyal mo/thugs chen sdug bsngal rang grol/g.yas g.yon du gu ru gtso 'khor gsum che chung gnyis/ g.yas ngos slob dpon 'di sngon gyi rnying ma lha khang mes tshig skabs kyang yod pa nyams gsos/ de rnams sman 'dam/ mtsho rgyal bla shing shing padma can nu 'bur gnyis mngon pa/rdo zhig la mtsho rgyal phyag zhabs kyi rjes dang / gu ru'i zhabs rjes bcas bzhugs shing / spyir nyams spro zhing byin can 'dugabasgrags yongs rdzong gnam tshal gseb lha khang ka bzhi mar/ston pa mi tshad/mchog zung gnyis/ rigs 'dus/ yum / bi ma/ bee ro/'jigs med gling pa/ zur rje gling pa dang /ka gdong g.yas g.yon du sgrol ma/ drag po dra khyung bcas 'jim sku mi tshad re dang / ldeb bris klong snying rigs 'dus gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs/ thugs chen sdug bsngal rang grol gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs/ ma mgon lcam bral gtso 'khor/ tshe ring mched lnga/ ngos gcig ston pa gnas bcu/ g.yas ngos sbug tu mgon khang du ma mgon rten mdos/ ma gza' rdor legs 'jim sku mda' tshad/gtor sgrom sogs zur khang pas bzhengs pa dang /snying thig bu gsum/mdzod bdun bcas kyi spar shing yod 'dug go/bsgrags yongs rdzong gshin rje rol pa'i sgrub gnas stong shod 197

gnyis su/ steng gu ru'i gsang phug tu/ gu ru'i sku tshab bye ma a krong mtho tshad lhag gtso 'khor gsum/ gsung 'byon sku tshab khru gang ba bcas byin can bzhugs pa dang /mtsho rgyal gsang phug sangs rgyas ye shes/me long rdo rje bcas kyi sgrub phug dang / rang byon ni mas mthon po la 'dzegs te phyin pas/ gu ru rin po ches sgo chung ngu yangs por byas pa'i sgo g.yas g.yon du zhabs rjes/ yig drug rang byon dang / gu ru'i dbu skra'i rjes/glags lta ba'i srin po'i sbar rjes/ srin po mnan pa'i brag srin khungs/ de nas yar la them skas la 'dzegs pas sgo srung dang po shol gyi bya rog gnyis pa dung dkar g.yas 'khyil/ gsum pa gser gyi rus sbal dang / de nas skas mthon por mar phyin pas sgrub phug dang gu ru'i phyag rjes/ phug pa'i nang gzugs sgra dri ro rog bya dang / brdung na so sor skad 'byin pa/ sangs rgyas stong gi gaṇḍi brdung bas gaṇḍi'i skad grags pa/ glang chen sa la rab brtan/ srin po brtul ba'i gnas/bsgral ba'i brang / glo snying / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gzhong mchod rten rjes/ mkha' 'gro'i bro ra/mkha' 'gro mang po'i phyag mdzub rjes/gter sgrom/gter sgo/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi phyag phreng rgyu rakṣa'i rjes/gshin rje zhal gzigs dus ma lha'i zhal rang byon byis pa lo brgyad tsam gyi phur pa sa la gdab pa ngos la 'bul ba/ gu ru'i phyag gis bris pa'i ju yig mtho 198

gang pa shin tu gsal ba sogs dang /sgrub gnas shod du/sku smad rang byon sku stod gter chen rarna gling pas sman 'dam las bzhings pa'i dpal chen po bzhengs sku mi tshad lhag gu ru'i sku tshab gsung 'byon bdud dpung zil gnon/ gu ru mtshan brgyad mda' tshad ma/ gu ru drag mthing mda' tshad lhag gsar bzhengs dang / padma phrin las tshad cung med tsam pa bcas 'jim sku/ sgrub chen chos 'phel gdung rten gser dngul bkra ma mda' tshad med tsam rdo rje drag mo'i sku rten bcas so/ /gnas 'dzin la rdo rje grags pa brgyad grwa 'dug sku zhabs rig 'dzin chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i mdun nas/ gu ru chos dbang gter ma slob dpon za hor ma/ rgod sdom gter ma gu ru za hor ma dang / kun bzang dgongs pa zangs thal gter sgrom rin po che shel gyi mchod sdong mtho gang pa dbyibs bal yul mchod rten spar gdab pa lta bu zhig mjal/zla2tshes1la u rgyan smin grong gling du mjal/ dbyar gnas gtsug lag khang phyams ka ba nyi shu sgo shub tu mchod bskor phan yon/ dkar chags/ srid 'khor/ brtsam par bya zhing ma dang / rgya chen bzhi'i zhal byang sum 'bi sogs lo chen gsungs shin tu legs/ khri chen dang /mkhan po'i bzhugs khri shin tu legs pa/rgyan bzhi ser po'i bla bre g.yon spug gu ru mtshan brgyad dang /gnas bcu ngos bris shin tu legs/dri 199

gtsang khang ka bzhi thog gnyis/ thub pa rgyab yol rgyan drug thog mtho gnyis/mchog zung 'dom do pa zhi dul thal sbyar can bog dro/nye sras 'dom phyed do pa dang / khro bo sgo srung gnyis bcas shin tu legs/zangs gser thub pa mi tshad/shing gi rnam rgyal dang byang chub mchod rten 'dom do pa gnyis/ sgo gsum steng sgo bcas/ khyams g.yas su si rgya mtsho dang / sbug kun bzang la bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi bla ma brgyud pa/'phros tshe dpag rgya sku chen po bris/ gser rnga gsar pa drug cu/ gtsug lag khang g.yas sbug zhal ras lha khang ka bzhi mar/ gu ru mtshan brgyad rdza 'dag gser mi che tshad shin tu sgros/ gtso bo u rgyan za hor zangs gser rten gtso tshe dpag thog slebs/ g.yas 'jam dbyangs smra seng /g.yon spyan gzigs seng ge sgra rnam 'joms khro dkar/ yid bzhin 'khor lo bcas mi tshad/ thub dbang zangs gser mi tshad/ gter bdag gling pa zangs gser mi tshad/ gos rnying gnam rgyan/khri bde chen mchog grub dngul gdung 'dom do 'dra zhal bcas/ bka' 'gyur cha gcig spu na rtul tshon khang bcas/ g.yon sbug mgon khang dpal chen lha khang ka bzhi pa/ gtso bo che mchog rol mtsho'i dam can sde dgu/ bla rdo srog 'khor sogs/ gter ma lo lnga mtshams brje gtor khru gang pa re/ rtse khra khru gang yod/g.yon sgo 'chams sa don pa'i sgo g.yas sgo rgyan khang sgo /200

tshul shing nyis brgya lhag yod/thog g.yon nas khri chen yid bzhin dbang rgyal dngul gdung khang ka bzhi mar/spug phyed yar mtho dbus/ yid rgyal dngul gdung 'dom phyed gsum phra rgyan phun sum tshogs/g.yas nas yum ka bde chen rgyal mo/sdug bsngal rang grol gtso 'khor lnga/ dpal chen 'dus pa bcas 'dom phyed re 'dam legs/dkar shod mtshan brgyad dgu thang /khri padma dbang rgyal 'jam dbyangs/tshe dpag med/sgrol dkar/slob dpon rgya gar ma/rgyal ba phrin las rgya mtsho bcas sman 'dam/ dbus 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'i dngul gdung 'dom gang / thub pa gser byug 'jim sku khru gang gtso 'khor gsum/phur pa yang gsang spu gri mi tshad 'jim/ rdor sems dngul sku mi tshad khri zangs gser/ phun rab pas phul 'jam dbyangs zangs gser khri bcas mi tshad/ sangs rgyas kun dga' rab byung dang / de'i sras mo ye shes sgron me'i 'dra sku/ gnas bcu lnga thang /zangs mdog dpal ri sogs thang / rgya mthong khar rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad 'jim sku /rnying rgyud/kun mkhyen snga phyi'i gsung sde spar li ma bzhi bcu tsam/ 6rgyan gos sku bcas/ lha khang nyi 'od 'khyil pa ka bzhir/bstan 'dzin chos sgron/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ thang rgyal/ rje tsong kha pa/ sa paṇa/ zhang / zur chen shāka 'byung lnga pa/a ti sha bcas sman sku 201
