rtse khru gang lhag khri legs pa/ slob dpon sku zangs gser yum bzhengs mkhan chos gnyis 'jim/ khri padma dbang rgyal gyi dngul gdung 'dom phyed gsum rgyan phun sum tshogs/ shing gi mchod sdong cha brgyad/ lha rgya ris pas phul ba bka' 'gyur bris ma/ rigs lnga chos rgyal li ma sogs li ma sha stag sum cu lhag thang ka bco lnga tsam/ gnam rgyan phun tshogs rgyan bzhi/shar ngos gter gsar lha khang ka brgyad mar/ dbus su bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor/g.yas su zhi ba/ g.yon du khro bo bcas blos bslang gsum lo chen rin po che'i rnam dpyod las byung ba shin tu khyad mtshar/che mchog bskyed rdzogs 'bring po khru gang / gter bdag gling pa sku spar lnga bcu/pad gling rta mgrin/thugs chen bder gshegs kun 'dus/rdor sems rig 'dzin thugs tig dregs 'joms/ drag dmar/bla ma rdo rje 'chang bcas shin tu sgros ldan rdza sku gser byugs mi tshad chung ngu re/ lkorgyan gter bdag gling pa'i sku khri bcas byin ldan sku tshad/gar tshe dang /slob dpon za hor ma zangs gser byis pa lo bcu gnyis tshad/ padma 'gyur med rgya mtshor bka' 'gyur mi dbang gis spar phud phul ba/ rdzas brgyad zangs gser ma/dus 'khor dang /padma brgya ldan dkyil thang rnying pa/ gnam rgyan mngags btags rgyan bzhi/202

g.yas logs bde chen gling ka drug mar dbus su mi 'gyur dpal sgron dngul gdung rin po che 'dom bzhi pa phra rgyan ngo mtshar/ g.yas su thub dbang zangs gser/ g.yon du gter bdag gling pa dang rin chen rnam rgyal khri bcas mi tshad 'jim sku/ nub ngos tsandan dmar po'i mtshan brgyad khru gang gtso bo bcas/ li ma sna tshogs brgya tsam/ bka' brgyad dpal dgu 'dam sku legs pa bskum khru gang / rgyab 'bum/rgyal ba lnga pa'i bka' 'bum/ bka' ma'i gzhung pod sogs/ g.yon du thub dang /gter chen bka' 'bum pod dgu tsan dkar mchod rten cha brgyad/bka' brgyad dgu thang /mchod rdzas gser jus rtags brgyad gnam yol/drag dmar dkyil 'khor zangs gser/mi 'gyur dpal sgron sku bcas/nub ngos gnas brtan lha khang ka drug mar/ gnas brtan khri rgyab yol bcas sku mda' tshad rdza 'dam shin tu spus dag bcu drug sangs rgyas rab bdun/smin gling bla brgyud bcu gcig bcas tshad de mtshungs/gu ru zangs gser khri rgyab yol bcas/de nas rtsa 'chams dkar yol yu ring yod pa'i phyag mdzod khang pa gcig de nas spyi so'i khang pa gcigade nas thogs khar 'dzeg te phyin pas/lo chen rin po che'i gzim chung bde ba can du lo chen 'dra zhal dge slong bgres po zhi dul can sku tshad khri bcas/ g.yas su rgyal ba klong 203

chen gangs thod 'dra zhal dpe can mda' gang /mdun du thub pa mda' gang zangs gser/gter chen rin po che dang /o rgyan rin po che lo chen thugs dam sman sku khru gang ba/ mtshan brgyad gser sku khru gang pa shin tu sgros/zhal thang rnying pa lnga/ gsar pa zhi khro sogs drug legs po/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang dus gsum sangs rgyas zangs gser mda' gang pa re//drong rnying rgyud bshad gter sgam nang / dpe cha pod sna tshogs nyi shu dbu rtser bla ma lha khang ka bzhi mar sman 'jim khyad 'phags kyi/ khri rgyab yol shing brkos spus dag dbus su kun bzang rgyan drug g.yas na rdo rje sems dpa'/'jam dpal bshes gnyen/u rgyan/bee ro/mtsho rgyal/rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/g.yu sgra snying po/mnga' bdag nyang /chos dbang /g.yon nas dga' rab/ye shes mdo/shrī seng ha/chos rgyal/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ nam snying / rdo rje bdud 'joms/ phrin las lhun grub dpal yul kun sher lta bu/ gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal ba skal bzang dang / yang sku phreng gcig dbus su rgyal ba klong chen/padma 'gyur med rgya mtsho/ rin chen rnam rgyal bcas/ btsun mo bkras btags //ma yol dang / ka dam 'ga' re bzang mdo dbang bla brgyud ngos 204

thog rgyan khang lcang lo can na/ gsung sprul rin po che tshul khrims rdo rje'i phyag bzos che mchog shing 'bags legs po dang / zhubs legs po kha shas mjal/ rgyan gnyer bar sgrubs sil dgu cu tsam yod/mgon khang bsil ba tshal du gter chen rin po che'i phyag bris bskang rdzas nyams mtshar snang /mgon po zhal gyi mgon khang yin/sgo shub g.yas rgyan khang nam mkha' mdzod ka drug mar/ sil snyan srid gsum kun khyab hor sbrubs dam can yid 'gugs/ shang sbub mkhal ma 'brug sgra/ rgya sgrub je gar dus 'khor ba bkra shis 'brug sgrabaka' brgyad rgya sil mtha' yas 'brug sgra/ bka' brgyad sil skad bzang ya la skyon song ba/ lo sar tshes gcig lnga pas gnang ba'i gzhung sbub/ tshes bcu'i tshes brgyad rgya sgrubs srid gsum zil gnon/ tshes bcu'i mang thos 'brug sgra/ gnam gang gtor gshegs hor spub dngos grub 'khyil pa bcas/ rgya gling srid gsum yid 'gugs dang /lha mo yid 'gugs/rkang dung srid gsum nya kha cha gnyis/dngul dung 'dzam gling 'brug sgra/ phyag mdzod kun dga' tshul khrims dang / mkhyen rab gnyis kyis phul ba'i rgyan bzhi'i sku phod/ tshangs pa brgya byin gyis gser gzhi btsun mo bkras btags bcas/ gos phod phal cher nang sha gos chen/phod ka brgya lhag yod zer/snam sbyar bzhi bcu tsam bkyo rgyu yod zer/205

stegs kheb yang de ltar yod/ bkras btags dang skyin khab sngon po'i phrag 'geb/ dngul gyi spos phor drug rgya rag gser ma'i spos phor bzhi/dngul gyi ril ba spyi blugs snod bcas/ gzhan rab gnas dngul bum chen po dgu sogs yod/yang dag dang tshogs 'dus thod sku/ bka' brgyad rten dgugur dgu/thod dgu/bum byang dgu sogs mjal/kun bzang mchod sprin khang sgo khang g.yon du mchod chas sku chas mang du yod/sil zhing skyong /de nas gsang sngags pho brang sgo 'phyor sod g.yab la/ chos rgyal chen po/bdud 'dul/ nor skyong 'dul ba/o rgyan gsung 'byon mi snas bskor ba rnams ngos bris shin tu legs/ 'du khang ka ba sum cu so drugaka ba re'i bar 'dom lhod gsum pa zhi ba'i drwa phyed la shing lo bcas pa'i me tog nor bu'i phreng ba/ rtags brgyad phyag mtshan lnga/ drag po'i drwa phyed mi mgo'i phreng ba'i gdung yol/zhing glang stag gi lpags pa mgo lag rkang snying glo mchin rgyu ma'i phreng ba/bskang rdzas 'phan sna tshogs phye 'phul gru gsum pa'i rgyal mtshan brgya/ dregs 'joms bskang ba nang 'khod skong rdzas/'phan ring shar nyi shu pa cha gnyis/zhal thang kun bzang bde stong mkhyen bris dgu thang / yang cha gcig bla ma gsang 'dus/ gter chen bla ma/ snang srid zil gnon sogs mkhan chen rma rgyan bstan 'dzin 206

rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i tshes bcu'i zhal thang bcu gsum can/ skyes rab dpag bsam sum cu snar thang spar ma tshon btang / sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/yang dag mnyam sbyor bcas/ gshed dastar/ dus 'asdor/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ tshogs chen 'asdos pa bcas nor chab mtha' shan gter chen phyag bri/ rgyab byang can/rdzogs chen bla brgyud rdor sems rigs lnga/dga' rab/ ldang ma lhun rnal rtse btsun zhang / me long rdo rjer shādma las 'brel ku ma rā dza/ phyin las lhun grub la sna tshogs rang grol/ bstan 'dzin grags pa/thugs sras zla tā sogs/u rgyan rin po che la khri stod /mtsho rgyal/ shri seng ha la bi ma dhadha /tshwa na sna tra/ chos sku kun bzang 〉sdo 'bar ba/mkhas shā nyi 'bum la jo 'bor sogs/ mkhas grub mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/ gsang bdagaku ma rā dza/gter chen rin po che bcas 'gran gyi do med/ lha bzo sprul sku mkhyen brtse chen mo'i lugs/ zhal thang sgam bco lngar nyis brgya lhag yod snang / thub dbang gos sku 'phred 'dom drug rnga lnga bcu lhag sbug 207

zangs gser sku khri phun sum tshogs par gter bdag gling pa'i 'dra zhal byin chags gsung 'byon ma/gser kong sogs mchod rdzas bcas/g.yon ka gdong zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo'i zhal thang gter chen shangs mtshal gyis bris pa/ spug tu rig 'dzin thugs jig zhal thang gter chen sku dus shom pa dang / thugs thig gtor ma gtan mi brje ba/ khri chen/mkhan po'i bzhugs khri brkos ma gnyis/gtsang khang spug ka bzhi mar/lo ro bkra shis mthong smon nas drangs thugs chen phyag bzhi zangs gser zhal mtho gsum pa 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor mi tshad sma na sku thub pa drug 'dom phyed gsum tsam pa dang / khro bo gnyis/ bzhugs khri gnyis/nang du sangs rgyas stong / phyir sangs rgyas stong ngos bris/ sgo yar bstan gnyis/gsang sgo gnyis/ldeb bris gter chen gsung 'byon/thog khar stong sku lha khang du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mda' tshad/sangs rgyas stong khri rgyab bcas rdza sku zhal ngor gser/ gzhan rag 'gyur byugs pa/rig 'dzin lha khang du/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga brag ri ma 'dam legs pa dang / li ma bcu lhag rnam rgyal mchod rten/ sgrol ma sogs/phyir grwa tshang ljongs rgyu'i gur mang /20sdung bde chen gling lha khang spug rje btsun phrin las chos sgron sku

gdung dngul gdung 'dom phyed do/ rtser shel sgor thugs dkyil nas phebs pa'i ring bsrel rdo rje can/ mkhan slob chos gsum/ bcom ldan 'das/ sgrol ma dkar sngon/gter bdag gling pa/ rin chen rnam rgyal/phrin las chos sgron bcas mi tshad 'dom sku spus dag khri rgyab yol bcas/smin gling gter gsar thang chung legs po nyi shu skor/ li ma sna tshogs sum cu tsam/ chos pod kha shas/ gnam rgyan sogs legs/dbu gur bzhugs sa'i khang mig gcig 'du khang rgya mthong song g.yab la thub pa gnas bcu dang /o rgyan rje 'bangs ngos bris legs/drug bde chen yang rtse ka bzhi mar dbus khri padma bstan 'dzin dngul gdung phra rgyan phun tshogs 'dom phyed gsum/ g.yas g.yon du gter chen sku'i zhun thig gi gdung / yang lo chen rin po che'i gdung gser ljang brdung khru gang pa/ dngul gdung 'dom gang pa phra rgyan khyad 'phags/tsandan gnas bcu nye sras sogs dang / li ma che chung sna tshogs brgya lhag kha sarsha ṇi/ sgrol ma bcas mda' tshad/ gu ru/ gter chen sogs bla sku bzhi/'bum gser bris dang / snag bris/yang mdo sna tshogs rnying rgyud spar ma gcig bris ma pod bco brgyad can/ bka' brgyad bder 'dus pod dgu/shing gi mchod rten cha brgyad bcas/dngul gdung khang ka drug mar/ dbus su rgyal sras rin chen rnam 209

rgyal dngul gdung 'dom gsum phra rgyan phun sum tshogs pa/ g.yas su phrin las rnam rgyal dngul gdung 'dom phyed gsum/ g.yon du nga phod blo gsal rgya mtsho'i dngul gdung 'dom gang / phyag mdzod gcung arshal dngul gdung / zhug tu g.yas su kun bzang mi tshad zangs gser rgyab yol rigs lnga sogs/ de nas rdor sems mi tshad zangs gser/ de'i g.yas lo chen/ de'i g.yas u rgyan gter bdag gling pa zangs gser mi tshad/ g.yon du yorgyan khri rgyab yol la mtshan brgyad can/dga' rab/bi ma la/ ye shes mtsho rgyal bcas zangs gser mi tshad/ yang gu ru rgya gar ma dang / za hor ma zangs gser mi tshad/ 'di rnams shin tu spus dgagayon du rin chen rnam rgyal mi tshad 'dam byin ldan bka' 'gyur chen mo 'brum nag rgyun gcod bris legs pa/ mchod rdzas legs pa mang /mtshan brgyad thang ka legs po dgu sogs bzhugs/g.yon du chu bsgyur lha khang ni/ mkhan chen u rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rjes lha sar chu phyur ba bzlog pa'i grags pas/ rnyed pa chen po'i lha khang bzhengs pa ka bzhi mar rgyal ba tshe dpag zangs gser khri rgyab yol bcas 'dom do/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs khri rgyal yol zangs gser/ dngul sku 'dom gang lhag gu ru rin po che gtso 'khor gsum tsandan dkar pos bskos pa mda' gang / tsan dan dmar po'i mchod 210

rten mda' gang pa re/ gnas bcu dang khyad par thub pa rgyab yol bskos ma ngo mtshar tsandan can/ mtshan brgyad can sku li ma brgya lhagabaka' 'gyur gnam rgyan rgyan bzhi legs/ pod sna tshogs bzhi bcu/dngul ril tshad bzhi'i kong bu sogs bzhugs/mgon khang bsil ba tshal na rol mtsho sde dgu cha tshang sogs yod/yang rgyan khang du gos chen jus dmar zla gam nyer lnga yod ces zer/bla zang chos 'khor lhun po'i dang rten rgyas par dam 'byar/ khri chen khams phebs su khel bas ma mjal kyang / phyag dam med pa rnams rdor 'dzin nas mjal kha gnang / thog mar gzim chung kun bzang pho brang gi chos dbang gter ma yin kyang zer ba'i thub dbang khyad chos gsum ldan lha kṣiṃ smug po gser gyi ga'u mig gsum pa nang dbus su sha lug nas gter bdag gling pa rang gi gter byon gu ru bde ba chen po dngos grub dpal 'bar 'dra ba'i bye ma a krong sku tshabs/ g.yas su rdo rje gling pa'i gter ma she'u'i snyan zhu thur lhub gsol ba rdo rje thod pa can lha kṣiṃ mchin skya li ma/ g.yon du zhig gling gis 'bras spungs mda' khyung tshang brag nas gter bzhes pa'i rdo nag gu ru padma sku 'gags sku sham gsol ba khri la skyilta krung can phyag g.yas rgya gram sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag thod pa bcas/ yang ga'u gcig nang bye ma a krong gi u 2/1

rgyan nor lha g.yas nor bu/ g.yon ne'u le/paṇa zhu chos gos can/ mdun du nor gzhong bcas/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa dgung lo drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i 'dra zhal dbu spa rgyab tu phab pa byin can gser ga'u can/khri chen phrin las rnam rgyal la bu legs po zhes gsung 'byon pa'i sgrol ma rgya gar shar gyi li ser bzhings pa/ sgrol ma rgya gar nub li dmar po phyag g.yon me tog chang bu 'dzin pa/ padma li ser khri phrin las rnam rgyal nas gter chen sku spur la bzhengs sgrol ma 'bum ther lnga bsabs pa'i thugs dam zhal thang / sgrol ma lha kṣi ser po'i sku khyad mtshar/gter chen rin po che'i sku phyag nas brgya rtsa ma/ lo chen rin po che dngos 'dra/khri yid bzhin dbang rgyal la rnam sras gling pas phul ba'i rdo mi la'i rang byon/ dung dkar can sogs tshem gyis bskor ba'i dngul gyi gdan dang khang bzang bcas/ rnam gling nas phul ba 'ja' thugs dam gur drag sku 'dam byin ldan/mkhar rtse dge bsnyen rgyal po dang / snye mo kurma zer ba sman par mkhas pa'i lha pa gnyis kyis lo ngo gnyis la bris pa kun mkhyen lnga pa'i thugs dam 'khrungs rabs kun bzang bde stong ma'i zhal thang /rten sgam dam 'byar nang / rgyal po dzaḥl gsang bdag gis dbang bskur ba'i gser dang gnam lcags 'dres pa/ gter chen thugs/bsam gtan rdo rje'i phyag ngar padma sambha'i rang byon can/ril bu a dam 212

ma dang trīḥrgya ma/klong chen pa'i snam sbyar sogs nyi shu rtsa grangs/yang sgam dam 'byar na gter chen rin po che'i sgrol ma bu shog ser thams cad yod/ chos rgyal khri srong phyag spub mnga' bdag nyang gter/ yang mnga' bdag nyang gi phyag sgrub shangs sgrub/ sde pa gzhung kun mkhyen lnga pas gnang ba'i sil gser shub ma 'dzam gling sgra snyan ni gaḥthog gar spyod 'dra ba/ tshes bcu'i 'chams rol ngar cha 'brug sgra/mi dbang dmag brda' zer ba'i 'khar rnga khyad mtshar/ gter chen bla mar mkha' 'gros phul ba'i dung gser ljang gshog beeḍūr dkar po sogs za rgyan btab pa bcas/ sgam dam 'byar nang jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i sku rgyan rin chen byin ldan nyams mtshar de yod zer/ gzim spug ka bzhi mar padma dbang rgyal 'dra sku la bka' brgyad chos tshan cha gnyis/snye mdo nas drangs pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku li ma byis pa lo brgyad tshad/ phrin las lhun grub dgongs rdzogs tsandan gu ru gtso 'khor la mtshan brgyad/g.yon bde chen mchog grub bzhengs pa tsu ru/ spug tu gong ma na gter bdag gling pa/ 'og na yid bzhin dbang rgyal dngos 'dra/ thugs dam bka' 'gyur/lo ki shwa ra tsan dmar/li ma sna tshogs brgya lhag phyi rol gzim chung mdo ka ba lnga bcu/ g.yas su mtshan gzim khang na gter bdag gling pa nga 'dra ma gsung byon/ li gter sna tshogs brgya tsam/213

g.yon du dpe mdzod khang na pod nyis brgya lhag pa/shar ngos mkhan rabs bzhugs pa'i gzim chung rnam 'grel yang rtser bde gshegs kun 'dus lha cha tshang gser sku legs/ gter bdag gling pa/rgya nag mchod khri gnyis/li gter gser zangs sna tshogs bdun cu tsam dang /pod brgya nye/g.yas ngos dbang khang ka drug phyir shar ngos mdo sbug gnyis dbang chas khang khro bcu khra thabs gtso bcas/ phur cha bzang ngan gnyis/tsandan dkar dmar la brkos pa gnyis mjal/'og tu zhug na gser gdung lha khang ka bzhi ma'i dbus su gter chen rin po che'i sa'i gser gdung zangs gser dngul bkra ma 'dom gsum lhag pa'i mchon rten cha brgyad mi tshad lhag re/kha sarsha ṇi li tshad/sbug ga la'i bkod pa'i dbus dus gsum sangs rgyas mi tshad zangs gser/ g.yon gdung tha ma sras chung zhig gi gdung / phyi rol 'khulas ka ba bcu gnyis par khri gnyis/ gter chen rin po che khyung ras pas bzhengs zangs gser/u rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i gzim chung ngo mtshar kun gzigs ka gnyis mar thub pa byin chen dbus li ma brgya tsam/mchod rten chen po'i shar sgor byams khang du byams pa 'dom gsum/byang chub sems dpa' gnyis/tshad med gong ma'i nang du sangs 214

rgyas byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can sman sku mi tshad dang / logs ris phyi nang du lta bar sangs rgyas stong sku dang /rdor sems/sgrol ma bcas brgya sku re dang / rigs gsum nges med sna tshogs bzhugs/bum pa'i nang /logs ris kha nang ltar/ shar ngos su/ rigs drug pa kun bzang yab yum/ rigs lnga/ sems dpa'/ thub drug sgo ba yab yum/ sgyu 'phrul zhi ba/ kun bzang yab yum/ rigs lnga/ thub drug sgo bzhi/sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gtso 'khor/ sgyu 'phrul khro bo gtso 'khor/yang dag so lugs gtso 'khor/ phur pa yang gsang sru gri gtso 'khor/bka' brgyad bder 'dus/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa gtso 'khor/'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gtso 'khor/ nyang gi mkha' 'gro chen mo gtso 'khor/ dus 'khor yab yum sogs/ kha nang lta'i shar ngos rnam snang mi tshad 'jim sku gser ljib byugs/ srog g.yogs grub bzhir logs bris bder gshegs kun 'dus yab yum gtso 'khor/ lung gi che mchog yab yum/ khrag 'thung rigs lnga / dbang mchog he ru ka sogs gsang 'dus thod phreng rtsal yab yum mtshan brgyad bcas so//bum pa gong mar/ gu ru gtso 'khor gsum mi tshad lhag sman 'dam gser grib byugs/ logs ris nang du/mkhan slob chos gsum/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang / zur chen gtso bo la mdo sgyu'i bla ma rnams kyis 215

bskor ba/ gnub chen la gnub kyi bla brgyud yod pa/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa la rdzogs chen bla brgyud gu ru chos dbang nyang ral gnyis la gter ston brgya rtsa sogs/pad gling rgyal ba lnga pa/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ gsang bdag dpa' bo phrin las lhun grub/gter bdag gling pa/ srog shing g.yogs gru bzhi zhal ba kha phyir bstan la rgya gar rigs 'dzin brgyad/ snang mtha'/shāka thub dang gtad rabs bdun/sa 'dzin phar tshur 'dam bcu gcig dang gru gang / rtser gser gyi chos 'khor rim pa bco brgyad/ gzungs chen sde lnga/lañtsa zar tshags bcas spus dag gtsug lag khang gsum la gser rtog re/ khyad par gsang sngags pho brang gser tog spus dag dang / mtha' bzhir gser tog chung bzhi/ gnyer khang gzim chung kun bzang yang rtser zangs gser khang bzang 'dra ba gnyis/ lha khang gsum la gser gyi rgyal kṣiṃ/tshan brgyad/bskor lam jo gcal/ rdo brtsigs khar rje 'bangs nyer lnga / snga 'gyur bla brgyud/ ltung bshags gnas bcu sogs rdo lha legs po dang / grub chen brgyad cu/ lhung bshags sogs mtshan gzungs sngags lardzo wa rtu bris ma sna tshogs/shug sdong chen po lnga tsam 'dug khri chen man grwa skal ba len mkhan gzhi byes tshang ma brgya lnga bcu nga brgyad yod do/ /zla dang po'i gzhug tshes gnyis bka' brgyad sgrub mchod gter chen sku mchod la khel/216

gnyis par thugs chen bde kun lnga pa'i tshogs mchod/ gsum pa deng sprugs mang /bzhi par bka' ma'i sgrub mchod brgyad/lnga par tshes bcu/drug par dbyar gnas/ bcu gcig par khro rol/ bcu gnyis lo gzhug dregs 'joms gtor bzlog sogs yod/ltag na sgrub grwa gsar pa sga rje dbu mdzad dang / 'bras ljangs sprul sku/ lha lu gung gis btsugs pa'i sgrub grwa phog yod mi drug rdor 'dzin nor bu dpon g.yog lhag gnyis/g.yog bcas/phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i phur cha legs po gtso phur khru gang lhag pa dang / gu ru mi tshad spyan che ba/snar thang spar ma'i skyes rabs gtso bo tshon/ gzhan mtshal thog snag tshas yang bcad byas pa so ma sogs 'dugagayon zur rje btsun ma'i gdan sa bde chen gling gong 'og gnyis na li sku brgya med tsam yod/ smin gling thad 'dir g.yung ston gdan sa ri khrod skyid po shing tshal can na mgon po byin ldan dang / yang zangs ri ras pa'i gdan sa sogs ri khrod lnga tsam yod/grwa phyi brag po cher grags pa'ang brag chung bde gter sbas yod/grwa phyi tshong 'dus tshogs pa'am byi rdzing tshogs pa gtsug lag mdo ka ba bdun/ gtsang khang ka ba bzhi can/ dus gsum sangs rgyas chen po 'jim/ nang rten gtso bo klu sgrub thugs dam kha che paṇa chen mu stegs 217

rtsod rgyal ma sku bzhings pa mtho gang li snying jo bo'i sku rgyu dang 'dra ba/kha che paṇa chen rdza sku dang / yang sku gcig klu sgrub ka ma rū par phyag bskos/ thub pa mdzad bcu/ klu 'jim klu sgrub phyag bzos thub pa gtso 'khor gsum rgyan drug bcas/ yang thub sku rgyab nā ga ri'i yi ge can/mchog gling spyan drangs gu ru'i tshab/ rgyal ba lo ras pa'i zhun thig las phebs bde mchog he ru ka phyag rgyas pa/'phreng po gter chen gter byon rdo nag la 'byar ba'i g.yu'i sgrol ma ngo mtshar/ smri ti'i thub sku/rdo nag seng gdong / pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi chems 'phel nas dam pa'i sku nyi 'od ma gsal ba/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan chem/a dkar po'i mchod rten nang sangs rgyas ring bsrel bye'u'i sgo nga tsam/bka' gdams spyan snga ba'i tshems 'brong rtse lha btsun gyi rten khyung po rnal 'byor thugs/ sa paṇa thugs las byon pa'i dung sogs dngul gyi zi khang na yod/ paṇa chen gyi chos dung / kur lha brgyad mgon khang / thog khar rab gsal du li sku spus dag brgya tsam nang rigs gsum li ma dang ṭī /sna sagazab sku snang / dbu rtser thub pa gnas brtan mi tshad 'jim sku mtha' 'dul chos rgyal gyis bzhengs tshong 'dus lcog na thub pa thog mtho ngos/ nye sras brgyad brgya lugs la bod kyi blon po'i ngo 'dra ba/218

sgo srung ging gang bcas mi tshad byin ldan/mon mkhar rnam sras gling sbug na/ dbus su bla ma yon tan dpal bzang gi chos longs sprul gsum 'khor lo re/ de'i 'og na brtan rgyas gling pa'i sdig bshags ma ṇi 'khor lo/ de'i 'og na rnam sras gling pa'i bka' 'gyur bcas 'khor lo chen po chu 'khor khyad mtshar sogs spus dag yod/rnam sras gling zhwa dmar dgon gsar na tshogs khang ka ba bcu gnyis/ zhug mgon khang / gtsang khang gnas brtan brag ri/ gu ru/pakhri sogs/ sku gdung khang ka drug na zhwa dmar dkon mchog gar dbang rgya mtsho'i dngul gdung 'dra zhal/ sku phreng gnyis pa bstan 'dzin phrin las rnam rgyal 'dra zhal/ gsum pa 'jam dpal ngag dbang 'dra zhal/ bzhi pa gar dbang kurma mkhas grub 'dra zhal/ nang rten na dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i tshems mchod rten gnam lcags rdo rje/ dpe cha sna tshogs pod nyis brgya tsam/bka' bstan 'gyur/li ma sna tshogs brgya tsam/rol sil bzang kha shas bcas/la brgal te thur gzar por babs 'phrang skyid g.ya' tsam la brgyud nas song bas bying mda' o dkar brag ri'i mgul na u rgyan rin po che dang por shel brag nas 'phur 'ong nas babs pa'i phug pa rgod tshang can/ rdo skas ring po la 'dzegs/ gu ru'i sgrub phug de'i 219

gong na bee ro'i sgrub phug rdor sems sogs gter bzhes pa'i gnas na rje tsong kha pa'ang zla gsum bzhugs/ de'i 'og na mtsho rgyal sgrub phug sgo dogs zhug yang / de nas nam snying sgrub phug skas ring 'dzegs pa'i gong na yod/ tshur ngos brag skas bzhi 'dzegs pa'i gong yang dgon pa'i gzim zhug na ri shul yon tan dpal bzang bzhugs khang /brag ngos gu ༵ /na po che'i phyag g.yon pa'i rjes 'dom gang pa shin tu gsal bar poyo//ra gzar por babs ring du song bas shel brag gi rgyab ri legs zla ba gsum par khu byug slebs skabs gzhung gi bya ston btang dgos pa'i bya sa lha khang dpal 'khor btsan gyis bzhengs pa ka bzhi sbug khyams ka brgyad/ bskor khang bcas thog shin tu mtho ba gnyis ka gcig gis btegs par/ gtsang khang sgo chen gsum bsgrigs/ dbus rnam par snang mdzad longs sku li ser zhal la mtho bzhi yod pa/ g.yas g.yon snang mtha' thub pa gnyis gos mnab pa de tsam 'jim/ nye sras 'dom phyed gsum pa brgyad/dang king bcas/ g.yon lha khang ka bzhir dus gsum sangs rgyas rgya lugs/ sems dpa' bzhi/ rta mgrin thod mkhar phyag gnyis dbyug pa ltar gdeng ba dang /sgo srung mi g.yo ba bcas/220

rtses thang lnga mchod grwa tshang na tā yi si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan bzhings pa thub dbang dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / nye sras brgyad thog gnyis pa/ 'du khang ka ba nyer lnga / g.yas 'jam dbyangs lha khang na rje tsong kha pas zhal gzigs 'jam dpal legs bris li ma lnga bcu tsam/jo bo a ti sha'i thugs dam/thub pa gser gling ma/grwa tshang brgya tsam/dga' ldan bshad sgrub chos 'khor na rgyud pa dang 'dra ba'i bsgrigs legs/ dpon po mi dbang gis bzhengs pa'i 'du khang spus dag khyad par bka' 'gyur gsor bris spus dag mi dbang gdung sogs/ rje rin po ches bzhengs pa'i rigs gsum lha khang snga ma phan bde legs bshad gling pas 'dzin pa'ang yod/'on rgyal sras gong ma'i sku gdung grong mthar mchod rten ser hrul/chu phar don/ mnga' ris grwa tshang grwa sum brgya mtshan nyid rtsod/ dge 'dun rgya mtshos bzhings pa'i gtsang khang du byams pa/ nye sras brgyad/dzam lha/rta mgrin 'dam thog re/ byams pa gser sku thog gcig rgyal ba gnyis pa'i sku/khri/mi tshad thub sku li ma/'du khang spus dag ka ba so lnga/steng zhal ras lha khang du rje bkra shis rdo kha ma/ dge bshes pu to ba'i thugs dam byams pa li ma char 'bebs ma khru gang lhag rta nag 'gos khug pa lhas btsas gser gdung rgya gar ma zer yang 'gos lo gzhon nu 221

dpal ba'am yid bzang rtse pa yin snyam/ li ma sna tshogs lnga bcu tsam spus dag kha shas/ mgon khang na pu to ba'i thugs dam gsang 'dus li ma yang bka' 'gyur khang na/ 'gos khug btsas sku yid bzang rtse pa 'dra/bka' 'gyur gnyis bcas so//zangs dri mkhar dmar na 'og 'du khang ka bzhi mar/ ma gcig dgung lo go dgu pa'i 'dra sku khru gsum pa/ rdo rje 'chang phyag rgya can spyan gsum zhi ma khro byin chags 'jim sku la zangs gser dbu rgyan dang mgul rgyan/ gser sprug zhu ni sgam du dam 'byar ro/ /sras thod smyon/ li ma/dam pa sangs rgyas/ rgyal ba don 'grub/ thod pa bha dra la 'dus rdo rje sgron ma sogs sngar yod/ ma gcig grub rgyal/ su kha si rnyi/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ yum chen mo/jo bo a ti sha/ sras mo rgyan bzhi sogs mda' tshad/rje tsong kha pa/rgyal ba lnga pa dus gsum sangs rgyas/gnas brtan bcu drug mda' tshad brag ri ma legs pa dang / nye sras brgyad rtse khru re bcas gsar bzhengs 'jim/ bsam 'grub pho brang gis bzhengs rdor sems dang /yid bzhin 'khor lo mi tshad gsar bzhengs/byang chub mchod rten bcas/nang rten grwa mngon gter ma yin skad phyag drug pa 'jim spar lta bu phag mo li ma/ thub sku li dmar/ ma gcig gter ma rdo nag rdo rje 22 2

'chang yin zer ba sogs phor pa chen po'i nang cha shas/ skyo ston bsod nams bla ma'i dbu thod la chadang / khyad par phag mo rang byon ngo mtshar can/ ma lab sgron gsol phor kha gcod bcas/gsol khag thod phreng /phyag ṭam zlum po la la can/ phyag dril rgya gar ma/ kṛ 'i rwa dung cha/sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gsol dkar bag spyan cha brgyad yod pa/de'i sku chos/ sku rags/ma gcig zhal lham/sras mo la 'dus zhabs lham yin zer ba/ ma gcig rus rgyan 'thor bu bcas/ de nas gdan sa thol brag ri dkar po shug pa'i nags yod pa nyams dga' bar 'dzegs te phyin pas mchod khang chen por slebs/ thog mar nang rten mjal bas rdo rje gdan gyi rgyal po ma hā rā dzas spyan snga phag gru rgyal ba rin po ches rdor gdan zhig gsos gnang bar phul ba'i ston pa'i tshems sor byed gsum/byang sems chos 'phags chegros 'gram so mkhyid gang / phag mo gru pa'i phyag gi dar thag bod khri skor la dbang mdzad kyi spyan snga sde srid phag mo grub pa'i ba ba'i phyag dam mkhyid gang / phag gru spyan snga rgyal ba rin po che'i dbu thod ngo mtshar/rdo nag la yig drug rang byon/rdo rje phag mo phag mor grur lo bcu drug dus 'das pa'i dbu thod la phag mo'i rang byon gsal ba/stag lung thang pa'i dbu thod smug dkar/ 'gro mgon rin po che'i thugs rten lha kṣi mchod rten/'gro mgon bzhengs khag lcags grub/ 223

yang dbu thod zhal byang med pa gcig 'gro mgon rin po che'i mnab chos/snam sbyar/zhwa ser/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i gdung rus/ phag grus gdung zhugs 'bul rdo la ring bsrel phebs pa/ rdo rje rgyal po'i lham/gzhon nu dpal gyi zhal 'gram khug pa lhas btsas zhal 'gram/ gsung rten rdo nag la rdo dkar a dkar 'bul dod/ lcags gser rdo rje rtse lnga chos skyong phyag bzhi'i rten/ kri sa ri'i zhal dung / 'gro mgon phag grub pa'i gsol lhung lha kṣiṃ dmar pos chos rgyal srong btsan dbu yi prog zhu khyad 'phags/phag gru'i gdung gi zhabs rjes/thugs dam brgyad stong /hu la hus phul ba'i g.yang ṭi dang / chu shing nag po'i phyag 'khar gnyis khams nas phebs pa'i shang lang / 'khar gsil dang kha ṭwāṃ/gsang ba 'dus pa yab sna kṣiṃ ser/ yum dmar po khru gang / rgya gar shar li khyad 'phags bcas/phyi rten gyi rim pa la/ shar 'bri gung pa lho skal ldan ye shes seng ge dang g.ya' bzang pa/ nub khro phu khu dbon/ byang stag lung pas brtsigs/khyon sgom chen brgyad brgyas brag brkos/ phyag rjes mang po yod pa'i gtsug lag khang dmar po 'og khang 'dom drug bar 'dom do/ steng do bcas/shing cha mkha' 'gros nam mkha' nas drangs/ thog so lnga / ngos rer 'dom nyi shu yod/ 'og khang ka ba bzhi bcu can gyi ka ba 'dom gyis 224

mi 'khyud tsam thog khar nub ngos rab gsal ka gnyis mar/thub pa rdor gdan li ma rgyab yol rgyan drug ma bzang po khru tshad bzhi gtsos/ li rag zangs gser sku rnying sna tshogs dang / bka' gdams gdung rten skor nyis brgya tsam/ rgyal ba lha gzigs ras pa'i sku mi tshad/ stag lung thang pa'i gser 8 tsandan phyag stong spyan stong khru phyed do tsam phyag re re nas yod pa/u rgyan mi tshad gnyis/byang shar zur khang du/ rgyal ba rigs lnga chos rgyal li ma mda' tshad dang / li ma sna tshogs bzhi bcu tsam/thub dbang li ma mi tshad/ 'gro mgon sku/spyan snga mi tshad gser sku/zhwa dmar 'jim sku mi tshad/bkra shis tshe ring ma dang /phyag bzhi pa'i rten/shar ngos bla ma lha khang ka bzhi mar tā si byang chub rgyal mtshan gser sku mi tshad/ dngul gar blugs tshe dpag med sprul sku mda' tshad/thub sku sogs li ma khru tshad bdun/ thub li mi tshad/ zhwa dmar sku 'jim mi tshad gnyis/ spyan snga rim byon mi tshad che li ma bzhi rgyal ba thog rgyugs li ma mi tshad che zangs gser dbu zhwa bcas/ dbu steng bde mchog zangs gser gdugs/ yang gdan sa thol bla rabs zangs gser mi tshad lnga /yang gnyis pod chen brgya lhagachos skyong rten bcas/gtsug lag khang chen mo'i byang ngos nas rim par/ rnga chen 'dom 225

gang pa gnyis/steng mchod khang sogs/spyir rdo rje 'chang la bka' brgyud bla mas bskor ba nang gi lha/ gdung rten bkra shes sgo mang phyi yi lha/ 'gro mgon 'jags skyis sku bzhi sogs gsang ba'i lhar grags/shar dbus/byang g.yas/lho g.yon/nub sgo phyogs so/ /dbus su rdo rje 'chang /g.yas te lo/g.yon nā ro/ g.yas mar pa/ g.yon mi la bang rim dang po/ bang rim gnyis par dbus thub pa bal po'i li ser bla ma ldum ra sgang pa'i nang rten 'dom gang lhag g.yas dwags po/g.yon phag mo gru pa/de'i g.yas spyan snga rin po che/g.yon 'bri gung skyobs pa bcas 'jim sku sman 'dres mi tshad sne gdong dgon gsar nas bzhengs/ bang rim gsum pa la rje yab sras gsum/ bang rim bzhi par phag zhang rje gsum li masna tshogs khru tshad/'dom phyed pa sogs khyon lnga bcu skor nang rgyal ba rigs lnga legs po yod/bang rim de kun gung la/ phag gru'i gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar 'gro mgon thugs bzhugs pa/ nyi zla la gser gar blugs kyi sku/ bka' gdams gdung rten/gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis pa'i gser zangs dbu gdugs 'khrugs pa zhi byed/ g.yas 'bri gung skyobs pa'i gdung rten bkra shis kun tu 'od/ gser gar sku nyi zla'i dkyil bzhugs pa dang / g.yon de mtshungs spyan snga rin po che'i gdung bkra shis 'od dpag g.yas 'jam dbyangs grags pa ye shes 226

gdung /g.yon gnyis mchod rin po che'i gdung bcas tshan 'dra rgyu 'dra/byang lho'i ka bar dom ring la g.yas nas bla ma rgyal ba rin po che ste thog thub ma zhes hu la hu stod hor dang / rgya gar rgyal po dbang du 'dus pa de'i sku dang / bcu gnyis rnying ma rdo rje rin chen 'gro mgon sprul pa lo drug mi gzim nas sgom pa po de dang / 'jam dbyangs grags ye zhes zhog pa rer sdud pa re tsam thugs la chud pa can dang / gser thog pa'am gnyis mchod pa zhes pho nya'i lam la mnga' brnyes pa phyag rdor sprul pas gdon 'dul ba dang /tshes bzhi rnying ma grags pa rgyal mtshan/spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa'i sku mi tshad sman 'jim mo/ g.yon nas bcu gnyis gsar mar grags pa shes rab bde mchog bsnyen pa dung song ba dang /tshes bzhi gsar ma grags pa byang chub dang /bco brgyad gsar ma grags pa byang chub dang / gnam gang gsar ma dpal ldan bcas pa'i sku/dbus ka g.yas nas spyan snga ba rgyal ba rin po che'i gser gdung bkra shis sgo mang thog mnyam zangs gser li ma spus dag lo bcu gnyis su bzhengs 'bri gung sgo mang las cung che 'dam bzhi tsam yod par gda'/ 'og sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i steng zlum brtsigs la mgon po phyag bzhi sogs chos srung / rnam sras sogs nor lha/sa'i lha mo sogs 2 27

lha/dga' bo 'jog po sogs klu brgyad/ rgyal chen bzhi bcas/ che ba rnams mda'/'bring ba khru/chung ba mtho/gzhan phyed sku 'bur ma pa tra'i bar gnas so/ /de ni srung ma'i bang rim mo/ /de'i steng yar mar pad zlum so/ /de'i steng lo gyon ma sogs lha mo nyi shu tsam 'bur sku dang /mchod lha byed 'bur mchod lha'i bang rim/ de nas zur bzhi logs brgyad rta babs lta bu'i khri bang rim la sangs rgyas thub pa rdor gdan li ma/rigs lnga/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas li ma/ sangs rgyas stong sku phyed 'bur sangs rgyas bang rim/de steng rdo rje dbyings/ rtse mo/dpal mchog sogs rgyud sde 'og ma'i bang rim/ de steng shar gsang 'dus/ lho bde mchog nub dgyes rdor/byang dus 'khor li ma/ 'khor bla med rgyud sde'i bang rim steng bde mchog lhan skyes bzhi dang / phag mo bcu drug bya ltar lding ba/ de'i steng rdo rje 'chang nas bka' brgyud bla ma'i gser sku/ de nas gdung khang / nyi zla'i dkyil na gser gar blugs sku/ mdor na lha grangs nyis stong brgyad brgya sgo mang thams cad 'di 'dra phyogs mtshungs las 'di spus dag shes so/ /dbu gdugs dgyes rdor lha dgu dkyil 'khor gser zangs/ hor rgyal hu la hus gser bre bdun re las 'phan re/brdung ba'i gser 'phen drugaspyan snga dpal ldan bzang po'i sgo mang lha sum stong dgu brgya pa'i dbu thog tu bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor 228

gdugs/spyan snga lha gzigs ras pa'i sgo mang lha sum stong dgu brgya drug cu rtsa gnyis la dus 'khor dkyil 'khor gdugs gser zangs/ spyan snga grags pa shes rab dngul gyi sgo mang lha sum stong dgu brgya la bde mchog drug cu re gnyis ma'i gdugs/lha chen brgyad kyi zangs gser thub sku g.yas 'jam dbyangs gu shrī nang rten/ g.yon sangs rgyas mar me mdzad steng phyag rdor 'byung 'dul zangs gser gdugs/ de'i g.yon byang chub chen po'i sku byams pa dang spyan gzigs can steng na bde mchog drug cu re gnyis gdugs yod pa/de'i lhor thub sku/ g.yon na tshe dpag med bcas zangs gser re/dbus kyi ka gdong g.yon par a ti sha'i thugs dam kha sarsha ṇi li ma sogs ka ba rer bla ma re'i thugs dam li ma re/ sgo g.yas bcu gcig zhal/rdo la ma ṇi rang byon sogs/'jags skyil rgyab na spyan ras gzigs byin can tsandan go shi ṣa'i lha thugs dkar yod pa/'jags skyis nang du lo bdun bzhugs/ g.yas na lam 'bras mdzod nag ma sogs dpe cha'i sgom du pod bco lnga tsam/nyer spyad sgom/g.yu phug ron tsam/g.yon du nas mdzod/ dbus su rje nyid rabs gnas la byon nas nga 'dra gsungs pa'i sman sku tshad ma/phyag mkhar rdo wa dha ru nag po byin can/ mdun du ka ba 'di 'bri gung skyobs 229

pas 'dzugs skabs 'ja' zug pa la/ skyes mchog nā ro pa'i dbu gdugs li dmar las grub pa mar pas drangs pa/phag gru'i phyag dril/rdo la zhabs rjes bcas/'og na mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sku mgon khang / phyogs bzhir pod stong tsho lnga nye gser snag sna tshogs pas bris pa che shos mtho do pa'ang yod/phag spu'i chos khri steng mnga' ris paṇa chen pas rab gnas gnang ba'i 'dra sku bzhi'i nang gcig rtsigs ngos dha rdo la bskos par rta mgrin zhal gzigs/ gser g.yab 'og gong na phag gru rdo rje rgyal po dang /'og na spyan snga thog thug pa'am rgyal dbang rin po che'i sa 'bum thog gsum pa re bskor lam bcas/ phyi rol chos steng gong ma spyan snga sanyis mchod pa dang /'og rgyal ba tshes bzhi rin po che'i gdung /gsham 'du khang 'phel rgyas gling ka ba bcu drug par gung la 'gro mgon zangs gser 'dom phyed do tsam/ byi pa ma mi tshad/g.yas su rgyal ba gtsang pa rgya ras sman sku/ g.yas su nam pa rang byung rdo rje/ mi bskyod rdo rje/zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug bcas zangs gser mi tshad tsam/ lnga pa/ skal bzang sman sku/ dus gsum sangs rgyas li ma mi tshad/li ma sna tshogs lnga bcu tsam gnas brtan gser sku dkyil 'khor du bzhugs phyag bzhi pa/ bal bris spyan snga bka' brgyud gser phreng gser bris nyams 230

mtshar bcu gsum/ 'gro mgon phag gru'i rnam thar bris rnying khyad mtshar bcu gsum sogs dang pon brgya tsam/de'i 'og tu 'jol mo mthil khang brag phug 'gro mgon dang por phebs par 'gro mgon sku/ yang par ku'i brag gsham na sgrub phug nang du 'gro mgon sku bcas/ dge ldan dang / bde mchog lha lnga 'bri lugs thel lugs bskang gos sogs btang / grwa lnga bcu med tsam/ shug pa stag ma'i nags tshal skyid do//chos 'khor khra 'brug sgo khang g.yon lha khang na skal bzang rgya mtsho/tshul khrims rgya mtsho/sangs rgyas rab bdun/yang gnyis/tshe dpag med/yul 'khor srung bcas 'jim mi tshad/ sgo khang na rgyal chen sde bzhi mi tshad che/lha khang na sde srid kyis bzhengs lnga pa'i sku zangs gser che/ thub dbang /jo 'brom/ dge 'dun grub/dge 'dun rgya mtsho/bsod nams rgya mtsho/yon tan rgya mtsho/rje rin po che/ u rgyan pad zhwa 'dra mnab pa'i lho brag grub chen/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin po che/ u rgyan pad zhwa 'dra mnab pa rtogs ldan 'jam dpal bzang po/ gu ru sher bzang / yang bla ma gcig mi tshad 'jim/mgon khang na/ thel gyis bdag 'dzin skabs bzhengs pa'i phyag bzhi pa 'jigs zil sgros nyams can/bde mchog lhan skyes dang /mgon 231

po'i 'khor khru gang pa nyer lnga tsam/ ngos bris lnga pa'i dus kyi skyes rabs dang /gu ru'i bka' thang spus dgayang lha khang na phyis bzhengs thugs chen rgyal po lung thog gcig rdo rje sku rang byon yin gsungs pa/ g.yas su nags kyi rin chen/ g.yon du sha ba ri bcas mi tshad chung li ma/mi la/lha rje dge 'bum/ sgrol ma dkar ljang / phyag rdor g.yas u rgyan/ rje rigs gsum bcas gsar/snar thang bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur/yang lha khang na mtsho sna bas bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas rab bdun 'jim mi tshad dang mtsho sna ba'i gdung dben sa ba'i gdung 'bum pa mchod/ dge slong dpal mo'i lugs phyag stong spyan stong / dzambha la dang /yul 'khor srung /phyi khyams paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud sbyor drug bla brgyud rgya paṇa mi tshad 'jim rnying bcu bzhi/yang lha khang na/ chos rgyal gyis bzhengs thub dbang sprul sku 'dom gang / g.yas spyan ras gzigs dang / 'od zer spros pas dmag bzlog pa'i rta mgrin/ 'dis rgya la sprul pa'i dmag gis bsdigs/ g.yon rnam 'joms dang /phyag rdor mi bcas mi tshad bcas/dbus gtsang khang gi dkor mdzod g.yas par/ chos rgyal srong 232

btsan rgya bal bza' gnyis/mgar thu mi bcas mi tshad re chos rgyal dus bzhengs dang / gsar bzhengs rnam 'joms sogs/ sgrol ma zhal gzigs gyang ris/dbus gtsang khang ka bzhi mar/ chos rgyal gyis li yul nas zhabs thang la drangs pa'i nye sras li ma mi tshad tsam li ser 'gran bral/ gnam lcags rdo rje/ral gri sogs phyis phul ba/sgo srung g.yas phyag dor dang /spe brtsegs/ 'jam dbyangs gsung gi dbang phyug phyag spyi bor thal sbyar yar stod ra ma nas chu la rkyal nas phebs/ dbus rnam snang /g.yas snang mtha'/ g.yon mi bskyod rdo sku 'dom gang lhag bcu gsum gter nas bzhes 'phros rin 'byung don grub gnyis gang po ri nang yod/lnga pa rin po ches li ma rin 'byung don grub kyis kha bskangs mdzad/ li yul sgrol ma jo mo zhal zas ma gu rur gsung byon/mdzod khang du/chos rgyal gsol thabs na/ dzambha la thugs chen 'gro 'dul/yum yi ge drug ma/sras/sras mo mi tshad/ 'di na rig gsum bgro ba mdzad pa zhal gzigs gnas/ phyi khyams gser bre bdun gyis thu mi /rdzu ṭas phyag bris mdzad pa'i yig drug oṃ ring cha can 'bru rer mtho g.yon lha khang na chos rgyal dus bzhings sems nyid ngal gso/sras/233

sras mo/ rnam sras mdung dmar/ smre brtsegs bcas 'jim mi tshad/ sgrol ma gsar bzhengs/yang lha khang na sangs rgyas kyi sku mi tshad dgu 'gro mgon phag gru bcas/gu ru lha khang ka bzhi na/lha sras mu tig btsad po'i phyag bzo dbu la sku lus jun gar bas bshigs pa 'ol ka rje drung gis bsru/ u rgyan 'dom gang gtso 'khor gsum/rigs lnga yab lnga/yum lnga /nye sras brgyad/khro bo bzhi bcas mi tshad 'jim lha sras dus nas so/ /e bzos mtshan brgyad mda' gang /logs bris rje 'bangs nyer lnga /sgo shub na lo chen bee ro'i phyag bzo tshe dpag med bcas/ rta mgrin sogs mtha / chos rgyal mtshan tho g.yas g.yon mchod rten dkar po gnyis yan chad sgo drugatsandan ka ba drug yod/ man chad lnga pa dang / skal bzang gis bzhengs/gtsang khang dbus ma'i mdun bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor khyams sa stegs shing khra can phan tshun 'dom gsum ring ba/ zhing 'dom gsum can/ birlu pa/ dam pa sangs rgyas yod/ khyams dbus gter ston las rab gling pa'i lung babs slob dpon stong sku kha shas bcas/sne gdong ban gtsang du phyin nas nang rten mjal tho/ thog mar gter ston rin po che chos dbang zangs gser mtho gang lhag zhal lung sgron gsal thogs pa/ phyag g.yas chos 'chad/ sngags pa dar ma g.yu rna 234

thor tshugs can/ thugs kur me long trīḥcan/kun skyong gling pas zab lung ma tshor gnyan phugs nas drangs pa dkar chags dang /bee ro'i phyag bris shog ser/ u rgyan rin po cher shrī seng has gnang ba'i rdo nag gi tshe bum rdza ma'i me tog dam 'be lta bu/ gu ru chos dbang rdo nag gter gzong mtho gang lhag rdo rgyu ba gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rdo rdzab ljon nagachos dbang gzi mchong sgrom nar mo shog ser bton shul can/ krom 'bum ste khra 'brug bar chos rgyal bzhengs pa'i mchod rten nas don gu ru'i sku rig 'dzin pad phrin dbu thod dum/ lo chen bai ro'i phyag bzos gu ru rgya gar ma mkhyid gang dar 'dam mkha' 'gro'i raktas byugs pa ngo mtshar/chos dbang zangs bum mtho gang /la cha'i sgrom bu bcas/thod pa smug legs dang bde mchog li khra legs/ 'ja' tshon gter byon yin skad gnam lcags phur pa mtho gang lhag zhal gsum pa shar gnyis khyad mtshar/ sne gdong dus kyi gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu pa mtho gang / sa skya dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs rjes rdo la dod pa dang zhabs lham/ ma gcig sras mo la 'dus rdo rje sgron ma dang / gter bdag gling pa'i dbu zhwa/ bse ru'i rwa dang 'gram pa bcas/ yar lung phu yi bla ma khyab ba la lhun grub kyi dgongs rdzogs la bzhengs pa dngul srang brgya dang dgu cu'i rgyu song zhes bris pa bka' thang spus dgu thang mtshan brgyad rgyu 235

bcas sgrub chen bka' brgyad gser bris thang nag chen po 'dom gang lhag pa dgu/ gtso bo re la mtho gsum lhag sne gdong rgyal po'i sus hor gos cod paṇa bkra shis tshe ring ma/ sne gdong rgyal po'i rten gnas brtan mkhyen bris shin tu spus dag mtha' lnga can nyer gsum/ mnga' bdag rgyal po shāka ldes bzhings pa'i nyi khri pod bzhi tsandan dkar po'i dpe leb khar le paṇa thams cad gser bris dang /dbur chos rgyal mes dbon gsum/mkhan po bho rnyi satwa bcas brkos pa ngo mtshar can dang /'du khang ka ba bco brgyad pa'i g.yon u rgyan gling pa'i sku gdung gzhung gis sku sha cung zhus 'phros dam 'byar/ g.yas su bka' 'gyur/ sbug tu gtsang khang na sne gdong rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas la dbus sman sku bsam yas nas blangs pa/ g.yas g.yon zangs gser sku mdun du lha gzigs ras pa zangs gser/ g.yas su phag gru 'gro mgon gdan sa thel 'dra sku'i sa lhag gis bzhengs pa 'dra mnyam/g.yas su zangs gser mchod rten dang / dngul gdung chen po/ bka' gdams mchod rten khru gang lhag li ma khru gang lhag pa nyi shu tsam/ gser zangs gu ru/sman sku gu ru kha shas/sa phur phur cha tsan dkar las brkos khru gang mtho gang phur so lcags las byas pa cha tshang / gos kha thi'i shub can sgam bzhi sne gdong rgyal po'i chas shin tu sgros ldan/ rgyab ngos su 236

kum pakhri sogs sman sku/ g.yon ngos phyag bzhi'i mgon khang / ma mgon lcam dral/yar lha sham po'i 'chams sku sogs/ 'du khang tshes bcu'i bca' ka gtor khang che ngos/thog khar rab gsal du gu ru'i sku dang li ma sum cu tsam/khang ltag sne gdong rgyal po'i rdzong zhig nas drangs pa'i gur zhal phyag bzhi thel lugs gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs bcas so/ /sne gdong ban btsun grwa lnga bcu/ 'don rgyu bla ma gsang 'dus tshes bcu/ 'chams le gnyis re nang yod/ 'chams gos gter ma yin zer te mthong rgyu med pa lta bu'i rtses byed pa don du bkras 'jigs gser ma shin tu 'thug po glang chen bse ru sogs yod pa mang /bka' 'dus chos rgyam gsar 'dzugs/sa phur 'chams bcas thel lugs bde mgon bton/sne gdong rtse tshogs pa'i nang rten bzhugs pa la thog mar/ grub thob o rgyan pas gter sgo gangs nas drangs pa sangs rgyas thub dbang tshems ring bsrel can sna dkar rtse'i khri dpon kun dga' blo gros kyis phul ba sor dngos gser gyi ga'u can/ rje rin po che gtsang kha pa'i mkhan po tshul khrims rin chen gyi ljags ring bsrel can/mkhan po bho rnyi satwa tshems gcig ba so'i za ma tog can/ mkhan sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhun thigs las spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal bzhugs pa'i 237

sor do sgos ldan/ mkhan chen bsod nams dpal bzang thugs ring bsrel can/ mkhan rdo rje dpal bzang gi gdung rkang pas rang byon/mkhan chen seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi gdung ring bsrel/ mkhan bkra shis tshul khrims gdung rus spyan ras gzigs kha sarsha ṇi'i sku/ mkhan rgyal dbang pa'i gdung ring bsrel/ rgyal ba skal bzang gi phyag tsha ring bsrel can/ mkhan chen byang chub bzang po'i zhun thig sha ri ram̐/ mkhan don yod bzang po'i tshems/ mkhan byang grags zhun thigs ring bsrel/grags pa rin chen gyi gdung rus ring bsrel dang dung g.yas 'khyil can/dwags po'i dbu klad la mi la'i sku rang byon si tu'i khams su gdan drangs 'dir bla ma 'jam dbyangs pas phul ba ngo mtshar/ rgyal dbang pa'i tshems ring bsrel can/ 'bri gung skyobs pa yin snyam skyu ru'i gdung rus las phebs pa zhes bris 'dug pa'i bde mchog rang byon zhal phyag rgyas pa yum bcas zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa shin tu sgros ldan/ mkhan grub nam mkha' bkra shis tshems sha ri ram/kha che paṇa chen chos dbyings kyi shing nag po'i phyag phreng / paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi phyag phreng phreng ser/paṇa chen blo bzang mkhas btsun tshems dge sbyong blo gsal rgya mtshos phul ba mkhas pa bslu med chen po'i zhun thig rdo rje phag mo rang byon/ gong sa lnga pa'i gzim thul 'dzer ba'i dngul gyi sha zung /238

rin chen phun tshogs bkra shis gdung sha ri ram/ mkhan bkra shis seng ge'i ring bsrel/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sku chos/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan phyag phreng / blo bzang chos rgyan dbu paṇa/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i sku rags/skal bzang phyag shan/skal rgyam phyag dpe tshems/ kha che paṇa chen lo tsā'i tshogs bcas zhal thang bal bris/ tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs chags re/ gong sa lnga pa'i gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu mtho gang dar sna lngas brgyan pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i zhabs lham/blo bzang chos rgyan sku chos ngur smrig mtshams pa rgya mtsho thogs med kyi tshems ring bsrel can bcas/'du khang sbug tu kha che paṇa chen thugs dam shing tā la'i lo mar rang byon sgrol ma bkra shis don 'grub phyag bzhi ma/paṇa chen rdza sku/ sgrol ma li ma/thub pa gser gling ma sogs li ma sna tshogs nyi shu tsam/phag gru/rdo rje dpal/byang chub dpal/tshul khrims rin chen sogs mi tshad sku bcu/lha khang ka ba sum cu/ g.yas su byams chen thog tshad nye sras brgyad mi tshad/bka' 'gyur legs pa sne gdong tā sa'i yin pa dang / phyi rol du snar thang bka' bstan gnyis/dri gtsang khang ka gnyis mar/rigs lnga/nye sras/khro bo bcas mi tshad 'jim/thog khar lcags khra lha khang nang / grub chen brgyad cu gser 239

sku mkhyid gang re rdo rje 'chang bcas sku shin tu spus dag sne gdong rgyal sbyadro bzhings pa/ bye ma a grong gu ru'i sku/ li ma sna tshogs che chung brgya yang lha khang gcig na ba so'i gnas brtan nged rang gi dkar yol gnas brtan ji lta ba dang /bag spyan cha brgyad/ sgrol ma bcas/ grwa pa kha btsog pa yod pas rgyal po sne gdong gi btsun mo phab i nus byas pa ma nus pa'i sdig bshags la mu tig dang gser rgyan spel ba'i kha san ṇi'i gos sku 'dom gang pa beeḍūdma'i phra rgyan can dang / de'i zhal dang mas bzhengs pa'i gos dmar la gser bris bcad/ mu tig gi sgrol ma'i thang / rgya bza' kong jo gdan 'dren skabs bal bzas phrag dog dang blon po mgar la bde ma 'dod nas sdug gtad pa'i snying ngan gyi rgyal po la sna med btsun mo la bse dri bro zhes pa'i dbyen gyis lo gsum mjal kha bkag nas gsang phur bzhugs pas gsang phu zhes grags par rgya bzas 'thag pa'i gong gsham bkras 'thag can ston pa thub dbang gos sku mthong grol yod/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang byams pa ni 'dzam gling rgyan gcig dang /gtsang bkra shis lhun por bzhugs zhes grags/ sangs rgyas sku gzugs jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku tshad/ sku rang la dpe byas te 'thags/gong du de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po lañtsa dang / 'og tu mu 240

ni ye dhar sogs padma/ sprin sogs bkras 'thags/nyi mar bya/ zla bar ri bong /spos phor shing bcas/'thags pas shin tu ngo mtshar/rtse tshogs pa grwa nyis brgya lhag se 'bras dga' gsum/ mnga' dwags rgyal gsum du 'gro ba'i grwa pa mtshan nyid pa cha shas dang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum sgrub mchod yod/de'i phar ma'i ngos su lha khang ser po ka bzhi ma rnam rgyal gser khang na jo bo'i bzhugs khri yin zer bar mkhan tshul khrims rin chen gyis rje tsong kha pa chen po bsnyen rdzogs gnang sar rje yab sras gsum sku/'dzam gling rgyan drug gnas brtan brag ri ma bcas/ de nas ri de'i gdong / snar rgyal sras lha rje mchog grub rgyal po'i gdung bang so'i rnam pa can nyin mo mis bskor/ mtshan mo lha 'dres bskor bar grags pa/gseng nas sman khug 'dra ba thon zer/de nas yar lha sras mu tig btsad po'i btsun mo ngang tshul byang chub rgyal mos bzhengs pa btsan g.yu yi lha khang / bskor khang phyi nang gsum/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad/g.yas su thub dbang / g.yon du mar me mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/sgo srung gnyis/ btsan thang sgo bzhi pa lha ri rol po zhes bya ba rgyab ri der rje gnya' khri gnam las babs pa'i gnya' shing gi khri steng rnam snang bzhengs/ mdun du 241

gnya' khri'i sku gdung khar mtshan brgyad sku/ dga' ldan chos 'khor sa bzhis sman bla gsungs/tshe chu 'bum pa ni/ltag na mchod rten chen po lcags ri can snang /cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang /mnga' bdag rgyal pos bzhings pa chu shel gyi kha sarsha ṇi las tshes bco lngar tshe chu 'babs/yar lung shel gyi brag phug bsam 'grub gnas chen la mthon po'i rtser 'dzegs pas/g.yas rdzong mgon po nag po/dbus ki ri ki'i rdzong /g.yon padma shel phug rdzong rgyab ri rtse gsum tshul/dbus ri nas rtse bskor g.yas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal sgrub phug dang / dbu skra gter ba'i sur dkar nags ri nas bskor ba bar bskor/rgyang bskor bcas yod/dbus ri rtser bsam 'grub shel gyi brag phug sgrub phug rang byon can/de dbus dur khrod ras chen gyis bzhengs pa'i li sku byis pa lo brgyad tsam 'di btsan thang nas blugs rgyab steng gsung 'byon ma yin skad/ mkha' 'gro gnyis bcas gzi byin 'bar bar bzhugs/ de nas 'og der mtshan brgyad lha khang ka bzhi ma khyon yongs su gzhung gis bzhengs pa'i gu ru gtso 'khor gsum/mtshan brgyad e bzos 'jim mi tshad/sngon yod gu ru za hor ma dang / mtshan brgyad byis pa lo bcu drug pa'i tshad can/yang gu ru gtso 'khor gsum/steng du bka' brgyud gser phreng kur sku bla 242

rab/smin gling gter chen/ 'ol ka rje drung sogs bla sku bzhi bcu lhag dang /g.yu sgron mgon khang /'og sbug tu phyag drug mgon khang /rdo skas lam ring mo nas thur du phyin/ sngon shar gling brgya dang nub gling song / zhes grags pa'i shel brag bla brang dbu rtse ka ba bzhi can du/nang rten/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i sku tshab rgya gar shar li ma/ ga'u nang /g.ya' ma lung gu ru'i tshe ril/ gu ru'i chib pa'i tshem la rta mgrin rang byon/sangs rgyas gling pa'i brda yig mthong grol/rig 'dzin chen po padma phrin las tshem la arang byon/bram ze dung gi rna cha can gyi phyag ngar tshes gsum zla ba rang byon can/dur khrod ras chen bskyed yum dbu thod/ gu ru'i chos gos ther ma dmar ser/snam sbyar gos ser dum sgom nang yod pa/ gu ru'i chib g.yag tsā ri nyin gcig bskor ba'i spyi gtsug rwa nang du mgon po bya rog bya rang byon/shel rdo ril po bya sgong tsam nor bu sbuga.u rgyan rin po che'i zhabs lham rgya lham he/ ngo ma 'dzam gling rgyan gcig nang yod zer/ yin pa ni la dwags lham 'dra/dbu zhwa 'dab ldan rigs lnga za hor rgyal pos phul ba gos ya shes dmar po/mtha' cha kha thi rnying pa can/nang phying dmar ro//gu ru rin po che'i gsol thod bram ze skye bdun dbu thod a rang byon can chang khal lnga brgya gsol snod/ u rgyan rin po che'i phyag gi gsog shang kha ṭwāṃ gzhong pa lha chur 'dzug pa de lcags las 243

byas pa 'khar sil yu ba lta bu/ lha khang dbus shel brag tu gna' bo'i dus nas yod pa'i gu ru nga 'dra mar grags pa byin rlabs can mi tshad/she'u'i snyan zhwa thur lhub rgod ldem can byin can mi tshad/ yang u rgyan rin po che mi tsam/ rgyal ba rin po che/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang lo brgyad byis pa tsam/slob dpon rin po che khru tshad las che chung li ma gsum/ kha sarsha ṇi bzhengs sku li ma/ rgyal ba rigs lnga chos li sogs li ma nyi shu tsam/bsam lhun sman sku bcu gsum sogs/bar khang lha khang ka bzhi mar/dbus su u rgyan sman sku mi tshad byin can/ sangs rgyas blo gros/ chos kyi blo gros gnyis mi tshad zangs gser/dwags po 'dra ba gcig dur khrod ras chen sogs/ de'i dbon bka' brgyud bla rab bcu gcig gdung rten thog sleb ma zangs gser bcu gcig yang u rgyan 'jim sku mi tshad gsum bcas/yang zangs mdog dpal ri'i blos bslang khang du/ mtha' mtsho brag ri phug pa can sha stag legs rer khang pa bdun re/ sgrub phug grub thob sogs/steng du phyogs bzhir zhabs rjes bzhi/ lcags ri logs rer them gnyis/zur bcu drug pa la mchod lha bcu drug pa/sgo khang rta babs bzhi ma/ glad rgyab mig gsum na grub thob re bzhugs/ rgyal chen bzhi mtho gang /nang du lcags ri gru bzhir mchod lha bcu drug mdun nas mtshan 244

brgyad sku khang kha bad gser can/ shar lho ma ning cog byang shar na thod mkhar steng mchod rten/ dbus khang bzang mda' yab can sum brtsegs nang slob dpon gtso 'khor gsum/rje 'bangs nyer lnga / bar khang du thod phreng sde lnga yab yum/ steng khang du snang mtha' gcig pu/gser g.yab tog bcas/ 'ja' gur/ bya 'dab na sprin nang mchod lha lus phyed don pa/ging thur ma la 'dzer nas bar snang yod pa'o//me rtog phreng ba gzhal yas khang rtse mo nas 'then mkhan mchod lha/lho phyogs khang bzang steng khro bo dbu dgu pa/dgongs 'dus lha khang na/ sa gdung mchod rten 'dom gang pa gnyis/ bla ma dgongs 'dus blos bslang 'dom gang ba sgros nyams ye med kyang byin che ba 'thor zin/de nas 'og khang du dri gtsang khang ka bzhi mar sangs rgyas blo gros/chos kyi blo gros/ dge 'dun blo gros te dur khrod ras pa'i dben po gsum gyi gser gdung 'dom do pa bzo rnying shin tu sgros/ u rgyan mi tshad 'jim/ mchod rten cha brgyad/ rgyab tu thub sku zangs gser thog gcig rgyab yol rgyan drug legs/ mar me mdzad/ byams pa/ nye sras brgyad/ khro bo gnyis bcas 'jim/rdo rje 'chang /te lo/nā ro/ mar mi dwags gsum/dus mkhyen/ phag grupakshi sogs dang /gsung sprul tshul 245

/sdos rdo rje rnams mi tshad/ pha dam pa nyi 'de ma li ma byis pa lo brgyad phyi khyams la slob dpon mi tshad/ thub sku li ma mda' gang legs/gnas bcu khru gang spus dag dang /gu ru mtshan brgyad spus dag mi tshad/'bum cha gnyis sogs/ bka' gdams mchod rten mda' gang che/bka' brgyud bla sku li ma dang / mi la sman 'dam legs/ ka ba nyi shu yod rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad mi tshad 'jim sku bcas/yar lung g.yas yar steng phu/ pho zang 'om bu bla mkhar ni/ bod yul gyi khang mkhar la snga ba dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa'i par grags/khang pa zhig gsos song snang / rten gtso jo bo nor bu bsam 'phel mgul yan rdo/ de man sman 'dam/ thugs kur nor bu bya sgong tsam pa/rgyan zangs gser can mi tshad srong btsan gyis bzhengs/ g.yas g.yon mchog zung gnyis/ g.yas nas thugs chen bcu gcig zhal/ chos rgyal gnya' khri btsan po/srong btsan/mes ag tshom/khri srong lde'u btsan/thon mi bsto ṭa byams mgon rnams mi tshad/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ sman bla mched brgyad/g.yon phyogs su khri ral/'od sung /mgar dam pa rnams mi tshad 'jim/ lha khang ka brgyad/ri bo chos gling pa bzhi sdes sman bla gsungs pa'i pho brang bcas/246

steng khang du 'phags pa lo ki shwa ra tsan dan las byas pa rtse khru gang /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig khru gang lhag pa re/ mdun du slob dpon rin po che gtso 'khor gsum/byams pa/rje tsong kha pa/rgyal ba lnga pa sogs/bka' 'gyur bcas lha khang ka brgyad/ rtser mkhar de steng gser g.yab/'og khang jo bo'i rgyab tu gnya' khri'i sgrub khang bang so dkor mdzod chen po yod par grags/ yang slob dpon rin po che'i sku byin can steng khang du bzhugs/ mkhar 'di spre'u byang chub sems dpas bzhengs pa yin par grags so//de nas yar phyin par lha ri sman rgyal lha khang dmar po'i thog ka bzhi mar/ sman bla mi lo bcu drug tshad li dmar khyad 'phags chos rgyal thugs dam sku li ma chen po bcu gcig tsam/ gnas bcu mda' tshad 'jim legs nyer gsum/u rgyan rin po che/ yang 'og 'du khang ka brgya ma'i nang dbus thub dbang 'jim thog slebs/ g.yas g.yon thub sku mi tshad li ma/bka' 'gyur dang / 'bum bris ma 'thor po pod nyis brgya tsam/ rgyal po sku lnga sogs dang /bka' gdams gdung rten li ma bcu phrag ri mgor sngon sman bla mched brgyad byon pa gsum lar sdams gos g.yogs pas lus/lnga 'phur bar grags/ 247

de nas ring du phyin pas stag spyan 'bum par/ sman pas rigs gnas rgya mtshos bzhings pa'i lha khang ka gnyis/ rten gtso thub dbang zangs gser mi tshad/ sa lung phu dgon rnying shar gling grwa brgya/nub gling stong byas pa zhig pa las drangs zer/u rgyan sku gsum/sman bla mched brgyad mi tshad chung 'jim/ mkha' 'gro ma rtag snang zhabs rjes/zangs gsor rnam rgyal mchod rten/gnas bcu khang thub dbang mi tshad/gnas brtan khru tshad la 'jim/'bum pa thog gsum gser tog can bya 'dul 'dzin nas bzhengs pa'i nang / rgyal po khri srong thugs dam shel gyi mchod rten nang byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngu'i spyan g.yon bzhugs pa yin skad/lung pa de ga'i mdar sngon chos rgyal pho brang yin skad/ bshigs ma asta spos pa'i nang du chos rgyal mes ag tshom sku gdung yin skad pa'i zangs gser thog sleb dang / li ma sna tshogs lnga bcu tsam nang khyad 'phags thub pa sogs mang /u rgyan sku kha shas/bka' 'gyur bcas/yar klung bkra shis chos sde'i 'du khang ka ba bcu drug dus 'khor sku gsung thugs rdzogs dkyil/ rdo rje gur rigs bsdus/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ kye rdor tshar lung / mi 'khrugs pa bcas/ sa bu ṭa/ kun rigs/tshe dpag lha dgu/rnam rgyal ma/ sgrol dkar/bde mchog ltu dril 248

nag gsum/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ mgon po lha brgyad/phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/bdag med ma/mkha' spyod ma/gshed dmar/'jigs byed bcu gsum pa/ grwa lnga bcu lhag spubs sil thang ka sogs bzang 'du khang du tshar chen sku byin ldan/ g.yas su mgon khang na 'dam shin tu legs pa'i rdo rje gur lha brgyad/zhal/ lcam gnyis bcas thog tshad/ zhug tu dri gtsang du thub chen thog sleb/ nye sras brgyad mi tshad lhag khro bo //kā bcas 'dam shin tu legs/slob dpon rin po che/kun mkhyen lnga g.yon du rnam sras lha brgyad thog sleb 'dam sku khang na bca' ka mang /'chams chas gos rgyu bzang legs pa yod/thog khar gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs pa'i sku/ g.yas g.yon du sa skya'i lam 'bras byis pa lo bcu drug tsam nyi shu lhag ka bzhi lha khang /'du khang steng gdan sa thog mar btab pa so mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros sku dngul gdung / bka' 'gyur/ 'dra sku mi tshad/li ma sna tshogs bdun cu tsam/g.yas su gnas sar mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dngul gdung khang /yang gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan 'dra zhal 249

dang /dngul gdung khang /nger lugs lam 'bras bla brgyud bcas/dbang phyug rab brtan sku gdung dngul gdung thog sleb lha khang /sde dge'i bka' bstan 'gyur bcas/dbu rtser lam 'bras bla brgyud rgyas pa mi tshad khri rgyab yol bcas 'dam sku legs pa lnga bcur nyer bar/ 'chams gos sbub sil sogs lnga pa chen po'i khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bar bdag rkyen gnang bas shin tu legs/sde dges phul ba'ang mang tsam dang / gser rtog rgyal mtshan bcas spus dgaras chung phug tu lha khang gsar rgyag zhus pa ka brgyad mar/ sgrub phug shin tu nyams skyid dbus/gtsang smyon ho ru ku'i 'dra zhal rgod tshang pa phyi mas bzhengs pa mi tshad smug po la/thod snyam dngul las brdungs pa/rdo rje 'chang nas stod 'brug bla brgyud dang / ras chung snyan brgyud kyi brgyud pa rgod tshang pas bzhengs pa'i li 'dra mtho gang ba so dgu/g.yas su mi la dang / ras chung pa sman 'dam byin chags khru gang pa/g.yas su nye gnas rin chen grags/grub thob bshes gnyen pa/g.yon du rgod tshang pa/ phag gru'i spyan sra ba bcas/mda' gang sku rnying 'jim khri rgyab yol bcas/g.yas su dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i dar sku/ ras chung sprul sku 'chi med dbang po mi tshad bcas/ rgod tshang sna tshogs rang grol 250

gser sku/gtsang pa rgya ras gdung rten zangs gser thog gnyis pa/rgod tshang sna tshogs rang grol gdung rten mda' gang pa/gtsang skyon ho ru ku'i phyag mkhar sngags kyi 'khar gsil kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum mi tshad nyams mtshar/ras chung phyag 'khar rgya gar gyi ram pa ste durlu tshig nyer bzhi la yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bzhugs pa/brgyadam/gon khang phyag bzhi/zhing skyong /tshe ring ma/ rta dag dregs pa sde 'du khang khyams ka ba nyer lnga pa nang sangs rgyas stong bdun stong ri mo rgyas/ spug gtsang khang rnam thar sgo gsum pa'i dbus su/thub chen zangs gser grub mchog dbang pos bzhengs pa'i sku zhal mtho bzhengs che legs/nye sras brgyad/sgo srung gnyis bcas mi tshad gnyis lhag 'dam sku/ bka' 'gyur bcas/dbu rtse ka ba bcu drug sbug rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ te lo/ nā ro/sa dra ha/ klu sgrub/mar pa/mi la/dwags po sogs g.yas ras chung snyan brgyud/ g.yon stod 'brug bla brgyud mi tshad tsam grub mchog tshwa na'i mtshan gyi phyag bzo 'jim su shin tu mtshar ba/ khri rgyab yol bcas khyon sum cu so brgyad/ chos rje gling pa 'dzam gling rdo rje dwags zhu can kyang snang /251

g.yas su lha khang ka bzhi mar kurma pa zhwa dmar nag gsum mi tshad 'jim/grub mchog dbang po dang / grub mchog dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen lnga pa/byams pa'i bzo phud thub dbang zangs gser mi tshad/byang bdag rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i gdung mi tshad/ ras chung sprul sku gong ma nges don rgya mtsho/ gang rab 'byams pa bcas mi tshad 'jim/phar tshad na dgon thang 'bum pa mchod rten dkar po thog lnga pa sgrol ma'i sprul pa nai tso dang g.yu sbas pa smi tis rab gnas mdzad/ yar lung g.yu gser lung gnyis 'khrugs pa stum pas sri gcod 'bum par grags/lha khang gcig tu gnas brtan rdo sku brag ri ma gcig grub brgya rdo sku/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa mi tshad 'jim/ tshong dpon nor bu kārshadī po/ rgya gar gyi grub thob kyi sku zhig dang / slob dpon padma'i sku ni /ga ri gzar ngos bai ro'i sgrub phug na bai ro'i phyag rjes gsal po chag sdod na/sa yang ring tsam 'ong bas ba gor dgon ni a ṇi dgon khang ༵ shā/ po byas pa zhig 'dug pa zhig gsos gsar pa yin tshod nang du de nas sol nag thang po cher phyi rol du 'du khang che tsam ar po 252

khang bzo gsar rgyags dang khel/nang du mgon khang gcigadabus su dri gtsang khang na thub chen rgya gar li ma mi tshad chen po bzhi/ phag mo gru pa'i gdung rten yin pa'i bka' gdams mchod rten mi tshad/ khu ston 'dra sku mi tshad 'jim sku/ bka' chos sogs/ grong pa'i ltag ngos jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i gzim khang na jo bo'i sku dang / gzhan 'dam sku mi tshad cung med pa mang tsam yod/de nas yar ring du phyin/don mkhar lung pa'i phug cher phyin pas/tshe ring ljongs su kun mkhyen chen po'i gzim chung lha khang gtsang khang ka ba bcu gnyis pa gung la byams mgon thog sleb 'dam sku byin ldan/g.yas su slob dpon mi tshad/g.yon du kha sarsha ṇi mi tshad/ mdun du klong chen pa zhal gzigs mi tshad/ yang rgyal ba rigs lnga mi tshad re g.yas spug tu kun mkhyen rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i dngul gdung thog sleb/ bar du lcam blo gsal sgron ma'i gdung / de nas sku zhabs mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje'i dngul gdung rin po che thog sleb/ kun mkhyen rang gi sku chung / mgon khang rten bcas der yod gtam tshogs nang gi kur chags ltar/rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che bcas/steng na gzim khang sogs ni yang las byas par yin par snang /pha ri sde pa pu shud pa'i sar/ mkhan slob chos gsum padma sa 'dra 253

ba'i bai ro bcas par bsam lhun gyis bskor zhal thang bzhi/ yang siddha rgya mtsho/ klong snying rigs 'dus yum bka' sdug bsngal rang grol bcas/zangs mdog dpal ri 'di rnams la tshon gser 'gran bral yod/ yang lung bshags sangs rgyas so lnga zhal thang so lnga / gser thang spus dga'adi thams cad kun mkhyen chen po'i phyag bris bka' rtsom smon tshig can no/ tshe ring ljongs da lta bla ma chos seng gis gsos pa ma gtogs bar skabs su cher nyams par 'dug go/'phyong rgyas ri bo bde chen lha khang ni dge dgon che shos yin/ grwa bdun brgya yod zer te lnga brgya lhag gling smad lha khang bka' blon 'du ru khang gsar pas bzhengs pa ka drug na/ rgyal ba skal bzang sangs rgyas rab bdun/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum rigs gsum mgon bo rnams mi tshad 'jim/dngul gdung thog sleb/bka' 'gyur/gnam yol gos bzang /khyams chen sgo g.yas sa yi mchod rten che/byams khang g.yas na/ gnas bcu khang ka drug mar brag ri gnas brten 'jim dar bzo gser ljib byugs spus dag rje yab sras gsum rgya nag ma zangs gser mi tshad/steng khang lam rim byis pa lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad bdun cu don gsum 'jim gser blugs sgros gtsang / lha khang ka drug gnam rgyan 254

sogs bzang po rgyal ba skal bzang nyid bzhengs/g.yon dgongs rdzogs lha khang ka drug mar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas/nye sras brgyad mi tshad 'jim gnam rgyan sogs legs/yab rje bsod nams dar rgyas kyis bzhings pa byams chen zhal ngo dngos mtho drug dbu rgyan bcas brgyad pa zangs gser/ nye sras brgyad/ khro bo gnyis bcas 'dom phyed do pa 'jim sku legs pa/ thub pa grong khyer ma thog slob/ mdun du tsandan dkar po'i lo ki shwa ra/ nye sras brgyad mtho lnga pa/ byams pa li ma mi chung tshad legs/ bka' 'gyur rgya nag mtshal spar/ gnam yol sogs legs/ka ring gnyis/steng gser tog bcas/bla brang gtsug lag khang thog khar bla ma lha khang ka brgyad mar/ rje rin po che mi tshad rgya nag zangs gser khri rgyab yol bcas/sras gnyis/nyi khri 'dzin pa blo gros dpal bzang / thub pa mi tshad 'jim/ byams pa mi tshad zangs gser/rgyal ba skal bzang dngul gdung /sangs rgyas stong sku 'jim sku/ li ma sna tshogs lnga bcu tsam/skal bzang lha khang ka bzhi ma skyabs mgon gzim chung na/ jo bo zhal thang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rnying pa/li ma sna tshogs brgya tsam/skal bzang rgya mtsho'i skubaka' bstan gtsang spar/rje yab sras gsung 'bum/255

zhang dang phag gru rnying pa/ gos chen spus dag yod/ sgrol ma lha khang du rdo rje 'chang gser sku byis pa lo brgyad tsam/ dngul gdung sogs li ma sna tshogs lnga bcu tsam/bka' 'gyur/zhal thang rnying pa mang /blos bslang khang g.yas su bde mchog dbus su gsang 'dus/g.yon du 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor nam spus ldan pa/ yab bsod nams dar rgyas zhwa tog dbus kyi tog byas pa nor bu chu shel zur brgyad/twa sa'i spyan snga bka' brgyud gser phreng thang rnying spus dag rgyal ba'i sog gur na yod/ lha khang thams cad kyi steng du zangs gser rgyal mtshani che legs bzhi/ gser tog bzhi/mgon khang du gsang bde 'jigs gsum sle'u chung ma legs pa'i gser sku/bka' 'gyur gser bris/'du khang ka ba bdun cu can nang / spug g.yas rgyal ba lnga pa chen po'i dngul gdung thog gsum gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bzhengs/ bka' 'gyur gtsang spar/bstan 'gyur bris ma/ chos rgyal sogs thang chen mang / dbus su gtsang khang na 'jam dpal dbyangs dang / byams pa thub pa rnams thog slebs zangs gser/nye sras mi tshad che 'dam sku/ khro bo gnyis 'khar rnga mang / gos gnam yol shin tu spus dag phyi rol bla mchod sogs zhal thang chen po mang / kun mkhyen lnga pa 256

dang byams pa zangs gser mi tshad/g.yon du mgon khang na phyag drug phyag bzhi/ zhal bzhi/ dam can//dī /la/ rnam sras/ dmag zor/pe har sogs mi tshad 'jim sku sgros 'du khang mda' na rnam sras khang shin legs/byang chub lam rim bla brgyud thang ka rje skal bzang rgya mtsho'i yab kyis bzhengs pa gos chen phul du gyur pa'i padma gsang lam/ padma sgril btags sogs kyis byas pa'i mtha' cha can thang ma'i me long 'dom gang pa lnga bcu yod par grags pa las gtso thang thub pa dang gnyis mjal bas lha bzo phul gyur sman bris rnying pa legs/phun rab gzhis dkar sman gsar ba chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i phyag bris gong sa rgyal ba'i 'khrungs rab sman gsar shin tu spus dag bcu sogs mjal/'phyong rgyas srong btsan sor kun mkhyen 'jigs gling dkar chags ltar/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i gtso bo rnam snang thog so mtho nges/ 'khor rnams 'dom gang pa re rje btsun sgrol ma/ sna tshogs yum/ phyag drug pa/chos rgyal bcas mi tshad 'jim/btsun mo gnyis/ mgar bcas khru do pa re rnams gna' bzo/ g.yon na sangs rgyas gling pa'i sman nag gi rtiXs

bu'i steng du kun mkhyen 'jigs gling phyag bzo sogs gu ru gtso 'khor gsum byin ldan/ nye sras brgyad sman 'jim mi tshad tsam med mang / lha khang ka ba bcu gnyis yod/ thag na mgon khang du ma ning nag po'i sku dang / gu ru chos dbang shangs mtshal las skal ldan yar lung sprul sku'i phyag bris mdzad pa'i zhal thang yod/ dkyil du nor mdzod na snum blugs pa yin zer ba yod/'phyong rgyas phur/ rtag ngu'i spyan g.yas/ lha ri sman rgyal mchod sangs rgyas rin chen zla ba/mtshan legs bcas/phag gru'i sku byin ldan/yar lung g.yas ngos su g.ya' bzang ba'i gdan sa/yar stod skyam phu na e ka dza ti'i bla mtsho/ dar rgyas gling zer ba'i dge ldan dgon sogs su 'gro ma thub bo//'phyong rgyas dpal rir/ 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis pa na/ kun mkhyen 'jigs gling bzhengs pa rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad mi tshad 'jim/slob dpon za hor ma mi tshad che/ phug g.yas nas thog tu ma mgon lcam dral mgon khang kun mkhyen dam 'byar/ 'du khang sbug na 'phreng gter rin po che'i dngul gdung 'dom gang par bre nang gter byon thub dbang rdo sku shel sgo yod/ dpal ri mtsho rgyal sprul sku sku phreng gnyis kyi da/rdo8 gdung 'dom gang re/kun mkhyen 'jigs gling gis bzhengs dbu

nas ldeb lnga yan shog nag ser/dmar/ljang la/gser dngul 'dul mthing spang gis bsgyur te bris gzhir dbu lha legs pa'i 'phros snag bris rdzab rnying rgyud pod nyi shu rtsa lnga spus dag yod pa'i pod gcig zhal phye skabs gsang rnying rtsa rgyud dang 'phrad pas rten 'brel legs/ dbus su kun mkhyen dkar chags ltar 'u shang rdo'i rten gtso rnam snang li ma mi tshad/ g.yon du rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa nga 'dra ma shin tu byin chags/sku 'dra li ma sna tshogs nyi shu tsam/ bka' 'gyur mtshal spar bla ma kun bzang 'od zer bzhengs/kun mkhyen 'jigs gling bzhengs pa snar thang bka' 'gyur/yang yi ge sna tshogs/dri gtsang khang dbus skyid grang thugs mchog rdo rje dang rig 'dzin 'jigs gling gis bzhengs o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha'i 'jim sku thog mtho/ lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi kha ṭwāṃ rgya gar bskor ba/phyogs bcu'i byang sems mi tshad bcu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mi che tshad gsum/ nye sras mi tshad brgyad/ khro bo gnyis bcas/ dpal ri 'di sngar yod jun gar gyis gtor/ phyis de mo tshang dang mnyam du gzhung bkyon phog pas da lta nyams/ grwa brgya lhag yod/ zla ba dang por bla ma gsang 'dus tshes bcu/de nas grol tig lam rgyas/dgongs 'dus dkyil chogatshogs chen 'dus pa 'jigs gling lugs sogs/ tshogs rgyu yod/259

mchims phur 'gro dgos/ zhal thang kun mkhyen 'jigs gling gi rnam thar thang ka gos spus can gsum sogs dang / 'jigs gling bka' rtsom mang po yod pa'i mtshan brgyad bgres po legs pa dgu thang sogs yod/'og tu rdzogs chen padma rig 'dzin zhabs rjes/ phar kur phreng po gter chen gzim khang shul/ de 'og grong / kun mkhyen 'jigs gling 'khrungs khyim shul sogs yod/ mchod rten bgros po mthon po'i bum pa dang sangs rgyas sku yod pa'ang 'dugade nas 'phyong rgyas phur zhol khang gzim shag tu sdod sa'i nub mo la/rgyal ba'i 'khrungs rabs thang ka bcu gsum/ gnas brtan thang ka bzang po cha gnyis sogs mjal/ de nas yar 'brog shar byang lcags rtse gri gu nas sum mdor phur/ mnga' bdag nyang gi gdung rabs bla mtsho yod/gri gu ni 'brog chen gyis yar 'grog mtsho gling dgu'i shar ma/ yar lha sham po cher gsal/rkyang mang po yod/zad nas lho brag sa skya bo'i ring du sleb/ lho brag shar du gtam shul gyi tsher ma lung na mkhan chen nam /lha/ /rngo mtshan dgon chung dang / brag sdig pa 'dra ba'i rtser bo dong de nas bla ma mnga' bdag gzhis ka na/ gu ru rin po che rang gi phyag bzo bye ma a krong sring thod zhabs bcas pad gdan brda yig can 260

gu ru bde ba chen po mkhyid gang sku tshab nyer lnga'i gral nas dang /lo chen bee ro'i phyag bzos bye ma a krong sor bzhi gu ru bde ba chen po'i sku tshab nyer lnga'i gral gnyis ka yar lha sham po nas mnga' bdag nyang gis gter bzhes pa/ dam can gyi gnam lcags rdo rje che gras brgya mtho gang pa rtse lnga thod skam can/ bar gras brgya srog shing gnam lcags rgyu lha kṣiṃ ser pos byas pa'i gral gnyis/ gnas gzhi sa'i thad rdzing nya 'dra lcang 'dra nas nyang gter bram ze skye bdun dung rna can gyi dbu thod dum srab legs pa/ shwa yi rgyal sras legs pa'i zhal 'gram 'gro 'dul thugs chen phyag bzhi pa'i rang byon/ rgyal po'i bla dpe bee ro'i phyag bris ro bsregs sogs tshan bzhi tsam/ brag srin mo sbar rjes nas gter bzhes pa ma mo bod gtong bse sgrom che nges/smra'o cog la che ngos la 'dzegs te song bas brag lcags phur pa la btab 'dra rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dra ba'i 'og tu dgon gzhug na khang hrul du mnga' bdag gi gdung rabs zhig gi sku gdung sa 'bum thog sleb mnga' bdag bdud 'dul gyis sa skyar mthu sgrub sa'i mthu khang /rdo gcal steng sa 'bum chen po gser tog sngon por song ba gnyis/mnga' bdag nyang rin po che'i gter rdzas du ma bzhugs pa zhig gsos skabs mthong ba thog gsum pa/ gor chen po gnyis/ 'dir gnas yig 261

ltar na nyang gi gdung rten yin par snang / de'i ltag rig 'khris na mnga' bdag sras 'gro mgon gyi gdung 'bum/ sprul pa'i gtsug lag tu grags pa ka brgyad mar/ dbus su sa skyas 'phrog gsung byon te slar 'khor ba'i dus gdan khri sa skyar lus pa chos rgyal li ma nyang gi dgongs rdzogs shing khri rgyab yol rgyan drug thog sleb can gyi steng rigs gsum mgon po mi tshad sgros/ rnam snang /mi bskyod/ tshe dpag med/ nyang lo brgyad ma 'jim/ sras 'gro mgon dbu ral chen po can zangs gser/slob dpon bal li mi tshad che tsam/gser gdung mi tshad ma gnyis mnga' bdag gdung mtha' bcu bzhi pa'i rten yin/ bka' 'gyur bris ma/'bum cha bdun sogs bris ma jun gar gyis gtor ba pod sum brgya lhag nyang rin po che'i gdung rten yin zer kyang brag stod srin po'i kha gnon sa 'bum pa ṭa lañtsa sogs sa yi 'bur dod thog sleb phyed gnyis/nyang gi gzigs snang rnam dang / thugs chen 'gro 'dul/ bla ma yongs rdzogs bal bris nges bris khyad mtshar/bskor lam ltag la padma gsang phug o rgyan sgrub phug chung /mgon khang ka bzhir nyang gter mgon po mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/pa ṭa ma mo zhal gsum phyag drug phyag bzhi/ dregs pa sde brgyad sogs kyi sku bcas gog kyang zil che/262

de nas tshogs khang ka brgyad du/ dbus u rgyan zangs gser/mtshan brgyad sa 'jim khru gang pa sogs/ gzim khang dpe 'thor mang tsam/ brag rtser mtshams khang kha shas/ lho na sras 'gro mgon dbu skra las shug sdong / nyang gis klu dgug chang rdzar bcug chang zad med la nye gnas pas bltas pas sbal sbrul sogs shor nas thim pa na ba shing sna can/ bskor lam gong mar mnga' bdag zhabs rjes/ma re ma'i shangs mtshal gyis yig drug bcu gcig zhal rang byon/ ltag na mnga' bdag gter ma tshe chu/ rgyab na dur khrod/ byang na a rgyu rang byon slob dpon rang byon bcas/brag rigs gsum/rten rigs gsum/shar na chags ston pa rin po che/ rdza ri'i ri mgor thub dbang gi sku rang byon bcas/chos rgyal khri lde'u nam snying mkhar chur sgyugs pa'i las lhag nyang rin po che'i gtam shul rda ro kha phyes na skye ba bzhes pas sa shin tu sdug po/spang lag mthil tsam yang med sa pags pa bshus pa lta bu'o/ /grwa nyer lnga/nyang gter dong sprugs dbang med lung med dang / mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa ṭa ma mo sogs bton/ chos dbang rtsa gsum dril sgrub ste gsang 'dus bton/ tshes bcu'i 'chams 'dra ba'ang yod/ gzhung gi gnyal lhun rtse rdzong du bka' brgyad khro rol slang dgu ma lo re bzhin 'tshogs 'gro dgos/263

lho smra 'o lcogs kyi gnas yig mthong gsal me long bzhugs/ stod na grags che ba gangs dkar ti se/ smad na grags che ba tsā ri dang tsā gong /bar na khung btsun pa la phyi dang chu bar/ de gsum bod kyi gnas chen yin/ khyad par mes dbon rnam gsum gyi mtha' 'dul yang 'dul mang po yod pa las/rgya nag nas bsgyur ba dbus 'gyur tshal lung bstan nas rdo cog can zhes sangs rgyas thub pas gsungs/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis zab lam can du lung bstan/paṇa chen shākya shrīs snyung gu bragagater yig las 6rgyan gsang phug padma rdzong / ri bo rtse lnga nas 'jam dbyangs mched lngas bka' bgos smras pa ltar shin tu lcog por byung bas nges tshig smra'o lcogs/'gro 'dul lung byang las/sku mkhar skyid skyid sger mo'i shar gyi phyogs:lha sman 'jol mo gnas pa'i nub kyi phyogs:rje rigs klu rgyal gnas pa'i byang gi phyogs: dge bsnyen gtam lha gnas pa'i sku dpang du:lung pa rta ro mang po(dmar po'ang brtags te gnyis ka 'dra)phye 'dre'i nang du: gsungs pa brag dmar rdo rje rtse lnga gnam bslang 'dra ba/ lcags phur sa la btab 'dra ma mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas gtam shul lung pa'i lte ba'o/ /phyi ri song la/ brag spyan ras gzigs dbus/'jam dbyangs g.yas/ gsang bdag g.yon/ bya ri dwags byang chub sems dpa'/ smra yig drug nang ltar brag zangs mdog dpal ri rdo 264

thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/bya ri dwags ye shes ṭā gsang sngags snying po'i rang sgra/gsang ba dbyings rnam dag lhun grub 'od lnga'i thig le/brag snang stong lha sku lhun grub/ bya ri dwags sems can sangs rgyas/ skye med a sgra rgyun mi chad pa'i sa/ mthong bas bde ba 'bar/ phyi ri mtho sa gtsang / shar rang byung sku rten rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gling / spa gro ske'u tshang zhi khro'i phreng / lhor rang byung thugs rten mi 'gyur zung 'jug rin chen mkha' 'gro'i gling / srin mo sbar rjes zab mo'i gter gnas/nub rang byung gsung rten padma mkha' 'gro'i gling / bde mchog gi pho brang / byang rang byung bdud rtsi las kyi ṭākki'i gling klu rgyal 'jog po'i pho brang / shar sa:rdu rang byon/ lhor thugs rje chen po'i zhal rang byon/ nub ma re ma'i shang mtshar yig drug rang byon/byang nyi ma 'od zer gyi tshe chu rang byon/ngo mtshar che ba bzhi/ chu btung bas sdig sgrib dag go /gzhan yang sgrub gnas 'dir/ ri sbrul nag thur rgyug steng / sde brgyad kha gnod/ dregs pa'i rgyu lam gcod pa'i sa/ shar rgyang grags tsam la sa la glang chen nyal ba 'dra ba'i steng bum bzang dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan/bdung rtsi'i chu rgyun bab pa lta bu'i sa dpyad rten 'brel/ g.yas ri seng chen 'gying ba lo 'bras nor bu'i mtshan bu'i mtshan pa'i kha nor bu skyugs pa 'dra ba/rgyab ri khyung chen lding bar gdugs dkar po g.yab pa lta bu/ mdun ri 265

dar dkar yol ba bres par/ mchod lha gar byed pa lta bu mdun chu bo rgyud mi chad par chu bran nya ltar 'phyo ba dang / lung pa me tog bkram 'drar dgos 'dod yid bzhin 'grub pa'i rten 'brel/ de'ang rigs gsum mgon po gong du bshad/ sa de'ang g.yas me rtog bkram 'dre'i sa la 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge g.yon me ri rgya gram bsnol 'dra'i steng gsang bdag phyag rdor/ dbus thal mo sbyar 'dra'i steng na spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dngos su bzhugs pa'i sa dpyad rten 'brel phyi nang phun sum tshogs pa lags/nang rten ni nyang rin po che de nyid rtag lta sun dbyung du sku mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pa'i skabs/ sku sras 'gro mgon nam mkha'i dpal gyis yab kyi dgongs rdzogs rten rigs gsum mgon po chos rgyal li mar bzhengs/ gzhan yang nyang gi sku che 'bring chung gsum bal bo me lha har gyis brgya brgya re bzhengs/ gsung rten gsar rnying rgyud 'bum tshar gsum gsum/ bka' bstan 'gyur bcas bzhengs/ thugs rten mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar gnyis 'og tu bzhengs/ yon tan rten bal bris thang sku brgya dang brgyad/ phrin las rten chos 'khor gyi lha sar chu rags 'dzum shor dang / nag po 'dzum med grub rtags tshul du bzhengs/ rab gnas kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī gdan drangs/mnga' gsol 266

la rtags rten 'brel khyad 'phags byung ba lags/ sngon gtsang sa skyar hor rta bdun gyi dmag kha lud pa'i dus/rigs gsum mgon po sa skyar gdan drangs nas bzhugs skabs/lha rnams nyi ma'i zer yod sar byon/a chu chu/ gnas skyid po smra'o rtsog na yod de/ las dang smon lam gyis 'dir sleb gsungs/ sku gnyer bas lha 'dre gdug pa can du 'dug ces thugs chen gyi zhal la ste'u/ zhabs g.yon la tho ba/ 'jam dbyangs phyag ngar la sta gri zhus pas rtags cho 'phrul du ma byung bas slar skyar ba'i khri sa skya na yod par 'dug bcu gcig zhal dang / 'od dpag med/slob dpon rin po che/ ma re ma'i gdung rten dang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ tshe dpag med/thub dbang rnams kyi sku yod/'gro mgon gyi gser sku 'di ni 'gro mgon zhal bzhugs skabs/nga 'dra ba'i rten gcig bzhengs gsungs/ 'di nga 'dra'o gsungs/ zhal 'dzum pa las rten gyis kyang zhal 'dzum par mdzad/ gser gdung gnyis ni mnga' bdag gdung mtha' bcu bzhi bstan 'dzin chos kyi dbang po dang /bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po gnyis kyi dgongs rdzogs su bzhengs/ sman 'di mchod rten ni/ sgo stod srin po brag gi kha du bzhengs pa'o/ /ngos bris ni dge slong dpal mo'i lugs thung gnas bla brgyud/phyag rdor rigs lnga'i bla brgyud/ rgya gar rig 'dzin brgyad/ bod yul 267

mkhas pa brgyad/ sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ nyang rin po che skye bcu bdun gyi 'gro don mdzad tshul dang /'gro mgon rin po che'i mdzad tshul bcas pa'o/ /yang gtam lha'i zhus len las/ slob dpon rin po che'i zhal nas/lho brag smra'o lcog gnyal smad dge ri brag chu bo ri dang /brag yer pa 'di bzhi dar na bod spyi la bde/ 'byung ba rang gnas me btsa' shin tu dam: thugs rje chen po'i sgrub sde btsug na legs:lho phyogs gtam shul yul gyi snying po ni: rigs gsum mgon po'i brag ri 'di nyid yin: rab gnas mchod bstod byas na yul la phan gsungs pa'i lho rong mkha' 'gro'i gnas phyag mchod bskor ba sogs byas na phan yon bsam mi khyab pa lags/zhes gnas yig snying por bsdus pa dge'o//zhes pa'i phyag bris bzhugs pa mtshams 'dir dkyus su btsud pa'o//phyir 'ong ba'i la rtsar bo dong ba'i dgon chung thig pas 'jigs pa na thub dbang gtso 'khor 'jigs med grags pa bcas mi tshad 'jim/mgon khang thub sku li ma mi tshad chung /tshogs khang bka' gdams gdung rten li ma phyed pa dang / khru gang pa lnga/bris ma chos pod 'thor nyis brgya tsam sogs yod/chags mda' nas yar dar ma gzim khang du/ nyang gi dbu thod a rang byon can dang / yum gyi dbu thod rta mgrin rang byon can/nyang rin po che'i dbu ral sogs yod/268
