lho brag grub chen gyi gdan sa dge dgon chung ngu'ang bar 'dir snang / 'di'i pha ri ta ri rong grog so las rang grub mchod rten dang /rang byung lha sku'i tshul 'ga' yod/ brag ri sde dge rnga mang sna'i dbu la'i ri dbyibs 'dra ba phar tshur rir snang / chos dbang lugs thugs chen yang snying 'dus pa'i ka na'i 'dzul sgo mang po snang /lung pa zhig gi spug na/ mkho cog grwa tshang gi dus mchod tshogs sa thugs chen 'gro 'dul bum sgrub 'dzugs sa 'gro 'dul lha khang yang yod/ sa rong yid shin tu skyo ba'i gnas 'grim nas dro lam na da lta smin gling 'dzin bdag ban sngags grwa bco brgyad yod pa/lho brag gnas gzhir slebs/ 'du khang ka ring bzhi/ ka thung brgyad gung la gu ru chos dbang rin po che'i 'dra zhal dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshad shin tu byin ldan/thugs kur me long can/phyag yon bharnya/ g.yas sa gnon/sngags pa thor cog can/yang chos dbang sku/ slob dpon rin po che byis pa lo brgyad tsam bal sku/ston pa'i gser sku/de'i sbug lha khang du chos dbang rin po che'i gser zangs sku gdung 'dom do cung lhag padma rā ga'i phra khyad 'phags mun par 'od gsal ba lta bu dang / nor bu chu snying phra/ gdung rus la thub sku rang byon yin zer te bre la shel sgo'i nang du thub sku sgo khyim du 'dra zhal zangs gser can/269

g.yas g.yon na gdung brgyud bla ma drug byis pa lo brgyad tsam 'jim ka ring bzhi/ zhug ngo mar 'jim sku byin ldan dus gsum sangs rgyas rten garnyo la bcas thog mthor slebs/rgyal ba rigs lnga 'dom gang re g.yas/yum lnga de 'dra g.yon/ sgo srung rta mgrin dang phyag rdor byin can chos dbang phyag bzo nyams dod 'dom gang lhag pa gnyis bcas/ brag rir gnas brtan bcu drugatshogs khang du 'bum cha gcigagayas zhug tu zhi khro bka' brgyad lha khang ka bzhi mar dbus nas rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin grags pa zangs gser gdung 'dom gang /dbus sa gdung kurma dpal 'byor/ g.yon zangs gser gdung brtan 'dzin rnyarma shrī zhes chos dbang gdung brgyud/ zhug tu che mchog gnam zhal bcas bskyed rdzogs rgyas pa 'dom gsum mtho nges/ phyag zhi ba zhe gnyis sogs zangs sku mkhyid gang re/ gser 'khor lha brgyad klu brgyad byol song sogs zhib la rgyas/g.yas su yang dag rta mgrin/ gshin rje/phur pa/g.yon du/ma mo/rig 'dzin/mchod bstod/drag sngags bcas zhal gsum phyag drug sngon gyi bzo snying khyad mtshar zhal ngo mtho do re ste 'jim sku rang rang gi rgyab ngos gyang la bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs dur khrod bcas zhib rgyas bal bris shin tu mtshar/sgo ba yab yum 'khril sbyor mtho bcu pa bzhi bcas/ spang gdung brgyud chos rgyal bstan 'dzin 270

nas bzhengs pa sngon gyi bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs dgu thang thang nag chen rdzogs gser thang dang / zhi khro na raka dong sprugs gnyis thang khyad 'phags thod ra bcas/steng na chos dbang re ma ti'i mgon khang du chos dbang sku/ shing gi sku gdung mchod/ mtshan brgyad snga mo'i bris snying khyad 'phags nges bris bcas/ che mchog yab yum/sku yi bar la rang gar bzhag sa chos dbang gter ma song ldeng phur pa zhal gsum pa mchu lcags can/smin gling khri pa'i gzim khang dang gser rtog bgres po bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs 'tshogs rgyu dang / gzhan smin lugs 'tshogs rgyu yod/ 'di mnga' bdag chos kyi dbang po zhes mnga' bdag nyang gi gdung rgyud zhig gi gdan sa yin ces snang mod/ gu ru chos dbang gdan sa yin shas che snyams sa 'dug ste dpyod/de nas brag ri rnams zangs mdog dpal ri'i chags tshul shwa mong sul lta bu/ res 'ga' mchod rten sku dbyibs/ re rul sul mang grogs stong can 'jigs skye mtshar ba'i g.yang sa sogs brgyud/ brag srin mo sbar rjes gter gnas na ri rgyud rong shwa mong sul 'drar srin mo sbar rjes chen po kha shas/gsham lung mda' gu ru'i zhabs rjes/de nas ma tshad na chu kha nye bar gu ru'i sgrub phug sgo rdo bcigs can/ de nas lung 271

ring brgyud phu la sleb nas/ chu pha rir sman gsham mam sman gshed du sman lha mchod brgyad/gangs ri brgyad/chu brgyad/ gangs ri sgrub phug nyams mtshar sogs yod/'bog to dang /lde mig dgon zhes dge lugs dgon chung gnyis/ban pa thag phyi dam phyag rdor lha khang du 'du khang ka ba nyi shu pa legasawa/ dbus spug tu lho brag grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sa 'bum thog sleb/ g.yas zla ba rgyal mtshan/ g.yon nam mkha' lhun grub dang /yang bla rabs bcu gcig gi gdung / mdun na nam mkha' rgyal mtshan 'dra zhal mi tshad/thub pa li ma mi tshad che spus dgagayas su kha sarsha ṇi/g.yon du de 'dra bcas li ma bzhengs pa mi tshad gnyis/ zhug tu dus gsum sangs rgyas thog gnyis re 'jim sku las dbus rnam snang longs sku'o/ /'dom phyed do tsam pa'i phyogs bcu'i byang sems bcu/ rta mgrin dang mi g.yo ba 'dom do pa gnyis/ bal bris shin tu legs pa'i ltung bshags/rigs lnga chos 'khor gsum bskor ba sogs/ bka' gdams gdung rten li ma 'dom gang pa gnyis/ phyi rol du mkhan chen sa khri rgyab yol bcas pa/ thub sku legs pa dang bcu gcig zhal bzhugs pa'i li ma legs/ 'du khang g.yas lho brag grub chen bzhengs pa sman bla mched brgyad byis pa lo bcu drug tsam//snyan brgyud lugs phyag rdor rigs lnga/272

rta phyag chung gsum de mtshungs bcas 'jim/ me chu'i kha gnon mchod rten re dang /klu yi kha gnon pa'i mchod rten che/bskor lam/g.yon nges bka' 'gyur mgon khang nang byang sems zla rgyal sa 'bum che bcas skyid tsam yod/spro ba dgon khyung tshang dgon kun bdag pa'o/ /grwa bco brgyad/gsang 'jigs phyag rdor/dbyar gnas sogs 'tshogs/de'i phyir legs g.yas der lho brag shud pu'i sngags brgyud dang mkhan chen gyi khyim tshang shul yod/ban pa drug ral lam gru lus lha khang du/ mchog ldan mgon pos bzhengs pa'i 6rgyan rin po che zangs gser bal po'i li tshugs zhal ngo mtho lnga / phyir pad gdan yan dang rgod ldem man mtho sum cu pa za hor ma zla gam med pa/ mkha' 'gro gnyis mi tshad las lhag 'jim sku/ li ma nye sras gnyis byis pa lo brgyad pa tsam bzhi/ bka' gdams mchod rten 'dom do pa gnyis/ gru do pa gcig rigs lnga las mi skyod pa dang /rin 'byung chos rgyal li ma mi tshad gnyis/kha sarsha ṇi li ma mi tshad/g.yas g.yon du sku de 'dra khru gang gnyis khri li ma bcas/ thub sku li ma mi tshad che tsam phul du gyur pa gcig yang bzhugs gdan med pa'i thub sku li ma mi tshad/ 'bum gser chos pod gnyis brgya tsam/sgo khar nya yod pa'i chu rdzing / kham bu'i sdong po gnyis bcas/ 'di'i g.yas mnab ces pa'i 273

lung pa der mchog ldan mgon po'i 'khrungs khyim/ de nas mdar khang ral shug sdong can de gter ston ba grang mkhan gyi khyim tshang sde pa de red zer/ phu der sgro ba dgon na/ lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i thog ma'i gdan sa yin pas steng lha khang ka bzhi mar/ thub pa rigs lnga sogs dang bcu gcig zhal bzhugs pa sogs li rnying byis pa lo brgyad dang bcu yi tshad can bcu/ bka' gdams gdung rten khru do pa bzhi/gzhan khru gang ba'i li ma lnga bcu tsam dang 'bum pod bris ma cha brgyad tsam/zhug tu sgrub phug na phyis bzhengs pa'i las kyi rdo rje'i sku mi tsam/lha gnyer gcig gi mchog ldan mgon po'i sku gdung chu la 'phangs pa'i sgom chus gyen la khur/ 'ja' zug pa de sgro ba dgon pas der blangs te ṭā dṛ sa 'bum dkar po la dga' ldan gser khang pas nyams par byas 'og tu lha khang ka brgyad mar dbus su shud bu nam mkha' seng ge'i sku gdung sa 'bum/ g.yas su lho brag las kyi rdo rje'i bla ma dmar ru re ba sa khu ser po byas pa lta bu gsol/ g.yon du rje tsong kha pa/rdo la de gnyis kyi zhabs rjes/ rdo nag la rdo dkar yig drug sgros ldan/ chos bcigs 'thor pa pod brgya tsam pa khag gnyis/ bskor lam gyi gong tsam la mchod rten chen po gsum/ 'og na gcig pha tshad na je tsong kha par 274

grub chen rin po ches gdams pa gnang ba'i khri yod pa'i khang pa/ de'i thad nas sangs rgyas stong gi zhal gzigs pas/klad kyi brag ri sul can ngo mtshar ba de la ri nyi shar btags/'di'i phu na bsam 'grub ces rnying dgon dbon po dgon ste ser khyim pa/ zhi khro kur gling gter ma/ thugs chen bde gshegs kun 'dus sogs bton pa gcig dang / )rdza dkar ram lha dkar dgon ces rnying ma'i dgon shul/de nas phal la brgal na ratna'i gdan sa/gru shul byang chub gling / mdo mkhar lhun grub pho brang sogs yod zer/de nas mkhar chu'i gong tsam nas lung phug la phyin pas mon kha seng ge rdzong la slebs/lho brag mkhar chur/ sa rong lam 'phrang rong thur brgyud glang ma'i nags la nyi tshan nas nags tshal thang shing can legs pa 'grim rgya mtsho kha zhes pa'i g.yar can nas rim par bdud 'jam dbyangs gling du slebs/ ri bags can gyi bskor lam nas mar phyin pas nyi ma zla ba rdo rje dril bu phug rnams rgyang mjal/ras chung phug tu mtshams khang na phyin/de nas rba ratna zhes sad mi mi bdun gyi che ba de'i sgrub phug gong 'og gnyis las 'og ma mjal/ der yang khyim btsun ma'i khang sar snang /dgas chen gyi rong la 'grim/chu brgal gyen skas 'dra bar 'dzegs/dam can gyi sbud pa'i rlung / ra rjes sogs mjal/spyir mkhar chu rta gdong 275

dkar mo sku yi gnas/ phu na haṃ yig gangs ri/ spyo kha'i bla mtsho 'jigs rung gi chu dga' bzhi'i 'gros/rong gi nyi tshan gtum mo'i me/ nags ri 'thugs po rtsa 'khor/ shing ljon pa rigs mi 'dra ba brgya dang brgyad la ba lu 'dra ba me tog dmar ser dril bu lta bu dang / lhag ma chung lta bu me tog skag mdog can/thang shing rig gsum/be rigs gnyis/glang mkhris stag ma sogs mang ngo / /brag phug brgya dang brgyad yod par grags srub g.yon brag rgyal ba rigs lnga / don grub sked rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i sgrub phug gong 'og gnyis/thabs rdo rje lha mo mkhar de wi ko ṭi ni brag ling ga 'dra ba'i ngor bde mchog rang byon/ dbu gtsug tor lha khang dbus su 'bur/brag skas gzar po la song bas/ dbang phyug gi ling ga dang brag la rgyal ba rgod tshang pa mgon pa rdo rje'i zhabs rjes yin nges pa/ dung dkar 'khyil ltar brag steng lha khang mtho/ g.yas g.yon mdun gsum g.yang sa 'jigs rung rtser/ nges bris gu ru mtshan brgyad/ za hor ma/yang dag lha dgu/ bka' brgyud 'brug lugs/bde phag lhan skyes sogs bris/gzhi pad dkar dus la phyis zhig gsos byas pa/ thub sku li ser khru gang phul gyur/ bka' gdams gdung rten mda' tshad ma gnyis/ slob dpon rin po che mi tshad/yang rtse khru gang pa/ tshe dpag med mi tshad/ bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum mda' tshad byin ldan/ sngar lam nas thur du 276

babs/ pha ri ngos gzar skas 'dra ba la gyen du dka' bas 'dzegs/ rdo skas them pa sum cu tsam rer 'ong ba dang / rgya skas sogs brgyud/spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal sku dbyibs brag nges phyag g.yas las brag phug na sgrub chu zhim mngar dwangs pa/ la mgo nas thur la rdo skas gzar so gnyis las babs pas g.yas ri 'di shes rab yum gyi mkhar lcags phur can dung gi gzhal yas o rgyan rin po che lo bdun bzhugs pa'i sgrub phug shin tu che/ nam mkha'i snying po'i sku rjes brag dang / phur pa btab shul/ steng na chos dbang rin po ches lcags phur gter bton pa la yag gu ru lha khang du yod pa yin gsungs/ hor gyi kha gnon la mchod rten dkar po lnga bzhengs pa sa 'bum 'dom gang lhag re la bre sogs shing dang rdza ma las byas pa/ gu ru rin po che byis pa lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshod tsam/ 'khor mkha' 'gro bzhi khru gang 'jim sku chos dbang sku dus bzhengs pa/ yang dag chung /thub sku li ma mi lo bcu gsum tsam/bka' gdams gdung rten mda' gang pa gnyis/zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol dben gnas sogs rdo la bskos pa bcas/spyir mkhar chu la nye ba'i gnas bzhi/ shar 'od gsal chos rdzong rgyab ni rdo rje phag mo'i sku dbyibs/ lhor seng ge rir sman sna tshogs 'khrungs/ sgyug skye nab tshe lam dpal rir tshe bum 'dra ba'i ri/ nam 277

mkha'i snying po nyi zer la phebs/bzhud mdzad pa'i gnas/byang kho mthing lha khang spyi zhung pa'i sa gnad gnon pa'i me btsa' yin/ mkhar chu la ring ba'i gnas bzhi 'khor gyi tshul/shar na ne ring seng ge rdzong /lho sbas yul mkhan pa ljongs/ nub sgrub mtsho padma gling / byang smra'o cog lcags kyi rdo rje sa la 'dzugs 'dra bcas so/ /lcags phur can gang der gu ru'i zhabs rjes/nam snying nyi zer la chibs nas 'phur rjes zhabs kyi rnying pa/lcags phur can gong mkha' 'gro bro ra nas yas ngos gzar la 'dzegs ma mkhar chu bla brang rtser/sgrol ma lha khang du nang rten ni/ rten sgom du gu ru chos dbang gi sku tshab gter lnga'i gral phug ring nas bzhes pa'i bye ma a krong gu ru bde ba chen po ser lnga srin thams cad zhabs bkag can/byang chub ljon shing lo mar thub sku rang byon gser gyi bcad pa shing la glan pa/ chos dbang gis lcags phur can nas bzhes pa'i gnam lcags phur pa zhal gsum am gcigs can phyag drug phur pa gsum can mtho gang lhag gter ston ngag dbang 'chi med rdo rjes phug ring nas bton pa'i gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu pa mtho gang lhag tsā ri mtsho dkar nas ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi phyag mdzub gsum gyi rjes/ ma lab sgron zhabs lham he cha/ 'brug kun mkhyen pad dkar dbu thodal a rang byon/chib g.yag snying ring bsrel can dang / tshem ring bsrel can/ chib 278

rtali tshem ring bsrel bcas mkhar chu'i rtsa klu bdud rdo rje'i byin rlabs yin par grags/ grub chen me long rdo rje'i dbu thod cad la a rang byon can dum/ 'gro mgon dung mtsho ras pa'i dbu thod cad dum la 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal rang byon/ lcags phur can du gu ru rin po che bzhugs skabs ra ji ra dang bcas pa sangs rgyas/ra dkar mo gnas sgo 'byed mkhan yod pa'i dug rjes rdo la gsal/phyi rten la/ gnas mgor lha khang dri gtsang khang kun mkhyen padma dkar pos bzhings/ lnga pa rin po ches bsgyur/grwa bzhi bcu lhag bdud 'joms gling pa sprul sku ni rdo rje brag bla khag bcu gsum zhes lcags zam sprul skuchu bzang /zur chen/yar 'brog brag ra/gtsang lha ri gzim phug sogs las dge slong lha mchog ces rig 'dzin pad phrin slob ma 'ol ka rje drung pas lung bstan/ bad pa'i gnas phran re zung dang / seng ge ri/sbas yul long mo lha steng zer ba sogs gnas sgo phye mkhan zhig go /dri gtsang khang ka bzhi dbus na rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa zangs gser thog so mtho nges slob pa 'dom de'i cha 'jog tsam/ khri rgyab yol 'dam can/chos brtsegs pod nyis brgya tsam mar mi sogs sku 'thor dang li sku khru gang tsam bcu/mgon po'i rten/tshogs khang ka ba nyi shu lhag pa/ngos bris rnams bka' brgyud 'brug lugs bla brgyud dang / bde mchog gsang 279

'dus/dgyes rdor sogs/rgyal ba lnga pa'i sku dang /phyag rdor 'jim sku mi tshad/ bka' 'gyur sogs/steng khang sgrol ma lha khang du sku 'dra li ma bzang po drug cu tsam dang dge slong lha mchog sku phreng bzhi pa'i gdung zangs kyi mchod rten/'chams gos rgya dar rtse mdo'i lcags la rgyal po snga mas phul ba sogs mang /rol mo legs po kha shas/mtshan brgyad sman thang cha gnyis las/lha khang sbyin bdag gis bzhengs pa shin tu legs pa gu thang rje 'bangs nyer lnga bcas/ le bdun bcu gcig pa'ang legs/bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs sman rnying spus dag thang ka bcu gcig gi yang sman bla don grub gnas brtan nyer gnyis yod/yang nam snying sprul sku'i gzim khang bcas/ sprel lo sprel zla la tshes bcu chen mo 'chams/ tsā ri'i 'du tshogs 'ong / rgyal dbang lnga pa'i mi 'khrugs pa/byang gter thugs sgrub/ le brgyad ma/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/tshe bdag bcas lnga pa chen po'i yig cha steng nas gsungs/ sgrub pa pho mo nyab nyob mang ngo / /'dir la rgyab thugs sras nas rdor gling gter ma sku tshab bye ma a krang sor drug pa'ang mjal to//mkhar chu phug ring zhes mdun du brag seng ge gnam 'phyong lag sor bkram pa lta bu yod pa gcong rong po yu za ba'i rtser/ seng ge bzang po'i rgyal khang /gsang sngags sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du rje 280

'bangs nyi shu rtsa lngar dbang bskur ba'i gu ru rin po che'i sgrub phug gu ru chos dbang gis bzhengs tshergyan rin po che za hor ma lo bcu drug tsam/nam mkha'i snying po dge slong paṇa zhwa can 'dom phyed pa/ a ṇi byi lus g.yag snying ngam chos nyid sgrol mar/ nga yi 'gro don lho brag mkhar chur yod ces gsung 'byon pas lha sa'i bar skor khang nas khyer 'ong ba'i thub sku rgya gar li ma lo bcu drug tshad 'od dpag med sman 'dam sku dam tsam pa/mkhan po bho snyi satwa/ shel dkar rdo rje mtsho phyis bzhengs mtsho rgyal lta bu khru gang lhag gu ru mtshan brgyad/ zhabs dkar sogs bris pas/ zhabs dkar dus nyams gso byas pa/ nam mkha'i snying po dang / shel dkar rdo rje mtsho'i zhabs rjes/de nas phar brag g.yang la 'grim phyin pas/dur khrod la kha nas yar nags dbus khang pa zhig tu grub thob me long rdo rje/ yab yum sras gsum gdung yin zer te sa 'bum dkar po gsum/'di'i logs bris rig 'dzin ku ma rā dza'i phyag bris yod de zhig dkar sogs bris pas/ zhabs dkar dus nyams gso byas pa/ nam mkha'i snying po dang / shel dkar rdo rje mtsho'i zhabs rjes/ de nas phar brag g.yang la 'grim phyin pas/dur khrod la kha nas yar nags dbus khang pa zhig tu grub thob me 281

long rdo rje/ yab yum sras gsum gdung yin zer te sa 'bum dkar po gsum/ 'di'i logs bris rig 'dzin ku ma rā dza'i phyag bris yod de zhig gsos zer nas cher nyams/me long lha khang zhig gso byas pas/ me long rdo rje'i bla mtsho nyams/ dbu spa tshar 'khyil ring tsam/ spyan hur/ sku smug sa gnon mnyam bzhag sku stod gcer bu sgom thag can zla gam gsol ba mi tshad chung / rdo rje 'chang gser sku/ te lo/ nā ro/ mar mi dwags gsum/ gling gtsang rgya ras lo rgod/ padma dkar po bcas/ gu ru rin po che/ bde mchog lhan skyes/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa bcas khru gang tsam re/ me long rdo rje'i zhabs rjes gsal po/ de nas dur khrod lha mo'i mgon khang yod/ de nas rong gi nags brag gting zab po mthong / chu klung sogs snang g.yer che/de nas ring du babs pas lho brag kho mthing lha khang ka brgyad yangs pa na/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rdor sems/ rin 'byung /snang mtha' bcas sa g.yos kyis cher zhig pas nyams gsos dang /don yod grub pa chos rgyal srong btsan dus yin pas shin tu byin chags/ rigs lnga re la zhal mtho bzhi pa yin pas thog so mtho nges gnyis re/ nye sras brgyad gsar bzhengs thog so mtho gnyis pa re/ sgo 282

srung khro bo gnyis/ rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal thang thog tshad gnyis/ sgo rgyab rgyal chen sde bzhi thog sleb/khyams ka ba bcu gnyis/ bka' gdams mchod rten li ma 'dom gang pa gnyis/ thub sku li ma 'dom gang pa lnga/ yang chung gnyis/g.yas su slob dpon rdu chen ka ra li ma slob dpon rgya gar ma lta bu rdo rje thod pa can/ grub thob me long rdo rje zangs gser mi tshad/ u rgyan/rje tsong kha pa/ rgyal ba lnga pa/ bcu gcig zhal/ srong btsan sgam po rnams mi tshad re/ lo ras gser sku mi tshad/ sa 'bum dkar po/'bum sogs pod chen bzhi brgya tsam/ gu ru'i phyag mkhar yin skad kham bu sdong po 'bras bu can/thog mar tshe bdag mgon khang / li ma rgyal ba rigs lnga li ma bzang po sna tshogs lnga bcu tsam/ 'di nang dgyes rdor mar lugs thod pa can legs/rdzong gi nang 'og lo ras sku gdung sa 'bum che/ sngar bka' brgyud 'brug pa'i dgon shul yin par chos bcigs hral hrul/ logs bris thar thor sa 'bum sogs mang / thog khar yang kun mkhyen padma dkar po'i sku zangs gser mi tshad/ thub sku sogs li ma kha shas/rgyal ba dpag bsam dbang po'i phyag bzos dud sol mgon khang /283

grong phyogs bzhir gu ru chos dbang rin po che'i byin rlabs shing sdong chen po bzhi/ mchod rten/ sgrub chu/ par ku'i brag la yig drug rang byon bcas so/ /rgya gar nye bas me tog legs po mang po skye/'di nas mar ser ge ri phyogs na dug sbrul chung ngu yod/ ser ge rir dge slong lha mchog gis bzhings lha khang yod/ de nas phar la rgyab nas sbal yul rol mo steng du slebs/ mda' nas mar song na mon ku ru stod la nyin gsum tsam gyis rkang thang sleb/ der mon kha shrī rdzong sogs yod/tshe lam dpal rir phug mo che'i nang / gu ru'i rdzu 'phrul zhabs rjes rtse khru gang las mtho gang lhag gu ru chos dbang gi gter ma tshe chu 'og na mtsho rgyal zhabs rjes/ yang gu ru dang nam snying mkhar chu nas 'phur 'ong ba'i zhabs rjes gnyis nas gter yod/ rgya dmag dang be ri dmag sogs 'ong dus brag chad 'ong ba'i brag pha bong tshad/ gu ru chos dbang rin po ches dmag bzlog la bzhings pa'i rigs gsum mchod rten/ tshe lam dngos la 'og tu mtsho rgyal phug na/ mtsho rgyal sku 'dam las grub pa/ steng du gu ru'i sgrub phug mkhar chu lcags phur can du lo bdun bzhugs dus nyi zer la chibs nas snga dror 'dir tshe sgruX8 /nang / phyi dror mkhar chu nas yang dag sgrub pa yin skad do/ /

'dir 'ja' tshon snying pos bzhengs pa'i gu ru sman 'dam rtse khru do/mkha' 'gro gnyis/ bsam yas bzo phud li ma/ gu ru rtse khru gang /yang rgya gar nas 'ong ba'i rdo mi 'dra bar tshe bum lta bu/ phyi khyams li sku kha shas sogs yod/ rtser brag gi nang la mkhar gong dkar po'i lam ༵ dro zlom zer/ sgrub khang hral hrul mang / sngar 'bri gung pa'i dgon gong tsam du pad ri dgon na nges don snying thig dang / pad gling bla rgyud 'dam sku sogs lha lung 'dzin bdag ser khyim pa kha shas/dbu rtser gsang phug bgrod dka' ba bsgrags yongs rdzong gi gsang gug lta bu na tshe ril tshe chu sogs yod zer/mdangs bya pho zer ba btsan dug za ba/ sa yi ma thub pa las rma bya yin pa gtsug sgro can snang /de nas 'phrang la thur song lho mon gyi sa sner zin pa/ shing rigs dang / me tog mi 'dra ba mang ba/ shin tu stug po'i nags rong brgyud de chu rong nyin mtshan med par char babs/ smug zil can gyi u rgyan mkhan pa lung gi gnas sgo'i la rgyab na/ dang po 'og du khyim na/mchog ldan mgon por gung thang rgyal pos phul ba'i u rgyan bal po li mi tshad byin can/ sgrub btsun khyim sngags pa'i grang ngo / /285

de nas gong tsam du gzim khang nub ces pa pad gling brgyad pa gsung sprul rin po che'i gzim bskyil thog gnyis na/ 'os tu 'brug rgyal pos sbyin bdag byas pa'i lha khang ka bzhi ma che mtho shing che bzang po'i dbus lho 'brug mgar bas brdungs ba'i gu ru za hor ma gser sku mi tshad che/ thub dbang / spyan ras gzigs/ padma gling pa/ gsung sprul rin po che sogs 'dam sku rtse khru gang pa brgyad/ ma ṇi 'khor lo/rje 'bangs nyer lnga ngos bris/ shing gi sgam bur snang bshags so lnga bzhugs pa'i nang bka' 'gyur rin po che spus dgamachod rdzas dang /rgyal mtshan sogs legs/ g.yas su mgon khang / steng na gzim khang /mdor bi ma snying thig dang / mkha' 'gro snying thig bla rgyud ngos bris/mkho mthing lha pa zhig gis gsar bzhengs gu ru mtshan brgyad la si rgya mtshos bskor ba lnga thang rgyab byang phyag bris sum thad legs po can spus dag zhi khro gser thang gnyis/ pad gling brgyad pa'i phyag bris tshe ring rnam drug mtshan byang can/ phyi'i rdo gcal steng bstan 'dzin grub mchog rdo rje'i zhabs rjes yod pa'i rdo'i mchod rten/pha tshad gzim khar shar na nang du u rgyan zangs gser/ sgrol dkar dngul sku sogs sku 'dra legs po bcu tsam/ dpe cha spus dag pod sum brgya tsam/ sprul sku legs gzigs phyag bris gu ru mtshan 286

brgyad brag phug bzhugs pa sogs yod/ lung pa'i phur rgyal po khyi kha ra thod khang shul sogs yod/ lung pa 'di'i phu na ma mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi bla mtsho sgrol ma nyer gcig bla mtsho/ srin mtsho gong 'og dang /phu gangs/ spangs ri rdza ri cung yod / lhag par nags rong 'thugs/ byin che/ 'jigs zil can lta bur snang ngo / /de nas sbas yul dpag bsam lung na u rgyan bzhugs khri dus rgyun mkha' 'gros bskor ba byed sa sogs dang / bzhugs khri brgya dang brgyad/ shar ku ru kha/ mon shrī rdzong la thug pa/ nub bum thang la thug par sbas yul chen po mkhan pa ljongs lam yig ltar yod do/ /'di nas tshur 'ong ba'i pha ri brag phug na khams sprul te rwa kha sprul pa'i sku'i gdung yod / 'di nas sngon stag sham rdo rje bzhugs pa'i brag phug yin/ 'di nas nags rong 'bu mang ba/ stag ma'i me tog skag mdog legs po yod do/ /de lta bu'i la chen po 'dzegs nas lho brag gu zu'am dge bcu gzhung la slebs pa/ la khar spang me tog bkra ba mtshe'u/ sgang shog legs po yod pa khu g.yung gis bzhings pa'i bkra shis gling du/ thub sku li ma 'ga' dang / dpe rnying chos brtsegs/phyag bzhi'i mgon po legs po yod/dol gter rgyud nas sangs rgyas gling pa'i zhal slob zhig gis 287

bzhengs pa'i lha khang na sa 'bum chen po mched rten brgya dang brgyad pas bskor ba'i/ mched rten sangs rgyas gling pa'i sku gdung zhig dang /gu ru mtshan brgyad sogs yod do/ /bu dgon dkar 'di na rdor gdan chen po khru gang lhag pa bzhi/zhi khro lha khang bcas yod/ 'bying dkar don yod rdo rje'i bzhugs gnas yin/thog na spang dkar bla ma grags pa dpal bzang zhes kun mkhyen lnga pa'i bla ma red zer rgyu zhig gi 'dra zhal dang / zhabs rjes/ shod na gser 'bum/ sa gdung che chung bzhi/ chos thar thor pod bzhi bcu tsam/ lha mo dud sol mgon khang bcas yod/gzhung na rngog chos sku rdo rje'i gdan sa yin kyang de phyogs brgyud na brag rong che bas ma slobs/ chu pha rir lha bro rnam rgyal khang bzang a mye sngags dgon gangs sman sham rgyab lung phu na/ khro bo ri khrod zhes 'ja' tshon klong yangs sgrub phug dang / srub sbug na rtogs ldan ye shes mgon po'i sgrub gnas na sku gdung bcas/ srin mo brag ces ming 'dogs so/ /lug lo hor zla5pa'i tshes13la lho brag sras mkhar dgu thog tu phyi/ ṭwāṃ/ /de ni zhib cha dkar chag spar ma ltar la dbu rtse gser g.yab

dang / skor lam lcags thag bcas par sangs rgyas sogs zangs gser 'bur sku drug cu re bzhi/ nang bkra shis brgyad pa'i sku mdun/sangs rgyas bdun pa'i mdo'i sku/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa'i sku sogs rje dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas bzhengs pa/dbu rtse lha khang dril bu brgya dang gcig gnam yongs la dus 'khor dgyes rdor gnyis la/ gsang bde sogs dkyil 'khor ling tshe nyi shu ma bla brer bris pa/ srog shing la mchod rten mang / a co 'jigs sngangs phud pa'i skor lam sgo bzhi/ dwags po/ mi la/ rnal 'byor ma bden gnyis zhal bcas kyi 'dra zhal khru gang bzhi/ mar pa/ mi la/bdag med ma bcas sman 'dam sras mkhar ka thog la 'phyang rgyu'i bu chen bzhis bris pa'i ras 'phen bzhi/ bka' gdams gdung rten li ma mi tshad bcas/ ngos bris rgya gar grub thob mang po 'di'i 'og nas brtsams te khang pa'i ka gdung sogs mi la'i phyag bzo yin/de'i 'og thog khang na/ rdo rje 'chang li ma khru gang lhag de 'dra'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bde mchog lhan skyes sman 'dam/ dud sol ma 'dam byin can khru gang / 'di'i logs bris 'ga' re shin tu rnying pa/ dgyes rdor mar lugs dang / bde mchog sogs dkar bris rnying pa'i tshugs can/ mar ba'i rnam thar/ mi las sras mkhar bzhengs 289

tshul/ bka' brgyud gser phreng / rdor gling sogs bla ma sna tshogs/rigs lnga sogs ngos bris legs/de'i 'og khang du/ tsandan dkar po'i ka ba dang dmar po bcas kun gyis gris gzhog sa/ thub sku zangs gser khru gang mtho gang /spyan ras gzigs dang / te lo pa'i sku sman 'dam/ sangs rgyas rab bdun sogs logs bris/ 'di la them bcu gsum pa'i rgya skas mi la'i rdzu 'phrul gyis skar khung nas drangs pa/ dpal rtse dbyings gsum dang /rnam snang mngon byang ngos bris shin tu rnying pa'i li tshugs/ /thog mtho ba'i bar khang phyi khyams sgo khang steng / slob dpon gtso 'khor mkhan slob chos gsum dang / klong rdol bla mas bris 'jug pa rje yab sras gsum/ ngos gcig nas mar pa yab yum sras gsum/ rje btsun/ ras che chung rngog bcas/ yang ngos gcig la sku lha mkha' ri rnams bris/ ngos gcig lcags dra'i nang / dbus su rje mar pa'i sku rtsa ris ma mar pa rang gi phyag bzo la gzhung gis dbu brgyan zangs gser phul ba/ sngon gser ljang brdung dbu rgyan yod pa 'khyam po zhig gis khyer/ de'i g.yas su sras dar ma mdo sde dngul gyi rigs lnga can/ de'i g.yas su ras chung pa/ rje mar pa'i g.yon du mi la bal li'i tshugs can/ de'i g.yon du yum bdag med ma bcas mi tshad/290

bka' gdams gdung rten/ mchod pa'i bkod pa bcas/ /de nas 'og tu dbus su thub dbang li ma mi tshad shing gi rgyab yol bcas/ g.yas su 'od dpag med/ dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub/g.yon du tshe dpag med 'jim/ gnas bcu mi tshad ngos bris/ g.yas sgo chung ngu nas bdag med ma'i gsol thab khang / 'di'i brag thog nas bla mas bkyon pas rje mi la 'phyong bar brtsam pa'i gnas/yang de'i 'og tu thog mthon pa'i nang phyin pas rnam par snang mdzad 'dom phyed do sman 'jim/ g.yas su lho 'brug pa stag sgom zhes mar pa'i chibs kha pa dge slong ag tsom can/ g.yon du mar me mdzad/ sangs rgyas sku mang po dang / ngos bris bal bris rnying pa/nang du mar pa'i gzim mal/ dbu sngas mgor skar khung gru gsum/mar mi bdag med ma bcas mi tshad 'jim/ dpa' bo gtsug lag pas sman thang bal bris bcol ba'i mdun du/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod/spyan gzigs 'jam rdor/ g.yas su bde mchog lnga/ gdan bzhi/ ma hā/ ma ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ gshed mar/ dbu sngas phag mo mthing / g.yon du phag mo dmar mo/ dus 'khor rgyab tu mar pa la kerma pa zhwa dmar nag gis bskor ba bcas tshugs shin tu ngo mtshar ba/sras mkhar lte ba la/ sgo khang nas 'phyis 'thud pa/ g.yon rje 291

kurma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i gzim chung na ngos bris shin tu mtshar/ sgrol ma glang dar khrims phog sogs li ma sna tshogs/ gdung rten brgya lhagabe har rten/ arga la g.yu rdzong dga' ma sogs yod/de nas 'og tu 'khyams ka ba bcu gnyis pa rje btsun mi la mi gcig gis bzhings pa'i lha khang phyi 'khyams brgyad na/ dud sol ma rje mar pa'i shangs mtshar gyis bris/ mdun sku dang / rten gtor sgam/dus mkhyen nas zhwa dag sku lnga/ zhwa dmar dpa' bo bcas mi tshad 'jim bzo khyad 'phags/ chos pod chen po mang /nang rten nang / paṇa chen nā ro pa'i dbu yi glegs bam 'chang rgyu'i lhar bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum/ phag mo gnyis/ thub pa/sgrol ma dkar sngon/ spyan ras gzigs/ rta mgrin/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa bcas tshon gang ba/ shing gi drwa mig dgu pa/ mtshur phu 'jim dbyangs phyag brkos bal po'i garnyo lar phag mo shin tu sgros ldan/ klu 'jim nā ro sa brgyad la margyu'i yi ge can gu shel bcas/ zhwa dmar dkon mchog lag sku bskos pa/ sur rdo la a rang byon/ sras dar ma mdo sde'i dbu thod la a rang byon can dum bu gcig karma pa brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rjes phyag bcang rdo yi chang bu/ rje btsun mi la'i phyag cha rdo sta ma ste'u/ lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang rdo brag rig 'dzin chen 292

po sku phreng gsum pa'i phyag phreng gnyis/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i sku ching ser po/ kerma pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang / dpa' bo gtsug lag zhabs chags ya re/ gtsang ston ho ru na'i sgom thag rje mar pa dang /bdag med ma'i phyag dam/ klong rdol bla ma'i phyag rdor g.yab dar/mar pa rin po che'i tshems dang / sras dar ma mdo sde/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ gtsug lag rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin rnam rgyal grags pa/ rig 'dzin padma dbang rgyal tshems bcas rdo'i pa tra nang bzhugs pa/ kurma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i mnab chos dmar/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i mdab chos ser/ chab mdo 'phags pa lha'i dbu zhwa bcas so/ /dbu rtse gtsang khang ka bzhi par/ thub dbang 'dom do pa/ mchog zung / gnas bcu mi tshad/ sgo srung khro bo gnyis bcas so/ /rdo 'bru gsum rang byon can mkha' 'gro'i bla rdo/ khyams 'di'i sgo rtsar gyad rdo mtho lnga can/ sgo rtsar sras dar ma mdo sde'i dbu klad 'thor rjes shing skyes pa/g.yas su 'du khang dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas bzhengs par klong rdol bla ma dang / khams sgar bla ma ye shes snying pos zhig gso gnang bar/ khyams la ka ba bcu drug la gnas brten zangs gser khru gang pa bcu drug ngo ya ma/ bka' brgyud gser phreng mi tshad ma 'jim 293

nyer gsum/ rje rin po che bcas/ bka' 'gyur dang 'bum bris rnying pa mang / ngos bris gos/ zhug tu mgon khang na/ 'jigs byed phyag drug sogs phyis bzhengs/ ber nag zhing skyong sogs sngon bzhengs/rdo nag phyag bzhi pa dpa' bo'i gter ma/ dbus su gtsang khang na thub dbang thog gsum/ sangs rgyas rab bdun 'dom do pa gser byug pa 'dam spus dag khro bo gnyis/ sangs rgyas stong ngos bris bcas/ yum bdag med ma'i brgyad stong gser chos/ klong rdol bla mas bzhengs pa mar pa'i rnam thar/ dwags po'i rnam thar bcas khyon zhal thang nyer ༵/ rgyal ba bskal bzang phyag rjes yod pa lha sman rnying tshugs legs dbu rtser bla ma lha khang na/ rje mar pa mi tshad yab yum sras gsum/ mi la/ garma pa dang dpa' bo zangs gser/ 'jim mi tshad bzhi/ g.yas su dpa' bo'i zhabs kyis bzhengs pa zangs gser mchod rten rin po che'i phra can/ dpe brtsigs nyung shas 'thor po bcas so/ /de nas la 'dzegs te lho gro bo lung du phyin te/ lung pa na rje mar pa'i dbu spa gtor bas skyes pa'i glang ma'i nags dang zhabs rjes las chu rdol ba dang / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gzhong yod/ sgang der gyang khang sde pa'i ka ni'i 'dzul sgo/ de gang der mi la byon skabs ma ra pa phru klog 294

pa'i zol gyis bsu 'ong ba'i zhing da lta tha bar song ba/ mchod khang du dbu rtse dmar po thog mtho bar/ dbus su mar pa'i thugs dam dus gsum sangs rgyas 'jim sku mi tshad gsum/ mdun du rje btsun mar pa mi tshad dbu rgyan can byin chags rdo chen a mo li ki'i khri steng glang chen khri brtsegs la bzhugs pa/ mi la/ bdag med ma khru gang pa/ ras chung / mar pa'i chibs ka ba lho ma stag sgom/ slob dpon rin po che dang / seng sgra/ mnyam med dwags po/ yang mar pa'i sras dar ma mdo sde bcas/ phyi rol du rje btsun ras chen gyis zangs dkar rna bzhi ma phul ba dang du yod pa'i sa 'bum chen po/ sgo kha der rdo la zhabs rjes/ mar pa'i mkhar ram yum bdag med ma'i mkhar thog lnga pa dung nge ba'i nang / steng khang du li sku sna tshogs sum cu tsam/ mar pa/yum sras gsum 'dam sku/ thang ka cha shas klong rdol bla mas bzhengs pa 'dra/ 'og der thub pa/ snang mtha' sogs yod pa bcas/ /dbu rtse dkar po'i thog khar/ aṣṭa dha tu ste snga mo'i rgya gar dkar yol gsol zhal shing dkar yol bsres pa 'dra ba/ mar pa'i chu zhing phyag mkhad gter ston 'ja' tshon nyi zla snying po'i thugs sras dbu thod/ klong rdol bla ma'i zhal slob sras mkhar mkhan po ngag dbang chos bzang phyag ngar 'bru gsum rang byon can/ bcom ldan 'das nya yi skye 295

ba bzhes pa'i ring bsrel dkar dog mar pa'i yon bdag gyang mkhar nor thod/ klong rdol chib lcags/ klong rdol phyag mkhar/ 'brog spang gshong nas mar pas bsnams pa mkha' 'gro'i chos dung rdo las grub/rdo nag mchod rten rang byon/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes bha ga rdo la rang byon/ mar pa'i chibs rgan tshems/ gtsug lag phreng ba dang rgya mtsho'i zhabs chags/ mar pa'i phyag rdor yin zer ba a mye bsam kho nas blugs pa ngo ma red pas brjes pa 'dra/ lu zer ba'i grong nas ba pa/ /sa rtswa klu bdud rdo rjo zos pa'i tshems la ring bsrel byung ba dbu rtse dkar po 'og khang na ba bcu gnyis nang / sbug tu mar pa'i rdo yi dbu thod rang byon ma mi tshad/ sku g.yas su thub dbang 'bri gung gcung / snang mtha'/ don grub/ mar me mdzad/ byams mgon bcas mi tshad dang / phyag bzhi/ dud sol bcas 'jim sku/sku g.yon du thub pa li ma mi tshad/ kurma pakshi/ rdo rje 'chang / te lo/nā ro/ bla ma zhang bcas/ g.yas su gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar dang / g.yon na padma 'od 'bar bka' gdams li ma khyams dbus jo bo bcu gcig zhal bdud rtsi ma 'jim mi tshad che dang / dud sol ma mar pa'i phyag bzos/ ngag dbang chos bzang zhes pa de'i sa 'bum/296

de'i sku/ slob dpon padma'i sku/ mar pa'i chos brtsegs pon stong tsho tsam bcas/ klong rdol rin po ches bzhengs pa'i gos chen legs pa mi la'i rnam thar zhal thang lnga/ thub dbang ngo mtshar bcas/ jo bo nā ro pas lung bstan nas mar pas thog mar sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas bar khang sgrub phug na/ dbus su chos rgyal li ma mar pa bya gzigs ma byis pa tsam sras yum khru gang 'dam/ phyi khyams na/ slob dpon rin so che/ mtshan brgyad/ rje mi la/ rkarma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis/ lho brag daX' bo rin po che/ rje rin po che bcas mi tshad chung / lha khang ka ba bzha/khang 'og na zangs phug mar pa'i sgrub phug sgrub chu/0 tshe chu sogs/ steng na li ma kha shas bcas/de nas sgang rin so gsum tsam dang / mthur lam ngos gzar brgyud nas brag gi drung gyen du 'thogs pas/ chu drag por 'babs pa/ glang ma'i tshal gong na ru ba sdod gnas can/ brag gi drung rje btsun mi la gzim phug ltag gnya'am/ ltag gnya' lung bstan phug na/ lha khang mi la che chung ngos bris gnyis sogs/ rje mkhyen brtse dang 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'ang bris snang / tshur ngos na dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i gzim phug lha khang na sa'i mchod rten bcas/297

pha ri 'dir ban tsa gser gyi lha khang yod/ yang 'dul rnam snang sogs/ de'i sa 'bum dkar po 'di mar pa sku 'khrungs sa bkra shis ldeng nga ltem zhes bya/ ri sna 'dir cig pa gru gsum yod pa 'di mi la'i sras mkhar gru gsum pa bshigs shul/ sras mkhar nas mar phyin pa chos la sgang ngam phyag 'tshal sgang 'dir ri mgor rje btsun mi la rje mar pa bdag med ma yab yum gyis chibs bskyel mdzad dus tshogs gzhong rdo gzhong sogs mjal rgyu yod/dmi pa zhwa dmar spyan snga chos grags rin po che'i gdan sa lho brag nyi lde dgon/ sa shin tu skyid/ 'du khang sbug lha khang ka bzhi mar/dbus su byang sems zla rgyal gdung rten stod li'am stod hor li ma/spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal mi tshad bzhugs pa/ g.yas su lo ki shwa ra khams pa rkun mas khyer bar nga'i 'gro don 'dir yod gsungs pa li ma khru gang / khra mkha' spyod dgon par bzhugs pa'i lo ki shwa ra sog jun gar bas chab la zhus par mu rgan mor gsungs byon nas 'dir pheb pa/ byang yangs can nas byung ba'i 'od dpag med rten li ma gru gang lhag yar 'brog yon pa de'i sprul sku mdo sngags bstan 'dzin phyag bzos u rgyan/ g.yas rdi tsha sprul sku bsod nams ye shes dpa' bzang dang / g.yon thub bstan nyi ma gnyis kyi dngul gdung 'dom gang pa 298

re/ bka' 'gyur bris ma cha gnyis/ bla sku 'jim mi tshad bzhi/ li ma khru gang pa tsam brgyad/'du khang ka ba nyi shu pa'i dbus/ gi tsha sprul sku sku phreng bcu pas bzhengs pa'i slob dpon dngul sku mi tshad spus dag g.yas su zhwa dmar spyan snga chos grags sku zangs gser mi tshad/ tshe lha rnam gsum 'jim sku mi tshad re/ gser rnga lnga bcu tsam/ bka' brgyud gser 'phreng zhal thang nyer lnga zhwa dmar dus sgar bris rnying pa sogs gos jus mtha' can sngon gyi lha shin tu khyad 'phags ngo mtshar dpe bral/ g.yon du phyag bzhi/ zhing skyong / ber/ dud sol/ dam can/ mgon khang /bar khang dbus su ji tsha bdun pa 'jigs med rnam rgyal sku gdung 'dom gang / bum sgor byi ru'i tshe dpag med/ g.yu'i sgrol ljang / mu tig sgrol dkar/ spos shel 'jam dbyangs/ mu men phyag rdor yod pa/ gnas bcu mi tshad 'jim/ lho 'brug lha bzos bzhings pa ngo mtshar/ bka' gdams gdung rten 'dom gang li ma gnyis/ sku 'thor lnga bcu tsam/steng khang na/ mi pham don grub rnam rgyal sku gdung / rje dbon bskal bzang chos dbyings dbang phyug dngul gdung rin po che/ gnas bcu brag ri ma e bzo mi tshad shin tu ngo mtshar ba la/ bder gshegs 299

brgyad/ zangs mdog dpal ri/ gu ru mtshan brgyad/ bka' brgyud gser phreng bcu bcas 'di thams cad shin tu spus dag yi ge sna tshogs zhwa dmar gsung 'bum gtsos pod sum brgya lhag pa/ gos chen btsun mo bkra shes btags gser gzhi ma sogs mang / gong ma chen pos kurma pakshir phul ba'i dung dkar rin po che mchog gi phra can/rab gsal khar nang rten sgom bur/ kurma pa zhwa dmar chos grags phyag bris ma mgon 'khor lnga/ chos dbyings rdo rje'i phyag bris dpa' bo sogs zhal thang lnga/ klu sgrub phyag bzo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sku klu 'jim chag gang shar li'i tshugs/ mon la'i gsham na rdzi bo zhig gis rdo sku spyan ras gzigs mjal/ sku brag la thim/ phyag dad rten thob pa ngo mtshar ba/ tshems ring bsrel can gsum/ sras dar ma mdo sde'i dbu klad/ bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i tshems/ lho brag mar pa'i tshems sum bsgrigs/ gi tsha bdun pa'i gdung ring bsrel dang a 'bur can/ zhwa dmar spyan snga'i chib g.yu drung tshems/ kurma dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rdo'i phyag bcang / padma las 'brel gter byon mkha' 'gro snying thig gter sgrom rdo snying mdog ma/ kurma pakshi'i phyag dam malnga'i yi ge can g.yang ṭi'u/ rkarma pakhrir rgya nag gong mas phul ba'i g.yang ṭi'i me tog can gyi gsol zhal/ kurma pa de bzhin gshegs 300

par twa ming rgyal pos phul ba'i g.yang ṭi'u'i skyogs/ yang tā ming gis phul ba'i ma na ho dmar po'i zhal skyogs shing lo can/ g.yang ṭi'i sgrom bu/ man shel ser po zur gsum/ kurma pa de bzhin gshegs pa la tā ming rgyal pos phul ba phyag 'khor yu ba chibs lcag gsol lder bcas g.yang ṭi las grub pa/ kurma pa de bzhin gshegs pa la lhas phul ba'i rol mo pad 'dab lta bu skas mtshar ba chung / rtswa mu le sbram phyag lcag cos dbyings rdo rje dgung lo bcu pa'i zhabs rjes/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bharnya'i mchod zhal/ dam can gyis gu ru rin po cher phul ba'i rdo rje/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i phyag shan rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra can/ kurma pa'i mgul phur gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu pa rtse khru gang / rdor brag rig 'dzin chen po'i mgul phur dang / sgom thag gzan bsdom bcas/'du khang steng na rab gsal du li ma cha shas/ kur sku sogs yod/ 'di na zhwa dmar chos grags kyis bzhengs pa bka' brgyud gser phreng zhal thang nyer lnga shin tu spus dag po bris rnying kurma'i sgar chen lha bkod phul gyur yangs pa can pa'i gser phreng da lta mtshur phu rgyal tshab mdun yod pa dang khyad med pa jus gser leb brdung lta bu'i shan can snang / yang je 'bangs nyer lnga'i zhal thang gi tsha gong mas 301

bzhengs pa/ mkhan slob chos gsum bcas sku gser bris yul bkod tshon can gos legs pa'i shan ldan nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ nam pa'i phyag bris mar mi dwags gsum thang ka gsum la rgyab rgya nag tā ming gi mdun nas 'thag pa'i kye rdor lha dgu'i sngags dang / a gser 'thag shan can bcas yod/lung pa 'di'i khar mtsho gsum yod/ 'di nas yar sgang gsum tsam na spang ljongs/ shing me rtog sogs skyid po yod/ dngar zhes bya ba nas mar brgyud chu khar phyin pas/ je btsun mi las brgyad stong brgya /// zlo/ pa'i dud tshang sa shul rtsig khang hral po sgo khar shug sdong de nas yar sgrub mtsho phyogs song bas bkra shis chos gling ste lha lung dgon lag gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje'i gdan sa sngags dgon na/ lha khang nang thub chen thog tshad/ nye sras/ sgo drung khro bo bcas dang / thog khar bla ma lha khang ngos bris/ rig 'dzin pad gling bcas/ de nas yar mtsho 'og ma dang / gong ma 'das te rdza spang shing gsum 'dres pa'i khar sgrub mtsho padma gling khar lho brag don gnyis pas phyis gsar bzhings lha khang ka gnyis mar/ dbus su dus gsum sangs rgyas rgya gar li ma 'thor bsgrigs pa khru gang pa shin tu spus dag302

tshe lha rnam gsum dang rigs gsum mgon po zangs gser mtho gang pa mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bal li legs po/ rje rin po che bkra shis rdo kha ma/ dbus su u rgyan rin po che/ g.yon thub dbang gangs can mtsho zhabs spus mo bslang ba/ phyag lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ bla ma zhang zangs gser khyad 'phags/ ras chung rdo je grags pa dang /dar ma mdo sde sman sku/ bka' gdams li ma gdung rten cha brgyad/gnas brtan bcu drug sman sku/ sgrol ma khru gang / mar pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad/ kurma pa dus mkhyen/ mnyam med dwags po/ nam pa zhwa dmar nag rang byung rdo rje sogs/ chos bcigs pod lnga bcu tsam/ chos dbang gter skas 'gro mgon gtsang rgya ras la mkha' ris bskul bas sgrub mtsho nas bzhes pa'i phyag dor gzi khyim smug po mtho chen gang khyad 'phags slob dpon rin po ches klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen la gnang ba/ chos dbang pheb pa'i mtsho nang zhabs rjes mang po yod kyang dbyar chu rgyas pas ma mjal/ chos dbang la mkha' ris bskul ba yar 'brog nas bzhes pa phyag rdor sku tshab chung ba rgyu de 'dra zhig su ru lha khang ltag rnam rgyal brag nas chos dbang gis bzhes pa'i gnam lcags rdo rje dang phur pa bcas yod/gtsang pa rgya ras kyis spang me long 'dra ba'am rta stan 'dra bar lha 303

khang bre tsam bzhengs pa'i nang bka' brgyud gser phreng bla sku mang po 'jigs nye/ltag nas rgyang tsam 'dzegs pas brag phug na u rgyan zhag bdun bzhugs pa'i sgrub phug na zhabs rjes/ 'dzul khung nas bsang btang ba phyi rgyab mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal brag na 'ong skad pa/gangs nyil dang chu sgra zil che ba sgrub mtsho dung gi dbyibs nyin gcig la lan bdun tsam 'khor ba gong 'og gsum/ sa skyid/ kham dwangs/ don gnyis gling pa'i gnas 'dzin grwa gsum nas chos dbang phyag rdor lnga pa'i ljags bsgrigs ma 'don/ 'di skor grum la nang mtsho gong 'og gsum yod/de nas la brgal te/ sa snum med kyi skya bo 'grim nas lho brag lha lung / gzil skyil bde chen gling du sa mug zla tshe la bsdad de/ dgon pa 'dir lcang ma'i nang mchod rten 'dom gang pa brgya dang brgyad kyi lcags ri mthon po/ dgon mthar mchod rten thog gsum pa gsum/sgo bzhi/ sa bde/ lcang ma mang / bkod legs gru bzhi/ dbus gtsug lag khang gi dkyil 'khor ltar zur bzhi glo 'bur bcas logs brgyad/ thog mar 'du khang sgo ngos pad gling phur pa/ tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng ba'i lha tshogs ngos bris/ lha khang ka ba sum cu/ ka ring gnyis/304

g.yas spug tu chos rgyal srong btsun dus bzhengs zer kyang de las phyi ba 'dra/ sangs rgyas rab bdun bzang po'i bzhugs stangs can thog phyed gnyis pa gsor byug 'dam sku/ mgon khang ma ning dang ber nag sogs dang / gser rtog che/ rgyal mtshan bzhi bcas/ spyir gtsug lag 'di dpa' bo gtsug lag gis bzhengs/ g.yas tshe sgrub rdo rje'i phreng ba mi tshad 'jim/ g.yas su khang bzang 'brug sogs bkod legs nang du slob dpon rin po che rgyan can dang / g.yon pad gling bdun pa ngag dbang chos kyi blo gros 'dra zhal mi tshad re/ g.yon ngos mchod chas 'chams chas rnga sogs yod/gtsang khang shing brtsegs can ka bzhi ma nang mnga' bdag khri ral nas bzhengs pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas rgya lugs thog gnyis 'jim/nye sras mi tsam/ khro bo gnyis/ bka' gdams gdung rten li ma 'dom gang / thugs sras bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i dngul gdung 'dom gang ba/ g.yon thugs sras bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i bris ma dang / nged rang bris dpe rnying rgyud bcas/ thugs sras 'khrungs rabs dang gsung sprul 'khrungs rabs sman lugs sprul sku legs bshad/ phyag bris smin gling zhal thang 'dra ba/ yab sras zung 'jug 'khrungs rabs zhal thang bcu gcig nang dbus kun bzang snang 305

mtha' kha san ṇi can/ g.yas dang po lha lcam padma gsal/ sha ri'i bu sogs/ g.yas gnyis pa padma sgron/ klu sgrub sogs/ g.yas gsum pa padma las 'brel/ zla ba grags ba khyab bdal lhun grub sogs/ g.yas bzhi pa padma gling pa/ drag dmar sogs/ g.yas lnga pa tshul khrims rdo rje/ g.yon dang po sangs rgyas skyid/ ind+ra bhu ti sogs/ g.yon gnyis pa rin chen grags pa/ g.yon gsum pa klong chen pa/ g.yon bzhi pa bstan 'dzin grags pa/ g.yon lnga pa kun bzang rdo rje can/yang gsang bskor dgu legs bshad phyag bris dbus thod phreng rtsal nor rgyal lha tshogs/ g.yas thugs chen mun sel sgron me(gcig)/tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng bzhuganyis)/ bka' brgyad thugs kyi me long zhugasum)/rta nag lcags ral(bzhi)/g.yon dang po gu ru padma(gcig)/ gur drag yongs rdzogs(gnyis)/ rta mgrin yang gsang bla med(gsum)/ phyag dor lha tshogs bcas(bzhi)/ kha skong phyag rdor gtum po(lnga)/ rnam 'joms(drug)/ rnam thos sras bcas(bdun)/ kha skong g.yas phag mo dmar mo(lnga)/ gshin rje yang gsang bla med(drug)/ mgon po ma ning (bdun)rnams lha bzo mgran zla bral ba dang / gnas brten nyer gsum sogs zhal thang sgam bcu gcig yod/ngo mtshar ye shes bde chen pho brang phyi 'khyams ka ba bcu gnyis/306

rdo rje 'chang bka' brgyud gser phreng mda' tshad ma 'jim sku sum cu so gsum/spug ka bzhi ma nang / 'brug rgyal po krang gsal sde srid nas bzhengs pa'i gsung sprul dgu pa kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dngul gdung 'dom gsum pa/ phra rgyan phun sum tshogs pa/ khri srong thugs dam gu ru'i sku dngul gar blugs/ g.yas su bi ma snying thig bla brgyud brag ri ma/ zhug sku brgyad sku phreng gsum mtho do pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad/pad gling mi tshad/ g.yon du pad gling bla brgyud sum cu so drug dbus su kun bzang mi tshad bcas/ ras khra gos bar bsres pa'i gnam rgyan/ dngul gong che/ma ṇi lha khang ka gnyis che/ pad gling thugs chen mun sel sgron me mi tshad/ 'khor bcu bdun mda' tshad 'jim sku legs/ khams sprul rba kha rin po ches bzhengs pa'i 'khor lo che/ rdo la dpa' bo'i zhabs rjes/ sgo khar tshe ring yul ljongs thugs sras lnga pa'i gsung rtsom snang /'du khang sgo g.yas rgyal khang /kun gzigs rtse smin grol chos kyi pho brang ka bzhi mar gsung sprul kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi mas sku nye 'brug sde srid padma bstan 'dzin dgongs rdzogs su bzhings pa spus dag gnam rgyan gos bzang /307

dbus rdor sems dngul sku mi tshad tsandan mchod rten cha brgyad/ sman bla bder gshegs/ nye sras brgyad khru gang pa bcas 'brug lha bzo phur rgyal zhes mthe bong la a yod pa lha bzo'i sprul pa lta bu yin zer yang de tsam mi mtshar/ nyang chos dbang rnam thar la logs bris/ spug tu kun mkhyen tshul rdor nga 'dra ma mi tshad/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba klong chen pa'i 'dra zhal phyag bzos ma/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sol dang bsam lhun lha tshogs ngos bris/ 'phan tshul rdor phyag btsem legs/bde chen lha khang na/ thugs sras bdun pa 'gyur med rdo rje'i dngul gdung 'dom do pa phra rgyan bcas/ thugs sras brgyad pa zil gnon bzhad rtsal dngul gdung de 'dra/ thugs sras drug pa 'gyur med rdo rje'i dngul gdung 'dom gang / 'dam sku rdor sems/ klong chen pa/ thugs sras zla ba rgyal mtshan/ gter ston padma las 'brel rtsal/ bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal bcas kyi sku mi tshad/ 'bum nyi khri brgyad stong sogs yi ge gos ras khra bsres pa'i gnam yol bcas/khang steng rdo la thod skam brkos pa'i dud sol mgon khang na/ nā ro pas phyag bzo ro lang wags pas bzos pa'i dud sol zhi 'bag zhal 'gyur 'gro ba/ rgyan gsar bzo'i dpa' bo'i skabs mdzad/ sku smad 308

sras mkhar na yod/bla ma lha khang ka drug mar dbus su thugs sras 'gyur med rdo rjes bzhengs pa'i pad gling gter rdzas rnams nang du bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin padma gling pa zangs gser mi tshad/ g.yas su o rgyan rin po che zangs gser mi tshad/ g.yas su rnam snang gangs can mi tshad zangs gser/ g.yas su gsung sprul grub mchog rdo rje'i dngul gdung 'dom gang / g.yon du thugs sras lnga pa mchog grub dpal 'bar/ gsung sprul drug pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dngul gdung 'dom gang / snar thang bka' 'gyur spar phud dang sde dge'i bstan 'gyur bcas/ mchod rdzas gos sogs legs/gnas brtan khang ka gnyis mar/ thub dbang rgyab yol sangs rgyas rab bdun bcas/ lho 'brug gangs ldan sprul sku dkon mchog bstan 'phel phyag bzos thub dbang 'gran bral mi tshad/ 'khor thams cad gos chen chos gos can mi tshad khyen nyer gsum/ ngos bris sgar chen bris rnying kurma srid bral gyi rdo rje 'chang / bcu gcig zhal/ zhwa dmar nag bde mchog sogs/mtshan brgyad lha khang du gu ru gtso 'khor gsum/ mtshan brgyad mi tshad tsam/ gsung sprul bdun pa ngag dbang chos kyi blo gros dngul 309

gdung kun gzigs rtse nas drangs pa/ pad gling / smin gter/dpa' bo gtsug lag mi tshad re/ sman 'dam tshe dpag brgya sku/gsung sprul rin po che'i gzim chung shar na/ gtso bo tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng ba'i sman sku mi tshad gtsos lha tshogs thams cad/ li gter sogs lnga bcu tsam/ gsung sprul lnga pa ngag dbang kun bzang rdo rje'i zhabs rjes/ ka ma ru pa'i ston pa myang 'das sku/ bar khyams la sangs rgyas stong bris pa/spar khang na/ dud sol ma/ le'u bdun ma/ dri med bshags rgyud/ rig 'dzin thugs thig 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/ rgya can gro lod/ lo gyon/ sgrol chog lam zab le'u bdun/ zung 'jug snye ma/kun bzang dgongs 'dus snying po rab gsal khrid/ klong chen rnam thar sogs/ theg mchog mdzod/ dpa' bo gtsug lag spyod 'jug 'grel pa/ chos 'byung / bka' 'bum thor bu/ bstod tshogs/mgur/ rnam thar pad gling tshe sgrub/ thugs chen/ kun bzang dgongs 'dus/ bka' brgyad/ nor rgyab sgrub khog bcas/ gur drag/// rje dregs 'joms/ chos spyod/ bka' thang shel brag ma lha lung grwa pa smin grol nor bzang nas bzhengs pa'i zhi khro'i lha 310

khang ka bzhi mar/ sbug tu kun bzang dgongs 'dus tshogs zhing /shing lo me tog gi gur khang du bla sku bcu drug dam pa rigs brgya rdo sku tshon snagaras khra'i gnam yol brag ri byas pa'i lha khang mtshar mo yod/'du khang nas zhal thang mjal bas bla rgyud chen mor grags pa lha lung rnying brgyud kyi bla rgyud sprul sku legs bshad phyag bris tshon mdangs gser bris gang thad nas bod tsam na 'gran zla bral ba yod pa'i nang /dbus kun bzang rgyan can rgyab yol rgyan drug khri brgyad zur ma la rgyal ba rigs lnga li tshugs can/ g.yon dang po nang rigs bdag rdor sems/ gtso bo dga' rab chos gos thor tshugs can mtsho gling padma 'gran bral la bzhugs pa/ ind+ra bhu ti gos khra can/ rgyal po dzaḥ'ajam dpal bshes gnyen/ sgeg rdor sangs rgyas ye shes/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ bde ba gsal/ dharma bho rnyi bcas/gnyis pa nang snang mtha'/ rghaṃ dar/ 'jam dpal/ klu sgrub/pra bha ha sti/ dha na sem skṛ/ bi ma la/ ram bu gu hya/ shārnyilta ga /u rgyan rin po che mtsho gling me tog sogs 'gran bral/g.yon gsum pa'i nang / slob dpon rgya gar ma/ nyang stag gdan la dkar chas sngags pa g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon gter sgrom zhal tsam cung / chos dbang me long can sa gnon mnyam bzhag ral pa 311

thor cog can padmas 'brel/ klong chen pa/ ratna gling pa gzan sham u rgyan pad zhu/ g.yas skyab sbyin/ g.yon pu ste can/ rdor gling yo rgyan pad zhwa mthing / ber mthing la ju rgyan gsol ba/ ḍā dril 'khrol/gtso bo pad gling ber dmar mnyam bzhag tshe bum/ u rgyan pad zhwa dmar po rna ba can/ mchog ldan mgon po pad zhwa mthing gter sgrom chos 'chad/ nang so rgyal ba don grub/g.yon bzhi par/ ri rab mar me'i rgyal mtshan mar me mdzad lta bu/ seng ge rgyab pa/ me long rdo rje/ ku ma rwa dza/ klong chen pa/dbus rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin grags pa naḥdam pa lta bu/ thug sras dkon mchog bzang po/ kun dga' grol chog zhig gling / mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/g.yon lnga par sangs rgyas rdo rje snying po/ khri bsod nams dbang po/ gangs rā lo chen/ zhwa ser/ nor bu dbang rgyal/ rig 'dzin snying po/ go 'jo bkra shis rin chen/ rtse le padma legs grub/ dbus gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ phrin las lhun grub/ bon lung tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/g.yon drug par rnam snang / sangs rgyas mos pa/ rdo rje chos/thu mi bsto ṭa/ kun dga' bo/ lo chen bee ro/ rgyal po dzaḥ zur chen 312

shākya 'byung / dbus gter bdag gling pa/ grwa pa mngon shes/ rong zom/ ra shag chos 'bar/ rdo rje gling / kun skyong gling pa/ mchog ldan mgon po/ srin po chos kyi go cha bcas/g.yon bdun par/ kun bzang / rnam grol ye shes/ mkhas mchog kun grags/ bsam gtan yon tan/ dbang phyug dpal/dbus bstan 'dzin legs pa don grub/ khyab bdal lhun grub/ dri med gling pa/ tshul khrims dpal 'byor/ rgyal sras padma phrin las/g.yon brgyad par/ dbyangs can ma/ bstan 'dzin grub mchog rdo rje sogs phyis kha skong kha yig med pa'i bla ma brgyad/g.yas dang po rigs bdag chos sku kun bzang / rdo rje sems dpa' gtso bo che/ 'khor nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ bkod pa mtshar/g.yas gnyis pa/ rigs bdag mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo lam 'bras bdag med ma lta bu/ tsā na su tra/ bi ma la/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ ldang ma lhun rgyal/ gtso bo shrī seng ha paṇḍi ta'i cha byad/lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug rgyal ba zhang ston/ mkhas pa nyi 'bum/gu ru jo 'ber/g.yas gsum par/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi/ nam snying /sangs rgyas ye shes/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs gtso bo mtsho rgyal gasdu/

cang te'u 'grel/ g.yon bharnya can/ tsā na ku ma ra/ 'brog mi dpa' ye/ khri srong / bee ro/ rlang dpal seng /g.yas bzhi par mkhan po bho snyi satwa/ mkhan tshul khrims dpal 'byor/ gter ston byang chub gling pa/ gtso bo sna tshogs rang grol/dbu mdzad grub pa kun 'dus/ rdza sna ba rin chen bzang po/ bla ma kun ra ba/ sman rtse blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bstan pa'i 'byung gnas sngags pa/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan rab byung /g.yas lnga pa mu khri btsan po/ khyab bdal lhun grub/ grags pa 'od zer/ 'khrul zhig sangs rgyas dban po/ zla ba grags pa/ kun bzang rdo rje sngags dkar/ dar lung mkhan ngag dbang chos grags/rgyal sras padma phrin las/ dge slong pad zhwa can/ mkhan chen rin chen shes rab/ so bla ma kun dga' lhun grub/g.yas drug par/ rta mgrin/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ mi tra dzo gi/ mgon po klu sgub/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ dngul chu thogs med/ thang stong rgyal po/ gtso bo bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje thor cog padma 'dzin pa gzan dang sgom thag khra bo/ zla ba grags pa/thugs sras zla ba rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras nyi zla rgyal mtshan/ nyi zla kloX sdungs/

g.yas bdun pa padma gsal/ sangs rgyas skyid/ mtshur za padma sgron/ sngags pa rin chen grags/ padma las 'brel rtsal/ gtso bo ngag dbang kun bzang rdo rje/ klong chen pa padma gling pa/ bstan 'dzin grags pag tshul khrims rdo rje bcas/g.yas brgyad par gsar pa thugs sras 'gyur med mchog grub dpal 'bar/ rig bdag spyan ras gzigs ngag dbang kun bzang rdo rje/ gter bdag gling pa/ bstan 'dzin legs pa don grub/ padma 'gyur med rgya mtsho/ bstan 'dzin grub mchog kun bzang phrin las rnam rgyal/ 'gyur med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gar dbang dpal ldan don grub bcas/g.yon dgu par snang mtha'/ kha sarsha ṇi/ u rgyan/ gsung sprul kun mkhyen tshul rdor/ bstan 'dzin srid zhi rnam rgyal/ gtso bo bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/ bskal bzang padma dbang phyug smin gling khri 'gyur med padma bstan 'dzin sogs so/ /yang sprul sku legs bshad phyag bris/ gu ru za hor ma/ mtshan brgyad/ thod phreng sde lnga rnams gtso bor byas pa dang / zangs mdog dpal ri bcas padma bka' thang zhal thang bco lnga pa la/ yul bkod/tshon mdangs/ mdog gser bris zhib cha 'gran bral/ bde chen chos 315

'khor yongs 'dzin sprul sku'i phyag bzhugs khams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis rjes stod lha bzo chos bkra la bzhengs su 'jug pa de dang yang 'dis lhag pa tsam mjal/yang gu ru mtshan brgyad zhal tshur gzigs dgu thang la/ 'khor si rgya mtsho ri mo zhib/ sku che/ de'ang legs bshad phyag bris phul gyur la tho blo bzang gis bris pa'i spang leb spar ma de las kyang lhag pa/ lhag par mtshan brgyad gos bris ha gser bris zhes pa 'di 'dra sngar ma mthong la mdzod gos sprin ris ma'i mtha' shan can mjal/yang dbang khang chos ra khang na shom rgyur legs bshad slob ma lha lung grwa pa zhig gis bris pa/ gu ru/ nyang / chos dbang / kun mkhyen/ padma gling pa/ tshul khrims rdo rje/ lnga pa rin po che/ gter bdag gling pa/ bee ro rnams gtso bor byas pa'i bka' thang dgu thang /hor gos bkra shis ma'am/ padma gsang lam ma padma rgya bya dang / rgyan // /la gyur gyis spras pa 'dom do pa dgu thang ngo mtshar phul gyur thugs chen mun sel sgron me/ bka' brgyad thugs kyi me long /tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng ba/ bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho/ bka' srung yongs rdzogs/ pad gling bla rgyud yongs rdzogs sogs thog sleb re mjal/316

yang thugs sras bstan 'dzin lnga pa'i phyag bris bka' brgyad zhal /dri /cu gcig 'dom gang lhag tshon gser gang la'ang 'gran bral thugs sras gzim khang me tog lhas nang / gser ljang brdung thub sku khri rgyab yol rgyan drug ma dang / dngul sku rdo je 'chang / dngul sku rdo rje sems dpa' sogs sku shin tu che legs pa nyi shu tsam/ thugs sras lnga pa'i phyag 'theb a rang byon can/ gsung sprul mdun klong chen dbu klad/ gu ru jo tse'i sku tshab gnyis las 'phros rten mang po yod pa rnams gsung sprul gsang yum gyis grong du chang gis myos te rtsad mi chod /ra bor nas da res ma mjal ba phyis nas gu ru lha khang nas mjal rgyal ba klong chen pa'i gza' khang mkhar thog lnga par/ 'gram na mkhas grub khyab brdal lhun grub gza' mkhar bcas hrul/ klong chen pa'i sku chas dpe cha/ na bza' sbas pa'i jig sgo do'i char ba steng nas mar brtsis pa'i thog gsum pa na yod/ gnyis mgon khang bgres pa'i nang / u rgyan/ klong chen pa/ pad gling bcas pa sku yod par 'then 'khor bzhag snod 'dra ba'i nang / kun ma' klong chen pa'i gter byon gnam lcags mgor rgya mdud/ rked pa lcags thur ring po/317

mjug tu chu srin kha nas phur pa bcas rtse khru gang lhag pad gling gi rdzong 'og sman mdo brag nas gter byon gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu mtho gang /rdo rje gling pas la yag stod skyer chu'i gsham nas brag sdig rwa 'dra ba nas spyan drangs pa gnam lcags rdo rje de 'dra rtse lnga/ spyi phu gter sto na bsam gtan gling pa'i dbu thod/ pad gling zhal slob mkhan tshul khrims dpal 'byor dbu thod aḥrang byon/ gsol mdzo rwa gcig pa'i rwa la a rang byon/ mkhan rgyal ba don grub gdung gzhug la phul ba'i rdo nag steng rdo dkar gyis 'bru gsum rang byon/ la yag chos rgyal nang so rgyal ba don grub gsol shan gsol snod shing spar/steng khang srog bdud mgon khang na kun mkhyen thun snod stod khro bo zhal gsum/ rked sgyug dong / mjug rtsig skud phon po sprel ma'i rnga dom can/ kun mkhyen shangs mtshal las gos ya sha dmar por bris/gza' thang khra hrig ge ba/ shing gi phur sgrom cha tshang yod/ lha lung par grwa drug cu re gnyis/ pad gling thugs chen/ tshe sgrub/ nor rgyam/kun bzang dgongs 'dus zhi khro/ bka' brgyad thugs me sogs dang smin gling dregs 'joms tshogs/ pad gling bstan srung skor bcas lha lung dgon lag yar 'brog yon po do/ yang lding / gdong skya/ mnye gnas lha khang / 'on nang dgon pa gnyis/ grwa nang a ṇi dgon 318

gnyis/ bum thang na padma gling sogs cha shas/ 'brug gang lding /gtsang na'ang cha shas yod par snang / lha lung g.yon gza' mkhar yod pa'i lung pa phur gu ru'i sgrub phug lha lung dpal rdor 'khrungs shul gyi cig hral sogs yod do/ /de nas yar ri sna tsam phyin pa'i sa na la yag gu ru lha khang /gter ston chos dbang rin po che'i gdan sa/ thang dkyil chu 'gram na lha khang / gsung sprul rin po che/ thugs sras rin po che bcas pa'i gzim chung can gyi ra ba'i dbus/ lha khang thog gsum pa'i 'og ma'i nang du garjo la ste zangs gser gyi mchod rten dbyibs nang chos dbang rin po che'i gter byon thub dbang rdo nag sku 'phags pa klu sgrub thugs dam o rgyan rin po ches chos rgyal la phyag rtags tshul du gnang ba yar lha sham por sbas pa khru gang tsam pa ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyag na lhung bzed kha rgyan 'dzugs pas tshe bum byas pa/ chos dbang gi gnam skas brag nas bzhes pa phur pa sru gris phur pa li ser/ gter tshab song bas mi skyod pa'i sku dbu med pa gcig gis dbu rgyan/ rigs bzhi'i dbu zhal dbu rgyan zhal gsum phyag drug lcags la rag gi chu srin can rdo rje rtse dgu pa khru gang / yang sras phur zhal gsum phyag drug de 'dra bcas dang / ba so'i lag pa tsandan dmar po'i yu ba can/ yu 319

ba dngul thum phyag gnang rdzas gu ru la khri srong gis phul ba bcas 'ben 'khor khang ba 'dra ba'i nang yod/ gu ru'i zhabs rjes gter byon/ gu ru chos dbang yum gyi spur rdo la 'bru gsum rang byon can/ gung thang la thog tu gu ru'i rdo la chang bu gnang ba/ chos dbang rin po che'i rdo la chang bu gnang ba/ klu mal gro gzi chen gyis rgyal po khri srong la phul ba gu ru rin po cher bla ma gsang 'dus zhu yon phul ba'i nya skyogs rdo byis mgo'i dbyibs 'dra ba/lha khang ka bzhi/ sbug tu gu ru rgya gar ma mi tshad dang / dbus lha sa jo bo'i sku tshad/ g.yon du rje btsun sgrol ma bcas mi tshad/ mi las rdo rje 'chang chen/ chos dbang nas bzhengs pa'i rnying rgyud padma bris ma pod drug cu tsam snang bas cha lhag dang rgyud mang bas gar yin ma shes/ bka' 'gyur snar thang spar ma 'bum cha shas/ chos dbang sku ngos bris/ nā ga raka/ lha khang mtsho steng du yod pas klu bdud kha gnon mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang phyi nang 'dom gang ba gsum bskor khang ka drug g.yas su gshin rje 'char kha nag po dang khro chu bris pa der chos dbang sku gdung yod/ dkar chag rnying pa yod/ de'i yar ngos na chos dbang chibs pa bya rog 'phur shes sras padma dbang chen sku gong ma tsā ri mtsho dkar nas nyin gcig la sleb pa'i gsob rgyang /320

bar khang na 'khor ba dong sprugs ngos bris gsar rnying 'dres/chos dbang li ser gu ru rgya gar ma 'dra ba'i dbu zhwa sha ba'i snyan zhu phud na dbu spa yod pa/ g.yas su thub sku sogs/ nang spug tu rdo la chos dbang rin po che'i zhabs rjes gnyis/ dkyil tshe bum 'dra ba/ gu ru mtshan brgyad 'jim sku mda' tshad/ chos dbang mdze bzhes ma/gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ shar ngos sras kyi sku gdung sa 'bum gsum/ nub ngos phyis bzhengs dbus chos dbang / g.yas sras padma dbang ོ/ g.yon jo mo padma sgron/ yang gdung rgyud gdung rten/steng khang na chos dbang gter rdzas sbas pa'i dor sems ba 'dam sku mi tshad/ dbus na lha sa'i gtsang po lho ngos 'gran bral bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs dkyil 'khor blos bslang jun gar gyis bshig shul khri sogs/ phur pa yang gsang dkyil 'khor bris pa mgon po srog bdud kyi rten/thog khang bla ma lha khang du kun bzang / rdor sems/ dga' rab/ 'jam dpal/ shrī seng / u rgyan padma/ mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag nyang ral pa dbu dkris chen po can gter sgrom gru bzhi 'dzin pa/ chos dbang / pad gling / rgod ldem/ smin gling gter chen bcas 'jim mi tshad/ lo 'i pu ri sngon po mchod rten brgya ri mo/2 /sa

༵ /nga bsrel can/ gos chen smug po rgya ris can nas khri la g.yog 'di nas gong chu khar brag sna rlung rtas thel ba de shing gi g.yag 'bags lha lung yod pa de chos dbang gis gter bzhes shul/'di nas yar rgyang tsam na lhas stag grong pa rgya ras gdan sa/de nas yar la yag stod du rgyang ring tsam phyin pas chu phar khar/skyes chu lha khang mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang rnam snang kun tu zhal lam kun rig thog slebs/ nye sras mi tshad bzhings sku drwa mig ma bcas gral bsgrigs pa chos rgyal dus kyi byin chen rnam snang phyag na pad gling dang chos dbang gang rung gis bod kyi mi min gyi bla rdo chen po mar rdo tsam phyag mi snad par bzhag pa ngo mtshar ba phyis kha gcig gis mar phab pas yul du sad ser byung / tshur rdor gyis slar bzhag par grags/de ga'i phar ngos grong nag dbus dril bu lha khang nang rdo rje gling pas bzhengs pa'i u rgyan rin po che mi tshad che 'jim dang / ngos bris rnying pa can lha khang byin chen snang la/ lag sbug nang so rgyal don pa'i pho brang gsham na/ thub pa nye sras yod pa snga mo'i lha khang zhig kyang yod/ gu ru'i lha khang thad der/ yang lha lung dgon lag lha khang zhig du rten kha shas sogs yod/322

de nas zhi phu la nas yar 'brog gdong skya phyogs nas rdza rong gyi rgyang mjal/ slar yang shar gnyal ngos su phyin pa'i sa lug 66pa'i tshes 20la/ gnyal go bsdus phag tshang gi gsham na mdo mkhar chos sde'i dgon lag da lta dge lugs pa 'dra bar song ba/ gter ston ratna gling pas bzhings pa'i ra 'bror dgon du grwa pa med/ li ma jo bo shin tu byin can/ phug tu li ma chen po kha shas dang / gser sku re zung /chos brtsegs 'thor po/ sgo khar rje tsong kha pa'i phyag mkhar yin zer ba'i shing sdong sogs yod/bka' brgyud dge lugs su 'gyur ba lhas steng dgon na/ bka' brgyud rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa'i li sku byin ldan/ bde mchog dang /rje rin po che byin can sogs yod/ /chu phar khar ha rdo dgon dang /dar ma gling yang 'dul gyi lha khang / chu tshur khar 'brug pa'i dgon chung sogs mang du yod kyang gnyal phyogs dbus la bltas na rten cher dkon/ de nas gnyal sde drug bla brang na/ 'du khang lhor bltas ka ba nyer lnga pa/ g.yas su thub dbang rgyab yol rgyan drug can thog slebs 'jim sku gser byug legs pa bka' 'gyur bcas/ sbug tu phyag rdor li ma mi tshad sogs li ma chen po nyi shu tsam/ sman bla'i pho brang sogs yod/ g.yon ngos rnying ma byang bdag sras ngag gi dbang po'i slob ma sha 323

gzugs pas bzhengs pa'i zangs gser mchod rten 'dom gong ba'i bder gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad/ dgon 'di mtsho sna pa chen pos bskyangs/ bka' gdams mon grab pa'ang sngar 'di nas byon/ grwa nor mkhan chos skyabs bzang po'ang 'dir byon pa yin/ thog khar li 'thor brgya tsam yod pa'i lha khang dang / de'i steng thub dbang gnas brtan mi tshad cung ma lang pa'i 'jim sku bcas/ rab gsal khar gangs ri bal yul bkras lhun sa skya sogs bris par/ mtsho sna ba mi tshad 'jim sku byin can zhwa ser chos gos phyag chos 'khor g.yas pad zla rdor dril/ g.yon glegs bam can/ chos ra dbus rdo dkar g.yung drung dga' 'khyil ris yod/gnyal lung sa chus gang bar grub chen lu ba pa tsā ri nas rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs/ lu ba sa zhug tu byon/ chu skam nas chos dar bar dgongs pa gtad pa yin zer/ 'og tu grub chen lwa ba sbrug ces steng ma sa spug bzo legs pa'i nang sku byin rlabs can khru gang lhag pa dang /mi tshad yod pa'i lha khang lam rim bla brgyud sogs yod pa dang med pa'i gong 'og gnyis/ thog khar sgrol ma nyer gcig ngos bris bla brgyud kha shas/ mtshan nyid mkhan zhabs kyis bzung sde drug bla brang bca' gas gang ba'i khang zhug gnas bcu mi tshad yod pa'i lha khang chen po bcas/324

chu par nar 'brug dre'u lhas gser gyi chos 'khor yod pa'i mchod rten lha khang can che tsam dang / sku gsung thugs rten mang tsam yod kyang da lta tsho ma zin nas dge lugs la mgo shor/ dge lugs pa spus dag kyang ma byung nas khyim btsun lta bur song ngo / /do 'bur steng lhun rtse rdzong shar nub yod/ gnyal 'di sa rgya che/lung pa pha ka ri khra bo maṇḍal spungs pa 'dra ba 'di chos rgyal ratna gling pa'i gter gnas gnyal gyi dge ri brag rtser gu ru'i sgrub phug chu mig brgya dang brgyad/ dur khrod brgya dang brgyad sogs yod par grags/smra'o cog pa'i dgon lag dbon po dgon chung yang yod/ de nas mar phyin pas lam khar brag steng mchod rten sngon po mgo med pa 'di dwags po rin po che'i yum gyi mchod rten/ de nas mar rgyang tsam na dwags po'i sku sogs dang bka' brgyud gong ma'i sku 'ga' zhig yod pa'i mchod khang / 'di'i kha tshad 'gram gyang hral de mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i sku 'khrungs khang yin zer/ gnyal phu mdar gyang hral stong phrag tsam yod pa lho mon gyi 'bum dmag lhag 'das pa yin skad/de nas lte'u rar chags lo chos rje dpal gyi sku gdung sa 'bum yod pa'i gtsug shing nags kyis bskor ba'i dgon chung yod/de nas gad pa skas mang du 'jogs pas gad pa'i nang mtshams 325

khang gsum legs skyid/ rtser spen rgyan can/ je tsong kha pa dbyar ngo bzhugs pa'i sa phug shin tu skyid/ klong rdor bla mas bzhengs pa'i rje'i sku dang / lam rim bla brgyud/ rje rin po che'i tsā ri bskor ba'i phyag mkhar sogs yod/de nas gser phye dgon dang gser phye 'bum pa/ zangs chen dgon na bka' gdams pa zangs chen pas btab/ gnyal sde drug dgon pa 'di tsho dge lugs pa'i nang na deng dus nyam dma'/ 'di nas mar gser phye'am gsal rje gangs la gu ru'i sgrub phug zhal gcig mtshams gnyal dbus/ byar g.yon/ lo re g.yas chu rim par 'dus pa'i rdo bod mtshams 'bri thang ko ro brag nas bod rdzogs nas klo la thug par snang ngo / /mo la zer ba 'di nas rje tsong kha pa byams pas zhal gzigs par grags/ padma las 'brel bdud mos bskul te bkrong ba'i sa yin/ de // la thur chen babs nas nags spang 'dres ma sa nyams skyid tsam de nas sa ngan pa nas cung brgyud byar skyid zhug tu slebs/gsham der gtsang pa rgya ras tsā ri nas 'dir byon nas phug pa skyid po gsungs pa'i sgrub phug na rdo leb la rgya ras zhabs rjes nyams mtshar 326

ba/ rgya ras sku nga 'dra ma yang bzo byas pa/ spyan ras gzigs/ gu ru rin po che 'jim mi tshad cung med pa sogs/ sgo khar a ṇi ma rnams kyi 'du khang gsar pa can 'brug chen dgon lag 'di na g.yon brag zhing skyong / g.yas sgrol ma/ rtser zangs mdog dpal ri dang / dag pa shel ri sogs tsā ri 'dra yod/ shug pa nags can/ stod na rtogs ldan rin po che shākya shrī'i chos skor ro/ /de nas mar ring du phyin pas lung rong dogs po pa nyam nga'i gnas su bye ma skya bo/ gtsang phag sdig pa/ stag srin rnams mang ba'i gdong sner/ 'brug kun mkhyen padma dkar pos klo yi kha gnon la btab pa'i byar gsang sngags chos gling dgon/ grub thob brgyad cu/mtshan brgyad sogs rdo sku spus dag gis bskor ba/ dang po 'brug chen rin mo che'i spro khang / de nas phar bla brang na/ sgrol ma lha khang ka ba bcu byas par sde dge'i bka' 'gyur spar ma/ rgyal ba byams pa/ thub dbang / rdor sems/ rnam rgyal ma/ tshe dpag med rnams zangs gser legs/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dngul sku/ yang zangs gser sku bcas mi tshad che/ 'di phal cher chab mdos mgar yang 'brug pa rig 'dzin kun gzigs chos snang sogs sku rab gnyis kyi mchod sdong gser dngul bkra ma shin tu spus dag 'dom pa gnyis/327

'dra zhal zangs gser sku tshad gnyis keḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i mchod sdong mda' tshad/ yang sgrol ljang zangs gser mi tshad/steng na nā ro pa'i thugs dam zhal 'bags yod pa'i dud sol ma'i mgon khang arga spo chog gis gzim khang rnying par spos pa/ /rdo skas gzar po la 'dzegs nas gtsug lag khang ka ba nyer lnga pa/ nang ka ring bzhi/ sbug tu dri gtsang khang na kun mkhyen padma dkar pos phyag bzos thub chen 'jim thog gsum pa gser byugagayas g.yon byams pa 'jam dbyangs mi tshad che tsam smin mtshams chu shel mdzod spu/ gtsang pa rgya ras rgal tshig las rang byon spyan ras gzigs bzhugs pa/ kha sar pa ṇi dang / rje btsun mi la nas 'bru che tsam re snar thang spar ma'i bka' 'gyur bcas/ padma dkar po'i sku zangs gser sku tshad sgros byin can/ rdo la pad ma dkar po'i zhabs rje'i mthil a rang byon/ rgya dngul rdo tshad re yod pa'i ting phor/maṇḍal sogs mchod rdzas bzang tsam/rdo ra khar lha khang na/ rdor sems yab yum/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ 'brug pa'i drag po kri la ya khyad mtshar mi tshad bcas bsgrags ye shes nas mjim gsar bzos/thog mgon khang mgon mang gtor ma'i rtse khra zangs gser can 328

yod/thog khar gzim khang skor dang / de nas grub brgya bla ma lha khang na/ padma dkar po la rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang mi tshad/ kun mkhyen skye phreng mi tshad bcu bzhi/ bar na sku 'dra drwa mig lta bu'i ngos bragagangs ri/nags mtsho bya/ ri dwags khang bzang sogs yul bkod sna tshogs/grub chen brgyad cu mtho gang ba re/ 'di rnams bsgrags lha bzo ye shes kyis mjim sku gsar bzo byas pa/yang de'i dbu rtser gu ru mtshan brgyad lha khang na/ mtshan brgyad/ zhi drag seng gsum bcas mi tshad che/ bar na brag ri/ me tog chu/ lung pa/ ri dwags/ nags tshal/ gcan gzan sogs mang ba'i yul bkod nang rje 'bangs nyer lnga mtho gang ba re/yang mar mi dwags po/ o rgyan rin po che mi tshad/ bde mchog zhal phyag rgyas pa mi tshad sogs dang/ li 'thor kha shas yod pa'i lha khang bcas/ grwa grangs bdun cu tsam/ tshes bcu/ bde mgon/ bla mchod/ mi 'khrugs sogs bston/ sngar bsgrigs yod/ da lta lhod/bla brang phyag rdzas bzang /g.yon lung gyen ded nags tshal nang nas lung ring ded/ chags la brgal nas ring du phyin pas dang por srang kha/ de nas ring /2 ༷gro

ba'i sgrol ma lung mdor dwags po nas tsā rir 'ong ba'i gong mo la'i 'dzom sum mdor/ gnyos mkhar chos gsum gyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten yin skad de'u 'bur/ de nas chos zam la tsā ri yul smad nas 'ong ba'i 'dzom/ tshugs khang na rgya ras phyag mkhar/ rdo la zhabs rjes/ rten dbu ra sogs yod/ 'di nas mar gser tog la nas dag pa shel ri mjal/ gzhung spang ljang snum po/ nags tshal shin tu sgro ba'i klung 'grim/ tsā ri'i rdo mtshan can tshugs khang na/ rdo'i ling ga chen po dang / skye gnas chen po/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thim pa'i shul chu dang bcas/ cug na bde mchog gser sku mi tshad yod pa dang /phag mo li ma sogs yod/de nas klu bdud pho brang zhes bskor bas rkang nad zhi ba'i brag tu rbal 'dra ba shing tshal dbus yod pa skud pa bres pa sogs yod/de nas mar rgyang tsam na aḥrang byon yod pa dang / de'i ltag dang 'og tsam lung mdo na dag pa shel ri'i dbu rtse mjal/ /de nas bskor chen sar ja chang tshul btang shul sba phub pa'i shing rwa sogs yod/ chung pha ka na thang skyid po de zhing skyong rta rwa yin zer/la dgu lung dgu brgal nas gzhung shin tu nyams spro bar sa lug zla ba7tshes4la gcig char phag mo lha khang du slebs/ thog na gser 330

g.yab mda' yab legs par bcas/ zur bzhi logs brgyad phag mo'i dkyil 'khor ltar bskor lam phyi nang gnyis/ sgo khar yangs tsam lha khang na kun mkhyen padma dkar pos bzhings pa'i zangs gser rdo rje phag mo mi tshad chen po bzhings pa tsam/ li ma rin po che sku rgyu sna tshogs las blugs pa zi khyim bzang rtse dang 'dra ba'i spus dag zhal ras shinatu ngo mtshar la dwags po rgyu pa/ lha rgya ri ba/ sde dge tshang sogs kyis phul ba'i mgul rgyan ga'u sogs mang / rgya gser stod g.yogs smad g.yogs/ byur phreng sogs yod/ g.yas su 'brug pa sku gong mas mtshur phu nas bzhengs pa'i zangs gser chargyan dkar shod mi tshad spus dag g.yon tu rgyal dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor zangs gser mi tshad/ g.yas su bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta'i mchod sdong zangs gser mda' tshad/ g.yon du maḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i gdung zangs gser/ gser kong sogs mchod rdzas mang ba bcas/'di nas chu rong na snga dro tsam chu phar kur mtsho dkar nag la brgal ba'i lam/ mar song na klo mi'i khyim 'dug pa/ de nas zhag gsum lam sa stong / de nas klo mon la thugagacig char phu nas sgrol ma lar phyin pas dang por phag mo'i sgo srung bzhi las nub sgo srung ba pha wang rgyal mtshan dkar po 'dzugs pa/331

gcig char chu mig nag mos khrus byas/ 'di nas chab che chung 'dzem/nags rong la chen rdza rdo mang po yod pa nas yar phyin/ chu 'di la chu kun bzang 'gro ba 'dren pa nyin re lan gsum 'bab skad/ pha rir grub thob sha wa ri thim skad pa'i brag nag po/ de nas lcags sbal rong zhes rgya ras kyis gnas sgo thog mar 'byed skabs lcags kyi sbal pa g.yag shad tsam gyis lam bkags pa'i steng rgya ras bro brdung ba'i zhabs rjes sku rjes mang ngo /yang g.yu sgrol ma'i rten rdo la chos 'byung chu skyes yar ring du 'dzegs pas chab dor sa/ yar 'dzegs pas rdor sems khrus mtsho ljang gu nas khrus byas/ gyen du brag rtsar grub thob lu ba pa'i zhabs rjes/ brag phug na tshugs khang / de nas rdza lam nas phyin pas pha wang zangs gser rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa 'dzul shul dang / bar do'i 'phrang lam bcas/ mkha' 'gro rdo'i snying po rdo pha wang chen po/ gong du sgrol ljang bla mtsho/ de'i gong du sgrol dkang bla mtsho/ phu g.yas gnas brten bcu drug dbus sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rdza ri la/ lam kha gyen gzar por 'dzegs pas sgrol ma la mgo'i la btsas gong ma nas g.yon du sgo srung gangs ri/ de nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i brag ri lnga/ klu rong du mi lhags thang nyams dga' ba/ phur rta mgrin chu 'phyar dang 332

brag ri/ sangs rgyas stong sku/ sgrug pa dwangs nas spug tu dag pa shel ri'i gangs ri gur phub pa 'dra ba/ g.yas su thabs rdo rje'i ri/g.yon du shes rab dril bu'i ri/ dbus su zung 'jug dbu ma'i ri/dag pa mkha' spyod kyi ri bzhi/ g.yas sha skam la/ stag ma la dang /pho zang g.yu mtsho yod phyogs bcas mjal/ 'di nas bskor ba gla ba btang / nged rang bskor ba 'gro khom ma byung bas phyir ldog phar tsam na bde mchog bla mtsho/ de nas 'og tu bdud mgon bla mtsho/ lu ba spug thad sngags srung bla mtsho rnams yod/slar gcig char du slebs/ tshugs gong ma de sne gdong 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis tsā ri'i bskor chen 'dzugs pa'i mchod khang du 'dra zhal mi tshad dang / rten rnying gser sku li ma kha shas/ gu ru o rgyan nor lha dang / rol rdor drag khros 'jim sku gsar bzhengs/ /de nas chu kha'i lha khang na rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i thugs dam phag mo li smug rtse khru gang khyad 'phags dang / zangs gser mchod sdong mda' tshad sogs sku kha shas/zam pa pha rir tsā rir thog mar bzhengs pa'i lha khang du/ kong po rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' stag rdo rjes thog mar bzhengs pa'i lha 333

khang gser 'bum can na/ tsā ri'i nang rten thub pa li ma mda' tshad khri rgyab yol bcas/ tsā rir rong bskor dus klo la mna' bzhag pa'i sku rgya ras gter byon/ rta mgrin dang / phyag rdor li smug mda' tshad re/ phag mo grub pa'i sku/ skyems rgyal pos bzhings pa'i gser zangs mchod rten mi tshad khyad mtshar/ bsgrags ye shes pas gsar bzhengs ༵ /na rin po che'i 'jim sku mi tshad/ yum ka bde chen rgyal mo sogs pha rir rnam rgyal lha khang / gyen ri ngos rdor 'dzin bzhugs sa 'brug kun mkhyen gzim khang du/ gcung ngag gi dbang po zangs gser mi tshad/ bde mchog li ma dang / zangs gser sku sum cu lhag rdo rje g.yu sgron ma shel gyi rnga bsnams pa'i zangs gser mi tshad chung byin ldan bcas/de nas sgrub sde lha khang legs po/ dbus gsar bzhengs chos longs sprul gsum 'jim mi tshad/ g.yon chos mgon thub chen zangs gser mi tshad sogs yod/ slar sngar lam nas phyin skyid brug phyogs su 'ong ngo / /yar lam gsang sngags chos gling du mdzod khang steng shod bzhi/ thog gzim chung mdo zhug gsum/ spro khang gzim chung gnyis sogs mjal/ khyad par rgyud sde'i zhal thang kong po lha bzo rnying pas 334

bris pa tshon mdangs can 'gran gyi do med gra tshar dang / kun mkhyen pad dkar rnam thar lha tshon gos gsum khyad 'phags mang po mjal/lo ro bkra shis mthong smon sogs na rten mang po yod tshul 'brug chen nas gsungs/ byar phu stag rtse grwa tshang la lha khang gsum/ zangs gser mi 'khrugs sku che tsam li ma sum cu tsam/ bka' gdams zhig gi shā/sa dam/ rdo nag po la rdo dkar sku rang byon legs pa sogs phu na g.yag mgo dgon du rdo la phyag stong spyan stong rang byon sogs yod/ de nas le yi phu/ sham po'i gangs rgyab yar 'brog brgyud/ gtsang la phyin pa'i zla ba 8 pa'i tshes 1 la yar 'brog rdza rong sgyi mjal/ rdza ri khra bo'i dbu rtser shar ngos kurma pa rang byung rdo rje'i sgrub khang / g.ya' khang / kurma'i zhabs rjes/ zhwa sde 'khrul zhig da lta 'di'i rdzu 'phrul phyag bris oṃ lhu rang byon/ rdza ri'i nub tu : rang byon/ 'gram du o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub phug rdo leb chen po'i 'og tu yod pa/ mtsho rgyal sgrub phug ltag ngos rdo 6rgyan rin po che'i bzhugs khri/ yar 'brog gzhung nas srin mo don pa phyag rdo gnang ste btul ba'i zhabs rjes 'dams bag tu 'dres bdeg tu song ba lta bu/ de gong yon po do la gzigs nas/ rdo la byams bzhugs sar zhabs rjes dang phyag 335

'khar rjes/ de nas gong du rdo thal mo kha sbyor sman gter sbas rjes/sman btul ba'i rdo gzhing 'dom do ba sogs mang / sman mo'i pho brang rdo las rang grub sku mkhar la btsas yod/ 'di nas shar sham po dang 'od de gung rgyal/ lho sku lha mkha' ri/ nub bsam gtan gang ba bzang po/ nub byang jo mo kha rag byang thang lha sogs gangs ri mang po/ bar na yar 'brog g.yu mtsho do drug lhag par yon po de dgon par/ gzim phugagu ru'i rdzu 'phrul phyag rjes khang chen tsam rgyang ring po nas mtsho la gsal ba bcas mjal/'di'i ri ngogs lha lung dgon lag se ngu dgon/ yar gdong skya dgon phu na rdza ri smug po'i 'gram/ zhwa sde dgon du sprul sku sman thang phyag bzo bka' brgyad phur cha legs pa sogs rten mang po yod skad/shing tsha dgon dkar po gling tshur dzon dgon/ chos lding / seng ge ri/ klong sdod rdzong dgon/ bde chen che chung gnyis/ ri bo brag na 'brug kun legs dgon/ byang na rtag lung rtse shod/ brag ra/ chos 'khor rtse/ bsam sding / rdza mchod/ mu tig shel gyi spa ma gong ni 'di'i byang ngos pha tshad na yod/ gsa' lung / sna dkar rtser rba mkhar chos sde/ gling rdzong na gling grwa tshang sogs mang ngo / 'di thams cad yod phyogs lung pa mthong / gsham du yang 'dul yin zer ba'i lha 336

khang nyams gsos byas par/ thub pa thog sleb byin can sogs yod/zhwa sde 'khrul zhig rin po che'i gdan sa gsar btab mdo sngags chos gling na/ gtsug lag khang ka ba bcu gnyis par/ chos longs sprul gsum sman 'dam thog tshad/ kun bzang yab yum/ zhug na jo bo zangs gser dang / gnas brtan brag ri ma bka' 'gyur sogs/steng na gzim chung khar/ ltag na yang ti nag po gsor gyi 'bru gcig pa'i mun khang dang / khra khang bcas/bo dong ring lugs 'dzin pa 'brog gang lding dgon du/ padma 'od na tsan dan gu ru byis pa lo brgyad tsam/ dngul gyi mchod rten mda' tshad ma brgyad/ tsan dkar slob dpon gtso 'khor/yang bo dong bla brgyud mi tshad brgyad yod pa'i lha khang / 'jigs med grags pa'i sku phrug dmar dbu zhwa can/ ma ne ring so can/ phyag cha rje tsong kha pa lta bu'o/ /ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po ni/ ras pa/ yar 'du khang rgya mthong khar nye sras brgyad tsan skug byis pa lo brgyad tsam pa dang thub pa drugayang lha khang gcig na tsan dan dmar por bskos pa gnas brtan bcu drug khru gang pa/ bde gshegs so lnga yod pa/ thub pa rgya gar shar li mda' gang lhag337
