yang lha khang gcig na tsan dan nye sras brgyad mda' tshad/yang gzim spug na gu ru mtshan brgyad tsan sku/ phyi 'khyams su bcu gcig zhal tsan dkar kha sar pa ṇi/ rgya gar li ma thub sku mda' tshad las che khyad 'phags/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ 'jam rdor/bde mchog dril bu lugs zhal phyag rgyas pa dang / lhan skyes/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang / dgyes rdor bcas tsan dan sku khyad par 'phags pa mda' tshad re/ 'di rnams sngar bla ma bo dong la bal po yam bu'i dbu bla skabs bzhengs par grags/nang rten la/ bo dong 'jigs bral sku ras chen dpal 'byor bzang pos phyag bzhings gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i bka' thabs rten/'jigs bral chen po'i snam sbyar kha tshang / rgya gar dur khrod klag me 'bar nas la li ta badzra'i thugs dam/ klu mjim bde mchog lha lnga zhal phyag rgyas pa mtshams kyi bum thod bcas mkhyid gang spus dag yar rje lkorgyan gling pa'i zab gter thub pa li ser zangs thang ma dang / bdud rtsi sman snod/ rdo'i sgrom bu/ de nyid 'dus pa'i phyag phyug nang bcug pa 'jigs med grags pa'i tsan sku/ padma gar dbang sprul sku'i phyag bzos paṇa chen li sku ser po khyad 'phags/ gzhung sprel zhing mi la phug gi rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku me rdugs/ chos rgyal mya ngan med pas 338

bzhengs pa'i thub sku li dmar gar bu/ sna dkar rtse'am nang rten rdo nag dzam lha/ shangs pa bsod nam mchog gyur dbu klad ring bsrel shel lta bu/ bo dong pa chen po'i 'bral spangs phag mo li ser bsam lding 'dzam gling chos sgron dbang mo'i 'bral spang nor lha khye'u'i gdong /bo dong pa padma gar dbang dbu thod thub sku dang / dung g.yas 'khyil rang byon can/ grub chen rnam rgyal dbu thod/ bzhan pa rdo rje'i dbu thod/ rin chen bzang po'i dbu thod/ 'dus chen rab rgyas dbu thod/ mdun dang rgyab dum la ma ho'i zhal rang byon can sku chos thod phreng / bstan 'dzin ngag dbang dpal bzang dbu thod dum cig spus dag 'gran bral/ grub thob 'dus chen rab rgyas nas tsā ri lan gsum bskor ba'i chibs g.yag tshem la yorgyan rin po che shin tu gsal ba dang /yang ring bsrel can/ 'dus chen po'i rdo yi chang bu/ gar dbang padma rig 'dzin dbu thod la 'bru gsum dang / rtsib ma la phag mo rang byon shin tu gsal ba/ rdo rje snying po'i chibs glang la tshogs bdag glang sna rang byon/ thang rgyal gsang yum chos kyi sgron ma'i thugs dam bde mchog dkar po bal bris dkyil thang / chos rgyal nam mkha' dkar po'i dbu zhwa spu ma/ sbyor ra thams cad mkhyen pa'i drwa phad/ 'chi med dpal bzang dbu zhwa/ pho brang g.yu mtsho'i rdo brag ri ma/ gzhan zhabs 339

lham sogs mang /bo dong bla khag bdun ni/ gnyal sbyor thams cad mkhyen pa/'gro mgon/ me sprul/ yer 'brog bsam lding rdo rje phag mo/ gangs lding ngam dga' ldan padma gar dbang ni ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po'i sprul brgyud do/ /gling grwa tshang du slob dpon rin po che'i sku gsung 'byon bzhugs/gling rdzong 'og nas rtse yi brag ri'i bar sa 'og gi lam yod zer/de nas gnas chen med kyang yar 'brog gi g.yu mtsho kha nas phyin pas stag lung grwa tshang zhol thar gling chos gter sa skya pa stag tshang lo tsā bas btab pa'i 'du khang ka ba nyi shu pa na bka' 'gyur cha gnyis/mkha' 'gro ma spun bdun gyi rdzu 'phrul gyis nyin re pod re bzhengs pa'i bskal bzang gser bris 'dom gang med tsam pa pod bcu bdun/gtsang khang du dus gsum sangs rgyas mi tshad zangs gser dang / sman bla mi tshad zangs gser/ nye sras brgyad 'jim sku mi tshad dang li 'thor chen po nyi shu tsam 'du khang du rdo rje gdan sa rdzong pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gter sku yin zer ba'i sgrol ma mda' tshad tsam byin can li ma/dbu rtser g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal gyis bsnams 'ong ba rdo nag la ma ṇi 'bru drug lam 'bras bla brgyud 'dam sku mda' tshad nyer 340

brgyad sogs yod/rtser rdo rje brag dgon stag lung na'ang rten lha khag bdun tsam yod zer/ 'di'i rwa rgyu la chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal bzhengs pa khrag mtsho bcas khyad 'phags mgon khang yod/ de nas byin pas kha ru la yi mjug nas mtsho gnyis bar/ bo dong bsam lding nyams dga' ba rgyang mjal/ de nas rdzar brgyud kha ru la brgal nas gnod sbyin gang ba //nga po'am ha'o gang bzang 'gram nyang stod du byang thang chen po'i gtsang ra lung du sleb par/ bla brang nang du thog mar mchod khang sku 'bag khams gsum zil gnon khang ka ba bcu gnyis su rgya ras sku 'bags rin chen khams gsum zil gnon khang mi tshad li dkar/zangs gser bzhugs khang lho 'brug gis phul gser gyi dbu rgyan/mchod kong / g.yas su gling rje ras pa g.yon reg pa med pa du ba'i mchod rten li ma/ de nas chos rje nga 'dra ma/ lho 'brug ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhal rgya dkar po can/ 'brug chen 'jigs med mi 'gyur/chos rje spos skya pa gzhon nu song ge/ gling chen g.yon nas tshe dpag med zangs gser/ kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor bu/ kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba 'brug kun legs bcas mi tshad/ bris ma 'bum cha dang 341

jag me sogs yod/thog gzim chung khrug can padma bde chen khyams ka ba bcu par/bka' brgyud gser phreng dngul sku rtse khru gang ba nyer brgyad/ li ma chen po mda' tshad bco lnga/ sgrol ma sogs lcags khra'i nang li ma mang /khyad par rnal 'byor chos g.yung dbu thod a rang byon can/ a wa cu ti tshe dbang nor bu'i ring bsrel las grub pa'i mchod rten la 'od dpag med dang / kha sarsha ṇi rang byon/ rdo leb chen po gangs ri dang seng ge sogs rang byon yod pa bcas 'brug pa gong mas bzhengs/bde mchog pho brang ka gnyis mar rgyal dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor gdung zangs gser mi tshad/ lcags khra'i nang zangs gser 'byung rim rdo ra pad 'dabs steng nā ro lugs bde mchog lha lnga'i blos bslang ba so'i mda' yab byi ru'i mchod lha g.yu dang mu men sogs 'gran bral yod kyang bgres/ bde mchog phyag bcu gnyis dngul sku mi tshad che 'gran bral spus dgagatsug lag nor bu sgang theg chen gling du thog shod lha khang brgyad kyi nang tshe dpag lha khang ka bzhi mar/ tshe dpag zhal mtho gsum pa g.yu yi rgyal ba rigs lnga can zangs gser/ g.yas su rgya ras mi tshad li ma/ spos skya ba zangs gser/ g.yon du thub sku li ma gsum/342

dwags po lha rje/ mi pham chos rgyan dang / ngag dbang chos rgyal bcas/ dpe pod stong tsam sku 'ching med/spug byams khang ka bzhi mar/ byams chen kun mkhyen pad dkar dgongs rdzogs gser zangs zhal mtho bzhi pa/ g.yas 'brug ngag dbang chos rgyal zangs gser mi tshad/ g.yon bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan de tsam/ bka' gdams mchod rten li ma 'dom gang ba gnyis//rshadī gser maṇḍal che la tshom bu so bdun ma/ gnam rgyan sogs g.yon du gdan sa zhes pa'i lha khang ka bzhi mar/ thub dbang // sleb zangs gser rgyab yol rgyan drug can gsum/ li ma chung chung sman lha khang ka gnyis mar sman bla zangs gser thog tshad/ thub pa li ma mda' tshad gang tsam pa bzhi bcas/ byams chen ka ring chen po bcu drug bcas/steng shar rab gsal ngos/ dbus su rgyal ba rgod tshang pa mi tshad che/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ mi pham chos rgyal bcas zangs gser thog sleb spus dag rgyal ba yong dgon pa/ 'ba' ra ba/ 6rgyan pa/ skyid dkar ba/ ne ring pa bcas zangs gser mi tshad/ rdo rje 'chang sogs 343

li ma nyi shus bskor/ rdor 'dzin chos mgon 'dam sku/ glang dar khrims phog spyan ras gzigs li ma mi tshad/ te lo/ na ro li ma mi tsam rdo rje 'chang bcas ka ba bcu gnyis pa'o/ /dbu rtse nub lha khang ka drug dbus/ rdo rje 'chang zangs gser mi tshad g.yu sogs spus dag dang / bka' brgyud gser phreng 'jim sku shing khri gos 'bol gos zla sogs yod pa nyer bzhi bcas/ 'bum gser chos brgyad stong sogs pod brgya tsam/bla brang thog byang ka bzhi mar/ bka' gdams gdung rten brgya tsam/ sgrol ma dkar ljang zangs gser mda' tshad che tsam/ li ma sna tshogs nyi shu tsam/shar ngos a ga ru'i ka ba yod pa'i lcags rwa mar/ li rag zangs gser sku sna tshogs nyis brgyar nye ba/ mi pham chos rgyal/ ngag dbang chos rgyal zangs gser mda' tshad/ rdo rje 'chang sku/ pad dkar bka' 'bum bcas/tshogs khang sbrug gtsang khang ka bzhi mar/ rgyal ba 'brug pa dpag bsam dbang pos srid skyong rta tshags ring la bzhengs pa'i rdor sems zangs khri rgyab yol bcas zhal mtho bde mo drug can/ mu men/ byi ru/ g.yu/ spos shol/ li dkar rigs lnga can/ 'di na ra ma'i mgo 344

rwa lung thog pa de dam 'byar yod/ tshogs khang ka ba bcu drug can/bka' 'gyur bcas/thog khar klu'i kha gnon phyag rdor mi tshad 'jim/ras ṭwāṃ/ nas gling ras gzim phug zer ba khang pa sdug po'i zhug gling mthu chen 'brug ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi mthu khang dmar po'am 'brug kun legs sras zhing skyong 'brug zhabs rjes chung ngu / nang du ka drug ma'i dbus su spos skya gzhon nu seng ge'i sa 'bum chen po thog gnyis pa/chu pha nar gling kha nang khang pa sdug por rgya ras gzim khang du rgya ras sku 'jim mda' tshad bcas/spos skya'i nang rten las/ nā ro pa'i phyag mkhar/ me rmi pa'i phyag lcag mi la'i chu shing mkhar ba bcas/ rje btsun mi la'i mu med zhal skyogs/ rgyal dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor gyis dmar nag rakta nas gter bzhes pa'i tshogs bdag glang sna li ser phyag bzhi byi ba'i gzhon pa can/ ngag dbang chos rgyal phyag rdor dril bcas/'brug chen dpag bsam dbang po stod la dwags chings 'dum la phebs skabs gdul bya'i rdzas kyis bzhengs nas zhig gso byas pa/ 5

mchod rten chen por logs rer lha khang brgyad re/ khyon bzhi bcu zhe bzhi pa 'di'i lho ngos su seng khri la 'dom bcu gsum dang rtse khru gang /sgo dang rdo skas de'i thog khang brtsegs nang rdor dbyings rnam snang dang rgyal ba rigs lnga / dpal rtse dbyings gsum/ sbyong dkyil bcu gcigardor sems dbugs dbyung / mtshan brjod sges rdor lugs kyi 'jam //sdo ye shes sems dpa'/ chos dbyings gsung dbang / rgyu gzhan/ rsha gyi/ lha khang thog khar 'gro ba'i rdo skas dkar chag las lha nub ngos shākya rakṣi ta'i man ngag las byung ba'i khro rgyal gzhan gyis mi thub/ tshe dpag med nyer bdun/ nub kyi khang brtsegs la rnam snang mngon byang gi rnam snang gtso bo sogs lha tshogs thams cad/ gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba/ thub pa nyer sras brgyad/ 'od zer can ma/ mi g.yo ba/ 'byung 'dul/ thub dbang rdor gdan/ ma tī 'dzam dkar/ dug sel ma/lho yi zur la 'phags ma khro gnyer can/ tshe dpag med zhe bdun/nyi gyang gi zur la/ 'jig rten kun gsor ma/ rnam rgyal ma zhe ga 3sdu/

khang brtsegs la/ gtso bo tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma dkar sngon/gdugs dkar/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra/ rma bya chen mo/ stong chen rabs 'byams/ bsil ba tshal/gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ sor 'brang / gza' yum bcas/zur la sher phyin ser mo/ tshe dpag bzhi bcu/ shar ngos zur la 'od zer can ma/ sgrol dkar drug cu re drugakhang brtsegs la/ gtso bo dam tshig gsum bkod/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi/ bcu gcig zhal/ padma gtsug tor sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i thub chen/ 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po/ don zhags/ kha san ṇi/ tshe dpag med dkar/ rgyal mtshan dpung rgyan/ sgrol ma yid nor/ stobs po che/ sher phyin ma/ 'jam dpal 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba/ mi g.yo blo 'phel/ phyag na rdo rje/ rnam 'joms/ rgyud rdo rje sa 'og gi gsang bdag phyag rdor zhi ba/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ lo gyon ma/ stobs po che/— /ra la/ gtso bo nor sbyin ma/ rnam rgyal ma bzhi/ sgrol dkar sum wa/'i gong skor na lho zur 'og tu/ gtso bo sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo/ tshe dpag med bcu bdun/ sgrol dkar nyer gnyis/ 347

de'i gong zur bum pa'i shar lho gnyis kur sgo gnyis pa'i nang /rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ khri srong / khri ral/ mi tra dzo ki/ tshe bdag zil gnon/ drag dmar bder 'dus/ rdo rje phur pa/ kha che paṇa chen/ bu shrī/ rtsa gsum/ dril sgrub tshe dpag med/ sing ha mu kha/ mkhas pa shrī bha dra/ nags kyi rin chen/ 'gro lding phyag rdor/tshe dpag med gsum/ sgrol dkar gnyis/ rnam rgyal ma gsum/ khros ma dag mo/khang brtsegs dbus/ gtso bo dus 'khor/ bde mchog nag po pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ bde mchog sbyang yon/ gdan bzhi'i ye shes mkha' 'gro mngon brjod 'bum pa'i he ru ka/ chos rgyal zla bzang /'jam dpal grags pa/ padma dkar po/ dus 'khor rgyal ba rigs drug dus 'khor/ khyung sna tshogs yum/ rdo rje shugs/ dus 'khor zhabs che chung / rdo rje gdan pa/ bu dol gnyis/ ra 'gro gnyis/sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sde lnga/zur lho nub gong mtshams/ sman bla gtso bo mched brgyad/ bde pa/gas so lnga/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas/ sgrol ljang / 'od dpag zur las 'og tu sa ṭa'i rdor sems gtso bo/ sgrol dkar drug 348

cu re gsum/nub lho zur nas steng la 'gro lam can gnyis/nub dbus su na ro'i lugs bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/gdan bzhi rnyogs med/ bde mchog rdor sems/ dril bu lhan skyes/sangs rgyas thod pa/ sgo mtshams phyed ma/ sha ba ri pa'i phag mo bden gnyis zhal/ 'dzam gling rgyan drug yon tan 'od/ shakyu 'od/ a bhā ya/ rdo rje ki ma sogs sangs rgyas mnyam spyor 'khor lo'i bsgyur drugaphag dkar shes rab gsal byed/nub byang zur/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ lung ston pa/ gnas bcu rgyal chen bcas/ tshe dpag med bco brgyad/ rnam rgyal brgyad/nub byang khang brtsegs zur 'og/ thugs chen kha saspa ṇi/ sgrol dkar nga lnga/nyer /byed zu/ra 'og gdugs dkar/ tshe dpag bcu gcigasgrol dkar de gong nub byang gcig/ byang dbus khang brtsegs/ dgyes rdor mtsho skyes lugs/ tshe dpag yab yum/ ma gcig grub rgyal/ tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil/ thugs chen padma drwa ba/ bde mchog sdom 'byung /rngog lugs rdo rje gur/ rigs lnga dgyes mdzad/ mkha' spyod/3sdudma

gar dbang / tshe dpag med/ rta mgrin/ kha sbyor rdor sems/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ mar mirwags gsum/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma/ ye shes dbang phyug rtsa ba'i mgon po lha mang phyag bzhi pa/ ye shes snying po/ mi g.yo bla med/byang shar 'og tu sna tshogs yum/ rnam rgyal nga lnga/bskorardo / shar steng du 'brug padma dkar po bka' brgyud bla mas shar stod zur steng sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas gsungs pa'i sgrol ma/sgrol dkar nga bzhi/gong ma ni byang zur dang gcigashar dbus/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lha so gnyis/ 'jam rdor/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed lugs gcig ras chung lugs gtum po/ phyag rdor 'khor lo chen po/ ind+ra bhu ti/ zla grags/ ye shes zhabs/ rin 'byung zhi ba/ zhi sbas sogs dang dgra nagagadong drug sogs/g.yas zur 'og mar sgrol ma nga lnga/ gtso bo yid 'khor/bum pa'i nang bcu gcig zhal zangs gser mi tshad che ba khyad du 'phags pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra can/ rgyab yol can/ slob 350

dpon li ma/ bka' gdams mchod rten/ 'brug lugs bla brgyud ngos bris legs/ sangs rgyas stong /bri nang dbus srog shing g.yogs gru bzhir rdo rje dang / phyogs bzhir glo 'bur re bcas bka' brgyud zung bzhi ya brgyad kyi gser phreng / zangs gser gser phreng dang gzungs chen sde lnga la 'bur dod kyi chos 'khor bcu gsum/ gdugs/ zar tshags bcas/ bum ldir la 'dom nyer lnga/ phyir thog so dgu/seng khri'i lho na rgyal chen bzhi/nub na phyag rdor/ tshangs pa/ brgya byin/ rlung lha/ phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyu skur nyer brgyad sogs dpal mgon bdun cu/byang na phyag bzhi pa sogs mgon mang chos srung yongs rdzogs/shar na rnam sras/ 'phrog ma sogs dang / gzhig rnams yod/dkar chag nang dngul srang nyi khri chig stong song zhes 'dug phyi rol rdo rwa la 'dom so gsum yod pa'i ra ba sgo bzhi skor khang bcas yod/ sa 'di la rtags brgyad rnams gnas yig las gsung pa ltar tshang /sa 'di'i mdun nas lung pa thur ded la song bas gu ru chos dbang gi gdan sa gtsang kha mo ba da lta nyang gi brgyud pa yin kyang zer ba'i sngags pa mi tshang du/ chu rdo sngo ljang la gu ru chos dbang gi zhabs 351

rjes dang / yang chu rdo nag po la zhabs gnyis ku'i zhabs rjes par tshe bum dbyibs yod pa/ tsan dan dkar po'i phur pa khru gang pa bzo legs pa gter byon dang / gsang rdzogs shog ser bla dpe mgo tshem chung bcas/ shod du ba btags pa'i rwa ba phug 'du khang rnying pa ka bzhi mar/ chos dbang gi sku/ gu ru'i sku sogs yod/ skye bdun dbu thod dum bcas/ 'di tshang gi nang rten chos dbang gter ma gu ru rin po che'i sku tshab gtsang rong na brgyud 'di las gyes pa thog po dgon zer ba'i khyim na yod par snang / ser khyim pa bcu bdun tsam yod/sgo bzhi'i pha ri ngos ri brag shar shur can der/ sngar phi ling dmag gi rjes dbyar kha zhig la dgon pa gser g.yab can chen po thams cad kyis mthong rgyu yod pa/ nang na song na ci'ang med pa/ tshu ri nas bltas na kun gyis mthong ba zla gsum bar byung song zer/de nas rgya brag zer ba'i dge dgon chung ngu / de nas sgo bzhi'i chu yi sbug tu dpal nying rje btsun ma yod pa'i btsun pa dgon pa/grub thob dmar gyi gdan sa nye bre 'o rog zer ba'i brag dgon du a ṇi kha shas yod pa der yig rnying bris ma pod lnga brgya tsam yod pa/ phal cher bris ma bka' 'gyur rgya che/ gter lung gi rdzo nas gter bzhes pa red ces zer bar ma sleb/352

de nas rgya che lung spug mkha' 'gro gsang zhug ces rig 'dzin rgod ldem phyi ma/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs kyis rtsa gsum dril sgrub bzhengs pa'i gter gnas/ de mthar sgrub chen padma bshes gnyen gyis btab/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med dpa' bos bskyang / padma badzra byon/ da lta lha ri gzim sbug pa sbas yul phrin las rin po che'i sras kun bzang gi bar gyi gdan sa o rgyan 'gro 'dren gling gi gong na gzim khang ser po na/ zhug tu brag phug nang / sgrol ma'i sku byin can gsung 'byon ma dang / 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs/ 6rgyan rin po che sogs yod pa'i lha khang / /de'i phar tsam bla ma lha khang ka dgu mar/ rdo rje 'chang la rnying ma'i bla rgyud/ rgod ldem mi tshad sogs bla sku drug cu re gsum tsam/yang tsan dan gyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gnas bcu brag ri ma/ 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis par/ sde dge'i bka' 'gyur/ rnying rgyud/ thub sku/ 6rgyan rin po che sogs rten/ 'jigs med dpa' bo'i sku dang gdung zangs gser/ padma bshes gnyen sku/ dngul gyi sku gdung /gzim khang phan tshan gnyis na/ gser zangs gu ru mtshan brgyad/ sku li ma sogs sku sna tshogs brgyad cu tsam/ dpe cha sna tshogs pod sum brgya tsam/ sde spar dge brtse'i bka' 'bum sogs yod/ grwa bcu drug353

thugs sgrub/ tshe bdag bka' brgyad/ phur pa sogs dar/ de'i rgyab lung phun tshogs gling phu der/ grub chen gling ras gzim sbug bzong gis brkos pa yod/chu pha rir legs grub grwa tshang zer ba'i dge lugs pa dang / chu tshur phyogs khang sar grwa tshang zer ba'i sa lugs pa'ang snang /de nas mar gling phu lung / ru lu sgang du dpal chen lha khang na/'bras ljongs sprul pa'i 'gyur med 'jigs bral bstan 'dzin dpa' pos smin gling gi dgon gsar rgyag brgyad grwa can/lo rgyus ni khra ring gzhi ku'i gsham tsam na da lta mi tshang skyo bo zhig jo bo mṛ ti dzñā nas lug rdzi mdzad de ma sdig rar skyes pa'i sgrib stong la bzhugs skabs/ bzo rig bsnyel i 'dug dgongs par 'khrungs yul zhes pa'i lung par 'jim legs po don par dpal chen po'i sku smad bzhings te rba bar mdzad/ nang par sku stod rang byon la phebs/'ja' 'od zug der nga la ye shes pa dngos su byon 'di 'dra khyad par 'phags pa yod kyang nged rang mtha' mi 'khyal por song bas bzhugs yul lha khang med dgongs pa la/ paṇḍi ta sems khral ma byed/ nga rang sdod sa nga rang tshol gsungs/ dpal chen po mi sprul/ yum ra la sprul te sdu/ mda' gnang / der dpal chen mi sprul dang / ra ma gnyis kyi

zhabs rjes gsal por yod/ de nas phyag mda'i sgra gling bu ltar ra rdzis tshol/ da lta dgon pa yod sa der mda' zug der slebs nas dpal chen yab yum sku dngos su gyur pa mda' tshad lhag pa li tshugs ma sku byin rlabs can dang / rgya gar nas a tsa ra zhig gis khyer 'ong bar grags pa'i rdo nag la rdo dkar 'bur ba'i ru lu 'bru brgyad byin can/'bras ljongs rgyal po'i nang rten la yag stod nas gu ru chos dbang gis bzhings pa'i bye ma a krong gu ru'i sku tshab rgyal mchog lnga pas gnang ba/ sna kṣiṃ li ser thub sku mda' tshad/ ratna gling pa'i gter phur bcas/ khra ring nang rten 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i bca' ka las/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i dbu zhwa rgyun bzhes jus dmar pad zhwa/lha btsun dbu zhwa/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i lha chen dbang sdud phyag kham/ mi 'gyur dpal sgron phyag ḍam/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i dbu zhwa/ chos rgyal khri srong phyag bris ma ra ti ma'i brag phug tu tshe dpag med bzhugs pa nyams mtshar/ nam mkha' 'jigs med gsol zhal shing gi rba ba mi 'dra ba las grub pa/ gter phug gnam lcags ra ma lugs phyag can/ shel khrus gyin gyis rdo rje rtse lnga/ mu tig sdong po ga dza dang / bse ru'i rwa co/ g.yas 'khyil snyim pa kha sbyor/ 'bras mo gshong du o rgyan thugs sprul mon pa khyi ra ba'i tshul thig kong zab long 355

zhes pa/ lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med la/ mi lus gcig la rgas gzhon drug bar bsgug pa yin ces gsungs nas o rgyan sku dus nas ma shi bar lha btsun bar bsgug nas/ gnas bdag po la 'phrod pa yin // //'a lus yal ba'i gri/ lha chen bla rdo khyad 'phags sogs chu phar kur sgo bzhi'i ri thang mi tshang de g.yu thog yon tan mgon po 'khrungs yul/ g.yu thog pa'i sman gzhong yod/de'i tshur ngos skyed lung ngam/ rked lung zhes par sgyu 'phrul yang khyed bla ma dang / sgro phug pa'i gdan sa yod kyang snga ma stong nas smin gling gi dgon gsar chung ngu snang /'di'i lung pa'i phu nas la don nas phyin na gtsang rong phung po ri bo che mda' na yod/ phu na gnub chen sgrub gnas g.yung gi rdza rgyud mo'i khar mtsho/ de na chos 'khor rgyal lha mo'i bla mtsho ltar mthong snang can yod zer/gnas rnying rgyab der a kye snang gsal 'od de 'bum 'khrungs pa/rgyal rtse'i stag lung pa de'i phur ri nag dpon sar bag la phyin yul bcas yod/ 'khrungs yul ltag gu rus nyang lung chus gang ba bskams te sa byin gyis brlabs/ gu ru'i bzhugs khri la kha nags yod zer//356

'bras yul zer ba'i thad der/ 'dre 'dul 'dzin 'khrungs yul dgon hral/ de'i 'og chu mig ces pa bu lugs dgon hral/de'i 'og der ba tshab bu bzhi'i nang gang pa she'u'i gdung rten 'di nyang chos 'byung du rin chen bzhi'i ya gyal du bshad pa hrul nas yod/rin chen bzhi ni/ sgros pa nas o rgyan rin po ches sbas pa/ gser gnya' shing / sham por g.yu rin po che sogs yin par grags/gnas rnying dri gtsang khang du/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i thub chen thog gnyis zangs gser/ kun dga' legs kyi yum gyi dgongs rdzogs thub dbang dang / g.yon du 'bre chen shes rab 'bar gyi nang rten thub dbang zangs gser thog po dang / sangs rgyas li ma mi tshad tsam bdun/ mchod rten phi ling dmag gis bshigs pa dang / phyi rol lha khang ka ba zhe lnga dang / gos sku chen mo gsum/ rwa lo'i thugs dam 'jam dbyangs li ma dang / rje dge 'dun grub par zhal gzigs sgrol dkar ngos bris gar gzigs ma mi tshad tshugs legs/ chos brtsigs pod lnga brgya tsam 'thor ba/'dir slob dpon padma'i dngos slob sngags 'chang rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba'i gdung rabs bzhi bcu/ de nas gnas rnying mkhan rabs bzhi bcu bcas brgyad cu byon pa yin/357

gnas rnying 'jam dpal gsang ba'i mgon khang gi zhug pa gdung 'jig ran la khad pa'i nang du mkhan chen bho rnyi sa twa'i gdung /'jam dpal gsang ba'i sku dmar gdung / phyam khyams sbug de nyang rang rtsis kyi dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku thog so can gcig 'jim/de'i nye sras brgyad nang du yod/ sngags 'chang 'jam dpal gsang ba dgung lo brgyad cu gya brgyad bzhugs pa'i sngags rgan rdo rje dang bhaddha 'dzin pa/ dbus su grub thob 'dar phyar phyag bzos padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa snum me re ba/ 'khor rnams bcas/ ri nag dpon po'i sras kun mkhyen blo gros 'phel/ g.yon sbug tu mkhas grub khyung po'i dngos slob la stod dkon mchog mkhar gyis bzhengs pa mgon po phyag drug pa dang / bee tri pa'i shang mtshal gyis bris pa'i mgon po phyag drug 'bur thang stag zhin bcas/se ra grwa tshang du phyag drug pa byin can dang rje yab sras sogs/dus 'khrugs la rtags bstan pa'i mchod rten nor bu bsam 'phel rdo sku'i ra ba bcas/ sned phul grwa tshang du/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam gso sbyang rten thub dbang rin po che dang /spyan ras gzigs li ma/ phyi gling dmag 'khrugs kyis gtor ba sku li ma che chung nyis brgya lhag bka' gdams gdung rten nyis brgya tsam 358

bcas/ dbu rtse'i gtsang khang der chos rje sa paṇa gyi thugs bskyed gsungs pa'i chos khri dang / 'bre chen shes rab 'bar dang / chos rin pa'i bzhugs khri'i shul/ dbus su rten garjo la khyad 'phags nang /thub dbang sku yol sku mched gsum gyis bzhengs pa 'dod sku li ma thog phyed gnyis khyad 'phags dang / 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan dgongs rdzogs dngul sku rdo rje 'chang mi tshad gsar du nyam gsos byas pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan dmar gdung kun dga' bde legs dngul gdung / phyag rdor gter ma/ rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba'i thugs dam spyan ras gzigs/ thang rgyal phyag bzo rnam thar nas byung ba'i tshe dpag med/ phyi 'khyams su 'bum cha bdun cu 'thor/thub sku bal bris thang ka che bcas yod/ rje rin po ches phar phyin grwa skor mdzad pa'i bzhugs khri bcas chos sde 'di phyi gling dmag gis gtor bas yid pham pa 'dug dar ma rin chen 'khrungs yul 'di nas so/ /de nas 'og de ru ri ngos nas gyen du 'dzegs te sgrub phug skas gzar la gyen du phyin pas da lta bkra shis lhun po'i mnga' ris dge slong zhig gi sprul sku bzhugs gnas byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi sgrub phug tu 'dra zhal dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mi tshad cung dī sdung

ba/ dge slong ma dpal mo'i 'dra zhal dang 'bum sogs dpe cha bcas/thog khar brag phug nang mgon khang / de'i tshu ri'i sgrub phug kha sogs su mi mi thar ba'i ngos gzar sgrub phug tu byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi sku chas tsho yod par grags/yang 'og tu a ṇi tshogs pa'i tshogs khang ka ba bzhir/ thub sku/zla ba rgyal mtshan/ spyan ras gzigs sogs yod pa bcas/'di nas mar mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gdan sa lcang ra zer ba grong par song/ dbus thub sku li ma byin can yod zer/de nas rgyang rtse dpal 'khor chos sde/ da lta grwa tshang khag bcu drug de bco lngar byas pa tshogs chen zhi gnas grwa tshang dge lugs dang /rin lding / gur pa/ gser khang bcas che/ 'phros bcas/ sngar grwa stong / deng sang brgyad brgya lhag sa bu dge gsum gyi rgyud sde bdun cu tham pa'i sgrub mchod/ de'ang dbang med lung med phyogs tsam 'tshogs/ phyi gling dmag gis nyams chags 'bring / dbus na tshogs khang chen mor sgo nub tu rgyal chen sde bzhi thog gnyis re sleb pa'i 'dam/ tshogs chen khang shin tu mtho ba ka ba bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ /lhor 'du khang ka ba drug pa'i dbus/ kun rig zangs gser gser srang bcu lhag song ba rgyab mtho bco lnga thog phyed gnyis pa/360

gzhan dar 'dam las rigs bzhi de tsam dang / 'khor mi tshad cung med pa'i nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ bskal bzang sems dpa' stong las shar du nyis brgya zhe dgu sogs ngos bris lho nub byang bcas de mtshungs/skor lam dang bcas pa'i gtsang khang ka brgyad ma/ dbus su byang chub chen mo gser srang brgyad cus bzhengs zhes zhal ngo mtho gang ba blugs ma 'dra ba'i spus dag ma/ phyi gling pas sta res bcom pa slar gsos pa rgyab yol la ga la shing brkos/ steng gser zangs mchod rten cha brgyad mda' tshad sangs rgyas so lnga sogs/ gser srang sum cus 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs mi tshad bcas so mar me mdzad dang byams pa gnyis/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi byang sems bcu drug mi tshad bcas 'dam sku/ mchod rdzas mang po bcas/byang na ka ba drug pa'i lha khang mthon po'i dbus/ klu sgrub lugs rtsa phyag zhe gnyis pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ yan lag phyag stong gyang la ri mo 'bur can/ g.yas su 'jam dbyangs/ mkhan po bho dhi sa twa/slob dpon rgya gar ma kā ma shī la/ a ti sha bcas/phyis chos rgyal dgongs rdzogs dbus su zangs gser mi tshad 'dab 'gyur las mtho ba'i byams pa chos 'khor ma/nang nas byang sgo de ded pas lha khang ka bzhi dbus zangs gser 361

mchod rten thog sleb mtho nges 'dom gsum pa chos rgyal yum gyi dgongs rdzogs/ bka' 'gyur gser bris pod re la rgyab ya byas pa/bris/ glegs shing sogs phul gyur cha gnyis phun tshogs bco brgyad mar gsal ba de ga 'di na nyang gter thugs chen 'gro 'dul chos dbang 'khor ba dong sprugs sogs ri mo snang /rgya skas chen po la sgo shub g.yas nas 'dzegs/ lho'i thog khar glo 'bur ka drug lam 'bras lha khang du/ lcags ra'i dbus rin po che zangs gser dngul byi ru tsan dan dkar dmar sogs bde mchog lū yi lugs blos bslang bzhi mig gang ba/ rdo rje 'chang / rdor sems/rdo rje snyems ma/ g.yas bdag med ma/ g.yon birlu pa sogs lam 'bras bla brgyud mi tshad bcu bdun/ ngos bris grub thob brgyad cu /sdu dī shin tu mtshar ba bal bris rnying pa sa skya'i gdung rabs sogs nub ngos lha khang ka brgyad mar/ dbus su dus 'khor sku gsung thugs rdzogs dkyil/ g.yas na mi bskyod gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed skyo lugs/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ rwa lugs 'jigs byed/gshed dmar/ gshin rje gdong drug sa phur bcas/ dus 'khor 'phros g.yon nas mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho lū yi pa/ rdo rje gur rigs bsdus 362

pa/ birlu'i lugs kye rdo rje/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gdan bzhi/sa ṭi/ mtshams su dkyil 'khor mang / 'di rnams shar thams cad lha mgo zhabs ldog pas yid cung mi bde ba ma gtogs bal bris tshon gser zhib cha/ thig cha tshad khyad par 'phags pa 'gran zla bral ba/bar mtshams su'ang lha'i dkyil 'khor mang / bka' 'gyur bstan /sprar spar ma/ gser sku mi tshad tsam pa dang / 'jim sku mi tshad kha byang du gnas brtan lha khang ka bzhi'i dbus su shākya seng ge/gnas brtan bcu drug sogs brag ri ma nyams mtshar/de nas sman gla mched brgyad 'dam sku mi tshad kyi lha khang bcas/gser gyi rgyal mtshan/ gser tog bcas so/ /de'i g.yas su mchod rten chen mo ni/ dpang leb zhad logs rer rmang seng khri nas 'dom nyer bdun/ gzungs sngags sna tshogs la bris pa/ gyen du 'dom lnga bcu nga gnyis/ thog so bco lnga mtho nges yod/ ngos re la dbus glo 'bur/ de las g.yas g.yon na 'bur gnyis/ de las nyag gnyis bcas zur bzhi logs brgyad la sgo'am skar khung lnga re byas pa rim pa dang po seng khri'am bang rim dang po/ de gong sum brtsegs bcas khyon nyi shu pa phyogs bzhi'i lha khang brgyad cu 363

las/ thog la 'gro ba'i sgo bzhi lha khang dngos dang / bang rim gong ma'i zur bzhi la lha khang re re la sgo gnyis re go chod pa dang / bang rim gnyis par zhal ras lha khang bzhi dang / bang rim bzhi pa la bzhi bcas lha khang drug cu re drug bum pa'i nang lha khang bzhi/ bre nang skar khung bzhi bcas brgyad/ gong de kun brtsis na lha khang brgyad cu/ chos 'khor phyogs bzhi la bzhi re bcas/ lha khang dgu bcu go drug bcas bsgrang chog pa'o/ /dang po seng khri'am bang rim dang po'i lho ngos su/thub chen thog so gnyis mtho bco lnga/ mchog zung mi tsam/ rgyab yol rgyan drugasman bla dang / mtshan legs mi tsam bcas/ (gcig)g.yas bskor gyis 'od zer can lha khang / (gnyis)'byung 'dul lha tshogs/(gsum)nub dang po rta mgrin lha khang / (bzhi)lo gyon lha khang / (lnga)'bur du bde ba can na tshe dpag med mtho bco lnga pa/ spyan ras gzigs phyag rdor/ 'jig rten dbang phyug nam snying bcas/ (drug)bzlog byed gdug dkar lha khang / (bdun)dag byed sme brtsegs khang /(brgyad)byang ngos mi g.yo ba/ (dgu)gza' yum khang /(bcu)'bur mar me mdzad thog gnyis/ byams pa 'jam dbyangs/ kun bzang / sgrib sel bcas/ (bcu gcig)nor rgyun ma'i lha khang / (bcu gnyis)stag zhon mgon khang / (bcu gsum)shar ngos stobs po che'i lha khang /(bcu 364

bzhi)rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan khang / (bcu lnga)'bur chen byams pa dga' ldan khang na byams chen thog gnyis/ tshe dpag med gnyis/sa snying / phyag rdor bcas/ (bcu drug)rnam sras khang / (bcu bdun)khang steng 'gro ba'i them skas khang du rgyal chen sde bzhi/ (bco brgyad)gur mgon khang / (bcu dgu )rnam rgyal lha khang / (nyi shu)de dag bya rgyud gtso che ba'o/ /bang rim gnyis par/ lho shar smra seng khang / (nyer gcig)spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi khang / (nyer gnyis)lho 'bur zhal ras lha khang /tshe dpag med lha khang / (nyer gsum)sgrol ma lha khang / (nyer bzhi)seng ge sgra khang / (nyer lnga)don zhags khang / (nyer drug)nub zhal ras lha khang / rta mgrin nag po/(nyer bdun )ku ru kulle khang / (nyer brgyad)'jam dbyangs rgyal po rol pa'i khang / (nyer dgu)rnam 'joms khang / (sum bcu)byang zhal ras lha khang / dri med lha khang /(so gcig)kun bzang lha khang / (so gnyis)phyag rdor 'gro bzang khang /(so gsum)shar 'bur chen zhal ras khang / mi 'khrugs lha khang /(so bzhi)sgo khang gzungs grwa lnga lha khang bcas/ (so lnga/)de dag bya spyod thun mang ngo /bang rim gsum par/ me ltar 'bar ba phra mo'i lha khang / 3//

drug)dpal mchog gi dkon mchog gsum gyi lha khang / (so bdun)'bur chen tshe dpag med thog gnyis pa/ padma'i rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi/ (so brgyad)rdor sems lha khang /(so dgu)me ltar 'bar ba'i khang / (bzhi bcu)byang sems rdo rje'i lha khang / (zhe gcig)'jam dpal ye shes sems pa'i zhal drug pa'i lha khang / (zhe gnyis)nub 'bur rin 'byung thog gnyis/ rin chen rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi bcas/ (zhe gsum)rnam par snang mdzad zhal bzhi pa'i lha khang /(zhe bzhi)shes rab phar phyin khang / (zhe lnga)'chi bdag 'joms pa'i lha khang / (zhe drug)ngan song stong ba'i lha khang / (zhe bdun)byang 'bur don yod grub pa thog gnyis pa la las kyi rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi bcas/ (zhe brgyad)kun rig khang / (zhe dgu)tshe dpag khang / (lnga bcu)rdo rje rtse mo sangs rgyas chos 'dzin rgyal po'i lha khang / (lnga gcig)sangs rgyas sna tshogs gzugs can khang / (lnga gnyis)shar 'bur mi bskyod pa thog gnyis rdo rje rigs kyi sems bzhi bcas/ (lnga gsum)sangs rgyas nyi ma khang /(lnga bzhi)thog khar 'gro ba'i sgo nang bder gshegs mchod rten brgyad sogs bcas/ (nga lnga/)de dag rnal 'byor rgyud gtso che ba'o/ /bang rim bzhi pa la/ shar ngos kyi byang shar nas sgra bsgyur lo paṇa 366

lha khang / (lnga drug)rig 'dzin lha khang gu ru mtshan brgyad can 'di jun gar skabs red kyang zer/ don du phyogs zhen can zhig gis rje yab sras khang du bsgyur ba 'bur bris thams cad sngar las zhan/ (lnga bdun)shar gyi 'bur chen zhal ras khang / mkhan brgyud khang / (lnga brgyad)sgo khang rnal 'byor rgyud mtshan brjod khro bcu khang / (lnga dgu)jo 'brom rngog sogs kyi lha khang / (drug cu)byang 'bur chen dbu khang /mkhyen rab dbang phyug bu ston sogs mkhyen rab lha khang /(re gcig)lam shā thus lha khang / (ri gnyis)rgyal sras dngul chu thogs med sogs sems dpa' lha khang / (re gsum)nub 'bur chen ras zhi byed lha khang (re gsum/)bka' brgyud lha khang dwags po rin po che ni u rgyan pad zhwa 'dra ba mnan pa byas snang / (re bzhi)rig ldan jo nang lha khang na dol po byin chags a lo dpal 'byor sgang li ma dang / naḥthog kun gzigs lha khang li ma de ngo ma 'dra ba snang / (re lnga)byang 'bur dbu khang chos rgyal lha khang / (re drug)bum pa'i nang shar rnam snang rgyab mtho nyi shu zangs gser can/ (re bdun)lho phyogs ma hā bho lha'i che chung 'dra lon la gnas brtan brag ri ma ngo mtshar ba/ (re brgyad)nub shākya seng ge/(re dgu)byang yum chen mo gtso 'khor bcas/ (bdun cu)bre nang srog shing shar gshed dmar birlu lugs/ lho ngos rwa lugs 367

'jigs byed/ nub ngos gsang 'dus 'phags lugs/ byang ngos ye shes zhabs lugs 'jam rdor/ shar phyag rdor 'khor chen sogs/lhor gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs/ nub gdong drug rgyud kyi 'jam dpal zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ byang dgra nag sogs/ (don gcig)chos 'khor nang du dbus su dus 'khor shar/ lhor kye rdor/ nub bde mchog nag po lugs/ byang bde mchog lū yi pa sogs/ (don gnyis)chos 'khor stod char/ rdo rje 'chang mi tshad zangs gser phul gyur gtso 'khor gsum/ rdor sems snyems ma bcas so/ /chos 'khor gser srang nyis brgya la sangs rgyas stong 'jam ris/ nang du sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i lha phal cher rgyud sde/ bla rgyud sogs tshon spang gnam sngon dang /li khri sogs me 'bar ba lta bu snga ma'i bal bris li tshugs las ha cang mdzes pa gtsang gi lha bzo 'gran zla bral ba dag gis bzhengs pas mig gi bdud rtsir snang / gsar gdugs la gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun/ 'od dpag med 'bur sku brgya rtsa/ lcags thag brgyad/ sku bris pa khri nyis stong dgu brgyad brgya drug cu re lnga yod ces bshad/bar bar du dkar chag rtsom phul gyur bris snang / zhal ras lha khang dang / bum pa'i sgo khyud yod pa bcas brtsis na lha khang brgyar 'gro ste i ki ltar don gsum/ steng zhal ras lha khang brgyad/ bre las lhag 368

phyogs kyis gzhal ba gsum dang / chos 'khor la bcu gnyis bcas dgu bcu go gsum/ nang gi srog shing gi sgrom bdun la sgo khyud bdun bcas so/ /de'i lho na lha khang ser po/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa thog so mthon po gnyis yod pa'i lha khang snang /bris pa khang du bka' 'gyur rgyal rtse them spang las rtag par bka' 'gyur re bris grwa tshugs yod do/ /de nas mar rtse chen na grwa tshang khag dgu yod kyang phyi gling dmag gis gtor ba gsothab kyang rten cher mjal du med/ sgrol ma'i lha khang /na chen yod do/ /'on kyang gnas rnying du yid skyo bas mjal ma song bkra shis bde'i gong der ri 'bur zhig gi steng dga' bzhi'i thang grub chen kun dga' blo gros sku dngul gdung pas g.yog pa'i sa 'bum yod pa/ tshe ring ma'i lha khang na 'dug go/ /ma dpal 'khor chos sde/ bu brtse chen/ lag ri khrod dga' ldan du grags so/ /rgyab ngos su rnying ma'i o rgyan sgrub gnas yin skad pa dur khrod can a ṇi dgon snang /pha ri phyogs nas mar cung song bas nyang stod skyid sbug 'gro sdu/na

gtsang pa rgya ras sgrub gnas 'brug bde chen chos 'khor dgon lag rten gsum dang lha khang gnyis tsam mo/ /khal kha dkar shod gang der/ zur lung dpal chen lha khang na zur chung shes rab grags pas bzhengs pa'i 'bras bu'i nye ru ka dpal chen yang dag zhal la mtho do yod pa thog sleb zhal gsum phyag drugagazungs phyi nas rkun mas bton yod 'dra yang snga mo'i bal bzos sku tshugs khyad mtshar byin rlabs che ba/ dpral ba'i thod dpang che/shangs gnyer pa ṭa 'khyil ba lta bu lnga 'bur la gnyer ris can/ rdo rje dgu brtsegs ma/ dom gyi dbang phyug khyo shug mnan pa/ yum mchan khung g.yon nas yod pa/ sbrul mi mgo sogs bzo legs pa/ khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug zhig la bzo rnying zhal ras legs pa 'di 'dra sngar ma mthong / g.yas su ko ri dkar mo zhig gsos pas sngon mor byas pa byis pa lo bcu drug tsam pa dang / g.yon du pra mo dmar mo de 'dra las gzhan zhig gsos yin zer gshegs gsol byas tshar 'dug man lung gu ru yin zer ba bla ma ral pa can chibs pa dmar po mnab pa zhig gi sku dang / rta phag gnyis de tsam re snang / sa ni shing kha shas dang spang yod pa nyams skyid snang /de'i ltag der ri ngos u rgyan sgrub phug la za hor ma'i sku rjes/370

'og tu sdig pa shan 'byed ces khams pas bar do'i 'phrang lam zer ba 'dzul sa yod/ de'i rgyab ngos nye ba na ro rkyang stod zer ba'i gu ru'i sgrub phug bsgrags yongs rdzogs dang cha 'dra ba'i ri'i khong seng na 'gro sa yod/ kha rgyun la lung pa 'dir dang por bsam yas chags par rtsom pa red zer ba nyang chos 'byung gi nang yod rab zer yang ma dran/lung phu 'dir/ sman lung mi bskyod rdo rje'i gdan sa deng seng cher gog ri khrod du sgrub pa kha shas yod par snang / gter ma'i phyogs kyi dpe cha mang po yod 'dugade nas par tshad na/ rdor brag sa kha'u grub chen chos dbyings rang grol gdan sa kha'u dga' ldan yod/de nas rgyang rtse'i dus 'khor grwa tshang gi 'du khang na/ byams pa nye sras gnas bcu brag ri ma/ byang du dus 'khor sku mi tshad can lha khang /phyag drug pa'i mgon khang / thog khar gnas brtan brag ri lha khang na snang bshags kyang yod/rab gsal na dus 'khor li sku yod pa sogs zha lu'i dgon lag da lta khyung sprul padma'i slob rgyud do/ /chu phar nar 'byong rtse lha btsun gdan sar grwa brgya lhag/ lha khang kha shas/ rten gsar pa mang tsam yod pa/ ri bo dge lugs pa bkra 371

shis lhun po'i dgon lag dang / gnas gsar thad kur/ nyang spos khang pa'i tshogs sar dang rten mang tsam mjal du yod na'ang sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig gi rkyen las ma sleb bo/ /khal kha'i lung mda' phar kur spug tu theg mchog gling sngar kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa byon/ phyis rgya rong bstan 'dzin sleb ste da lta mi rgan shā sa nā'i slob ma yin kyang 'gya 'gyur mang po byung bas de yang nyam/ tshogs chen 'dus pa sogs nyams chag che/gnas gsar mtha' 'dul yum chen mo'i lha khang du lha khang shing brtsegs kyis phul ba'i ka drug mar/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad mi bzhi rgyab sprod thog phyed gnyis/ mtha' skor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya lugs gos 'khyud nyams mtshar can thog mtho ngos/ sbug na yum chen mo bcas snang / yang rigs lnga lha khang du/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga gos 'khyud bsam yas ltar/ gos chen ris can thog so mtho ngos re dang / sgo srung khro bo king dang bcas snang /de nas mar mdo chung lung pa'i spug na zhag gcig phyin pa'i sar gu ru ye shes khyung grags gter gnas dkyil 'khor drag sgrub ces bsgrags yongs rdzong dang 'dra ba'i lung pa'i spug nas ri'i khong gseng du gnas shin tu khyad mtshar mjal rgyu yod 'dug de mdar ri bo 372

mdangs can dgon pa hral po dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi gdung rgyud dbon rgyud yod pa'i lung pa phur rje tsong kha pa'i sgrub gnas phug pa dang / khyim der rje tsong kha pas rab gnas thab ka bcas/pha rir rdo rje brag chu bzang ri khrod/smin gling dpal ri dgon/'brug pa khams grags dgon sogs yod/pha rir gtsang dga' ba gdong / blo gsal gling pa'i dgon lag dgon pa che ba grwa sum brgya tsam yod/ 'di nas spos dmar bzang po de bzo/ chags pa re la ṭa bcu re tsam byed/ /tshu ri nas mar phyin pas pad khang gi zhwa lu'i dgon dbus su chags pas zhwa lu/ mda' 'phangs pas gser khang / tshon rtsi khra bo bcas ming du chags pa'i zhwa lu mthil du/ gtsug lag khang rtsi sngon po/ thog ljang 'od thib pa'i g.yu thab can/ sgo khang du rnam sras phyi nang / thang mgon/ chos rgyal yab yum sogs 'chams sku/ khyad par ka gdong la las gshin dam can chos rgyal yum/ phung po ri bo che nas zhang khrom gyis gter ma srin mo'i wags pa las ma de byas pa gu rus gnub sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang ba gzhi rtse'i dam 'byar yin/ bu ston rin po che'i phyag bzos 'bags de'ang gzhis ka rtse'i dam 373

'byar/ 'du khang lho rgyud gtsang khang seng sgo ma bka' 'gyur lha khang ka bzhi mthon por rtse btsun gyis bzhengs pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas zangs gser mi tshad che li 'dra khri rgyab yol shing brkos ṇa drug shin tu mtshar ba/ 'jam dgag pakshis bskul/ bcom ral dbus pa blo gsal/ rgyang ro 'bum sogs kyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro lcogs bsgrigs par/ thar lo'i mdo phran bcu gsum sogs bsnan/ bu ston gyis bsgyur gsang 'dus gnyis med rnam rgyal bsnan nas zhwa lu sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs/ dzam bu chu gser ma'i bka' 'gyur gsum gyi nang cha gcig 'dir yod/ mi dbang pho lhas spar phud gcig phul ba bcas yod/mchod khang dbus ma dbu rtse lho mar grags pa gtsang khang g.yas ka drug shing brtsegs can na/ dge slong ma dpal mo'i sku chings nang du rten la bzhugs pa thugs chen rgyal ba rgya mtsho bzhengs sku mda' tshad ma sman 'jim las grub pa/ rdo rje gdan 'dra'i garnyo la dbu rtse mchod rten bcas pa 'dir/ bstan pa phyi dar thog ma la/ dbus gtsang mi bcu'i rgal/ smad 'dul mkhan po lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug drung / lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas chos bros kyi nye gnas mdzad/ me bya la rgyan gang bzhengs nas lo bcu gsum nas grub/ yos lor zhwa lu btab ste/ bla 374

ma rgyan gang bzhengs/ da bdag gi zur du dgos snyam bka' zhus pas lo ston gyis phyag mda' phog par lha khang bzhings par gnang / phyag mda' gser gyis bkang ste phul ba gtsang khang byang ma'i nang mchod rten yod par phog der mchod rten bzhengs pa yin/ de ltar bzhengs skabs thugs rje chen po 'di thog mar bzhengs/ 'dis gsung lan gsum byon pa'i dang po 'phags pa'i yul nas dri baṃ kā ra 'byon par 'gyur/ zhes lung bstan/ bar du lce btsun la/ rgya gar song /thugs rje chen po sangs rgyas dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshad gdan drongs shig gsungs pas/ lce btsun gyis/ mgo ba ye shes g.yung drung mkhan por bzhag rgya gar du a gi ya las bsnyen rdzogs bskyar/ dbus su bzhugs pa'i thugs rje chen po li ma kha sarsha ṇi 'di spyan 'dren skabs lha srung gi chu bo gaṅga las spyan ma drangs par zhag bdun du gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po thang gi sprul pa mon pa mi gnyis 'gyur yod pas drangs te mthar yal song / gsung gsum par byon pa ni/ gtsang chu lo hi ta'i 'gram nas/ thugs rje chen po byon/ ces lung bstan pa yin/de ltar rdo rje gdan nas drangs pa'i dbus su kha sarsha ṇi dang / de'i mdun dge bsnyen sdom 'bum gyis/ sprul pa'i ras rdo la nyin re bzhin 'o ma 'thor ba de rdo nag rdo dkar gyi kha sarsha ṇi rang byon mjal ba de 375

gnan drangs te g.yas ru gtsang 'gram lha khang du bzhugs pa/ zhwa lu dge bshes brtson 'grus kyis mar la gser chos bka' 'gyur 'bum sogs phul/ yar 'di drongs shig ces gsung byon ltar rgya gar kha sarsha ṇi'i mdun du bzhugs/ de'i mdun du jo bo smri tis rdo nag la rdo dkar can gyi kha sarsha ṇi bzhengs pa bzhugs/ 'di gsum sems dpa' sum brtsegs zhes grags/ g.yas su 'jam dbyangs li ma mda' tshad phyed gnyis tsam pa 'di gtsang pa bdun brgyud grwal chos rje 'jam dkar po'i nang rten/ g.yas su sku zhang mgon po dpal nang rten tshe dpag med gser zangs byis pa tsam/ gtso bo'i g.yon spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi mgo pa ye shes g.yung drung nang rten zangs gser/bu ston seng ge 'od kyi nang rten thub dbang gser sku/ kha che paṇa chen sku/ bcu gcig zhal sman sku dge slong ma dpal mo'i gdung bzhugs pa/ sman bla gser sku/ rdo rje 'chang mi tshad/ mi g.yo dkar po bcas pa/ mkhan chen g.yag par zhal gzigs pa sogs/gtsang khang g.yon ma dbu rtse byang ma'am rnying ma zhwa lu gser khang khra mor grags par/ dbus su rnam snang gangs can mtsho 'dam thog gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad 'dom phyed do pa/ khro bo rta mgrin chu mig zhwa lu gnyis 'khrugs skabs rta skad 'tsher ba/ bdud ji 376

'khyil pa bcas dang / g.yas su lo ston phyag mda' gser bkang yod pa'i mchod rten/ 'di la bal bris khyad mtshar 'ga' zhig snang /dbus su byang gling ri zur sku gdung / bum sgo me tog shing lo rgya bzos 'dra ba zangs gser thog phyed gnyis che legs snang /mchod khang sgo gsum mar/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyi nang rten thub sku bzhings skabs 'ja' zug pa sogs ltas mtshar po byung ba'i li sku zangs gser 'dom phyed do tsam khri rgyab yol dbus su pa ṭa ṇa drug shing bskos can de dang gnas brtan bcu drug zangs gser yod pa dang /g.yon du a mes chen po'i nang rten thub pa zangs gser sku gong gi de tsam li tshugs/ g.yas su kun mkhyen bu ston gyi phyi rten sa 'bum gser gsol ba gnyis/ thugs sras lo tsā ba sgra tshad rin chen rnam rgyal nang rten sa 'bum dang / 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan nang rten thub sku khri rgyab yol bcas zhal byang gzigs rdo rje rnam 'joms gser sku khri rgyab yol bcas mi tshad dang / gtsang pa bdun brgyud las zhwa lu legs pa rgyal mtshan sku gdung sa 'bum la pa ṭa me tog ri mo can/chos brtsegs 'thor po bcas/gtsug lag khang khyams nang skor lam kha phyir bltas la bal bris sangs rgyas stong / nang bstan skyes rabs brgya pa kerma pa rang byung rdo 377

rje'i bkod pa ltar dang / khyams ka ba sum cu so drug nang na mar me'i kong bu 'dom gang rtsam blugs ma legs po yod/bar khang du rtse btsun gyis bzhengs/ pha ri nas a ti shas rab gnas mdzad par ri ngos la rdo logs a rang byon yod pa 'thor ba'i nas 'bru yum chen mo'i zhal la me tog chags pa yin/ ka brgyad shing brtsegs can/ dbus su yum chen mo phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad/'og ma gnyis skyabs sbyin dang / utpal steng du pu ste bsnams pa dang /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya lugs gos 'khyud lhab lhub can/ sngon gyi sman sku gnyis rnying pa thog so re sleb pa/ ma gha dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod skor lam du bris pa bcas/thog khar gzhal yas lho la ka bzhi mar bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo'i dkyil 'khor dgu/ dpal mchog gi dkyil 'khor nga gcigabu ston zhal bkod gnas brtan lha khang ka brgyad/ thub dbang mi tshad gtso 'khor/ gnas brtan khri rgyab yol bcas yer pa rwa ba ma 'dra/ rgyab mthon po nas brag ri'i bskor ba'i bar sa stong chen po //ra/ /sa rje sa paṇa zhal gzigs 'jam dbyangs song chibs gtso gzhal yas dbus ma ka bzhir/ rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i rdo rje 378

dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu/ khams gsum rnam rgyal bzhi bcas zhi bzhi gzungs dkyil drug cu re dgu/ dbus su zhwa lu mkhan rin chen mchog grub 'dra zhal mi tshad/ gser gdung 'dom gang / zhwa lu pa 'jams dbyangs mtshan can gyi 'dra zhal mi tshad dang / mchod sdong mda' tshad sogs/gzhal yas byang la ka bzhi mar/ ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor bco lnga/ gtsug dgu'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis gsang ba nor bu thig le'i rgyud las dkyil 'khor sum cu so gcig sbyin bsreg thab dkyil drug bcas/gnas gsar pa mkhan chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis rab gnas mdzad pa sku zhang kun dga' don grub nas bzhengs pa'i tshe dpag lha khang du/ sa bha dra'i thugs dam rdo rje rtse lnga pa bzhugs pa/tshe dpag stong sku mchod khri drwa mig bcas sa las byas pa/gzhal yas shar mar/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod rnal 'byor rgyud lugs dkyil 'khor bcu gcig rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor nyer gsum/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal dkyil 'khor so bdun/ bu ston yab sras mi tshad tsam pa sogs dang / gtsug lag khang rgyab ngos rdo brtsigs la a ti sha'i phyag rjes bcas yod/379

grwa tshang khag bzhi la da lta sum brgya tsam yod/ rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor lnga bcu tsam gyi sgrub mchod yod pas/ de'i tho ni/ dus 'khor gcig sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ (gnyis)bde mchog bzhiyi pa/ (gsum)nag po pa/ (bzhi)dril bu pa/ (lnga)lha bcu gsum lwa ba pa'i lugs/(drug)sdom 'byung chu/ (bdun)ma hā ma ya/(brgyad)rdo rje gdan bzhi/ (dgu)padma drwa ba/ (bcu)sgrol ma rnal 'byor bu jo 'dres pa/(bcu gcig)gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ (bcu gnyis)'jam rdor/(bcu gsum)spyan ras gzigs/(bcu bzhi)phyag rdor 'khor chen/(bco lnga)'jigs byed 'khor phyag mtshan rwa lugs/(bcu drug)'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ (bcu bdun)dgra nag(bco brgyad)gdong drug(bcu dgu)gshed dmar lha lnga/(nyu shu)bcu sum ma(nyer gcig)bde chen ral gcig (nyer gnyis)de rnams bla med skor yin/rdo rje dbyings/ (nyer gsum)khams gsum rnam rgyal/ (nyer bzhi)rtse mo rigs bsdus/ (nyer lnga)dpal mchog rdor sems/ (nyer drug)kun rigs/ (nyer bdun)gtso dgu (nyer brgyad)'chi bdag 'joms pa/(nyer dgu)mi 'khrugs pa/ (sum bcu)'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung dbang / (so gcig)'jam dpal rigs bsdus/(so gnyis)bcas rnal 'byor rgyud do/ /380

spyod rgyud la rnam snang mngon byang / (so gsum)bya rgyud la/ gnas brtan phyag mchod/ (so bzhi)sman lha'i mdo chog (so lnga)gzungs grwa lnga/ (so drug)gdugs dkar/ (so bdun)gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ (so brgyad)gtsug tor dri med/ (so dgu)'od zer dri med/ (bzhi bcu)'chi med rnga sgra (zhe gcig)don yod zhags pa/ (zhe gnyis)phyag rdor 'gro bzang / (zhe gsum)rnam 'joms dkar po/ (zhe bzhi)nā ro mkha' spyod ma/ (zhe lnga)phyag rdor gos sngon /shā/ (zhe drug)rgyal chen rnam sras/ (zhe bdun)de rnams gsar sngags rnying ma'i bka' brgyad bder gshegs 'dus pa/ (zhe brgyad)na raka dong sprugs/(zhe dgu)'di sngon g.yung ston pa'i yig cha/deng sang tshad ldan med/ bla ma gsang 'dus kyi tshe sgrub gong khug ma bcas/(lnga cu tham pa)yod do/ /zhwa lu ri sbug sa skyid/ shing tshal dang rtswa spang kyang snang / mo khrims dam/ ri khrod dngos gtsang gi thog mar shar khang bu brtsegs pa jo bo a ta'i sha'i phyag btab satstsha bzhugs khang / de nas rdo gcal 'gram du jo bo rje'i sgrub chu dwangs la zhim pa/ khang steng du dbyar gnas lha khang ka ba bcu drug ma/ snang bshags mi tsam ngos bris ma/381

khang 'og tu a ti sha'i sgrub phug dam 'byar/ 'du khang sbug der/ bu ston gzim mal sku 'dra dbu thod ja ril kha tshang nang bzhugs can 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal dbyibs phyogs 'dra sku mi tshad ma'i mdun/ man lu'i gu ru'i mchod pa phul ba'i nang 'ja' sprin dpag bsam shing lta bur shar ba sogs byung ba'i li ting chen po bdun/ sku'i g.yon nas sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal/(gcig)bu ston skye ba 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/(gnyis)mkhan sangs rgyas dpal rin/zhugasum)gtsang ston chos grub dpal bzang /(lnga)mkhan chen rig 'dzin rgyal po/(bdun)mkhan mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug(bcu bzhi)bsod nams dbang po/(bco lnga)byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan bcas/ gtso g.yas lha sa'i jo bo'i sku tshad thub sku zangs gser/ byang chub mchod rten/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mchod rten bum sku can/ mkhan 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ (drug)zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po/(dgu) bsod nams rgyal mtshan/(bcu)tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ (bcu gsum)ka bzhi bla ma/ rnam rgyal mchod rten bcas/ sgo de na birlu pa'i dbang bum gzhis rtse'i dam 'byar ma/ dbus su li ma legs po kha shas/ ngos bris la rwa lo'i thugs dam bris ma phul du byung 382

ba'i 'jigs byed thang ka bcas/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge ra dang ba dang po/ /dge slong gang zhig rab byung gsungs/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa/ /zhes bu ston lung bstan ces bshad/dbu rtse dga' ldan yang rtse phyi nang gsum du li ma sna tshogs/lcags dru'i nang rgyal ba rigs lnga gra tshar sogs brgya tsam/ maṇḍal mchod rten rin chen phra rgyan can/ bu ston thugs dam dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bal li mda' gang gsor ljang brdung phra rgyan sogs khri rgyab yol la thugs dkyil lha tshogs bzhugs pa/ rdo rje shugs zangs gser de 'dra/ rnam snang thar lo'i thugs dam/ khri rgyab la rdor dbyings lha tshogs 'bur ba'i zangs gser/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od thugs dam gsang 'dus zangs gser lha tshogs khri rgyab yol la 'bur dod can/byams pa dang / thub sku legs po sogs dang / grwa tshang phyir yig rnying bka' rgya khang mig gcig yod/lho na sde srid gtsang pas btab pa'i rgyud sde'i sgrub mchod 'du khang ka ba sum cu/ nang sangs rgyas mdzad brgya dang / bu ston 'khrungs rab sogs bris pa/steng du mgon khang na rnam sras dang / rdo rje ri phug bstan ma bcas blo gsal bstan skyong gzim khang yang snang / 383

payo//nga gling gzim chung na gu ru'i sku tshab sogs rten rnams spus dag 'og tu chos khri thang dbus sde snod 'dzin stong tsam la bu ston nas chos gsungs pa'i khang mig gru bzhi rab gsal chen po can/ bu ston phyag nas nga 'dra ma'i sku ngos bris la/ zhwa ser can rje rin po che 'dra ba'i bu ston/ ral glegs tshab rdor dril can no/ /kha che sna nyag ces mtshan grags/ sdom gsum bla rgyud ngos bris sogs/ rtser zangs gser gser g.yab rgyal ba lnga pas phul ba/ 'og tu bu ston dgung lo drug cu re gsum la so phag byang chub mchod rten phyag khru re dgu/ zheng khru nyer gsum pa/ nang na mi 'khrugs stong gsum/ thub pa stong /gtsug dri'i sātstsha 'bum gsum/ sātstsha 'bum phrag phyi na thub pa stong /mi 'khrugs stong sogs/ rdo'i gdugs/ rdo'i tog can/ sku tshe brtan pa/ mya ngan med/ lha bab/ dbyed skum/ pad spungs/ cho 'phrul/byang chen/ rnam rgyal/ bdud 'dul/ dus 'khor mchod rten bcas/ chos dbang gter lung du/ ra zhes bya ba'i lung pa ru/ /bu zhes bya ba'i dge slong 'byung / /mchod rten rdo yi tog can 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa/ rdo'i tog 'di yin zer/ gtsang paṇa chen rin po che'i zangs gser gdugs sogs phul/ mdun mchod rten jo bo rje'i 384

phyag tsha dang / paṇa chung gsum gdung bcas/ gzhan 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ blo gsal bstan rgyan/ nor bzang rin po che sogs mkhan rab gdung mang / bu ston gdung zhugs la phul skabs ri logs khang brtsegs 'ja' 'od ma/ dpal ldan bla ma bsod rgyal ba'i yum gyi gdung sogs dang / mdun na lag bskor che tsam gyi rdo'i maṇḍal/ mkhar gong tshom bu can rdo yi ka bas btegs pa bzhi/ me tog snod rdo ra bzhi/ rdo gzhong bdun tshar chen po bdun sogs yod/'di dag rin po che bsod nams mchog grub gsungs las bsdus so/ /zhwa lu nas mar tsam lo ston gyis bzhengs pa'i rgyan gang mgon khang du/ rdo rje rab brtan ma shin tu byin chags zhi ma khro gtor sgrom 'dra ba'i nang yod/ steng khang du sangs rgyas thub dbang / nye sras mi tshad sman sku/ sgo khar chos rje sa skya parnyi ta bsnyen rdzogs bzhes skabs dbu skra 'khru snod rdo gzhong chus bkang ba yod/de nas sa lug zla dgu tshes lnga la bkra shis lhun por phyin te lha zhal 'jal ba la/ thog mar 'du khang chen mo'i rgya mthongs byang ngos/ rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa dang / shes rab seng ge'i dngul gdung mthong ba don ldan/ bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad 'dom gang ma/ u rgyan rgya gar ma spus dag gu ru chos dbang zhabs rjes bcas lha khang ka 385

bzhi/'du khang thog khar lcags dru'i nang li ma sna tshogs/ gser sku sogs lnga brgya re tsam yod 'dra ba'i lha khang phyi nang gsum nang / kha sarsha ṇi/ sgrol ma/ byams pa khyad 'phags bcas gtso bo/paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gdung sgo nas mar phyin pa'i sgo khyams ra ba'i shar ngos thog khar yang li ma dang gter ma sum brgya lhag bzhugs pa'i lha khang phyi nang gsum/bka' 'gyur lha khang ka ba bcu gnyis mar/ jo bo mi tshad sogs dang / bka' 'gyur klog skabs khel/gdung rten sgo khang g.yas g.yon du da lta'i paṇa chen rin po che 'di pas gsar bzhengs/ g.yon du paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan zhal ngo mtho gsum yod pa dang / g.yas su tshe dpag med zhal ngor mtho gsum yod pa'i zangs gser che legs re'i lha khang gnyis/'du khang sbug tu rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi thub chen bdud 'dul zangs gser rgyab mtho nyer lnga pa/ ga ldem gnyis/ tshe dpag med dang sman bla/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad bcas/g.yas su byams khang du/ byams chen khru nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i byams che/ /yas chen g.yon ldem gnyis/

gtsang khang g.yon sgrol ma'i lha khang du yid bzhin 'khor lo mtho bcu drug pa/ g.yas g.yon sgron sngo dkar gyi sman sku bcas/mgon khang du 'jigs byed dang phyag drug pa sogs dang / gos sku chen mo sogs gos sku bdun/'du khang ltag na bla brang rgyal mthon po yod/de'i g.yon du gser g.yab zangs gser spyad stobs po che mda' yab sogs yod pa'i nang phal thog lnga'am/ 'dom gsum rer thog so re byas pa'i thog gsum sleb ngos kyi blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dngul gdung chen mo/ mchod rdzas rtags brgyad sna bdun rdzas brgyad sogs rtse khru gang lhag re/ gser kong / dngul kong / maṇḍal/ ting phor sogs dang / mu tig gi 'phan/ gser bsgrim 'thag 'phan sogs mang /bla brang g.yas na sbug tu rje yab sras thog sleb 'dam/ gsar bzhengs rje rin po che bskum khru gang pa 'dam sku stong tsho/ rgya nag zangs gser rje mi tshad gsum/de nas blo bzang ye shes dngul gdung chen mo'i sgor/ g.yas su thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug mi tshad tsam zangs gser/ rgya nag zangs gser sgrol ma nyer gcig mi tshad/ 387

mtho ///na du 'jam dbyangs zhi khro gtso 'khor gsum 'dam sku thog so sbug tu dngul gdung chen mo blo bzang chos rgyan gyi dngul gdung dang cha 'dra ba las/ mchod rdzas sogs cung lhag snyam gser g.yab sogs 'dra/yang de'i g.yas su paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dngul gdung rten bstan par bcas pa gong dang 'dra ba las/ phyi skor shar ngos thog khar lha khang gser sku sna tshogs nyis brgya re tsam pa gsum/sbrug tu mgon khang bcas/ paṇa chen blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gdung rten gong dang 'dra/de'i g.yas su da lta paṇa chen rin po che 'di bas bzhengs pa'i byams khang chen mor/ rgyal ba byams pa longs sku skyil krung phyag g.yon ril ba/ g.yas chos 'chad can lha khang phal thog dgu/ 'dom gsum rer thog re byas na thog lnga/ 'og tu sgo chen thog pad gdan mtshams nang skor lam/ pad gdan steng mdun thad nas phar tshur la ka ba drug yod/ bar nas sku smad/ de nas thugs ma'i rab gsal/ de nas zhal ras lha khang la mchod pa bang rim steng me tog dkar yol dam 'be mi 'dra ba mang / zhal thad tsam nas skor lam nas bltas na ma gi ri 388

rong nas bltas nyams 'dra ba/ phrag g.yas g.yon steng mi bcu re tsam shong ba lta bu/ de nas dbu rgyan thad rab gsal/ de nas thad thog khar zangs gser gyi khang bzang gnyis/ rgyal mtshan gnyis/ gser tog sogs so/ /nang na g.yas gnyan chen thang lha lta bu'i gzhi bdagagayon du gsang bde 'jigs gsum ri mo bcas/ byams chen khru brgyad bcu pa ste 'dom nyi shu yod ces pa/ pad gdan la 'dom do yin pas zhal la 'dom do ste bzhugs pa la gong gi tshad de mar bskum pas khyon 'dom pa bcu gnyis pa 'dra/de'i g.yas ngos blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug sku gdung lha khang bcas gong ma rnams dang cha 'dra ba/ 'du khang sbug rdo ma mo'i drod tsha ba sogs nang rten dang / dge 'dun grub kyi sku chas mang po sogs phal cher phur byams dkar chags ltar ro/ /snar thang gi 'cham ra chen mo'i rdo gcal mtha' skor sangs rgyas stong sku rdo sku shing gi drwa mig bcas/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa lnga/ jo rngog 'brom gsum sogs/dbu rtse lha khang ka gnyis mar/ rten gtso rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i thugs dam sgrol ma dngul blugs khru gang / thub sku li ma mi tshad rgyab 389

yol ṇa drug can/ rigs lnga sogs li rnying sum cu tsam/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi 'dra cog shing las byas pa sogs/bla rgyud lha khang ka bzhi mar/ gdan sa bdun pa mchims nam mkha' grags pa'i sku/ snar thang mkhan rab so drug 'dra zhal khru gang pa lhag 'dam sku/ mchims kyi phyag dpe 'thor ba lcags smyug gis bris pa'i pod sum brgya tsam/khams gsum rnam rgyal lha khang ka drug mar/ 'od zer go cha'i thugs dam jo bo mi khrugs li ma mi tshad byams pa/ kha saca ṇi li ma mi tshad/ bstan 'gyur spar phud/ rnam rgyal mchod rten zangs gser 'dom gang / dpag bsam 'khri shing spar/(so gcig)tsong kha brgyad cu/(bco lnga)gnas brtan bcu drug (bdun)gser gling lha khang ka bzhi mar rten gtso thub dbang sems dpa' sum brtsegs khru gang lhag li ma sna tshogs lnga bcu tsam/ jo 'brom gnyis/ gser chos chen mo gcigakhri khang zhes dge 'dun khri 'tshogs sar grags pa ka ba brgya dang brgyad kyi sbrug gtsang khang du/ thub sku li dkar sogs mi tshad li ma bdun/ bkras lhun byams pa'i gzungs la pod bzhi stong / pod 'a/ra sum stong tsam/ bka' bstan 'gyur spar khri shog sum cu so ba 9/0

rgyan khang nub g.yas lha khang ka bzhi mar/ thub pa me rdugs/ lha mo hri brgya/ gter khro lung bco brgyad ma/rgyan khang byang du ka bzhi mar/ bstan 'gyur bris ma/ thub dbang chu rdugs ma/ dge 'dun khri yi gso sbyong rten thub pa li ma/dga' ldan lha khang ka drug mar/ rten gtso gnyan lo dar ma grags kyi thugs dam byams pa gsung 'byon mi tshad li ma phul gyur/ li sku sna tshogs che chung brgya tsam/ gdan sa brgyad pa skyo ston smon lam /rdzu /mas kyis rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag pa/ byang chub mchod rten nang rten la/ gnas brtan bcu drug thim pa'i gro ston bdud ji grags kyi gsol lder/ mkhan rabs zhabs lham la gnas brtan zhabs lham du btags pa/ dge bshes bya yul ba la sogs pa bka' gdams gong ma'i thugs dam bris thang dam 'byar/ mchims blo bzang grags thugs dam klu 'jim thub dbang / mdzad bcu 'bur dod klu sgrub phyag bzos/ yang klu sgrub phyag bzos thub dbang gtso 'khor gsum/bcom ldan rig ral tshems dngul ga ma/ mchims nam mkha' thugs dam mchod rten li ma dkyil 'khor blos bslang lta bu bum pa shel las byas pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ring bsrel dngul gyi snod shel sgo can/391

mchims 'jams dbyangs la rgya nag gong mas rten bcas phul ba'i g.yang ṭi'u'i lag pa ba so'i yu ba can/ skyo ston smon tshul gyi thugs dam rdo rje gur li ser/ dge bshes po to pa'i phyag mkhar chu srin kha spru'am mtsho glang rwa zhes mi 'dra ba ser po'i nang nag po'i thig le can 'brom ston phyag mkhar shel gyi dbyugs pa tshigs zhe gnyis shel gyi tog bcas/ rdo ston shes rab grags pa'i phyag mkhar tsan dan ba so sprad pa/ gdan sa dang po gtum ston blo gros grags sku ber dang zhabs chags ko ba'i lham he/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags sku 'gag ser po/ 'u yug brag kha ba dang / sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs lham ram lding ma ba'i zhabs lham ho/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon tshul zhabs lham lha/ mchims 'jam dpal dbyangs/ gdan sa dbu ma mkhan nyi ma rgyal mtshan zhabs lham ho/ li'i rdza rnga rang grags naḥ thog las cung chung ba gsung g.yas bskor pho skad g.yon bskor mo skad yin ces bshad do/ /'og khang na 'du khang sum stong lding gi ka drug mar thub dbang li ma mi tshad dang / sman bla mi tshad mchims kyi thugs dam/ 'phros zangs gser thub sku lnga tsam sgor khyams chen ni nyob kyis bkang /'du khang sbug dri gtsang khang du gnas bcu brag ri zhwa lu'i dang 392

)sbya dro gser bris bka' 'gyur/ khyams ka ba bco lnga mgon khang dga' ldan lha khang rgyab mchod rten dbu 'bur ba de gdan sa dang po gtum ston gdung yin/ de'i phyi rol du rdo ston shes rab grags pa zhes gdan sa gnyis pa'i gdung sa 'bum che/bde chen thar pa gling / thog mar gdan sa gsum pa zhang btsun rdo rje 'od zer sa 'bum/ de nas 'dom bdun pa'i dbus bkra shis sgo mang ni/ bang rim gnyis pa la byang du mchims blo bzang grags pa'i lha khang / shar thub dbang gnas brtan brag ri ma/ lhor yum chen mo phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / klu sgrub bcu gcig zhal/ nub sman bla mdo chog lha tshogs kha tshang pa ṭa ma seng khri 'og mar ngos rer lha khang gsum rer yod pa'i byang dbus bcom ldan 'das brag ri ma/ lha khang thams cad du sangs rgyas stong bgos nas ri mor yod pa'o/ /de nas nub tu phyin nas gdan sa bzhi pa gro ston bdud rtsi grags mchod sdong / de nas naḥdam pa'i spyod 'jug gsan yul lnga pa zhang tshe spong ba chos kyi bla ma/ de nas drug pa mnyam med sangs rgyas sgom par bcas pa'i sa 'bum/ bdun pa mchims 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' grags gdung dbu rtse g.yu rtsi ma/ de nas brgyad pa skyo ston smon lam 393

tshul khrims gdung rten/ dgu pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ de nas bcu pa grags pa brtson 'grus/ de nas bcu gcig pa grags pa shes rab bcas kyi gdung rnams yod/ thams cad 'dul ba rang skang gi lugs seng khri sogs med pa'i mchod rten bu ram gor mo lta bu'o/ /spar khang gi las grwa rnams nas skyabs 'gro bslab bya rta khyer byas nas gsung rten la rtsi 'jog chung / spar grum 'thor 'gro ba'i dogs pa snang / bkra shis lhun por byams chen la gzungs phul 'phros pod nyis stong tsam dpe bcigs sku chings med par thang mar brdal nas snang ba la/ rten gsar bzhengs pa legs kyang rten rnying zhabs tog dgos 'dug snyam/grwa nyis brgya ma long tsam/ chos spyod 'jigs byed sogs bkra shis lhun po'i cho ga dang / sman chog gnas mchod/ sgrol chog sogs btang /'chams 'dra ba'ang yod 'dug go/ /ngor dgon du thar rtse bla brang bka' 'gyur lha khang ka dgu mar/byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis bzhings pa'i thub dbang 'dam gser byugs mi tshad gtso 'khor gsum/ sde dge'i bka' 'gyur cha gnyis/ bstan 'gyur cha gnyis/ sa skya'i bka' 'bum/ ngor chen bka' 'bum/ zhu chen bka' 'bum sogs/g.yab chen ka ring gnyis sogs ka ba bcu drug par/ sa skya'i 394

bka' 'bum pod bco lnga/ bu ston bka' 'bum/ 'brug pad dkar bka' 'bum/ ye shes rgyal mtshan bka' 'bum/ rgyud sde kun btu/sgrub btus sogs dang / mkha' spyod ma dngul sku sogs sku 'dra brgya tsam/ rje bla ma blo gter zhabs la nged rang gis bzhengs rog zhabs zhu byas ba'i 'jam dbyangs rin rdor/ byams pa zangs gser spus ma thog sleb tsam mkhan chen rnam pa'i bzhugs khri gsum nang gcig lnga pa'i bzhugs khri red zer/gzim chung kun gzigs ka drug mar/ dbus su rje mkhyen brtse'i gdung wa ra zhabs drung nas bzhengs pa/ g.yas su 'jam dbyangs rin chen rdo rje'i gdung / g.yon du byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bcas pa'i gdung zangs gser mda' tshad re/ sku sna tshogs brgya tsam/rnam rgyal pho brang na/ rigs gsum mgon po/ kun rig gtso 'khor bcas mi tshad zangs gser sogs dang / rje mkhyen brtse'i bzhugs gnas dang / rten bzhag skor yod/rtse/ kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gzim chung shar rnam grol yang 395

dpe mdzod 'chi med dga' tshal/dpe mdzod theg chen gzim zhugabasam gtan yang rtse bcas thar rtse mkhan zhabs gzhung gis byang du gangs star sgor bum gter sped pa sogs deng sangs lde'u bsnams nas ma mjal lo/ /stag zhon mgon khang /du yo//zim chung shar lhun grub khang gsar na u rgyan sku sogs rten mang dgos 'byung tshom chen na nged rang bsdad/ dus rgyun grwa brgya tsam/ dgun chos la grwa sum brgya tsam/ zla ba bzhi par bla brang nas kye rdor man ngag lugs/ phan bdes gur/ khang sar tshang nas sasbya ṭa/ thar rtses bde mchog lū nag res mos/ klu lding nas gsang 'dus/ mi bskyod pa dang / 'jam rdor res mos/ zla ba brgyad pa'i nang gshed dmar/ tshe chog zla ba dang po'i nang kun rig sgrub mchod nyin brgyad/ dgu pa'i nang mi 'khrugs pa/ lo gzhug tu sde pa seng ge rtse pa dang / pa paṃ mam dpal spungs la drug cu re 'phen srol snang /kha gcig dbyar chos dgun chos kyi rim gro red kyang zer/bla brang gzhung du/ zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer lnga la lam 'bras dgun 396

chos dbu tshugs/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyi shu bzhi lnga nas sa skya'i mdos chen la ltad mo btang bas chos mtshams/ de nas zla ba dang po'i tshe bco brgyad tsam la grol ba yin/bla brang rten mjal ni/ 'du khang ka ba sum cu so bdun pa/dbus su ngor pa'i khri dmar nang du yod pa'i khri/ rje bla ma blo gter gyis bzhengs pa'i byams sku gsar pa thog cung ma slob tsam la dung g.yas 'khril che tsam gyis mgul rgyan can/gtsang khang ka bzhi mar/ dbus su ngor chen rang gis bzhengs pa'i thub chen yid bzhin nor bu zangs gser ga la bcas/ g.yon du de 'dra'i phyag na chos 'phags pa'i lhung bzed bzhugs pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mi tshad 'jim sku/ rgyab gral du dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub/ sangs rgyas seng ge rnams kyi zangs gser mchod sdong 'dom gang pa/ g.yon du nam mkha' dpal bzang dngul gdung 'dom gang / ngor chen shangs khrag gis bris pa'i zhal steng mgon po gur sku yod pa'i logs bris yod par grags/ lam 'bras maṇḍal shing tsan dan can/rdo gcal lha khang bde mchog lu yi pa/ kye rdor sogs tā ming sku spus dag kha shas dang / thub pa chu lon ma li rnying khyad 'phags bde 397

mchog bla brgyud bal sku tshar gnyis/ lam 'bras bla brgyud tshar gnyis bcas sku dngos gtsang sum brgya tsam/ bka' gdams gdung rten sogs/ lha khang gcig na bka' 'gyur bris ma/bla brang thog lam 'bras lha khang ka drug na/ ngor chen nga 'dra ma/ mus chen bar ngor chen sku dus kyi lam 'bras bla brgyud tshar gcigade min mkhan rab rnams khru gang / mda' gang / mi tshad sogs/'byor pa ltar khri phyag ṭal sogs mchod rdzas bcas cha tshang /gser sku lha khang ka gnyis na/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub sku mdun du birlu pa'i gser sku spus dag li rag zangs gser sna tshogs kyi sku nyis brgya tsam/spar khang thog dngul gdung lha khang du/ dpal ldan chos skyong byams chen zangs gser thog sleb sprul sku/ g.yon nas ngor chen nang rten dngul gdung thog sleb/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ sgrub khang dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen bkra shis rgya mtsho/ ngo mi shes pa gcig sangs rgyas phun tshogs bcas thog ma sleb tsam/ byams pa nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ byams bsod nams dpal 'byor gdung chung gnyis/ dpal ldan chos skyong dngul gdung phra rgyan phun sum tshogs pa gnyis/ byams pa dpal ldan bzang po'i gdung / phan khang dpal 398

ldan blo gros rgyal mtshan/ khang sar ngag dbang kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bcas kyi gdung / g.yas klu lding zhabs drung ga / maṅga rgyal mtshan/ ngor dbon dkon mchog dpal ldan/ rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan bcas kyi dngul gdung / ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po'i dngul gdung / mdun du ngor chen thugs dam dngul sku rdo rje 'chang sogs sku 'thor mang tsam/phyi khyams ngos su ngor chen la blo bo rgyal pos phul ba'i gser gyi bka' 'gyur/bar khang du dpal ldan chos skyong gis bzhengs pa'i kye rdor blos bslang bgres pa 'khor lha mo dgu pa so mkhyid gang ba/ gtso bo tsan dan 'dra/ ngor chen dang / dpal ldan chos skyong na bza' rten sgom gnyis/ sku li ma sna tshogs zangs gser sogs lnga bcu tsam/rtser gsang sngags pho brang du/ ka ba drug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog grags pa/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rgyal ba kun dga' rgya mtsho bcas 'jim sku mi tshad lnga / thugs dam sgrol ma de tsam/ snar thang bka' 'gyur spar/ sde dge'i bstan 'gyur/ sa skya'i bka' 'bum/ sgrol dkar rgyun 'dzugs/ zhing khams rgya mtsho ka bzhi mar/ rten li ma brgya lhag byaX9 9

sems chos 'phags chegros/ a gnyan dam pa'i thugs dam rdo nag gur mgon/ bde mchog bal bris legs pa sogs/g.yan chen ka ba bcu drug pa'i spug tu/ thub sku li ma mi tshad mtsher chen rong gi sa nas gter ma lta bu yin zer/ dpal ldan chos skyong yum gyi sgrib sbyong kun rig rtsa lha sku sna tshogs lnga bcu tsam/ sde dge'i spar phud bka' 'gyur/ dpe sna tshogs 'di rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang dbyar chos gnang sa/sbrug tu gzim chung nang / dkon mchog lhun grub sku che tsam/lam 'bras bla brgyud mtho gang tsam dang / bal bris mgon thang legs po bcas/'og tu dbang khang ka bzhir/ phyag dpe pod brgya lhag dmag zor ma/ nang du gsang mgon zhal khra/ gur mgon rlung zhin ma yod/ 'di'i gter sgam du hor po'i bsgral chas lcags gser can phul snang / 'og tu asgo steng dmag zor rten mdung der rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bris/ khri steng nas mi nyer lnga rer nam tho rangs la mkhan po las thog pas kye rdor bsgrigs dbang 'di nas gnang zer/ zhug lam zab mdzod nag tu rgya dpe dang / phyag dpe yod/ rgya dpe 'thor 'gro skabs yin/ bya nag 'phrul bzo zangs dngul bkra ma'i dkyil 400

'khor lte bsgyur bzhi/ rje btsun grags pa tsu ris ma nang rten rje btsun grags pa'i phyag bris lam 'bras pod sor phyed tsam rgya nag sgam bu nang yod/ lam 'bras bla brgyud bal li cha gnyis/ gtso bo rdo rje chos mda' gang rwa lo'i thugs dam rdo rje 'jigs byed li dmar mtho gang /'di'i sbug na rje btsun grags pa'i sgom thag sgom dbyug sogs byi/ mdzod bka' rgya/ dbang khang zhug tu ngor chen gsol thab khang phyi khyams jig shar mgon khang bcas/ u rgyan rin po che'i sku gsum tsam las ma mjal/ dgon pa'i 'og der ngor chen gdung thal bzhugs pa dang / gsar bzhengs sogs thog gsum re yod pa dang /gdung chen rdza la ri mo btod cing me la bsregs pa sbyar/ chos 'khor rdza bzos la can/ zar tshags zangs gser yod pa'i mchod rten bcu drug tsam gral bsgrigs nas yod/ lar ngor 'di lung pa zhig gi phur rtsag ser sngo skya sogs gad shar mang po yod pa rgyang nas bltas na nyams sdug po yod kyang nang du slob na nyams skyid/ khyad par mdun ri dpa' bo ri spang cung zad yod pa thar rtse'i rtse nas bltas na nyams skyid bde ba lta bu yod/ thar rtse'i 'og tu phan khang / bla brang 'og tu zangs gser rgyal mtshan gnyis can khang sar dang klu lding tshang yin/ spyir da 401

lta ngor pa'i bsgrigs cung nyams/ khyad par grwa nyung / grwa rgyun rnams spyod pa cing bas phyogs kyi mi sde rnams mi dga'/ bla brang rnams kyang kha mchu 'dras zing zing por snang ngo / /'di nas lhor song na mus dang / srad kyi sa cha yod/ nub tu 'ong na chags chags la dang / zhang zhang la dang / a gro la gsum brgal bas sa skyar sleb/ bar 'dir seng ge rtse hral gdang / bkra shis lhun po'i dgon lag lhun po rtse dang / tsha rong ltag der sman khang /sman bla mched brgyad mi tshad tsam dang / bka' 'gyur tsan sku cha shas sogs yod/ a gro la nas mthong ba'i phu 'bras ljongs spun bdun ri deng rir 'gro lam red zer/ ri mgo so rdza lta bu gangs 'dres pa lang mkhar mu gu lung gi ri rtser sa skya nas mdun ri zer/ sa skya'i lung pa 'di'i phur bya 'gyur rje btsun grags pa'i gzim phug dang / kha'u brag rdzong dag po sogs yod/sa lug zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga la dpal sa skya'i grub dgon sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo mjal te/ thog mar/ sgo shub khro chen bdud ji 'khyil pa dang / rta mgrin thog sleb yod pa/ de nas rgyal chen sde bzhi thog gnyis yod pa/ de nas rdo gcal chen mo lha khang spyir ka ba brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ rgya mthongs ka ba bcu drug seng ge sha stag 402

gis brgyan pa/ lung chen ltar khyen yangs pa'i nub sgo chen gnyis pa'i gtsang khang lho nas nag po khrag 'dzag gam 'khun shas dang / bse chen ka ba gnyis/ 'brang so ka ba/ stag so ka ba bcas ka ba ming chen bzhi sogs mdun nas yod/ rgyab ngos mun rum du spen ma'i ka ba/ 'jag ma'i ka ba zer ba thang shing lta bu sogs dang / bar na lha khang grwa tshang bzhugs grwal rnams yod/ rten dngos snar thang spar bka' bstan cha/ rje btsun bstan pa'i nyi ma'i mkha' spyod mi tshad zangs gser/rmor drung tshe lha rnam gsum 'jam dbyangs bcas mi tshad zangs gser/ se ra zhabs pad mchod sdong 'dom gang / 'dzam gling chos sku dbang sdud gdung rten 'dom gsum gsar bzhings legs/ kun dga' bsod nams zangs gser sku/ de'i gdung rten chen mo legs/ bkra shis rtse'i rje btsun gyis rdor sems sku zangs gser thog sleb/ snying ri kun bsod rgyal yum gyi rje btsun sgrol ma mi tshad ma rgyan phun sum tshogs pa bkra shis rtse'i rje btsun gyi nā ro mkha' spyod/ dbang sdud snying po'i u rgyan mi tshad lhag gtso 'khor gsum lung bstan gnang skabs/ nga mi rgan pos nyan tshod med ces pas u rgyan rin po che dgongs pa 'tshoms pa'i gzugs/ rmor drung gi rnam rgyal/ sgrol dkar gnyis zangs gser 'dom gang lhag re/ khri chen bzhugs khri 403

gsum/ dbang sdud snying po/ kun blo/ go ram/ ngag chos/ kun blo'i 'dra zhal gnyis bcas mi tshad dang / sngags 'chang chen mo'i dngul sku mi tshad/ sgo pad rje btsun gyis nā ro mkha' spyod rmor drung gshegs rdzong mkha' spyod ma'i rgyan rnams rje btsun rang gi ga'u g.yu byur mu tig yin pas shin tu legs/ rje phyogs gling gis 'jam dbyangs mi tshad/ gdung chung nang brtse'i rje btsun mas mkha' spyod ma'i rgyan legs/ dbang bsdud 'dra zhal/ bkra shis brtses yab kun rgyal rdo rje 'chang mi tshad zangs gser/ rdo rje phur pa mi tshad zangs gser/ phun tshogs pho brang yab kun dga' rin chen nang rten sgrol dkar mi tshad/ gdung rten/ bde mchog rje btsun mkha' spyod/sngags 'chang kun rin/ sa chen sku zangs gser bcas/ gong ma dngos grub dpal 'bar gyis u rgyan dngul sku mi tshad che/ 'jam dpal dngos grub rgyal mtshan nang rten tshe dpag med mi tshad/ sgo ra zhabs pad kyis zangs gser mchod sdong 'dom gang / bdag chen bkra shis rin chen pas slob dpon snang srid zil gnon mi tshad zangs gser/ g.yas sgo nang nas 'gro mgon phyag nas thub chen li 'dra thog sleb/ ti shī kun blo/ theg chen chos rgyal shar pa rin bzang po bcas kyis thub pa mi tshad li ma bzang / lha chen dpal 'bar 'jim rgyab 404

nas chos brtsegs brag ri ma gong 'og ltar brgyad re/ phred la drug cu re lhag 'bum lcags lung ma bcas/ a myes zhabs kyis chos brtsigs gzigs pas pod che chung 'dres par grags pa chos brtsegs pod che chung 'dres song ba drwa mig rer pod chen mdzo rgyab ma bzhi re tsam gyis gang ba'ang snang / lnga bcu tsam rer yod pa'ang snang / brgya re yod pa'ang yod/ de kun bsdoms khri gnyis lhag yod nges/ mjal khang na rgyal yum bstan 'dzin bzang mo'i bka' 'gyur gser chos/yang de 'dra gcig dus gsum sangs rgyas zangs gser thog sleb mkha' spyod dngul sku mi tshad/ 'khon snga mo'i thugs dam nang na yod pa'i phur sku byin can 'dam mi tshad/ rdo rje 'chang sogs sku mi tshad bdun tsam/ bka' bstan spar ma cha gnyis/ slar yang lha khang du sgar chen mthu stobs dbang phyug dngul gdung thog gsum sleb/ 'di'i nang gu ru'i sku tshab nyer lnga'i gras sogs nang gzhug phul byung / phra rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bum sgor gser srang brgyas brdungs pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi sku yod/ dbus su thub chen 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag chos je sa paṇa phyi rten thog sleb li ma/ g.yas su tshe dpag med bdag chen kun blos dngul srang bzhi stong las bzhings pa thog sleb/ dngul gyi bcu gcig zhal mi tshad rmor drung dngul gdung sogs yod/ 05

tshes bcu lha khang du/ skyabs mgon kun dga' snying po'i dngul gdung thog gnyis/ gcung dpal chen 'od po'i nang rten u rgyan sku tshad che/ pad sdong mtsho dbus ma/ rje btsun rta mgrin dbang mo'i nang rten mkha' spyod dngul sku sku tshad ha las pa da lta'i skyabs mgon yum gyi nang rten mkha' spyod dngul sku mi tshad/ gzhi thog rje btsun bgres mo'i nang rten mkha' spyod bcas/ gur drag blos bslang zhing bkod thang kabaka' thang / gser phreng ngos bris/ gos rgya gser 'phan dang / sa skya'i skyabs mgon rang rang sku rgyan phul bas rgyan bkod gzi byur g.yu mu tig rin thang nges par tshad las 'das/gdung rten nub na/ bkra shis rin chen gdung rten dang / padma bdud 'dul dbang phyug dngul gdung thog gnyis/ mtho ngos kun dga' phun tshogs nang rten bcas/'du khang chen mo'i lho ngos phur sgrub 'tshogs sa yin/skas them nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod pa brgal nas lha khang rtse bla ma lha khang du/ rten gtso sa chen/ /mdun du kun dga' rin chen/ lam 'bras brgyud pa sum cu/ 'jim sku mi tshad cung ma lang ba/ ngor cher shin tu bgres po/ u rgyan gtso 'khor sogs/ mdo sgo 'dir/ dung dkar mo rgyang grags dang / birlu pa'i dbang bum bum chung dang bcas pa/406

mgon khang lha sa rdzong pa'i kha gnon la bzhengs pa/thig khang dpe mdzod khang du pod stong phrag lhag pa sa skya'i gtsor gyur gsar rnying sna tshogs/ thig khang shar zangs gser mchod rten sogs/ jig khang chen mo'i nub lhor gnyis char/ thub dbang /'jam dbyangs thog sleb 'jim sku/ 'khor du lam 'bras bla brgyud/grub chen brgyad cu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mi tshad dang mda' gang pa sogs 'jim bzo shin tu legs/ rgya dkar nag li ma/ bal sku/zangs rag gser sku/ rdo nag rdo dkar tsan sku/ bka' gdams gdung rten sogs lnga brgya lhag tsam/ u rgyan rin po che mang / gsang bde dgyes rdor gur brtag sum gsum/ dus 'khor/ dpal rtse kun rig sogs dkyil 'khor bcas bris pa'i rgyud sde'i ngos bris legs/lha khang bla brang mkhan po bzhugs gnas 'phags pa rin po ches bsnyen rdzogs gnang sar sdom rten thub sku li ma dang / mkhan rab thugs dam thub sku bcu tsam dang / 'du khang zhig kyang yod/'jigs byed lha khang ka drug ma 'gro mgon dbang sdud snying pos bzhengs par/ rkang lag glo snying rgyu ma sogs drwa phyed gdung yol/ mi lhags thog phub ras la bris pa/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum thog gnyis ma sleb tsam pa'i sku/ las gshin/ dgra sker thag 'dogs bcu 407

tsam/ phyogs skyong bcas/bskor ba byas nas phyir rtse chen lha khang du/ byang skya bo kha gdangs nas gdan drangs pa'i sa chen 'dra zhal byin can/ g.yas su rje btsun grags pa dngos slob kyis bzhengs pa/ g.yon du theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis sogs zangs gser phul gyur bla sku mang / shar du khri rdo rje rin chen dngul gdung / rdo rje 'chang / thub pa li ma mda' tshad/ chos rje sa paṇa skyabs mgon grags pa blo gros phyag bzo dbyar gnas tshugs nas zhal ras 'gyur song ba/ yang gser sku khru gang li ma khyad mtshar dang / 'bum sogs dbyar gnas 'di na tshugs sa lo'i rnam thar bris rnying thang ka snang /srub dgon lha khang 'di la nub logs su 'dom lnga bcu/ lho nas 'dom zhe gnyis yod/ thog mtho ngos bdun/ thog ngos sde srid gtsang pas kyang nyams gso che tsam mdzad/ gser tog chen po gnyis/ rgyal mtshan bzhi/ sgo pan/ span rgyan sogs yod/ nang du dkar yol gu gul shel sogs mchod rdzas/ dngul ting / gser kong sogs mang /gzhan du phyi rol mkhar chen bcu gnyis/ lcags ri mda' rgyang tsam pa/ dgra mkhar rdo phen sa bcas/ nang grwa shag mig bcu drug gnas brtan grangs/ chos dung dkar mo rgyang grags sa la lhung ba'i rjes 408

bcas/ lha khang grwa brgya/ byang nyin dgon grwa brgya tsam bcas khyen grwa nyis brgya tsam nas sa skya'i rgyud sde nyi shur nye ba'i sgrub mchod/ gtso bo phur sgrub yod/ da lta mtshan nyid ngag chos pa'i spyi ma thal rnams khral tsam/ nye dus su rdzogs chen mkhan gzhan phan pa'i rgya mchan kha shas sleb bo/ 'on kyang sham thabs le'u ma grwa mang gis gyon rgyur byas par lha khang mkhan pos gtsang sar bla mar zag dog gis rgyan mi chog rgyu byas pas mkhan gzhan phan pa'i slob ma gtsang sar bla ma ni bshum nas 'dug go/ /slob gnyer gsar pa la mi mos mkhan kyang mang ngo / /lha khang thog kha nas nub ngos phyag 'tshal sgang a ti shas dhīḥmadun 'iḥrgyu gzigs pa'i sa/mang mkhar mdar kun mkhyen g.yag pa'i gdan sa sa shul/ lho nub gzhung brgya dngos grub dpal 'bar ba'i gdan sa/ byang lha sa rdzong pa'i khang shul rnams mthong / rdo rje phur pa'i mchod rten bzhi las gnyis ngos 'phrod/ rdo gcal dbus chu shing sdong 'gyel shul dar rtser zangs gser rgyal mtshan yod/ sgo chen tsan dkar red zer/ spen rgya steng nas lha khang thog rta rgyug sa lta bu'i thang chen yod/chu byang ngos thog mar gnod sbyin ci'u dmar po'i mgon khang /thog khar bla ma lha khang na chos rje sa paṇa bzhugs khri/ lam 'bras bla 409
