brgyud gong ma lnga mi tshad/ 'phros mda' gang / thub pa gnas bcu mda' gang bcas/pu tra mgon khang ka ba bcu drug dbus/ gur zhal lcam gsum khru gang / sngags 'chang chen po'i thugs dam pu tra'i sku dngos su thim pa dag po'am smug chung / 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i thugs dam zhal 'bags nag po gsum/ pu tra'i bla mtsho zangs dkar chen po chus gang ba yol ba can/dngul gdung rig 'dzin lha khang ka dgu mar sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen nas/ dbang sdud snying po'i bar dngul gdung 'dom gsum re lhag pa phra rgyan phun sum tshogs pa bcu/ rje btsun grags pa'i gtsor gyur lam 'bras bla brgyud/ paṇa chen rdza sku sogs byin can/hā/ṭā rdor li ma sogs li ma nyis brgya lhag phur pa'i ngos bris gzhi thog gzim chung dbu rtse'i dbang khang ka bzhir/ li ma sna tshogs brgya tsam/ lam 'bras bla brgyud/ngag dbang kun dga' rin gyi beegyu'i mgon khang zil can/rgya gar rgya nag li ma khang ka bzhi mar/ rten gtso nā ro mkha' spyo/ sduda' gang lhagali ma sna tshogs sum brgya zin pa/

mgon khang lho na khyad par 'cham 'bag gsum sogs/gzhi thog tshom chen ka ba sum cu/ gong ma'i bzhugs khri mang /bde mchog 'tshogs skabs yin/ bdud 'dul sbug ces sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros bzhengs pa'i mgon khang / gangs dkar mkhyen brtse'i phyag bzor dper mdzad pa'i gur zhal lcam sogs lha bcu gsum thog sleb khyad 'phags/ 'cham sku bcas/dbu rtse'i gsham du bla brang shar sa chen phug tu/ thub dbang sku/'jam dpal sku mi tshad sogs dang / bka' gdams gdung rten sogs rten li ma nyi shu lhag zhug na 'jam dpal dmar ser sku dang /sa chen bar skabs zhig tu bzhengs pa/ gu ru li ma/ sku 'thor sna tshogs sum cu tsam/ g.yas su rje btsun grags pas dbang gi las sgrub pa'i phug g.yon du rje btsun rtse mo'i sgrub phug bcas sa phug go/ /sgo g.yas der sa chen dgung lo brgyad pa'i zhabs rjes gsal po/phyi g.yas su phag gru gzim phug sa phug sgo khar rdo rje sems dpa'i sku mi tshad/dbu rtse bla brang nub khyams ka ba sbom po 'dom do pas 'khor ba sogs ka ba sum cu/ shar du chos rje sa paṇa phyag bris 'jam dbyangs gar gzigs mi tshad bal bris rnying pa/411

g.yon ngos kha che paṇa chen dar len sgrol ma'i ngos bris/ mdo khyams g.yon du gsung rab lam 'bras bla brgyud mi tshad bco lnga/ gong ma lnga po'i gser sku mda' tshad/ chos rje theg chen bkra shis rin chen sa paṇa/ g.yas su rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birlu pa sogs bco lnga mi tshad thams cad zangs gser/ sgrol ma li ma mi tshad/ gnam rgyan la zangs gser kun rig dkyil 'khor bla brgyud bcas/rnam thar sgo gsum khang ka ring bcu gnyis dbus su sa paṇa zhabs brtan shākya mu ne/ gzhan li ma thub sku mi tshad bdun bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam/ bla ma 'phags pa'i thugs dam byang chub mchod rten lha can li 'dra phyag na ba'i thugs dam rnam snang li ma/ gser chos pon stong tsam/ dngul gdung mda' tshad gnyis/khrug tu dbu rtse'i nang khyams su 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba zhal mtho do pa li ma mdzes sdug 'gran zla bral ba/ zangs gser khang bzang rgyab yol rgyan drug phul gyur/ 'jam dbyangs thub bstan bzang pos gser rgyan phul ba/ g.yas g.yon 'jam dbyangs li ma mda' tshad gang tsam pa bdun/ dpe pod sdong phrag tsam cung 'thor ba dang rgyan bkod bzang /sgo rum rtse'i lha khang ka gnyis mar chos je sa paṇa dbus/ theg 412

chen chos rje g.yon/ 'phags pa rin chen g.yas mi tshad pa ṭa'i dbus bzhugs/ gser 'bum pod chen bcu gnyis/ rab dbye brtsam pa'i bzhugs khri bcas/sgo rung mgon khang du spyan gzigs mang / spug tu sa chen gsang chab khang red kyang zer/ gtor sgrom drug na bge 'bags nag po 'phur shes nag skya la zhal du bdud ji khri dal lung phab gta'/ phyi rol du rje btsan grags pa'i sku/ sgo 'og de nas sa chen gzim chung yod par grags/ri rgyab ngos ka drug zhug thub sku li ma mda' gang pa bdun/ rgya nag dpe shog dril/ sgo rum dpe mdzod du grags pa'i nang du yig 'thor thal ba'i nang song ba pod stong phrag gnyis tsam yod pa 'di ni sngon gyi bdag nyid chen po lo tsā ba rnams kyi phyag dpe yin kyang bkur ste ma byas pa ni nges par bstan pa'i snying po bshad sgrub nyams pa'i rtags su'o/ /gsob sna tshogs bcas/rgyal chen shugs ldan mgon khang yod/de yi sar zhal dro lha khang ka bzhi mar/ kun dga' blo gros kyis bzhengs pa/ gser ljang brdung sgrol ma mda' tshad/ 'khor zangs gser sgrol ma nyi shu/ u rgyan zangs gser mi tshad/ tshe dpag med dang rnam rgyal ma gnyis mda' tshad zangs gser bcas/ bla sku drug 413

tsam/ yid bzhin 'khor lo rnams yod/grub dngos pho brang du/ gong ma drag shul lags bzhugs pa'i gzim khang gong der/ sgrol ma lha khang bsnyen bkur legs po ka bzhi yangs pa/ dbus g.yu mkhar mo'i sgrol ma sems dpa' sum brtsegs mi tshad che/ dbu rgyan zangs gser legs/ g.yas g.yon sgrol ma gnyis mda' lhag re/ ngos bris sgrol ma nyer gcig mchod rdzas sogs mang / phun tshogs pho brang gdung sras gnyis mjal/ gong der skyed tshal nang / gong ma 'dzam gling chos sku dbang sdud kyi gdung mer bsregs pa'i gdung rus me tog padma'i sdong po ngo mtshar ba lngar gyur pa bdud ji ril bu yi ba snang /yang chu byang ngo mtshar rten gcig rnam rgyal lha khang du ba ri lo tsā ba'i gdung rten sa 'bum chen po thog gnyis/ bum sgo zangs gser dang rnam rgyal sku mda' tshad/ 'jam dbyangs thub bstan bzang po'i zhabs kyis zhig gsos gnang /bum thang steng gser g.yab yod pa der/ bdag chen kun dga' blo gros kyis bzhings dngul gdung thog mtho nges gnyis la slob pa phra rgyan phun sun sum tshogs pa/ zangs gser rdzas brgyad che legs snang /bde mchog pho brang zhes par/ gur zhal lcam gsum pu tra bcas 414

thog tshad 'jim sku legs pa/ dbu rtser bla ma lha khang du lam 'bras bla brgyud khru gang tsam 'jim sku sum cu/g.yas par gdung rab lha khang / rnam rgyal shar lha khang gcig na kho yon mgon po/ mkhon dkon mchog rgyal pos rnying ma'i dpe sogs sbas pa'i sa 'bum yod pa/ mngon dga' bde chen khang / dga' ldan bse khrab mgon khang bcas dang / gshag tshang shar nub gnyis/ 'du khang bcas/ g.yon nas zhabs brtan lho'i sgrol khang / nyi zla khang /rdzong chu sde mthu khang grong mo che/ rin chen sgang / gsang sngags bde chen gling bcas dang / sgo thad rje btsun ma'i pho brang / zhabs brtan lho byang / dge 'phel lha khang / thub dbang mthong ba don yod bcas yod kyang nam rgyun mi 'gro gi mi 'dugasku 'bum g.yu thog na sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / kun dga' bkra shis sa 'bum/bum thang 'og na gong ma rnam lnga'i sa 'bum/ de'i sa chen phyi rten /dro dus bzang la dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa'i rtags bdud ji 'bebs phyi rten ces dgon rgyab sa gdung de gsum sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gdung rten yin/415

'gro mgon phyag na bas phyag mda' 'phang bas rin chen sgang gsham du mda' chu zer ba yod/yang dgon bde mchog chos kyi pho brang glad der/ rdo la bsod rtse'i sku yod pa/ de nas bsod rtse mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i gnas yin/ sa dkar po seng gdong la snyi bdun dang hūṃ āḥbacas a ti shas gzigs pa gling skor lam na yod/rin chen sgang mgon khang na lam 'bras bla brgyud thal thor/ gur zhal bcas/ nai tso de chos rje sa paṇa rna tso rab dbye skor shes pa de'i spur yin ces bshad/ srub dgon phyogs lho ngos grwa pa tsho la 'dul ba par grags/ 'on kyang dam rdzas zhes chang bslab gzhir ye mi brtsi ba dang / byang ngos ser khyim grong pa la gsang sngags pa zhes ming btags/ mtshams pa zhes rin chen sgang du sdug btsun ma yin/ rgyu phrug khra'i dpang kheb dang / do lo dang g.yu sogs phreng ba rna lung chab chob btags pa snang / 'di dang bo dong phyogs a ni ral pa can spu phrug gi sa zhu 'dra po spu ra mgo la gyon pa zhig snang ba sogs dbus gtsang dam pa chos kyi sa dag pa'i zhing zhes bya mod chos min rigs mang /sa skya'i chu nyin srub la deng sang bris na sdom gsum rab dbye sum 'gyur 'ong ngam snyam/ a la rang gzhan thams cad phyogs nas bstan pa nub 416

nyer song ba la ci zhig mtshar/ re sdug go/ /rin chen sgang 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis/ rdo rje 'chang / 'jam dbyangs/ thub sku 'dra ba gnyis bcas bal li khri rgyab yol bcas 'dom gsum re yod/ lhor dpal ldan bla ma bsod rgyal/ byang du sa lo'i sa 'bum thog sleb/ yang thub sku mi tshad dang / bcu gcig zhal mi tshad bcas 'jim sku'o/ /sgrol ma pho zang dang / phun tshogs pho brang so sor gzim skyil phun sum tshogs pa mang du yod/ lhag par bdag chen rin po che drag shul gyi mdun du 'dzam gling rgyan drug zhal thang tshon spus legs pa mjal/'jam dbyangs thub bstan bzang po'i mdun rab byung rtsis sprod sa paṇa rin po che'i sku chos lhung bzed bcas yod/phu na dpal mgon zhal thim pa'i gnas kha'u brag rdzong dang /de'i phur bya 'gyur padma 'od rje btsun grags pa dang / sa lo'i sgrub gnas yin/ bar der phru ma mchod rten yod/ sa skya rang gi phu bsam gling dmag zor ma'i mgon khang rtsa chen/ de'i phar ngos dpal chen lha khang mkhon rog shes rab tshul khrims sogs mkhon gyi rnying ma'i bla ma gong ma rnams bzhugs pa'i gnas da lta hral/ 'di'i rgyab ngos rnying ma'i dpe sbas pa'i mchod rten yod ces 'jam dbyangs thub bstan 417

bzang pos gsungs/ kha'u na dpe rnying cung yod ces sa skya bdag chen lags kyis gsungs/sa skya nas lho ngos gting skyes/ nub ngos pu deng ri phyogs 'gro lam shel dkar dang rgyal gyi shrī la 'gro lam yod/ sa skya'i nub byang nas phar bltas pas kun mkhyen g.yag pa'i gdan sa'i shul dang /chos 'khor lhun po gzhung brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gdan sa grwa bzhi bcu tsam pa/ u rgyan rin po che'i sku byin can zangs gser dang /lha khang khag gsum tsam/ sa skya'i byang phyogs ri ngos sa bzang gdan sa deng sang a ṇi dgon par gyur/ de nas mar ring du 'ong bas/shar ngos slob dpon rin po che mkhar chen brag la lo gcig bzhugs pa'i brag ri'i rtse na sgrub phug dang / de nas mar do lo shar shing shug nags dkyil rnying ma'i sngags dgon chung ngu yod/ de nas lung mda' nas yar nub byang la ring du phyin pas mang mkhar mdar/ 'dar grong mo cher/ dbu rtse ka ba bcu gnyis pa'i lha khang du/ tshar chen rin po che blo gsal rgya mtsho'i dngul gdung 'dom gang / 'dra zhal dang / g.yas su mkhan ngag dbang chos grags 'dra zhal/ dbus su gnas gsar ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sku gdung zangs gser 'dom gang lhag lam 'bras bla brgyud khru gang pa tshar chen phyag nas ma/ li ma sna tshogs lnga 418

bcu lhagamakha' spyod ma byin can mi tshad 'jim sku/'du khang spug g.yas gur zhal/ dam can mgar nag rtse sogs mgon khang 'jim sku legs po ngo mtshar byin chags zil che ba/phyi khyams 'du khang ka ba nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ mchod rten cha brgyad sa sku dkar gsol ba'i sa gdung 'dom gang pa/dbus su dri gtsang khang / dus gsum sangs rgyas thog sleb 'jim/ 'od zer drug gur 'dam gyis bzhengs gsung 'byon yin pa'i sgrol dkar tshar chen phyag nas ma mi tshad/ 'du khang du rdor sems dngul sku mi tshad/ u rgyan rin po che dngul sku legs pa mi tshad/ tshar chen bzhugs khri/ grwa lnga bcu tsam/ tshar lugs dgyes rdor/ 'jigs byed/ gshed dmar lha lnga / rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa/ mkha' spyod/ mgon po rnams 'tshogs/ yar lung gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs 'byung gsol ras sde dge'i bka' bstan spar ma snang /sgo shub thog khar gnas bcu lha khang 'jim sku legs pa mda' tshad // /la bsgrigs snang / chos ra dbus rdo la sangs rgyas stong sku brkos 'di'i yar ngos brtse mgon khang grub thob 'dar phyar gyis bzhings pa der tshar chen sku 'khrungs/ de nas phur gnas gsar pa 419

mkhyen brtse 'khrungs/ rma lo tsā ba rin chen mchog 'khrungs sa der byang gter lugs sngags dgon sngags pa drug cu tsam bkra shis lhun po'i zhabs brtan pa/ mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel dang / cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong / ri khrod dga' ldan yang rtser tshar chen sku dang / chu mug lug sgra las 'brog mis mu gu lu du btags pa'i lung phur ga ya dha ra'i sgrub phug dang / phug chen bcu gsum/ phu gangs lha rgod mdung rtser u rgyan sgrub phug mtsho chen po bcas yod/mang mkhar mda' nas mar cung phyin pas mkhan ngag dbang chos grags sku 'khrungs yul dang / gangs bu ler u rgyan sgrub phug red mda' bzhugs gnas sogs/ stod na nub ngos gtsang chu tshu rir 'ol ba lha rtse phar ka la stod ri bo che sogs dang / shug khrod zer ba'i shug nag chen po/ de'i lung rgyab nub byang nas bkra bzang bla brang na se'i gdung brgyud dang / rnying rgyud sogs dpe cha mang / ngom ring rdzong dus 'khor lha khang sogs byang bdag rnams dbyar bzhugs pa/ de nas la rgyab nas stag brtan thad ldog gi lung phur zang zang lha brag ne'u ring dgon sogs 'brog sa la rgyab par thug star sgo gang bon dgon yod sa yod zer/42/nga mkhar 'da' gtsang 'gram 'dir bla chen 'brog mi 'khrungs

sa yin zer ba dang / chu phar ka rgyas sde thang / rgyas sde phug na sa sdu/sa dgon chung / thang rgyal mtshan mkha' 'gros gsol gnas de nas lha rtser sleb pa'i rdzong khyab 'jug chen po'i sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil pa wa bu ri de'u 'a༅ rtser/ byang bdag rim byon rnam rgyal grags bzang / bkra shis stobs rgyal sogs kyi rdzong / dbu rtser 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gzim chung ka bzhi mar/ 'phags pa rin po che'i sku tshad 'dra zhal byin chags/ chos rje sa paṇa/ dpal ldan bla ma/ rje btsun rgyang ro byang chub 'bum sku gdung sa 'bum/ mgon khang du gur mgon lcam dral/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa bcas/de nas mar babs pas ga ya dha ra'i sgrub phug tu rnam snang rdo sku mi tshad rang byon zangs gser srog zhu phul ba/ gzhan rigs bzhi kha skong ba/ ga ya dha ra'i chos khrir sa chen gyis bzhengs zer kyang 'brog mis bzhengs pa'i byang chub mchod rten bcas/gsham der lha rtse dga' ldan 'od gsal gling na 'du khang g.yas su byams chen thog mthon gnyis/ nyesas brgyad yod pa/ rdo rje 'chang mi tshad zangs gser legs po dang bla sku yod pa'i lha khang / g.yon du bka' 'gyur lha khang / rje rin po che gtso 'khor gsum/ gser sku kha 421

shas/ phyi ngos gyang la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal phyag stong spyan stong sa la btab pa'i lha khang / 'du khang steng du dngul gdung mchod rten cha brgyad 'dom ga nga pa/ li ma chen po spus dag sogs brgya tsam/ bka' 'gyur yod pa'i lha khang / rdo rje 'chang mi tshad dang /'jim sku khru gang pa'i grub chen brgyad cu'i lha khang / mdzod pa sku gang ma'i dngul gdung sogs yod pa/ bcu gcig zhal yod pa'i lha khang /thub sku zhal ras lha khang / thub sku 'di gtsang rong g.yung nas rten phud bzhes pa zangs gser zhal ngo mtho bzhi ma/ lam rim bla brgyud 'jim sku khru gang pa'i lha khang / byams sku'i thugs dkar sangs rgyas glang po'i skye ba bzhes pa'i tshems yin zer ba shel sgor 'dug grwa sum brgya/ mtshan nyid gsar 'dzugs/ dgon spus dag gser tog bcu gsum/ 'du khang du sman bla zangs gser dkyil 'khor rgyal ba bskal bzang phyag nas ma/ rgyang gi jo bo/ stag phu'i jo bo ste li ma gnyis/g.yas su dpal ldan lha mo'i mgon khang / dbus su thub dbang nye sras brgyad 'jim thog slob/ g.yon du sman bla/ gser chos bka' 'gyur/ yang bka' bstan cha bzhi/ 'du khang ka ba so drug bcas/rgyang gi byams khang du/ byams pa zhal mtho lnga pa 'jim sku byin ldan/rgyu non gyi phyi nang gi gzer zur bzhir mchod rten leb mo brgyad/ rgyang 422

lhor mchod rten chen mo'i bang rim dang por/ gu ru/ gnas bdag nor bzang 'jim/ srid pa'i 'khor lo yod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / bcu gcig zhal yod pa'i lha khang / gur mgon thog sleb/ lha mo 'dod khams ma sogs yod pa'i nang bde mchog dkyil 'khor bris pa/ thub dbang gnas brtan brag ri ma bcas lho/ u rgyan rin po che mi tshad/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro ngos bris/ thub dbang sku/ gnas brtan/ cing bshags/ sman bla/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas/ phyogs skyong sogs/ sangs rgyas byams bzhugs mdzad pa/ mdzad bcu/rnam rgyal/ lo gyon ma sogs/ 'od dpag med yod pa/ sgrol ljang yod pa bcas nub/ mi 'khrug pa gtso bo dang / stong sku bris pa/spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra/ klu dbang rgyal po/ rnam sras/ mi g.yo dkar bcas byang / shar du chu rgyud rgyal khang / de min ri sna thug pas lha khang med/ bar rim gnyis par/ thub dbang / zas gtsang /yum sgyu ma lha mdzes/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa/ 'jam dbyangs spros bral ma gtso 'khor lnga/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ 'jam dpal stong sku ngos bris/ 'jam dpal ma ti'i lugs/ tshe dpag med stong sku ngos bris/ yang tshe dpag med 'od dpag med stong sku ngos bris/ yang tshe dpag med/ 'od dpag med 423

stong sku ngos bris/ thub dbang chos 'khor ma/ phal po che'i rgyud ngos bris/ 'chi med rnga sgra/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba kun sgrol/ thub dbang lung ston ma/ rnam snang sku/ thub pa bdud 'dul ma/ thub dbang ting 'dzin ma/ rje btsun sgrol ljang / sman bla/ rnam snang lha khang bcas/ bang rim gsum par/ skyes rabs bris pa/ phyag stong spyan stong klu sgrub lugs/ 'od mdo ri bo ta la/ g.yu lo bkod pa sogs/ mdzad brgya bris pa/ thub dbang rgyan drug can/ yang thub dbang gnas bcu/ sman bla stong sku/ yang mi bskyod stong sku/ sgrol ljang / rdo rje 'chang / grub brgya/ mdzad bcu sogs/ sgrol ljang /seng ge la chibs tsong kha pa/ thub dbang / rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa/ sgrol dkar sogs/ mi 'khrugs stong / jo rngog 'brom gsum/phyag rdor dregs 'dul/ 'khor khyung chen sogs/ rnam 'joms bcas/ bang rim bzhi par rnam snang stong / spyan gzigs stong /sher phyin 'bur sangs rgyas sku mang / mdo'i gling gzhi/ thub pa chu lon ma/ 'jam dbyangs gang blo ma byang chub shing can/ thub dbang / 'dul lung / bka' bsdu sogs/ gtso bo 'bur/ 'phros bris pa'i sa 'bur/ sa skya gong ma lnga dang / gtso bo 'jam dbyangs/ca dam pa rgya gar nyi 'de ma/ chos sku kun bzang / zur che chung sogs/ sa 424

skya'i dpal ldan bla ma dang / theg chen chos rje sogs/ chos rgyal srong btsan gtso 'khor lnga/ sa thar zhal sprod/ klu thog gnyis bcu gcig zhal bcas/ bang rim lnga par/ bu ston dang / dus 'khor/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bris pa'i lha khang gnyis/ phal cher sgo bkag nas 'dug thub dbang ting 'dzin ma/ thub dbang sa gnon ma/spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi/ rdo rje 'chang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod phyag bzhi ma/ sgrol ljang lha khang / thub dbang dang / bo dong phyogs las pa/ kun mkhyen dol po sogs bcas/bum pa'i nang / rnam snang mi tshad 'jim sku bzhi/ dpal rtse dbyings gsum dkyil 'khor thams cad/ bre nang du/ shar du thub dbang / lhor dus 'khor/ nub rdo rje 'jigs byed/ byang du bde /rdokā bcas 'jim sku tshad ldan mda' gang / ngos su dkyil 'khor chos 'khor nang / kye rdor blos bslang 'jim/ ngos bris kye rdor skor/ phyi rol rdza las byas pa sangs rgyas stong sogs nyams zhig cher song / dpal 'khor rtse dang phyogs 'dra ba las 'dis leb/ de tsam spus med/brag dkar dgon 'du khang ka drug zhi khro'i rdo sku/ u // 5

sku/ li ma kha shas/ zur gyi gdung brgyud dang chos dbyings rang grol gzim chung du/ u rgyan rin po che'i zhabs lham/ rgod ldem gter ma gnam lcags phur pa khru gang rtser bya khyung can/ dam can mgar bas brdungs pa'i lcags phur/ rgod ldem gter ma gnam lcags rdo rje sogs nang rten mang / yul 'dir sbyang ki lug la rgyug pa 'dra ba'i ri snar rgyang 'bur mo yod/ pha tshad gla ba thang babs sa dpyad/ g.yas su sbrul nag thur rgyugs/ phu na seng ge gnam 'phyong rnams yod/ru gnon gram pa rgyang ni/ grum pa'i kha 'dra ba'i brag la sa chu thon pa'i sa skya'i grum chu las rgyang tsam du yod/ lha khang dbus ka drug chos rgyal srong btsan gyis rdzu 'phrul gyis nyin gcig la bzhengs pa'i rnam snang thog slob/ 'di dang ga ya dha ra'i sgrub phug chos 'phyod ma shing gi lha khang bcas kyi gtso ba'i dbu rgyan rnams bkra shis lhun yongs 'dzin pas phul ba spus dag byang sems brgyad 'dom phyed do/ /mi g.yo rta mgrin bcas chos rgyal dus kyi 'jim sku/ bar skor lam na chos rgyal srong btsan/ rdo rje gro lod/ bcu gcig zhal/ sman bla bder gshegs brgyad/ dus gsum sangs rgyas/ rigs lnga/ tshe dpag lha dgu/ rdor sems yab yum/ kun tu bzang po/ rigs gsum mgon po bcas/ mchod khri bang rim thams cad rag las byas 426

pa'i gser ma yin/ stong mchod stong spus dag po yod/ phyi rol du yum chen mo/ 'gro ba kun sgrol/ byams pa/ mar me mdzad/ sgrol ma/ mtha' skor du/ rnam snang rigs lnga lha khang / mkhan chen bo dhi satwa dang / chos rgyal khri srong phyis bzhengs pa/'jam dbyangs saseng gtso 'khor lnga/spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa lha lnga/ rta mgrin dang /mgon po phyag bzhi pa yod/ 'di nas 'khor lo 'bar ba gter bzhes pa yin/ skor lam na sangs rgyas rigs lnga mi tshad 'jim bzos ma/nub na rdo rje rnam 'joms khrus lha bzhis bskor ba/spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal/ rta mgrin/ stobs chen/don zhags sogs/ 'di rnams phal cher mu khri btsad pos bzhengs/rtser gu ru mtshan brgyad/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ las 'joms ma/ lha khang gcig na sgrol ljang / gcig na rnam sras khang bcas mi tshad re/sgo srung skang skang gnyis bcas byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba bzhugs/ gshag skor la rdo lha sangs rgyas so lnga/ mkhan slob chos kā/ma/ rigs gsum mgon po mi tshad tshon dbyib phun sum tshogs pa de nas yar rgyang gi yon po lung / brag khrab khrob/ shing tshal 427

sogs nyams skyid pa'i sa khyad 'phags su snang / thog mar gu rus srin mo bros pa 'dul slad srin mo thim pa'i brag la phur bus btab/ phyis gu ru chibs skyel skabs/ phyir lam 'khor lnga 'dir bzhugs pa yin/gter klung khang mdo'i gu ru'i sgrub phug 'dra ba/ phug pa skyid po'i spuganam mkha'i snying po'i phyag bzo gu ru'i sku mda' tshad ma che/ zhal tshugs rgyas la rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhal ngo 'dra ba/ 'khor mkha' 'gro gnyis phyis bzhings/ mgron gnyer tshe brtan gyis bzhengs gu ru'i sku 'jim pa mi tshad gtso 'khor gsum/ yang zangs gser khyad mtshar mi tshad gsum/ g.yas su lcags dong dgon rnying rten gtso gu ru mi tshad gtso 'khor gsum/ mda' tshad ma gu ru gnyis/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub 'jim mi tshad/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma'i gter gnas gter sgo/ phur pa'i rjes bcas/ brag la u rgyan gtso 'khor rang byon/khyung rang byon/ phyi rol lha khang ka bzhi/ steng du gzim chung du mdzad pa bla ma'i sku/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku bcas/nam mkha'i snying po'i sgrub phug na kun bzang rigs grol gyis mtshams khang gsar rgyab/ sgo khar mtsho rgyal zhabs rjes yod/ g.yas su mtsho rgyal sgrub phug yod/mdun du zhabs pad bshad grwa pas/ hor kha gnon dmag bzlog 428

lha khang du/ u rgyan sku mi tshad las che/ garma gu ru/ thang stong rgyal po/ bka' 'gyur bcas/bsam gtan gling na thub dbang bcas/bde chen ri khrod byang sems zla rgyal gyi gdan sa da lta lding po che rtsog gras bdag 'dzin/ khyung sprul gyi gzim khang skyid spug nas/ yon bdag zhus par rten li ma kha shas/ klong snying rtsa gsum/ rje mkhyen brtse kong sprul rin po che sogs 'dam sku mang po yod/ grwa bzhi sde/btsun ma kha shas/chu byang ngos na keḥthog rig 'dzin chen mo bzhugs pa'i dgon kun ldan na u rgyan rin po che byin ldan/ dge dgon dga' ldan gaba' spyod/ spungs dgon/ 'gyur med/ rdzong rtse zer ba sogs yod/gtsang 'gram mchod me'am chu ma shing gi lha khang bya ba dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang ji lta ba chu 'gram thang khud zhig tu/ dbus su rnam snang 'dom phyed do lhag 'khor nye sras mi tshad lhag king skang gnyis/ nang na skor lam bcas/g.yas su sgrol ma/ g.yon du byams pa lha khang bcas/de nas ring por 'ong bas/ rtag brtan phu bye ma rdo gram pa'i nang ring tsam song bas/ phur jo mo nags rgyal gyi mgul/ g.ya' rwa ༵ nyi

le ba/ spang ser gyis mgul 'khyud pa/ mtha' rdza rdo khrol ma can na gu ru'i sgrub phugagayon du mtsho chen yod zer/jo nang nyin/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gzim khang du 'dra zhal mi tshad/da gser zangs rdo rje 'chang sku mi tshad/ byams khang du byams pa gser srang lnga bcu gsol ba/ shin tu mdzes gtsang phul gyur zangs gser dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde'i ngos bris bal bris tshad ldan/ jo nang rje btsun phyag dpe dpe rnying sna tshogs/jo nang mchod rten chen po'i lho ngos seng khri nas rgyug 'dom bcu dgu yod pa'i bang rim dang por lha khang gcig na thub dbang zangs gser mi tshad che chung gnyis/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i yum gyi gdung zangs gser 'dom gang / bka' gdams li ma 'dom gang / bal bris khyad 'phags/ spyan ras gzigs 'dam sku phyag bzhi pa/ nub nas thub sku mda' gang pa/ byams mgon mi tshad/ rgyal ba byang chub shing bris pa/ byang chub sems dpa' gnyis bcas shin tu legs/gcig bkag nub byang nas steng tu 'jogs/ byang bang rim gnyis pa'i lha khang dang por/ rnam snang 'jim dang / sangs rgyas stong ngos bris/ spyan ras gzigs mi tshad zangs gser dang / 'jam dbyangs dpal rin pa'i 'dra zhal/ 'jam dbyangs dang / bla sku mi tshad 430

gnyis/ phyag rdor khro bo mi tshad/ sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/shar dbus rje btsun sgrol ma thog sleb/ 'khor gnyis/ kun mkhyen dol po sems nyid ngal gso can mi tshad zangs gser/ phyag drug pa dang 'od dpag med/ thub dbang mi tshad 'jim/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng ngos bris can/ lho ngos kun mkhyen dol po nga 'dra ma 'jim mi tshad/ li ma khru gang tsam bcu lhag rje btsun phyag mkhar mdud pa can/ sman bla mi tshad yod pa/ lar sku 'bum mthong grol 'di'i bal bris ngos bris 'dra'i ris sku tshugs zhal tshugs legs po ni gang na'ang mthong dka' bar snang / thog khar 'dzegs/ bang rim gsum pa'i nub thub sku mnyam bzhag lhung bzed can/ 'di na rta mgrin ngos bris snang ba phyi gling shog par bzang po'i yal mdangs 'dra snang / sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag lhung bzed can gtso 'khor gsum dang / nye sras brgyad bris pa bltas na 'bur 'ong ba 'dra ba/ mtshan brgyad rnal 'byor rgyud lugs bris par/ sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag can 'jim/nub bang rim bzhi par don/ byang na yang dag phur pa/ lung tshe/tshogs chen rgyud lung khro bo/ rdor sems 'jim mnyam sbyor sogs dkyil 'khor bris pa/ nyamasagaso byed zer nas lus pa sangs rgyas 'jim sbyar ba/ yang de 'dra gcig byams pa dmar ser spyi blugs 431

'dzin pa/ khro bo legs po ngos bris/ khang bu gso nyams/ dkyil 'khor chen po bris pa/ rdo rje 'chang 'jim/ ngos bris rdor sems legs/ dkyil 'khor bris pa/ u rgyan rin po che si rgya mtsho ma/sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag lhung bzed can dang / bka' gdams/ zhi byed/ bka' brgyud bla ma/ rgyan drug sogs bris pa/ snga 'gyur lo paṇa/ zhwa dkar paṇa zhu/ dkyil 'khor bris pa/ bum pa'i nang du slobs/ byang na mi bskyod pa sangs rgyas dkar po thog gnyis sleb/chos gos g.yung drung bya nag lcags ri ma mdun du kha sarsha ṇi/ lho na rnam snang bal bris thog gnyis slebs/ 'khor sangs rgyas stong sku sa la spar ba/ nye sras brgyad mda' tshad 'jim re bzhag shar dbus rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa/ nam mkhar 'bum/ dol po stong sku/ lho na snang ba mtha' yas ngos bris/ bcu gcig zhal mi tshad thub sku jo nang thog thub ces 'di'i 'jim sku las brkus pa yin pas sangs rgyas stong sku/ nub na rin 'byung ngos bris/ dus 'khor sku mda' gang lhag bri nang du/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mda' gang / gsang 'dus khyer nas mi 'dug dgyes rdor sku/ bde mchog bcas phyogs bzhir 'jim sku gsum dkyil 'khor mang po'i ngos bris/ chos 'khor nang /dus 'khor dkyil 'khor blos bslang phun sum tshogs pa/ lar mchod 432

rten 'di dang rgyang rtse gnyis mtho dman cher mi snang / phyogs 'dis mchod rten zhig nang byin chags pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug gis bzhengs pa 'dis bag dro bar snang / phyir lam bang rim gsum pa'i byang / rdo rje 'chang 'jim mi tshad/ dam pa rgya gar bal thul ma mi tshad 'jim/smra seng ngos bris/ sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag lhung bzed can/ shar na 'di 'dra gcig thub dbang mi tshad gtso 'khor gsum/ gnas bcu/ rigs lnga/ sangs rgyas mnyam bzhag can/ phyag rdor ngos bris/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gral de 'dra/ lho dbus chos rje kun mkhyen chen po 'jim/ rnam snang mi tshad li ma gnyis/ mda' gang bcas/ lho byang sangs rgyas sku gnyis/ sgrol ljang mi tshad 'jim/ sgrol dkar ngos bris 'ja' shar ba lta bu/ de nas bang rim gnyis par/nub thub dbang sku/ rnam snang ngos bris/ thub dbang chen po u rgyan rin po che sogs/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi 'bur/ sgrol ljang bris phul gyur/ de nas bang rim dang por mar slebs/ byang nas rgyal ba byams pa/ skyes rabs so bzhi pa ngos bris/ sangs rgyas sku gsum/bcu gcig zhal 'bul legs ha las ma/ bsam yas chags tshul ngos bris/ zhug tu sangs rgyas/ g.yas g.yon du byang sems bcu/ zhing rkang bcas bris pa/ yang sangs rgyas sku mdzad brgya bris pa/ bcu 433

gcig zhal tā ra nā tha/ rdo rje 'chang / tshe dpag med bcas mi tshad 'jim/ skor lam na gnas bcu brag ri ma/ gnas g.yog yul bkod bcas tshad du phyin legs/ yang shar ngos sgrol ljang 'bur/ bcu gcig zhal/ mdzad brgya 'phros bcas bris pa/ mtha' bstan 'jam dbyangs bcas/ mthar lcags ri zlum po che legs snang ngo / gong du 'du khang ka ba nyer lnga pa'i g.yas sbug gtsang khang du thub pa zangs gser thog phyed gnyis slob pa/ chos brtsigs 'thor/ dus 'khor ngos bris phul gyur/ kun mkhyen dol po'i sa 'bum thog gnyis slob/chos 'khor zangs gser gyi phyis gsos pa'i lha khang gcig sangs rgyas stong sku lha khang ngos bris la/ gser sku mi tshad mda' gang sogs nyi shu rtsa cha shas bcas/ byang du bde ba can ces lha khang dmar blum na/gong ma lnga bzhugs/ steng na skyid spug ri khrod/ phar ka na bde mchog khang thog chen zhu ba bcas yod/ de 'og rdo gcal phug na rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog 'dra zhal mi tshad 'jim/ phyi nang gur lta bu'i sa yi rtswa skyil du bzhugs so/ /gdan sa 'dir a ṇi rgan mo 'khog pa mang tsam dang / btsun ma mig zhar ba bu mo sra 'chal sogs sum cu tsam las med/ za thang longs spyod bkras lhun rtse phyag gis bzhes/ rdzong rtse sprul sku'i nyams gso cung gnang ba bka' drin che 'dug de nas mar 434

la rdo khrod du babs nas lung mdor/ rtag brtan phun tshogs gling na/'du khang sgo shub na phyogs skyong lha brgyad/ klu brgyad/ rgyal chen bzhi sogs ri mo'i bkod pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba/ rnam sras mda' dar 'dzin pa/ spyan mi bzang sbrul gyi gdeng ka can/ shing rtser bya tshe ring zlum bskor can bris/ 'du khang ka ba so drug khyon yongs/ zhal ba shin tu legs/ bka' 'gyur cha gnyis/ sman bla'i pho brang / bla ma'i sku 'dra bzhi tsam/ gtsang khang ka ba bcu gnyis/ jo bo phyogs las rnam rgyal li ma mi tshad/ mi bskyod rdo rje ltar dbu rgyan med/ gtsang pa sde srid kyi yin par grags/ 'jim nye sras byis pa lo brgyad tsam/ rdo rje 'chang li ma mi tshad/ thub sku li ma/ rnam rgyal li ma mda' tshad/gzhan ma mda' tshad tsam bco lnga/ sangs rgyas rab bdun las drug zhal mtho do/ gtso bo zhal mtho gsum bcas zangs gser shin tu spus legs pa/ gser 'gyur cha gnyis/ tā ra nā tha dang gtsang pa sde srid kyi'o/ /rgyan bkod bzang / hor gos gser gzhi sprin ris ma'i 'phan sogs yod/ dbu rtse byang ka gnyis can du/ dgon stod rje btsun sgrol ma dgos 'dod kun 'byung bal li gsar pa mi tshad/ dbus su yum sgrol ma phyag bzhi/ g.yas bdud 'dul sgrol ljang bcas mi tshad zangs gser khyad 'phags/ tshe dpag lha khang ka brgyad mar/ dbus tshe 435

dpag zangs gser mi tshad/ byams pa/ thub dbang / rdo rje 'chang /'jam dbyangs/ bcu gcig zhal bcas mi tshad 'jim/ dus 'khor mchod rten cha brgyad/ lto ba dngul/ bang rim gser/ phra rgyan rin po che padma rwa ga sogs phun sum tshogs pa/ rigs lnga dang / dol po pa sogs ngos bris ngo mtshar ba/ rgya gar lha khang ka gnyis mar/ rten gtso tshe dpag med dang / nag po spyod pa ro lang gdugs ḍā ru bcas ngo mtshar li ma/ gzhan rgyud sde shas che ba'i li ma sna tshogs nyis brgya tsam/ phur pa dang / dus 'khor/ dam pa sangs rgyas bal thul ma sogs sku rnying / phyi ngos mdzad brgya bris pa yul bkod nyams mtshar ba drag shad mgon khang bcas/ mtha' skor la nub ngos/ mkha' spyod 'jim sku mi tshad smug ltem ba/ phag mo rab 'byams bris pa/ bde ba can na 'od dpag med zangs gser zhal mtho do pa/ zhing bkod bris pa/ padma bkod na/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ dol po'i rnam rgyal/ u rgyan padma sogs ngos bris legs/ byang lcang lo can na/phyag rdor 'jim sku mi tshad/ 'khor phyag rdor ngos bris/ byang sham bha la ka bzhi spug nas rdo rje 'chang 'du khang du khyer/ rigs ldan so drug mda' tshad 'jim sku/ ngos bris rigs ldan cha tshang / mgon khang mngon spyod khang na/ gur/ phyag drug zhal khra/ rnam sras/ dud 436

sol/ bram gzugs bcas nyams phul du gyur pa/ rmugs 'dzin bkod pa na/ dzambha la zangs gser mi tshad/ u rgyan sku rnying / dzam nagatshogs bdag/de skor logs bris bcas nag rgyal ma'i mgon khang /sngags khang dpal chen lha khang na/ bde mchog nag po pa phyag bcu gnyis pa/ mdo khyams na grub brgya dpa' bo 'od gsal lugs bskang gsol 'tshogs/ byang shar dbang ldan lha khang na/ gshed dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ gshed dmar ngos bris sogs/ 'di'i thog khar sngar gsang sngags rnying ma'i yang phur gshin rje tshe bdag sogs yod pa'i lha khang de/ da lta dge phyogs pas gal chung byas nas du bas ngos bris nag po byas te mjal rgyu med pa bla brang gi 'bud rgyu khang lta bu snang ngo / sgo khang thog shar sman lha'i lha khang na sman lha 'jim sku bgres/g.yon du snyi ba blugs snang bas re sdug shar mi g.yo khang na/ mi g.yo sku mi tshad/ ngos bris rgyud sde gong 'og gi mi g.yo ba mang / lho ra gzhal yas lha khang sgor spar khang ka ba bcu drug nang rje btsun gsung rab spar/ chu phar ka tshad nas drangs pa'i bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po'i gser gdung 'dom do pa/ thub pa zangs gser 'dom do/ /sbug dus 'khor lha khang ka bzhi khyon yangs pa'i nang dbus zangs gser dus 'khor sku gsung thugs rdzogs dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar ba tshes lha 437

sogs tshom bu bkod pa 'dra ba dkyil 'khor steng na bton nas snang /byis pa tshos re re tsam khyer bas da lta rtsis sprod sku tshab kyis dam 'byar/ 'dir nag zlar jo lugs dus 'khor btang / lha khang rang la bskor lam/ sgo bzhi/ ngos la mchod lha bris pa/ rgya mthongs nas sgo bzhi nas mjal to/ chos ra dbus byis pa kha shas nas rtsod 'chams mjal ba/ dgra bcom zag pa zad pa ma khyab par thal/ khyab pa byung na/ lhag pa cung zad yod par thal/ 'dod/ 'khor gsum/ zer ba sogs 'dug pas byis pa'i rtsed mo ha ha/ lho na sher phyin lha khang na/yum gyi sku mi tshad/ ri mo du sub khur/ dga' ldan byams pa khang na byams pa de'i khyams na chos 'thor pod nyis brgya tsam/ he ru'i lha khang na/ rdo rje gdan bzhi sogs rgyud mang po las byung ba'i rtsa ba'i lha ru ke rdo rje gdan pa'i lugs grub brgya gcig lha 'jam dbyangs lha khang na/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa dmar po/ bcu gcig zhal 'jim sdo 'jam dpal sku thod ngos bris bcas/ mtha' skor lha khang thad gud chos ra rdo gcal khyon yangs pa shing yo 'bogs bcas skyid de ba'o/ /ri ngos su khro rgyal mgon khang na/ phyag drug pa/ 'dod khams/ dmag zor ma/ dam can chos rgyal/438

drug na rdo rje 'jigs byed lha khang du 'jigs byed mi tshad lhag byin can bal po'i dmag dus khrag byung ba/ bal bris zhal thang rdo rje 'jigs byed ha las pa/ phyi ngos ka bzhi bcas/byang gi brag ri'i ngos u tsa la na/traklud mgon khang 'jigs rung byin che zil che ba/ 'og na blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyis gzigs par gnyan cha che bas paṇa chen sku phreng nas kyang gzigs mi phod pa'i /kāsab mtshan can/ ltag na rje tā ra nā tha'i zhabs rjes 'dam la brdzis — jo/ nas ring du 'dzegs pas pho brang rtse'i gzim chung ka gnyis mar tā ra nā tha bzhugs sar/ tā ra nā tha'i sku brnyan mi tshad/ phyag mdzod kun dga' dpal bzang / paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma yin zer kyang rgyal ba lnga pa bcas/ tā ra nā tha'i phyag mkhar 'brug mgo khyi ra pa/na rdor/ mi la/ sha ba khyi bcas yod pa/ li ma sna tshogs sum cu zhug na mdzod khang dam 'byar/ tā ra nā bas gos chen la tshe dpag med dang / 'jam dbyangs phyag bris gnang ba bcas/tā ra nā tha'i zhabs 'bam bsnyungs sa mtshan nyid lha khang du chos 'thor pod brgya tsam/ sa sku sna tshogs/439

reg pa med pa'i lha khang ka bzhi par/ dbus na reg pa med pa du ba'i mchod rten/ gser dngul rang byung zangs can/ g.yas su zangs gser 'dra sku drag po/ g.yon du zhi sku 'jim/ mdun nas skye phreng bcu bzhi/ bsam yas rwa bsgrengs sogs dang / phun tshogs gling ngos bris/ tā ra nā tha'i rnam thar bcas/gtor khang du/ ngom ring dkyil mtsho nas gdan drangs zer te 'jigs byed yab kyi 'bag zangs gser/ padma rā ga'i spyan yum 'bag chos lung byang lung rtse'i dgon na yod/gzim chung rtse ka gnyis na/ tā ra nā tha'i yum gyi phyi rten dngul gdung / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod khyad 'phags 'dom sku brgya tsam/thub chen khang ste lha khang ka bcu mar/ thog gsum/ rgya mthong dbus tā ra nā tha'i dngul gdung chen mo thog gsum pa nang rten rnams chu la 'phang / phyi'i dngul gdung bzhes mdzad/ de'i tshab thub dbang rgyan drug ma sa sku chen po byung / da lta de yang bgres/ lhor bde mchoganub dus 'khor/ byang 'jigs byed sogs rgyud sde'i bris sku 'gran gyi do med/ 'on kyang sku la chu shor bar snang / tā ra nā tha dgung lo brgyad pa'i zhabs rjes/lhor sgra snyan lha khang ka ba brgyad na/ 'dam sku nyi shu tsam/ phug 440

na phyag mdzod kun dga' dpal bzang gzim khang / 'di rnams sngar dag pa ha las yod par snang rung da lta bgres hrul cung song rung byin che bar snang /g.yas ngos brag leb na gnas bcu lha khang gnas brtan mi tshad tsam pa nyams gso byas khul snang / rgyab kyi brag ri'i rtser po ta lar/spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ rta mgrin bzhugs sku dbyug pa bsnams pa sogs dang / kha sarsha ṇi/de nas mar ring du babs pas brag bya lug pa 'dra ba'i kha gnon du/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo'i lha khang du/ mgon po klu sgrub 'jim sku mi chad tsam/ sa ra ha dang / klu sgrub rnam thar ngos bris/ dus 'khor/ phyag drug pa/ lha mo sogs/de nas g.yu lo bkod par/ rje btsun sgrol dkar ngos bris gsung 'byon/ bcu gcig zhal mda' tshad/ tshe dpag med mi tshad/ sgrol ljang mdzes sdug phul gyur mi tshad/ tā ra nā tha chung / sgrol dkar mi tshad bcas 'jim/ dol po sa chung zangs gser thub sku mda' tshad legs/ nyi sbas lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig ngos bris/ lar 'di tsho'i bar ri ngos su rdo skas ring po snang / phun tshogs gling mthar rje btsan sgrol mgon dbu skra gtor ba'i shing tshal chen po/ rtse pho brang nas /rdos

dwangasabla/ ma lha khang du thub dbang sa sku mi tshad rdo rje 'jigs byed mi tshad 'jim/ g.yu lo ngag dbang 'byung gnas kyi sku zhal rgya kha spu skye ba/dol po'i sku mang / dpe cha pod sum cu tsam/de rgyab grub thob lha khang du birsha'i sku sogs ngos bris dang 'jim sku kha shas yod/ thang rgyal lcags zam kyang snang / g.yas mtha' na gling kha legs pa 'dra snang ba ma gtogs bye mas non pas skyo bo yod/deng sang jo nang pa dge lugs su 'gyur/ de la'ang rtsod pa chos ra nyams zhan tsam/ grwa nyis brgyar cung ma long / 'don rgyu 'jigs byed bde mchog bla mchod sogs dge lugs dang / jo lugs dus 'khor bcas 'don/de nas shar du phyin te bo dong du sleb par/ bo dong pa sa dwangs shing skyid pa'i sbug ri ngos gnyan yod bya rgod gshong na/ 'du khang ka ba bcu drug pa'i sbug na/ paṇḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / mkhan chen lcags thang pa/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho rnams kyi 'dra sku mi tshad re/gtsang khang du thub pa mi tshad gnyis/ chos 'thor/mgon khang du gur sogs/ paṇḍi ta gong ma rnams kyi phyag dpe lca/rdzu sgyug gis bris pa mtshan nyid skor pod brgya tsam yod kyang

'thor/ grwa sum cu tsam/ dbyar mtshan nyid cung zad yod/g.yon ngos steng du chos bcu lha khang u rgyan 'jim sku gtso 'khor gsum mi tshad sogs/ shar du yang 'dul spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal bzhugs pa/ rgyal sras mu tig btsad pos bzhengs pa///sa chen phyag bzhi pa dang / thub pa/ sgrol ma sogs g.yu thab 'og na 'od dpag med sku chen po/rnam sras byin chen yod pa'i mgon khang / 'dir sgye ta hor bcom dus mu tig btsad po'i phyar dar bris sku nang na yod pa dang /mnga' bdag nyang zhabs lham/ steng na gnas bcu brag ri ma gsar bzhengs dod tsam/ rnying pa sgrol ma nyer gcig lha khang bcas/mar rgyang tsam na bo dong g.yu thog ces dge ba'i bshes gnyen mu tra chen pos btab/ bo dong 'jigs bral gyis bskyang ba'i bo dong e na/ 'du khang che/ zhug na gtsang khang thub sku li ma mi tshad gnyis//rdzu /la rgyan drug me tog shing bskos/ mu dra chen po'i chos brtsigs 'di'i steng ngos dgra bcom nyis brgya lnga bcu sogs che bar bris/dbu rtse na bo dong 'jigs bral chen po'i zangs gser gdung /443

spar thal sku mkhyid gang / 'dra zhal mi tshad zangs gser li ma sna tshogs brgya nye ba sogs/g.yas su lha mo bong zhon mgon khang / rgyab tu dmag zor ma'i mgon khang sa skya'i dam 'byar/ grwa sum cu tsam/ 'on kyang ser khyim shas che/ gtsang chu par kur dngul chu chos rdzong na 'dra zhal byin can dang / gru 'dzin dgon pa sogs snang /de nas khro phu na slebs pa'i rgyal ba byams pa khru brgyad cu zhes grags pa zhal/ 'dom do par grags pa zangs gser byon legs shin tu ngo mtshar ba khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bzhengs pa khyad 'phags bcu gsum dang ldan pa ste/ byams pas byams pa bzhengs zhes sku khyad 'phags/ (gcig)rta nag u rgyan sgrub phug tsho ba/ khro lung sna gsum nas zangs gter bzhes/ phyag mgo zhabs mgo bal yul mthil nas bzhengs/ sku sman 'bri gung sku stod mgar tshang khro zhes par bzhengs/ nang du gser gar blugs kyi thub pa/ rdo rje 'chang /dngul gar blugs rdo rje 'chang dang / phyag rdor sogs li ma sku rten lnga brgya gsung bka' 'gyur shog dril ma/ gser chos/ skya chos bcas cha gsum/ ga dmar po'i shog bur baiḍūryas bris pa'i 'bum sogs gsung rten dang / thugs rten brgya brgyad cu'i dang bzhugs yod pa/444

rgya gar rgyal pos phul ba'i rnam sras 'thag sku khyad 'phags/ zhuganyis)byams pa'i gos sku khyad 'phags/ (gsum)rgya nag rgyal pos phul ba'i gser gyi dam 'byar bla bre khyad 'phags/ (bzhi)mi nyag mkhan pos phul ba'i chos dung khyad 'phags/ (lnga)zangs gling rgyal pos phul ba'i dung dmar khyad 'phags/ (drug)rong g.yag sde nas phul ba'i mahril khyad 'phags/ (bdun)sbud bkra mkhan pos phul ba'i ka to ra khyad 'phags/ (brgyad)gar mkhan pagis phul ba'i rnga bo che khyad 'phags/ (dgu)dbon dge dar gyis phul ba'i shing paṇa mi'i ka ba khyad 'phags bzhi/ (bcu tham pa)shang pa dge slong gis phul ba'i rin po che'i bdar khyad 'phags rtse khru do pa/ (bcu gcig)mgar ba phyag rdor gyis phul ba'i rin po che'i gtigs chu ste shel rdo khyad 'phags/(bcu gnyis)paṇa chen buddha shrīs phul ba'i dge 'dun brgya shong ba'i rma bya'i sgro gdugs khyad 'phags sog jun gar nas gtor song ba bcas bcu gsum mo/ byams pa spyan mda' gang / zhabs gzhu gang /bzhengs na thog bco lnga bzhugs na zhal thog dgu bar grags so/ /'on kyang zhal ngo mtho chung chung bcu drug 'dom chung na do pa'am mtho bcu drugami chen po'i 'dom phyed do ma long tsam yod/ rgya mthong khar g.yas g.yon du khro phu lo tsā dang / thugs sras sems dpa' chen po bcas 445

'jim sku mi tshad rnying pa/ sbug cig pa la yab sras kyi zhabs rjes bzhi/ chos 'thor kha shas/bar khang thub pa thog thugs dang / spyan ras gzigs/ bla sku sgam bu can lnga bcu lhag 'brug kun legs li ma bcas/yang bla ma lha khang na/ 'brug lugs bka' brgyud gser phreng mda' tshad ma 'jim legs/ gtso bo pad dkar mi tshad/yang lha khang na/ byang star sgo'i mtsho'i nas gter nas byung ba'i byams pa mi tshad/ bde mchog lhan skyes mda' tshad/ li ma sna tshogs lnga bcu tsam/'og khang na ka ba brgyad cu tham pa'i ka ba 'ga' rer 'dom skor mi chud tsam/ g.yas g.yon thub pa li ma mi tshad/ chos brtsigs pod lnga brgya tsam/ sgo khar bde mchog bris legs/dgon mthar mchod rten chen po bang rim gsum la lha khang lnga lnga re drug cu dang / bum sgor lha khang bcas rdo yis bcigs pa leb zhad can yod kyang / phyis lcang skya bla ma zer bas nyams gso byed pa yin zlo/ nas sgo rdo char byas 'dug go/ /grwa sum cu tsam 'brug lugs 440ra 'dir gangs can chos 'phel ba yod/

chu mig tu ngor pas 'dzin pa'i grwa bzhi/ g.yas su kun rig thog ma slob slob 'jim sku/ rtsa lha so bdun mi tshad tsam yod pa chos rgyal srong btsan dus zer ba'i ngag rgyun tsam/ yang lha khang zhig tu byams pa rdzus skyes yin zer ba'i li ma mi tsam dang / dbus su thub sku li ma/g.yon du spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi li ma/ chos brtsigs ngos gsum drwa mig nyi shu re khyon drug cu/ drwa mig rer pod sum cu re khyon chig stong dgu brgya'i gser skya chos bcas yod/gzhis ka rtse'i shar du zur gsang sngags gling na/ sngags pa'i bla brang chung ngur/ rigs gsum mgon po'i 'jim sku re dang / bla sku kha shas/ shing phur zur chen thugs dam zer ba khru gang tsam pa 'dugapan nor bu dpal chen zhes par sngar zur gyi bla ma gong mas bzhings pa byin can yod rung phyis rkun mas bcom/ da lta gsar bzos yin 'dug pan gyi gser mdog can snga mo dar rgyas shin tu che rung deng sang rgyad/ shang pa don yod dpal ba'i bla brang na zangs gser sku gdung 'dom gang pa dang / sku 'dra li ma sna tshogs/ chos 'thor pod kha shas bcas/ gser mdog can 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis pa zhig gsos byas par paṇa chen shākya mchog sogs bla sku mi tshad lnga tsam/gtsang khang du byams pa 'dam sku/ chos 'thor kha shas/ thag tu thub 447

pa zangs gser legs pa mi tshad che tsam/ mdun du grong khyer ma'i sku khru gang khyad 'phags/ steng du gnas brtan brag ri ma 'jim/ gur zhal sogs phyag bzos mgon sku byin can/ ltag ngos byams khang dmar po hral nang byams chen thog tshad mtho nges gnyis zangs gser/ spyan gzigs/ 'jam dbyangs mi tshad bcas/ thub dbang /mar me mdzad mi tshad/g.yas su shāka mchog pa'i zangs gser sgo mang /g.yon du tā ra nā tha'i gdung / rgya mthongs khar 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa dang / shāka mchog zangs gser mi tshad/ don yod dpal de 'dra/rgya mthongs khar rtse gdong mkhan chen gdung zangs gser/ ngos bris thub chen mchog zung bcas thog gnyis ma sleb tsam pa mtshar/ sgo khar 'du khang rnying pa ka ba so lnga pa hrul/byams khang gcig na byams pa mi tshad zangs gser/ bka' gdams mchod rten brgya tsam yod/de'i g.yas pan gyi thag gi lung phur 'ug pa lha khang thams cad 'jigs nas mi rabs gcig tsam song ba der ma song bas gyang ral kyang spang du 'gro skabs red zer/ 'on kyang de'i phu nas la brgal nas da lta lding pa che'i dgon pa bsam 'grub chos lding zer ba sgrol ma ba'i gdan sa gcig yod par 'dug rnying ma'i sngags dgon che tsam gyi 448

shul yod zer/ bkra shis lhun po'i byang nas gtsang po pha rir bzhud nas 'og tu gong na rta nag gi lung pa'i phur 'gos khug lhas btsan gdan sa dang / mda' na rta nag sgrol ma phug pa sgrol chen bsam 'grub rdo rje'i gdan sa ma rme yod pa dang / de nas mdo mkhar na dpal chen po zhal gsum phyag drug pa zil byin gnyis ka che ba dang lha khang yod pa gnubs chen gyis bzhengs pa yin kyang zer/ zur ha shākya 'byung gnas red kyang zer ba phyi ma dag 'dra/de nas klan gyi gdan sa'i shul chu bal lung pa dang / de'i phu na rtse mo dgu 'dus ma brag rgya bo zhes zur chen gdan sa yod de da lta sngags dgon zhig yod zer/ gtsang po'i srub gtsang 'gram g.yas nas rgyang ring na dben dgon rgyal ba dben pa pa'i gdan ri de'i rtse mthong /de nas rim par zhol a ṇi dgong rong byams chen phur g.yung gi rdza sad mo mcho mthong snang 'gyur 'gro ba yod ces zer/gtsang po'i nyin nas nyug chos 'khor gling / yang dben rdo rje sgrom na gnubs chen gyi phug pa bsam yas mchims phu phyogs 'dra/rtses dong thob rgyal na bkra shis lhun po'i dga' ldan rab rgyas/ bon po'i sman ri/ phu na 'khrungs khang / de nas yon po ru lag g.yung drung gling la thug de'u yug mda' yin/449

gtsang po tshu rir don/ zla (10)tshes 25la sram brag tsi tta 'dra ba'i 'og do rje gdan brag la rang byon na/ shang mda' dpal chen lha khang ka drug ma/ sgo shub bskor lam bcas/ gzhung gis nyams gsos gnang / khro bo/ khro mo brgyad 'jim sku rnying pa chu la btab pa sogs las dpon tshe thung bar bshad/ gang ltar yang / dpal chen po zhal ngo mtho do/ sku spyir 'dom do pa 'dor stabs liṅga bsgrengs pa mgo phreng can/ phyag gnyis rdo rje gri thod kha sbyor/ dang po rngams zhal mthar bzhad zhal du song ba shin tu ngo mtshar ba/ 'jal na zil che ba/ rū tra pho mo byi chings bsnol ba/ me ri pa tra bal bris bal bzos tshugs/zhal ras rgya bal li tshugs/ yang yang bltas pas 'bral snying mi 'dod pa/ sku mthing nag dbu skra thor cog gseb rdo rje can/ zhal ras la gser gsar pa byug snang bas bdag gis kyang phul lo/ /g.yas g.yon du kau ri khro mo brgyad mda' gang pa gser bcas/ zur che chung / u rgyan rin po che/ rdor sems sogs sku gsar dang / gter sgrom shel sgo can dang / bcu gcig zhal 'dam sku shel sgo can sogs yod/skor lam nub byang jig rmang la zur chung pa'i gyad rdo chen po mjal du yod/ btsun ma lnga bcu tsam yod/ rgyab nas par ri sul 'phrang lam nas phyin pas/ zur po che'i bdud ci ka pa la gang blug shul/ sgrub chu 450

dwangs zhim mngar ba sman dri bro ba/'og gad g.yang gzar po'i ngos nas mar babs pas zhang mo yon tan rgyan sa phug zur chen la phul ba'i sa phug nyams skyid sa chen phug pa dang 'dra ba la/ bgrod dka' ba nang yangs pa snang / de nas gad pa'i nang mar ring du 'ong bas rdo khang du/ bla ma zur po ches ru lu'i dzab bro brdung bas zhabs rjes long bu man rdo la zug pa/ de 'og tu zur chung pa'i dbu thod thor cog spyan snyan/ rna rgyab dung rna bcas sa la spar btab lo ba/ rtse mo gzhan phyag rjes sa rdos sub nas mi mjal kyang yod nges par snang / mi ma yin gyis brtsigs pa'i rdo ra/ 'og na zur chung pa'i ru lu'i sgrub khang bcas mjal to/ /khyab tshang gzhis ka nas par rked la brgal nas/ brag dkar ltag spang ri ser ngos su dgon khra chung yod pa de/ 'ba' ra brag dkar stod 'brug bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gdan sa/ 'ba' ra nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nam mkha' rdo rje sogs rim byon gyi bla sku gdung rten li ma sogs mang /de nas yar 'ong bas chu pha rir shang dga' ldan chos 'khor zhes pa'i dge dgon chen po rnam gling rdzong 'og tu yod pa der grwa lnga brgya tsam/ sngar kurma gsung rab gling zhes pa'o/ /451

de nas yar ri ngos shing tshal dgon pa bde gshegs rab rgyas paṇa chen rin po che'i gzim khang sogs yod pa'i bkra shis lhun po'i dgon lag go/ /de dang nye bar sreg zhing yod/de nas shang zhang zhang du/ 'og gi lam khar mkhas grub khyung po'i zhabs rjes/ phyag mdzub kyis rdzu 'phrul gyis bris pa'i ma ṇi 'bru drugalha khang dmar po gcig sngar 'tshogs pa'i mthar thug khri tsho brgyad yod shul da lta ka gnyis mar/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyi 'dra sku mi tshad khyung po gdu bu pa rang gi phyag nas ma/ gangs ri thod dkar kun mkhyen klong chen 'dra zhal dang phyogs 'dra ba las dpral ba'i dbyes chung ba paṇa zhu gsol ba phyag gnyis ka sa non gyi rgya'o/ de'i g.yon du rin chen brtson 'grus kyi sku brnyan de 'dra tsam yod pa/ slob dpon rin po che sogs sku 'thor nyi shu tsam/ 'bum bris ma sogs/ phyi ngos g.yon du phyag drug pa'i mgon khang du phyag drug pa bzhengs 'phro la 'chams pa 'dra ba khru gang lhag pa/ phyi ngos 'og tu sa 'bum gnyis snang ba khyung po'i gdung rten dang / rin chen tshul khrims gdung yin ces so/ /deng sang rtogs ldan nas gzhon lnga snang / spyir rmog cog nas bdag tu 'dzin pa yin 'dugade nas yar hre mo bya ba'i lung pa brag dkar mang po yod par u 452

rgyan sgrub phug yod ces zer/de nas 'phrang lam lha tho dmar po yod pa 'phrang btsan ces zab bu'i phyi yi sgo srung / de nas tre'o chos kyi rgya mtsho'i sku phreng dpag bsam dbang pos btab/ gtsang pa sde srid pas yon bdag zhus/ lha khang mtho ba dang bcas pa'i dgon da lta grwa lnga bcu tsam pas/ kur lugs ber nag can/ rgyal rgyam/ tshes bcu rgyas pa/ zab bdun phur pa sogs 'tshogs shing bsgrigs lam yod pa'i dgon pa/ yar sdod hor bla ri yin skad pa'i brag steng kha gnon rta rna tre'o rin po che'i dgon par pha rir bde mchog gnas brag lcogs po rtse'i brag dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'dra ba'i thad/ 'od gsal phug ces tre'o chos kyi rgya mtsho dang po khams nas phebs skabs bzhugs pa'i sgrub phug lan der dgon gsham brag ka pā la 'dra ba'i steng du zhing skyong sku mkhar/ lha khang ka ba bcu drug sbug na 'ba' ra nam mkha' rgyal mtshan phyag bzo thub chen 'dam sku thog slob shin tu byin chags/ byams pa 'jam dbyangs mi tshad tsam pa bcas/ g.yas su tre'o dpag bsam dbang po'i gser dngul bkra ma'i dngul gdung 'dom do pa khyad mtshar/'dra zhal mi tshad/ g.yon du tre'o phrin las dbang po'i dngul gdung 'dom gang lhag453

'du khang ka ba bcu drug pa/ sbug tre'o chos kyi rgya mtsho'i 'dra sku byin chags/ g.yas su tre'o sku thog brgyad dang / skyes rabs/ bka' brgyud gser phreng mda' tshad/ sde srid gtsang pa rgyal pos phul pa'i bka' 'gyur bris ma khyad 'phags/ 'og tu rdo ra 'cham khang legs/tre'o'i gzim phug sgrol ma lha khang du sgrol ma brgya dang brgyad li ma mang tsam/ chos kyi rgya mtsho'i 'dra zhal byin chags/ de'i sbug tu yong tāX'i gro lod mgon khang ka bzhi mar gu ru chos dbang gis rdo la zhabs dpag bsam 'khri shing kur shod bris gsar rnying gnyis/chu khar tshe dpag lha khang du/ kur shod mtshan brgyad dgu thang bris legs/ gzum chung shel khang na sangs rgyas gling pa'i sku tshab bye ma a krong srin thod ma mtho gang pa sogs steng shod du phyi dang rten mang /tshe dpag lha khang dngos su ratna gling pa'i tshe sgrub gsang 'dus gtso bo rigs lnga mgyogs ma sgo ma bcas lha yongs rdzogs mi tshad shel sgo can lha khang ka ba bcu drug pa'o/ /de nas yar zab bu'i phyi sgor tom ba la to stong btsan gzi brjid 'bar ba/ de nas glang gla chung spyi 'brang / de nas yar lung phur/shangs lha su shin tu sa dpyad legs pa/ rgyal po gdan bzhugs/ blon 454

pos mtha' bskor/ btsun mos sman bro/ dmag dpon khrab chen/dmag mi dar thogs sogs sa dpyad bzang po yod/ pu to dgon zhes bka' gdams pa'i gdan sa/ nub tu sog po'i 'dzul khung nyin gcig lam ri nang brag phug tu 'dzul nas 'gro sa yod pas skye bo phal pa rnams zab bu sog po gnyis sog pos ngo mtshar rtsi che/ zab bu bar sgo thul 'phrang ngam rag 'phrang gdong nas yar rim spang steng chu tshan 'og ma yod sa nas rgyal srid sna bdun rnams yod/ brag dmar glang ma rdza nang sgo yin/ dar brag mi ring 'dra ba'i 'og nas sngar ltog pa zhig gis gser gter yod par thos nas brkos pas thog brgyab nas ltog pa shi ba yin/ 'di'i pha rir me zer ram/ ma tshor brag lha sku'i rnam pa can/ bgrod dka' ba'i ngos 'og tu mtsho rgyal sgrub phug steng du rta mgrin sgrub phug nang du chu yod pa skyid po/ de'i byang shar sngar 'dom bdun deng sang bcu gcig gzhal ba'i sar gnas yig na yod rgyu'i rdo'i rgyu rang byon dang / g.yung drung gnyis bar gter sgo de shin tu gsal bar yod/ g.yas su brag sha ba kha thur bstan/ g.yas su ma tshor gnyan gyi brag phug zla gam dbyibs nang du nyams spro ba/ rang byon mang / rtser brag phug yod zer/ chu tshan si si drag tu khol ba dmyal chu drung du song bas 'jigs snang skye nges/ chos rgyal gshin rje/ dmyal 455

ba'i snyed rdo gsum/ chu tshur kur rdo la ma ṇi rang byon/ par kur se phung yod sa der gser gter yod sa yin 'dra/ lung pa de nas rag rdo/ dngul rdo gnyis 'ong / de'i ltag ngos brag mda' rgyang yod/tshur ka zab bu phyogs thong bas rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol rdo la zhabs rjes/ kha tram̐ dang khur po'i rjes/ a rang byon/ sog jun gar ba'i mi rta bdun rdo char gyis brlag rjes/ sgrol ma rang byon sogs yod/ gter lung dang po dang gnyis pa bgrod dka' srub phyogs yod/ zab bu dgon par sleb/ zab bu lung pa'i bla brang nang rten du/ bka' rdzogs chen pa rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams dbu thod ser dum bu gcig yon tan lhun grub pa yin nam kun mkhyen chen po su yin ma nges g.yon du ring bsrel dka' 'bur/ srab shing lo can shin tu legs pa gas grum yod/ grub dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dbu thod khyung mchu dang slob dpon rin po che rang byon can/ rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol phyag phreng dung phreng / gter lung bdun pa nas lha sras mu khri btsad pos gu ru rin po cher spos 'dzin phul ba li yi bse ru/ rus sbal khog pa ri bo rtse lngar rtsis gsung pa'i brda de gu ru'i gter sbas pa tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gter ma rtse khru gang / mtsho rgyal phyag gdub rang byung zangs las byas pa tshangs pa gdong gsum dang lha 456

sku bco lnga can/ grub thob kerma gling pas byang gnam mtsho'i bya dung nam mkha' de nas gter bzhes pa mu tig g.yas 'khyil chung / u rgyan chibs ngang pa gser ldan tshems rigs gsum mgon po rang byon can/ zab lung pha waṃ smyug sha ma nas rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol gyis gter nas bzhes pa'i slob dpon li ma gtso 'khor gsum mtho gang bal li 'dra la zad nyams che ba zangs gzi khyim dmar po'o/ /bdud pho ma tram̐ ru tra'i drod tshil las zangs mdog dpal ri'i dbyibs/ rdo ser po la mtsho rgyal phug dang / glang chen rang byon can/ gu ru rin po ches gangs dkar sha med dam btags gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu mi mgo can mtho gang / rdo rje legs pas brgya dang brgyad brdung gras gcig mi mgo can rtse lnga mkhyid gang pa/ ratna gling pas 'o yug ra yag brag skam nas spyan drangs pa lcags rdor rtse lnga mkhyid gang / gnam mtsho'i se mo do nas kurma gling pas spyan drangs pa'i dur khrod dga' ba tshal gyi rdo nag la rdo dkar g.yas 'khyil/ mang yul gung thang la thog slob dpon rin po ches rdo phyag bcing ngo mtshar ba rje 'bangs rnams la dad rten du bstsal ba/ ye shes mtsho rgyal sgom thag rdo rje rtse lnga phred rgyug 'thag pa ras dkar/ klu 'jim mchod rten brgyad/klu 'jim thub pa srong btsan sgam po'i dgongs rdzogs rgya gar shar li'i 457

spyan ras gzigs/ rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol gyis ma tshor nas gter bzhes pa'i phyag rdor/ kun skyong gling pa'i 'jam dbyangs chag gang nyams mtshar/ thub pa grong khyer ma klu 'jim/ bya btang grag shel gyi sgrub phug tu rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol gyis dang por rdo gla ba sgrug por phyag stong spyan stong rang byon bcas/'du khang spug gtsang khang ka bzhir/ rgya gar nas 'phur 'ong ba red zer kyang chos nyid rang grol nas bzhengs pa gu ru shin tu byin can mi tshad 'jim rnying bag dro ba/ chos longs bcas khang bzang yod/mtshan brgyad 'jim sku sgros ye mi gtsang ba sogs/ 'du khang ka brgyad/ sngags pa bdun cu tsam gyis dgongs 'dus dang / le brgyad ma 'don/ zhal thang legs po zangs mdog dpal ri sogs yod/ltag der rtogs ldan gyi sgrub phug shel phug ces lha khang zhig gi phur mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal sgrub phug yang mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal phyag phreng 'thor ba yin zer ba'i mchod rten brgya dang brgyad/ yang dpal ldan 'bras spangs zer ba'i mchod rten chen po yod/ gzhan lha khang 'ga' yod kyang 'brog pa'i lha khang yin/ thad ka der gter lung gsum pa nyams skyid pa'i khyung gshog pa brgyang nas gnam 'phur 'dra ba'i lung par rdza spang 'dres ma'i la la ring du 'dzegs pas/ thog mar 458

gu rus klu 'dul sgrub phug rdza gseng zhig gi nang na chen po 'phrang lam can/ steng du sa skya dbang sdud snying po'i sgrub phug sogs dang sgrub phug gsum tsam/ yang la gzar mo la 'dzegs pas mtsho liṅga khrag mtsho/rnag mtsho'i 'og gi g.yas spang steng pha waṃ legs pa de sa 'phar 'dra yin pas de'i zur der gter yod/ lung pa de na shin tu nyams skyid par snang / zab lung dgon pa'i ltag gi brag ri shug pa spa ma thar thor yod pa'i brag bzang po de zangs mdog dpal ri zhes 'dogs/ khyung gshog nyin gter lung gi sum mdo'i sngo leb ma g.yu'i maṇḍal brag leb steng rdo mang po spungs pa de yin/ de nas lung pa 'khyogs po'i gter lung bzhi pa dang lnga pa song mtshams sgrol ma gong 'og gnyis thad der phung po ri dang / dkar leb ma dung gi maṇḍal/ gter lung drug par 'das nas bdun pa'i thad spang na gzhung dbyar kha shin tu nyams skyid/ mtshor stod 'dir shing nags med/ mtshor glang sur shug gsum dri zhim mang / gter lung bdun pa thod pa rdzas bkang 'dra/mtsho skum po maṇḍal lta bu yod/ bgrod bde/ g.yas kyi rdza zur pha waṃ nag po'i ltag 'og sgrub phug de u rgyan sgrub phug yin/ stong shong 'bum rdugs zer/ de ltag der padma rgyal po dang / de nas gu ru'i chos khri pad sdong 'dra ba ri rtser gang nas bltas kyang mjal ba/ dbyar de nas 459

lho nub bkra shis lhun po'i lcang tshal tshun chad byang jo mo gangs dkar/thang lha/ 'o yug rdor legs tshun mthong / chos khri'i mdun der rdza shol dang / brag ri de bskor nas gser rdo bzang po de 'ong / ltag na gangs nang mtsho dang / lung phug mtsho yod/ yang byang rdza ri'i rtser ri mi hring 'dra ba gsum srin po pho mo dam la btags pa yin zer/ zab bu dgon rgyab zangs mdog dpal ri'i lung phu nas rgyang bltas byas pas byang du sbas yul yod/ da lta skabs su byis lham chus khyer ba sogs 'ong zer/ zab bu'i phu 'dir sga zhes bya ba sngo chu dug yod pas mtsho brag bar na 'dug gser rdo dngul rdo 'dra yod pas kyang yin par 'dug gter lung gi bcu gcig pa na brag dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'dra ba legs/ gter lung bcu gsum pa ni la gong yin/ byang shar na mtsho chen de nag ting ma'i mtsho/ gangs ri de shar sgo srung ba rmu bdud lcags ra yin/ de nas 'o yug nub lung pa nas rdza la brgal mtsho 'gram nas mar ring du phyin pas ri khyad mtshar brag mi dang sde brgyad 'dra ba mang po yod pa/ a ṇi dgon pa zhig gi 'gram du/ paṇa chen rin po che tsha gzim gnang yul tsha chu dwangs ma legs po yod/rab dkar gzhung la sleb nas par phyogs der brag dkar dgon pa ni bka' gdams dge ba'i bshes gnyen brag dkar ba'i gdan 460

sa/ grwa drug cu tsam/ thub pa lha 'brum lan gnyis bzhes pa'i li ma mi tshad chung sogs byin can gyi rten kha shas yod/yang chu gzhug la ring du phyin pas ri ser smug dang dag po chen po'i 'gram/ 'o yug gos sngon lha khang ni/ chos rgyal srong btsan gyis srin mo gan rkyal lag mgor mtha' 'dul byang phyogs tshangs pa rlung gnon gyi lha khang yin/ khrug tu lha khang ka bzhir rnam snang thog phyed gnyis pa dang / g.yas su yum sher phyin thog sleb/ g.yon du thub dbang thog sleb/ nye sras brgyad/ khro bo king rkang bcas 'dom do ma long tsam pa 'jim sku sngon gyi bzo rnying byin ldan/ mdo khyams na u rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i 'dra zhal mi tshad byin ldan/ grwa nyi shu lhaganam mkha'i snying po'i mchod rten zhes pa dkar po/ skor lam du bca' ka 'dras bkang nas mi thar/g.yas su lha khang ka bzhir/ u rgyan chen po nyang ban gdung rgyud zhig gis bzhengs pa thog sleb byin chags/ steng na sangs rgyas rab bdun mi tshad/ 'og na gu ru mtshan brgyad mi tshad bcas/g.yon na lha khang ka bzhir/ rje btsun byams mgon thog sleb bal bzas bzhengs skad pa/ snga mo'i gos 'khyud shin tu mang ba chu gnyer ma 'dra ba'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bzhengs pa mi tshad re/461

rnam snang la zhal yar lta'i lha khang ka bzhir/ dbus su dam can gter sgrom/ g.yas su stod slob dpon chen po'i phyag bzos/ smad nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i phyag bzos/ skyes bu dam can zhal bzhad pa/ dbu la 'ob zhu dmar po/ g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon sdig mdzub thugs ka nas/ bod pa'i jo jo'i gos gyon pa lta bu/ 'og tu dur khrod bsil tshal rdo nag las grub pa rwa dngos su skyes pa'i gdong rwa g.yon du bstan nas nyal ba'i ra ma tsho brjid steng du dam can bzhengs pa'o/ /dam can g.yas nas gsang bdag gos sngon can thog sleb gtor sgom g.yon du yum chen po lcags ral ma zhwa theb gyon pa'i 'brog mo dal yol zhig khrel bgad byas pa lta bu bzhengs pa/ g.yon na rta mgrin dmar po thog sleb/ sgo g.yas g.yon rgyal chen bzhi thog sleb/rgya mthongs steng nas mar dam 'byar khro bcu'i lha khang steng g.yu thab gardzi ra gser tog bcas/sgo khar chos rgyal khri srong gi me mda' stong phrag gi grab phyam/mda' gzhu/ mdung grangs med/ bal sogs rgya bod ral gri 'dra min du ma/ de nas chos rgyal khri srong phyag shan ba so'i yu ba can/ khri ral phyag shan mgo leb chen sogs rngams brjid dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yon du gshin rje dregs 'joms thog sleb/ bka' brgyad 462

bskyed rdzogs bsdus pa/ rol mtsho'i mgon khang bcas yod do/ /de phar tshur la dgon chung kha shas yod/ yang ring du 'ong bas 'o yug 'jom pa zhes tshong 'dus gong nas phar phyin pas la sked na/bka' gdams pa ram lding ma bas btab pa'i dgon na/ ston pa dang /lding ma ba'i 'dra zhal/da rje yab sras sogs/dgayas su gnas bcu khang / g.yon du smyung gnas khang / ltag na lding ma ba'i sa 'bum chen po nyams gsos byas pa/ mdun rgyab chu myong grol 'jigs byed sgrub chur grags/ grwa lnga bcu tsam yod do/ /de nas yar gling dkar gzhis sdod rdzong yod pa'i lung pa phur/lce btsun rin po che 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i gnas/ rdza ra shug pa/ spa ma spang / brag phug sogs yod pa/ da lta gru gu rtogs ldan rin po che'i phrin las las sgrub sde brgyad bcas yod/ de nas yar 'o bran gyi gzhis ka gong der brag la mgon po rang byon/ 'o bran gdung rgyud de'i khyim du/ gnub chen phyag bzos dpal ldan lha mo/ 'o bran sgrub phur tsan dan sbrul snying / gnam lcags rdo rje phur pa sogs yod/de nas yar jo mo gangs dkar dang nye ba'i lung phu nas la brgal ring du 'ong bas mtha' 'dul rab dang / de nas sa phu ring po nas sis phu la brgal te/ sis rna gzhung / byang yangs pa can/ gnam lha 463

brgyad gangs ris bskor ba/ dbyar nyams su dga' ba/ dgun grang ngad che ba nas mtshur phu la phyin par gyur to/ /'dir kurma pa'i gzhi byes gnyis kyi nang rten rnams mjal ba'i tho gong du bris yod/zhwa dmar grags pa seng ges btab pa'i lho brag dpa' bos bskyangs pa gnas nang du 'du khang ka ba bcu drug pa'i nang / bka' 'gyur bris spar cha gsum dang / bstan 'gyur ko khams rer pod bzhi rer byas pa lnga bcu nga gcig zung 'jug brgyud rim ri mo mtshar/gtsang khang nang mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs 'dra sku/ mtshur phu'i lha chen bzo phud thub pa mi tshad li sku dang / byams pa zangs gser thog sleb dang / me thub chu thub thub sku gser zangs mi tshad gnyis/ rwa lo'i thugs dam sman 'dam 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs/ zhwa dmar 'dra sku drug bka' gdams gdung rten li ma mda' gang lhag g.yas gser gdung khang / zhwa dmar grags seng gdung bye ma dang gser bsres pa thog sleb/ mgon po rgyal mtshan dang / dar ma rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gdung rten chung ngu re/ tre shod bsod nams rgyal mtshan sku gsung 'byon ma/ tshe lha rnam gsum dang rdor sems 'jim sku byis pa tsam/ mgon khang du phyag drug pa dang / dgongs btsan rol pa rkya 464

bdun/ bdud 'dul phur pa'i gtor sgrom/ dngul gdung khang na/gtsug lag chos rgyal dngul gdung thog sleb/ g.yon du gtsug lag nyin byed dang / gsang yum bcas kyi dngul gdung gsum tsam/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum zangs gser mi tshad/ gzim chung nang dngul gyi ga'u gcig na chos rje gling pa'i gter ma rgyal po gtsug 'dzin phyag ngar la gu ru rang byon/ 'ja' tshon gter shel sogs rten sna sum cu dkar chag can yod/yod/bla zang gong ma na mgon khang dang dpe mdzod mang po dam 'byar stod lung dga' ba gdong rje rin po che'i bla ma dbu ma pa'i dgon sa/ dpa' bo rdo rje'i sgrub phug rje'i sku byin ldan sogs/ da wamada' dngos grub lding gong der ser srung sdod pa'i sgrub khang na/bal po smon lam seng ge zhes rje nā ro pa'i slob ma/ pham mthing pa'i slob ma zhig dbus su byon/ rje ras chung pa dang mjal/ stod lung mdar sgrub khang btab pa'i nang gu ru jo tses zangs yag brag nas gter bzhes pa'i rgyu sna khri smug po shin tu bzang po las grub pa dpal rdo rje phur pa'i sku mtho gsum zhal byin chags/ 'khor g.yon du yum phur li ser/ g.yas su sras mchog khro bo bcu/ khro mo bcu bcas 465

bskum khru re li ser sgo ma bzhi'i shar du khro gdong bya mchu ring po can li rgyu khyad 'phags phur sgrom bcas/ 'dzin bdag spyir 'bras spungs blo gsal gling / bye brag smon lam seng ge'i khyim mi brgyud lags dngos grub lding ba yod/ rten sgam na/ u rgyan rin po ches gangs dkar sha med dam la btags pa'i rdo rje ser po dzhai khri mi mgo ltag sprod ma rtse dgu sor lnga/ smon lam seng ge'i dbu thod skam ma mgal med pa/ ku ku ri pa'i dug sbrul pags pa'i sgom thag nā ro pa'i dung chos legs po/ ku ku ri pa'i tsan dkar kha ṭwāṃ/ bal po a su la/ mkha' 'gro ma padma wa ra'i rus rgyan/ smon lam seng ge'i rdo rgyus sgom thag gzhung bzhes song shul dum tsam sogs yod/ sa lug zla12tshes 29la rtse dang mi ru'i gtor rgyags nyin lha bar sleb bo/lcags sprel zla 1tshes 1lha gdan kun bzang rtser lo gsar/ thag rgyug smon lam gral 'dzin/ rgyal ba bcu gsum pa tshes brgyad nyin tshogs pheb chibs bsgyur chen mo smar khams tshong dpon spo 'da' bu nyi rgyal pa dang / 'on rgyal sras rin po ches rgyu sbyar/ tshes bco lnga la phyi rol gsung chos ra bar stag mo lus sbyin skyes rabs bsdus pa gsungs rung / gsung lu skyon gyis mgul 'cham lab pa dang / grwa dang khrom mang 'ur nas ye ma thos/ bco lnga mchod par bla ma brgyud pa'i mchod 466

pa zhal zas ko ba mar gyis shan nas gsang thag 'then chog pas gnas chung chos skyong dang zhal ngo spre'u bzhin rgyug pa'i 'phrul sogs dang / mi tshogs chen po'i ltas mo/ 'di nub rgya gar cha byad dmag mi ser po rnams skor lam du 'gro bas phyi gling pa sleb pa 'dra ba'i nyams shar/skyabs mgon pheb/ gos chen ser po'i gzim gur nang cung bzhugs nas pheb song / tshes nyer gsum phyi mar gtor rgyags kyi mi rta pa dang /'bras spungs sngags pa'i gtor rgyags/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang gtor rgyags bcas la rgya gser phrag kheb can/ gser dang / rgya rag gser ma'i spos phor pa bcu bcu skyems phor pa gnyis/ gos chen bzang po'i dar mdung rten thug thog so re lhag nyi shu rtsa lnga / slob dpon pa so so'i zhal ngo bcas bzang mod/ 'on kyang chos skyong 'khor ba'i srog gnad sogs dang / 'khor lo bla rdo sogs yod par mi 'dug cos skyong rgyal po'i gsob tu 'dren dang bcas pa'ang pheb mod/ zil chags po ma byung / lung bstan gyi stobs las/ sku rten da lta btang snyoms su kha ri 5tham zer/ zla gam par rgyab 'phen mgo snam mang / sbub brgyad re 4sil gnyis re/ gser rnga brgyad cu rnams spus legs/ gzhung gi snga srol rta dmag tsho legs po snang / 'on kyang dgra bla 'khor bas mi ye mi snang / smon lam tshogs bzhugs dge 'dun khri gcig dang / gtso bor 467

skal lhag bcas stong tsho brgyad yod par bshad pas stong tsho bcu drug tsam smon lam tshogs pheb dang / 'phros stong gcig tsam dgon gsum na yod nges 'dug ltad mo 'di tsho 'bri rgyu ci'ang med mod/ don du dge 'dun mang po 'di lta bu'i zhal mjal ba la dag snang gi mos gus bgyis so/ /bla brang thog kha nas/ gnas chung grwa tshang / zhabs brtan 'bul mkhan mang / lab sprul sku rin po che rgya chas can dang / smin gling khri chen/ khu nus rtsis pa de wa ra sogs bcas sbug rnam par 'dren pa'i gser zhal mig gi bdud cir thob/ khyams ra na/ rjes su rtse nas asgo dang po'i spa dar gnang ba se ra ba red kyang zer/ dge bshes khams 'brog lo lon gcig dam bca' bzhugs/ rtse zhwa dzor dzor byed nas gyon/ rigs lung pa zhig gis rkang pa brdab/ gzan sked dkris byas nas/ g.ya'/ ma rig pa yin na rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan ma rig yin par thal/ 'dod yi/ 'o na byang 'phags rgyud kyi ma rig pa chos can/ khyod der thal/ zer nas thal mo gdeng gdeng byed pa la/ 'dod yi zer/ 'o na 'khor rgyu ma spang ba'i byang sems mthong lam pa yod par thal zer/ gong der dge bshes rgan song cha shas rub rub shub shub byas pas/ rtags ma grub zer/ 'o na rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyur pa'i ma rig pa 468

de 'khor rgyu'i ma rig pa min par thal/ tsha'i zer ba la/ rtags ma grub kyi lan btab bo/ /mtshams der g.yon nas rigs lung pa zhig lang byung bas snga ma de shed kyis bskrad pas snga ma des kyang phar bgrad tshur bgrad nan tan mthar shed dang ham pa g.yon pas che bas/g.yas pa de khros nas bzhin dmar po gyur nas 'dug song / des ki'i/ g.ya'/ theg chen 'phags par las nyon gyis 'chi ba yod par thal/ zer/ ci'i phyir/ ki'i/ 'khor gsum/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod srid rtse'i ma rig pa rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/rkang pas brdab/ lag pas 'dzing 'dra 'then 'dra byed/ rtags ma grub zer byung / rigs lung pa thogs thogs byed pa la/ thong shog zer/yang g.yon nas grwa pa gcig lang / des snga ma de bskrad/ de'ang bzhin dmar por song /khos/ki'i/kun brtags kyi ma rig pa yin na/rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi sogs 'brel med med 'dra ba 'phen/ der tshogs ska byas pa dang mi mang tshab tshub mthar bzhag mtshams med pa zhig thog lus song / gong der sprul sku sku gzhon rtse zhwa legs pa mnab mkhan kha shas 'dug kyang de rnams phal cher gsung bcad la mnal chog pa dmigs gsal yin 'dug tshogs chen de grol ring lha klur don gnyer ba mang tsam la dbang chos 'dra byas pa yin rna/ /469

lha sa nas rten kha shas mthong byung bar/ spu bo stag sham sprul skus bsnams 'ong ba/ stag sham gter ma li ser phur pa phra men smad gnam lcags can khru gang / lcags kyi rdo rje ra gdengs pa pad bkod byang sgo nas bzhes pa/ dga' ba lung gi gter ma srin thod zhabs bkag gu ru bye ma a krong ma paṇa zhu bde ba chen po 'chos se ba/dang po rtsa ra ba dbang phyug nyi ma'i lag nas rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i dbu zhwa rnying pa kha tshang / mchog gling gter sras tshe dbang grags pa'i sprul sku'i phyag nas mchog gyur gling pa'i gter byon gu ru'i sku tshab/ kong po nga phod phog dpon lag nas rig 'dzin sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter byon gu ru drag po'i sku li dmar dang / sku tshab byin ldan mjal/ pho brang chen mo po ta lar sngar lo las zhib pa'i lha khang nyi shu rtsa bdun tsam la mchod mjal rgyas pa zhus/ kun bde gling gzim chung khyad 'phags phan tshun thams cad dang /'du khang dang /rta tshags gong ma na rim sku gdung gser ldong legs po sogs mjal/tshe smon gling / mi ru ba dang / ra bsgreng ba'i gzhi sde rnams mjal rto/lha sar lha klu la sngon gyi lha bris phul du gyur pas bris pa'i rgyal ba'i 'khrungs rabs kung ka bcu gsum pa dang / mtha' shan tshad 'gran bral re 'ga'/ bsam 'grub pho brang na rgyal mchog gi yab bsod 470

nams stobs rgyal gyis bzhengs pa'i/ padma rgya bya/ thon thi/ ding phon/ tā hun/ gnas brtan sku rags/ hor gos ma nu/ gser jus gsang lam sogs sbyar ba'i rgyal ba'i 'khrungs rabs thang ka bcu gsum pa nang sha mdzod gos ser pos byas pa dmag dus sbas pa sogs mthong / rdo ring dang / ra ga gshag sogs sde dpon chen po rnams la sngon gyi thang rnying legs po yod pa phal cher nye char rgya dmag dus brlag pas ye mi snang ngo / /chos srid 'byor pa brgya phrag 'du ba'i gnas/ /dbus 'gyur lha gdan ni tsā la yi tshal/ /rten gsum rgya mtsho mchod sprin rgya mtshos bskor/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho rnam dkar rgya mtsho rgyas/ /ri rnams dpyad tshang skyid shod rgya che yangs/ /'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug phrin las kyi/ /dge mtshan bye brag 'khor lo nam du'ang / /rgyun mi chad pa lag na pad mo'i zhing / /mi bdag che rnams khengs pa'i ri bo mtho/ /tshangs pa rnams ni g.yo sgyu'i 'phrang la 'grim/ /dan 'bag rags rgyab khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /'jigs rung sgyu ma'i gnas su 'jigs pa'ang / /gdong na thal sbyar rgyab nas thal ba gtor/ /'phrad lang med par ha las gnam sa tsam/ /'dri rgyu ma khom mgo bsgril yid sun pas/ /sprel rgan gdung rgyud 'khrul med dbus 'dir 471

ngos/ /nyin re bzhin du ltas mo mi 'dra re/ /bro re bzhin du phyogs kyi gtam gsar re/ /yud tsam re la sngar ma mthong ba brgya/ /ji tsam bsdad kyang yengs ma lam du 'gro/ /za bar 'dod dang lta bar 'dod pa dang / /smra bar 'dod pa chu bo'i gnyer ma ltar/ /mtha' med 'gro ba 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid las/ /lhag par 'gro ba lha ba'i yul 'di'o/ /mchog gsum rten gsum rgya mtshos mtha' bskor la/ /phyag mchod mjal bas thar pa'i sa bon theb/ /chos dang yon tan lhag na shugs kyis mtho/ 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i sa 'di skyid pa'ang 'dra/ /gos rgyan mtho dman bkod dang 'byor pa'i 'grigs/ /legs shing rgyal srid 'byor pa thams cad kyang / dkon mchog mchod rgyur phal cher 'gro sogs kyis/ chos ldan gzhung rgyal 'dzam gling phal las lhag phra ma mang zhing cam bur dga' ba dang / /mi dgos dogs mang nor rdzas dga' ches skyon/ /grub mtha'i phyogs lhung phyogs 'dzin cher gyur pas/ /'grogs par dka' ba yul 'di'i mtshan nyid do/ /nyams mtshar du smras pa'o/ /lha gdan nas khams la btegs pa'i mar lam 'phan yul du/glang thang nas lha khang rnying pa ka drug mar/ dbus su glang thang pa/stag lung pa/ 'bri gung thang pa gsum gyi sku 'dra re/ brtags pa zhu 472

snod ljon gyi mtshan thub tā ming mtshan yig can/ logs na khung yod kyang chu mi shad/ nyes na chu 'dzag pa/ g.yas su glang thang pa'i thugs dam thub sku li ma mi tshad las kyang che ba rgyan drug sa 'jim/ rdo rje 'chang gser sku li ma mi tshad/ pu to ba'i thugs dam mchod rten zangs gter 'dom gang / bka' gdams mchod rten glang ri thang pa'i gdung ring bsrel yod pa/ byams mgon nyi zer zla zer du grags pa'i 'jim sku/ spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan gdung hril bzhugs zangs gser mchod rten thugs dam 'bum thel spang / rje rin po che zhabs bskyang ba'i sku/ phyi rol skor lam na gza' grib dang mdze la phan pa'i mchod rten cha shas/ grwa sum cu tsam mo/ /kun mkhyen rong ston pa chen po'i gdan sanā le nt+rar/ tshogs chen spang thang byang gzigs/ sa nyams skyid la 'du khang ka ba bzhi bcu zhe gnyis pa/ g.yas su mgon khang du gur lha brgyad sogs/ dbus su gtsang khang sgor rang ston bzhugs khri'i dbus su rong ston zhal ngo 'bur 'bur 'dra ba chos 'chad can/ g.yas su sku mkhan rabs sku gdung gsum/ drug g.yas seng khrir rgyal chen sde bzhi gur bcas shar ngos la yod pa'i gser dngul bkra ma'i mchod sdong shin tu legs par rong ston chen po'i gdung nor bu'i dbyig tu gyur cing ring bsrel pha 473

lam du gyur pa de bzhugs/ mchod rten 'dom phyed do tsam/ dbus su 'dom do pa rong ston phyi rten/ dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal nas bzhengs pa'i thub chen zangs gser shin tu byon legs/ de'i mdun thub sku 'dom gang pa/ g.yon du zhwa lu mkhyen rab chos rje'i zangs gser gdung / nye sras sgo srung bcas mi tshad lhag re/ bka' bstan spar ma cha re zung / 'du khang g.yon ngos lam 'bras bla rgyud mda' gang tsam/ rgyal khang pa nag po zhig na rong ston chen pos bzhengs pa'i mgon khang dang / zhug na kun mkhyen rong ston bzhugs khri sogs yod/ a mdo khang tshan/ tsha ba khang tshan/ rgya rong khang tshan/ yang bla brang la bco brgyad pa'i bla brang gzim 'og bla brang bcas/ grwa sum brgya tsam mo/ /byang du thag ring tsam phyin pas/ rgyal chen rnam sras kyi sku'i dbyibs yod pa'i ri'i gsham du/ bka' gdams sha ra ba yon tan grags pa'i gdan sa 'bras spungs dgon lag a ṇi dgon pa yod/dung dkar rang byon rdo chung mang po don/ g.yas su sha ra ba rang gi rdo yi mchod rten na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dkar yol gang dang / sha ra ba'i phyag g.yas sogs bzhugs pa byin rlabs shin tu che/ g.yon du ra gcig zhes sha ra ba'i lcam sring ra gcig ma'i zho dge 474

'dun stong phrag brgyad la zho ston drangs nus pa de'i gdung dang zho khagade'i shar du mkha' 'gro nam mkha' 'bum dang / shes rab 'bum gdung / de'i shar khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gdung cha shas yod pa'i gdung / de'i nub po to ba'i dngos slob ram lding ma ba'i ring bsrel yod pa/ de'i byang shar mchod rten bzhi ni sha ra ba'i brtan bzhugs dge slong tshul khrims dag pa brgyad kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i shar chu bcud len mdzad pa'i grub thob mched gnyis gdung dang /shar gyi mchod rten lho mar dbus smyon grub thob gdung rus yod pa dang /byang na kun mkhyen rgyal ba chen po'i gdung / byang gi mchod rten na po to ba'i ma nam mkhar 'bur nus kyi gdung / de'i shar sa phud rdo phud las rang byon 'bum pa/ de'i byang shar po to ba'i thugs rdog bdun gyi gcig bzhugs pa'i nang nā ro pa'i gsol lhung beeḍūrya nang shāka thub ring bsrel bre gang yod pa/ nā ro pa'i phyag dpe sogs yod pa/ de'i mdun po to ba'i nye gnas grub thob gsum gyi mchod rten dang / de'i byang shar du po to ba'i slob ma brag dmar stag rtse ba'i mchod rten dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyi bshes gnyen dang / sna ra ba/ sma rtsa ba/ lcags khyim pa/ ko khyim pa rnams kyi gdung dang / po to ba'i dpe cha bzhugs pa gur khang mchod rten dang / de nas lcags ri'i gong 475

khang pa chen po'i dgung lo brgyad bzhugs pa'i mchod rten tshe sgrub mchod rten dang / mdun du gtum ston snar thang blo gros grags pa'i ring bsrel yod pa/ de'i nub na brag ri lo rtswa ba'i mchod rten dang /de'i nub na bla ma brag nag pa'i mchod rten dang / de'i lho na bla ma mnga' ris pa dang / nub na bla ma bde chos pa dang / snar thang pa'i lho'i nang gser gling pa'i thugs/ 'brom ston pa'i dbu lo/ dwags po'i ring bsrel sogs yod pa/ 'chad kha pa'i gdung / nub na sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar ba'i gdung mi g.yo ba'i sku byon pa lnga bcu dang /de'i nub na phu chung ba'i gdung dang / de'i zur chos dbyings rang grol bla ma'i gdung sogs sman mo spun gsum/ 'di'i shar zing pa ltag mgo ba'i mchod rten padma gling pa'i slob ma zhig gi gdung dang / de'i nub gser mdog paṇa chen rdor rgyal ba'i gdung / nub na spyan snga ba'i gdung rten dang / de nas rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ bla ma ban rog pa/ snan mo ba/ kun dga' bsam gtan/ bya yul ba/ brag dkar ba/ grub thob ḍā ma ru pa sogs kyi gdung / sha ra ba'i mdun na yig drug rang byon/ bla chen mdun tsong kha pa'i zhabs rjes/ 'du khang na lharang byon sogs yod/ dkar chag las bshus pa'o/ /476

'phan po mda' nas mar ring du phyin pas chu par kur ri rtser lcang lung / 'phan po mdar mi la'i za khag sogs yod par grags pa'i mchod rten chen po brag ri gru khar yod/de nas gru don te dga' ldan rgyab ri nas yar la chen po khug pa bcu bdun 'dzegs pas/ dga' ldan gser khang khang tshan du gnas mal byas nas/ g.yas bskor gyis mchod mjal la phyin pas ri bor dga' ldan byang rtser/ rje bkra shis rdo kha ma/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang zhal dkar yu ring / sangs rgyas glang po'i skye ba bzhes pa'i tshems yin zer te ba so'i thub dbang mdzad bcu sne gdong rtse tshogs pa'i gnas brtan do gral/ mkhas grub thugs dam 'jigs byed li ser khru gang / byams sku mi tshad/ gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor/ li sku bzhi bcu tsam/ dngul sku mthong ba don ldan bka' gdams gong ma'i ring bsrel gcig bsdus zhal byang ltar/ klu 'jim mdzad bcu/'bri gung pas rje rin po cher phul ba'i phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sku li dmar khru gang mkhas grub rje'i dbu zhwa dang maṇḍal/ rje rin po che'i bzhugs gding / nus rgyan sogs thum/ hor ston nam mkha' dpal /shāng kha ṭwāṃ rdo rje rtse lnga ma/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang sho ga 477

khri thog khang du/ rje rin po che'i gzim spug na myang 'das bzhugs khri/ 'dra sku ngos bris/ dpa' bo 'ja' tshon ma/ phyag rdor 'khor chen dkyil 'khor/ phyag dpe na bza' dam 'byar skor/ rgyal paṇa dga' ldan khri rin po che bcas kyi gzim chung shel sgo ma mdo na khyams chen ka ba bcu gnyis nang gsang bde 'jigs sogs/ li 'dra mda' tshad ma ha las re dang / rje sku mi tshad/ gsung 'byon dam 'byar/ phyag dpe yig rnying pod brgya tsam/ bzhugs khri khang na/zangs gser khri/ tshe smon gling pas sa khri g.yogs pa chos rgyal thim pa/ dbu gdugs ser po tā ling gis thob phul ba/ byams pa mthong grol bcas mkhas grub phyag bzo/ rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro/ 'khor dag pa brgyad/ gser gdung khang ka brgyad mar/ phyi nang gur chen po'i nang rje yab sras gsum gyi gdung gser dngul thog sleb gsum/ klong rdol gser kong / mchod me/ maṇḍal chen po/ gos chen padma rgya bya sogs kyi mchod rdzas 'gran bral legs/ yang dngul gdung drugamakha' spyod zhal thang / rje rin po che'i tshems yod pa'i dngul gyi mchod rten/ lhung bzed/ gsol dkar/ tā ming ma'i bde mchog rgya gar li ma'i gsang 'dus bum sku/ bder gshegs lha khang du/ gser gdung dngul gdung bcu gsum/ khyams na gdung gsum/ bla ma lha 478
