khang na bka' 'gyur ljags klog ma/ rje tsā rir pheb pa'i bla ma grags pa'i sku brgyad tsam/ dbu rtser li ma khang na li rnying brgya lhag tsha gar no mi han/ tshe smon gling sogs khri rabs dngul gdung bcu gsum/ blos bslang khang na/ rje dus bzhengs pa'i gsang bde 'jigs gsum blos bslang / rje nga 'dra ma'i lha khang / gser 'gyur bcas/ byams khang nub mar thub sku dang / byams pa mi tshad zangs gser/ gser gdung dngul gdung bcu drug dpe jigs bcas/ tshogs pa lnga brgya yod/dus kyi dga' ldan khang ka ba drug cu ma/ zhug gtsang khang na/ thub pa tshul khrims ma rje'i sku tshad las che/ zangs gser 'brug can rgyal tshab dang / mkhas grub kyi thugs dam de 'dra gnyis/ gser dngul gdung drug mgon khang na 'jigs byed las gshin khyad mtshar byin can thog sleb gnyis zhabs dkar ba'i gser rkyang bla bre la 'bur sku can dkyil 'khor gsum/ dpon po mi dbang gi bka' 'gyur gser khang dang /bstan 'gyur khang / dpon po mi dbang gis bzhengs/ tshogs chen 'du khang ka ring bcu gnyis/ lcags gser bkra mar bskos pa'i sgo lcags/ thog khar tsong kha'i a mye'i gzhi bdag khang / zhug tu byams khang chen mo/ yang g.yas su byams khang dmar por rgyal ba skal bzang la gsung 'byon pa'i byams pa/ yang 'od dpag med zangs gser 479

thog sleb mtho/ byams pa zangs gser thog slob bcas/ lnga mchod khang rje 'dra ma/ rje yi sku/ phyag drug mgon khang / smon lam 'dzugs tshar ba dang / phul ba'i dbu rgyan can/ jo 'brom sku bcas/ da lta gtong sgo 'di nas yod/ grwa tshang 'og gam shar rtse grwa tshang 'du khang gsar pa legs/ sman bla gsungs skabs khel/ gtsang khang du rje yab sras gsum thog sleb zangs gser the bo sprul sku'i bzhengs pa/ bse khrab mgon khang / sgrol ma lcags sgrogs ma bcas/ byang rtse grwa tshang ngam grwa tshang steng mar 'du khang gsar pa legs/ gnam yol legs/zhug tu hor ston nam mkha' dpal bas bzhengs pa'i rje tshul khrims chos 'phel sku rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro/ mchod rdzas legs/ 'du khang rnying par lha mo'i mgon khang yod/ gser khang khang tshan du zhwa lu legs pa rgyal mtshan sku/ rnam sras mdung dmar/ bse khrab sku/ rgyal ba skal bzang khang tshan yin/ dga' ldan ri rtse nas bde chen yan/ nub 'phen po khog lo sogs lung pa mang po mthong ba'i sa cha snang g.yer che/ dbyar skyid po yod/ dga' ldan skor lam na gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi/ rje rin po che'i zhabs rjes/ chos rgyal zhal 'bags sogs dang / rang byon rnam pa gsal ba'ang shin tu mang / byin chags pa yang yod mod/ la la ni blun pos btags pa'ang yod tshod 480

grub mtha' gzhan gyis gnas dang ring byon sogs la zur za/ rang gi rig pas bzos pa'i lung rigs gang dang yang 'brel med pa'i zhen gtam gyis bcos ma'ang mang por yod par snang /rgya ma khams la shas 'dra ba'i lung pa/ rtsa dang sur shug glang ma sogs shing sna can nas phu ring por song bas/ g.yu sgang brag spang ser shug glang nya brid sogs dang brag dkar legs/ thog so gcig tsam gyen la 'dzegs pas phug pa rna gnyis ma'i bug pa 'og ma nas mar 'dzul bas gting ring por thag pa las shud de/ bee ro'i gzim phugade nas mtshams tho/ nyi zla/ cong zhi'i zi mar ra skyes/ cong zhi'i rgyal mtshan/ gdugs/ 'phan/ mkha' 'gro'i bro ra/ tshogs gzhong du tshogs/ de nas slar yang phug tu 'dzul bas u rgyan rin po che'i gzim phug tshe ril tshe chu/ mtshan brgyad sku khang zim 'dra ba brgyad/ yang 'og nas mar 'gro sa gting mi mngon pa/ slar lam gong ma brag gi gseng nas yar bar do'i 'phrang lam jur mig phug pa shin tu thar dka' nas gnam la don nas phyi rol du sleb par dpal 'bar gnyis ring 'gro sa yod/ mar ring tsam 'ong bas kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i cog la'i gzim zhug g.yu sgron mgon khang can/ pha rir bka' gdams dgon shul grong par gnas 'gyur na 'bum chen 'dzam gling 481

rgyan/de nas mar rgya ma khri khang na/ gyer sgom chen po dang / 'gro mgon sangs rgyas dbon ston khu dbon gsum gyi gdung sa 'bum shin tu che ba gsum/ mchod khang gong ma zhig mchod khang 'og ka bzhi mar phyag stong spyan stong zangs gser/ rang byon lnga ldan dang / che chung 'dra ba'i li sku bcu gcig 'gran zla bral ba/ rdo nag la rdo dkar ma ṇi rang byon/ thub sku li ma che/ chos pod lnga brgya tsam ngos gnyis/ phyi khyams grwa pa bzhi'i khang pa bcas/'di nas ma tshad na/ bkra shis mi 'gyur byams pa'i pho brang ste chos rgyal srong btsan sku 'khrungs sa'i pho brang shul/ chos rgyal sku 'dra byin chags/de nas yar ring du 'ong bas/ dbu ru ka tshal na dus gsum sangs rgyas/ gtso bo de chos rgyal dus bzhengs pa/ gzhan bzo bcos phog pa/ dgon gong ma na chos brtsigs pod stong tsam dang / byams pa lha khang dang / bka' gdams mchod rten sogs dang / grwa tshang nyung tsam yod do/ /kun mkhyen klong chen pas/ snye phu shug gseb tsandan gyi dgas tshal ga/sdus kyang da lta shug sdong gsum tsam las med pas dbus phyogs su

snga ma'i shing tshal yod pa zad nas da lta shug sdong chen po rdog re tsam las shug pa cher med/ rwa bsgrongs shug nags che/ klung shod na shug nags chen po re zung yod/ skyid shod mdar paṇa chen gtsug tor zer ba dang / ngom shod mchims phu'i rgyab log dang / mchims phu rang dang / phag mo gru gdan sa thel na shug nags che nges/ bsgrang nang shing stag pa'i nags/ gtsang gzhu snye mo nas rang chung jo mo kha rag phar rgyab shug pa stag pa sogs nags che/ la stod lha rtse nas yar gangs bu le'i rong / thang stong rgyal po'i gdan sa ri bo che'i phyogs na shug nags yar 'brog na spa ma'i nags sogs las gzhan sa phal cher bye thang shas che/ spang ljang me tog bkra ma'i tshal sogs ma bcos rang byung ni khams la nye ba/ klang shod/ 'bri gung / rgya ma/ lhag par rgya tshugs 'od zer ljongs/ kong po las legs sa yin no/ /'on kyang yar lung shel brag na sur dkar bkra ba'i ri bo khams dwangs po dang /yer pa dang / lhag par gangs ri thod dkar na dbyar me tog spang tshal skyid pa/ yongs rdzogs mchims phu sogs na shing rgyas pa'i klong me rtog sogs legs pa/ mchims phu'i blon chen gur dkar phug shin tu dwangs po yod pa sogs yul gyi bkod pa'o/ /kong po la nas mar ring du 'ong bas/ hu ma ri'i mar rgya mda'i 483

yar gong / brag ri chen po dang bo lo'i shing tshal chen po'i 'gram grong pa zhig na mtha' yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang gi gral mchod khang /thub pa rnam snang nye sras brgyad/ kung ging bcas dang / chos bcigs pod stong lnga tsam yod par 'dug kyang ma tshad sleb par rtsad ma chod/kong po rgya mda' dmyal pa'i zangs dang snyed pu'i dbyibs/dbus na gu ru rin po che 'di rig 'dzin sangs rgyas gling pas phyag /zos byin rlabs che nges su snang / rgya yi ge sar lha khang sogs yod kong po rgya mda' nas mar ri sna gnyis ma zin pa'i chu par kur shing rong lung mdor/ mchod rten de kong po'i sa yi 'dzer bzhi las slob dpon padmas bzhengs pa'i byang sems 'bum pa/ lha 'dres bskor ba'i rjes yod/ de na sangs rgyas gling pas sangs rgyas 'od srung ring bsrel gter bzhes pa/ de nas nga phod kyi lan pha ri der sangs rgyas gling pa'i 'khrungs khyim lang so gying phu na g.yu lung gangs btsan gyi gnas/ tshu ri brag rta phur can/ kong po kuḥthog dgon sngon rgya chen sogs jun gar gyis bshigs/ da lta a ṇi bco brgyad kyi dgon/ de'i phur lang so bkra shis tshe brtan gter gnas/ 'di'i mdo na pha mchog maṅga a yu'i 'khrungs khyim/ chu phar ka bder dgon 'dir sangs rgyas 484

gling pa'i sku tshab dbur bzhugs dgongs 'dus padma badzra yod/ nga phod pha rir kong po dkar 'phrang 'dir phyis chab mdo shangs paṇa gnas/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter gnas yin/ chu tshur ka nas mar 'ong bas lam 'phrang mgor slob dpon rin po che'i bzhugs gnas/lam nang bzhugs khri pha waṃ spus dag nga phod nas yar ring tsam na shangs paṇa sbrul du skyes pa'i rjes rdo la yod/ nga phod nas mar phyin pa'i ri sna gsum na grum pa nyi zla sangs rgyas dang / kurma gling pa'i 'khrungs sa dang gdan sa'i shul yod/ nga phod na nga phod dge stong blo gsal rgya mtshos bzhengs pa smin gling dur khrod lha mo'i mgon khang gnyan cha can dang / sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter phur mjal du yod/shing tog mnga' ris kham bu zhim la 'gran med pa/ mi rgan a mchog se'u 'bru sogs shing rtog mang ba dang / zhim pa gnyis ka bod dbus dwags kong na 'gran med zhig go/ /'di nas mar ring du song bas nyang po nas nyang chu/ lang po nas lang chu/ 'brug la phyogs sam brag gsum phyogs te nyang lang gtsang po 'dzoms sar rnam sras dgon gong der kurma pa'i mdzod nag de'u 'bur yod/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i sku 'khrungs yul kyang yod/kong po bang ri/ rtse gangs ri/ de mtshams brag zangs mdog 485

dpal ri/ bee dang shing re zung can nags chen po la mtho gzar ngos 'dzegs pas/ lha khang rkaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bzhengs pa ka ba bcu gnyis/ gtsang khang na gu ru dang / 'ja' tshon sku/gter chos lha rnams ngos bris can bcas/gong der bla brang steng sgrub phug 'ja' tshon gzim khang ka ba brgyad lha khang skyid por/ 'ja' tshon sku byin/ sku gdung sa'i 'bum pa lañtsa yod pa/ gu ru'i sku rnying zangs gser/ bang ri mtshams pa mkhyen brtse'i blo gros kyi sku gdung dang / 'ja' tshon rin po che'i gter zangs zi khyim du 'gran bral chu zom gsum 'gro ba/ rten sgam na/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i phyag bris/ dkar chag can gyi thod pa ngo mtshar rdo rje phag mo rang byon gsal ba/ 'ja' tshon dbu zhwa/ chos gos 'od phung ma/ gter byon gu ru'i phyag dam rnam bcu dbang ldan g.yang ṭi'u ma/tshe chu'i snod gzi khyim tshe bum/ gu ru drag po'i phyag mtshan gnam lcags rdo rje khru gang ma/ chos rgyal byar pas phul ba'i phyag dam/ gnam lcags phur ba/ dbu ru zhwa nas bzhes pa'i ma ning / shog ser snod ljon ser po'i sdig pa rā dza lag ya tsam/ nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i phyag gi rdo rje ljon ser legs pa/ gter ston rin po che'i sku chos skor cha shas/ nang du ma ning mgon khang zil chen po mjal du yod/486

grwa sum cu tsam/ yang zab bla sgrub nges don snying po/ gnam lcags rdo rje sogs btang / 'di nas mar ri gsham na/ bang 'bum pa u rgyan rin po ches bzhengs pa sangs rgyas 'od srung 'phel gdung bzhugs pa/ klung chu khar rjod ha 'phrang brag gter sgo can/ 'brug la gtsang por klu bdud mtsho sogs mjal to/ /kong po tsā gang dang / tsā nag tsa 'dra gsum gyi tsā nag phur lung lag gcig na gro ma lung nags rong yin pa/ phu na spang sogs yod pa lung pa rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa'i rdo zam chen po yod par mi byin de yan sa stong che ngos tsā ris byang shar phyogs mgo gtad pa'i sbas yul gcig 'dug par phu chu ri khrod pa'i bla rgan mtshan rang grol zer ba zhig la gter kha gnas sgo'i kha byang byung / kong por rgya dmag phog dus rtags tshang yang bla rgan lo bdun cur song bas 'gro ma nus zer/gtsang po mgo dgu ni gtsang ma chab kyis bskor ba'i ri snar/lam 'phrang dang / nags gseb lam phra mo nas don dgos pa brag ris bskor ba'i ngos dgon pa skyid po thang shing bro brdung dgon 'dra ba na dpe rnying mang du yod/ sog jun gar ma song zer/ kong po'i sa'i 'dzer bzhi ni/ bong 'bum pa/ byang sems 'bum pa/ brag dkar 'bum pa/ klung rta bye ma'i mchod rten bzhi na sangs rgyas 'od srung dang 487

thub pa'i ring bsrel bre gang re u rgyan rin po ches sbas pa phyis su khal mang por 'phel ba/ dad ldan la skor lam nas kyang ring bsrel lon/lha 'dre'i skor lam bcas yod/tsā ri bi bis rgyab bya khyung pa'i gdan sa/ kong po skye ma 'dong nas la brgal ba'am/ glo dong nas tsā ri gsar pa'i phyogs la sleb/dga' chags la brgal na/ 'brug pad dkar sku nye gter ston sdo/ga rdor zhes pa'i gdan sa sba lcags shrī/ snying thig brgya rtsa yod pa de nas rgya tshugs gla ru'i gong tsam brag dkar lha chu'ang mjal te/ shing nags dbus 'bum pa lha 'dre'i skor lam bcas/ yar chu khar theg dgu'i shing dgu mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i chu lnga/ mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi khrus rdzing / de nas yar pha waṃ rus sbal 'dra ba/ gser dngul gter rtags gsal ba/ klu sog ma med chu mig na dbyar gnas 'dus skabs mar me brgya rtsa sbar ba mthong / rta shod bu mo padma mtsho'i 'khrungs khyim mkhar su lu ma hral/ ba shas tshogs phul rjes/ dgon rnying sog jun gar gyis bshigs/ 'di yan sa shin tu skyid/ de'i yar mkha' 'gro'i bro ra yod/ dgon gong ma/ g.yas brag padma rā ga'i tshe bum 'dom brgyad cu'i nang nas nyin mtshan dus drug la tshe chu ngo mtshar 488

ba babs pa/ brag bha ga 'dra ba rdo rje phag mo'i gsang ba'i bdud ji chad med 'bab pa/ de gong chu 'phyar lung pa rdo brtsigs lam skas thung bzhi las gong du dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i bla ma/ g.yas rta mgrin dang tshe dpag med/ g.yon du rdo rje phag mo'i lte ba'i gsang phug nas thar mi thar gyis lcags thag 'dom brgyad pa gnyis 'dzegs babs byas pas je yangs su u rgyan sgrub phug rang byon mang / mtsho bcas mjal du yod/ gter ston mchog ldan rdo rje'i gter gnas gter sgo bcas/ lha khang gong mar/ kurma chos grags rgya mcho'i phyag bzos mgon po ber nag gnyan po yod/ yang 'og khang na u rgyan rin po che/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ maḥthog pa ma ṇi rin chen slob ma kong po rtogs ldan chos nyid ring mo paṇa zhwa chos 'chad kyi bla sku dang / rten sgam na yu mo'i rwa/ rdo rje rtse dgu dang / rtse lnga/ shel 'dra rdo yi tshe bum gter ma/ chos grags rgya mtsho dgung lo bdun pa'i zhabs rjes sogs nang rten khyad 'phags yod/ bon po lta bu sngags grwa bco brgyad rka tshang lugs 'dzin/ tshe sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor sogs 'don/de nas rim par brgyud/ byang ma rong la 'gro lam byang lha ri mgo nas mdo khams bu mar kha gyus nas/ rgya tshugs rkang chen mdo(gcig)lcags byang la brgal dkar shod sum mdo(gnyis)gsal mda' bon 489

dgon(gsum)rgya shod bad sgar(bzhi)ya nga mdo(lnga)'bo ru thang ngam rnyi ru thang(drug)lcam la rgan nas lcam zla bring kha(bdun)ri ya(brgyad)rong po rgyal rab/ (dgu)spa rta sum mdo(bcu)rma la bzhi nas gser sum mdo'i zam kha(bcu gcig)sa tsha bkra shis gling(bcu gnyis)khyung po gting chen(bcu gsum)de nas rdo shul ka ru gnyis sa mtshams(bcu bzhi)de nas rdo shul/ (bco lnga)ri bo che(bcu drug)sogs nas rim par phyin pa'i dang po lha ri mgo'i lung phu nas/ gsa' phu gangs zhes u rgyan sgrub mtsho bcas yod zer/ bon pos bon gnas yin skad/gangs jig po 'dugagasal mda' bon dgon nye 'gram chu dkar po'i phur/ mtsho chen dang / brag gsum mtsho dang / a tsar mtsho rnams spun red zer/ de nas rngod la mgo bstan/ shar gangs la'i tshur rgyab lung mda' rgya ston phyogs bstan par/ bya rna dgon zhes 'bras spungs dgon lag grwa brgya tsam/ de'i phur dzam bu klu grol gangs ri 'di gsal phu gangs ri de ku'i rgyab ri yin/ rgya dbus kong nas mthong ba'i gangs ri chen po yod skad/ shar spom ra/ dbus dza klu grol/ nub thang lha rnams spun byi/ ces yul 'di pas zer srol/ gsal phu na bon gyi ri khrod re zung 490

rgya shod ban sgar 'bras spungs dgon grwa nyis brgya tsam/ thub sku zangs gser thog tshad gnyis/ nye sras 'jim thog tshad/ bka' bstan 'gyur sogs/ gnas bcu lha khang / dpe cha dge phyogs sogs sum brgya tsam/ stag phu ba'i ma dgon du grags/ya nga mdo'i su mdo'i ri gdong gzhung der mkha' 'gro ma bsod nams dpal 'dren sku gdung / dbu thod rang byon can rdo la dbu klad/ sku mtshal sogs rten sgam kha shas/ bsod nams dpal 'dren gdung brgyud sngags btsun ru bar yod/ a ṇi sum cu/ ser khyim bdun tsam/ bde mchog 5yi sa dge lugs/ dam gling pa'i zhi khro/nang tshang phag mo bcas rnying dkar dge gsum 'dra ba 'don/ gdung brgyud pa rgya ston phyogs na dud khag gcig yod zer/lcam mda' dgon pa ni rje'i dngos slob mkhan chen bkra shis seng gis phyag btab/ se ra smad pa'i dgon pa/ grwa brgya tsam/rang po rgyal rabs thang phur yol rdzong zhes gangs chen sbas yul sbas sde nyung ma sogs dang bdud kyi bca' ka 'dra chus khur 'ong pa zhig yod zer/ gser tsha dang steng chen bar khrom tshogs nang bon pos bskor ba'i gangs chen gcig yod zer/ de'i ri rgyud yin/ rgyal rabs thang phur bswo me ri dmar po dang / me long brag zer ba khyad 491

mtshar pa legs so/ /phu 'di na ri khrod pa'ang yod/ dbyar yul ljongs skyid po 'dra ba snang /lcam la sar ngos/ wa nag dgon 'bri gung sa yig rnying pod mang tsam 'dug zer/ de'i tshur ngos 'bri gung dgon gcigarong po rab brtan dgon grwa sum brgya tsam/ dge lugs rgyud stod dgon lag nye bar tsha chu legs/ yar pa dha sum mdo'i bar sa skyid po dang / sa dpyad legs pa 'ga' re yod/ shug pa'i nags dang spang 'dres pa sum mdo na sa dwangs mo gter lhung rnga sna'i sa dbyibs 'dra ba'i phur/ 'dzum dkar de tshab spu rgyal gangs ri/ mtsho che chung gnyis tsam/ bon dgon zhu tshang na bon gyi bla ma sngags pa bon pos rtsa chen byed/ bon po drug cu tsam ser khyim/shar du lung pa ring po nas rma la bzhi brgal/ gser sum mdor/ pha rir tsha ba bang dgon chab mdo'i dgon grwa bdun cu tsam/bon dgon hral po/ phu na shel zhig zer ba'i bon rgan a ra dkar po/ grwa bdun cu tsam/gser tsha smad chu pha rir smar rdzong dgon/ gong du 'bras spungs dgon lag g.yu 'dzong dgon bcas kurma pa dang 'bri gung pa bsgyur ba'o/ /kurma pa dang 'bri gung pa'i zhabs rjes mang po yod/ 'di 492

phyogs nags tshal rnams lho rong du gzhi bdag 'dzing nas ded song ba la bdud kyi bla shing lhag pa yin kyang zer/ kurma pa'i dbu spa gtor ba red kyang zer ba nyin lam gcig na ri thams cad la nags med par ri gcig la thang shing nags snang /gser tsha bkra shis gling na chu nyal phyogs lung phur rab rgyas brag /// ces gshen lha 'od dkar gnas red zer ba brag dkar rdzig po yang gser tsha bu la nas spu thog snang 'gro phyogs/ rgya ston 'bri gung lugs/ gter ston nag po stong thub pas gnas sgo phyes pa bde mchog gnas brag dkar bzang po/ 'di nas byang rta rnar 'gro sa/byang sma ngan gnas brtan dgon/ nub byang gis sna/ byang na nang chen/ 'bri gung lho 'brang sprul dgon sogs yod/ spu thog sgang nye byang du rta tshags rje drung gis bon sprul sku mi shigs blo ldan snying po'i dgon pa bsgyur ba khyung po gser tsha bkra shis gling / ban ma bon lnga bcu tsam dge dgon hral po/ bon po'i lha khang yang yod/ khyung po steng chen phyogs bon po smon lam rtogs ldan bcud len gyis zas ma zos pa lo sum cur lhag pa song ba dang / lo brgya dang nyi shur bsdod pa gnyis byung bas bon rgyud yod/ bon po gtsang dgon/ rten gsum 493

mchod pa bzang po can gyi ri khrod yod zer/ gzhan bon po dgon pa shin du mang yang phal cher ser khyim sa bon gsar rnying bsres pa/bsam pa ngan pa'ang mang tshod/byang spu thog sgang mtsho gong mar khyung po ka ru phyogs bon po la jidaga' ba'i klu gdug pa can gnas sa bon pos rbad de ri bo cher gnod/ ri bo che rnying ma grwa tshang gi thog mar naḥthog lugs phur nag gsar 'dzugs mthar mtsho gtad dang / mgon po phyag bzhi pa bskul bas/ khyung g.yag shad tsam byung nas klu khyer bas mtsho khol/ nyin da nang do nub bar sbrul gyi rnga ma nam mkha'i mthongs su ma rdzogs/ de nas bon po'i nus stobs rtsad chod song zer srol dang / da lta khyung po dang hor spyi khyab nang 'khrugs sogs de'i mthu las so/ /khams ri bo che nas mar nyin gcig lam na ye ne shel mdung zhes/ spang brag dkar/ thang shing / shug nags mdzes pa rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bu'i sa/ bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje/ chags med rin po che bcas zhal 'dzoms/ gnas yig so sor yod/ de'ang gnas sgo rnying pa dpal 'bar mang po'i ring 'gro sa/ u rgyan gzim phug skas mang po 'dzegs/ rdo a mo li brdung na skad 'don pa/ tshe bum/ sa mi 'gyur sātstsha dkar nag gnam mi 'gyur sprin 494

dkar mo/ mchod rten rnam dag rang byon/ gur gum spang ri/ tsan dan dgas tshal/ khrus rdzing / tshe dpag med sku/ bcu gcig zhal cong zhi'i ka ba/ 'phan/ tshe ril tshe chu/ tshe bsnyen/ ma tre bsgral ba'i khog pa/ rgyungs pa/ sgal tshig bcas kyi rang byon shin tu mang /gnas sgo gsar pa de las kyang khyad mtshar yod par 'dug gis la brgal nas chab mdo'i ngom chu brgyud rong / pha rir rdza rgyal go bo khyung phug gi rgyab ri'i rtse sogs mthong / ri che'i rgyab ngos dzi chu kha'i byang ngos dpal chen rga lo mkha' spyod gshegs pa'i gnas/ de nas nang chen lcam zam kha nas gnas brtan dgon mar 'ong na/ byang rta rna'i bskor lam nang gze rgyal ga pa tshud snang / ngom rgyud rgyal chen bco brgyad yod pas/ ngom chu phar ka gis la phyogs rgyal po thod rgyal/ (gcig)rmo gzhung na rmo rgyal/ zhuganyis)de 'gram 'gram rgyal na zhugasum)gu ru'i sgrub phug mtshan brgyad lha khang / de nas mar rdza rgyal(bzhi)go khyung / gnas mdo'i phur gtam rgyal/(lnga) tham ka ru ba'i nang ngom rgyal(lnga) re ne dgon pa'i rgyab yo rgyal (drug) rdza dmar/ khrom byar stong pa'i sar rdza rgyal/(bdun) nang chen mdo khams ma sris tsha kha pa sogs mdo khams sku rgyal/(brgyad) ri che gtam nang sku lha gtam rgyal(dgu) chab mdo'i rin dmar dbang mda'i rgyab wa rgyal (bcu) dkar 495

ti/ chu srub skyo thog klu rgyal spo (bcu gcig) tho sa sgang zo pa'i phur zo rgyal (bcu gnyis) byang rta rna la gze rgyal (bcu gsum)ga pa/ ngom phug ri che nang chen shog lnga par ye rgyal (bcu bzhi)nam mkha' mdzod/gnas mdo dgon nye ro lam phur po rgyal ngom rgyal (bcu lnga)phyag mdzod/ ri che dzi pa ru ba'i phug dzi sku rgyal/ (bcu drug) chab mdo rdza srub ko rgyal/(bcu bdun) rdza nyin 'be rgyal lam khams sgar nye bar dkrigs rgyal (bco brgyad)bcas dang / khram rgyal zer ba khram grags pa'i ri la yod/ ri cher klu rgyal sha khyim zer ba'ang yod/lha ngos rdo shul khra mo gling nye bar 'jo rig 'dzin gdan sa snang /'di naḥthog bla ma/ gzhan phan rdo rje las rdzogs chen thob/ kuḥthog de gnas kyi gang zag byin gyis brlabs pa ru snang / der khong nas zla ba gcig bsgoms pas nyin mtshan 'dres rab gsung lab rgyu 'dugayol nang gle brag bang ba ma/ brag dkyil shing gi bang ba/ nor gter yod pa'i bang ba'i rta zur mthong ba yod/ rdza rgyud gter dpe'i mar /kā / rgyal ma bskor na dang / rong 'grus bskor na rang byon legs g.yu mgo brag la/ spom mda' zer te oṃ gyi mda' yin pas oṃ mda' ma/ ma ṇi rang byon gsal ba mchod rten rang byon sogs khyad 496

mtshar yod do/ /de rnams ni gnas skor gyi lo rgyus rags rim bris ba'o/ /'di nas mdo khams shar phyogs su byang ma rong lam du chas shing / mdor na sa rta zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la khams sgar sleb pa nas zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer bzhi la 'bri gung thel du dbus gnas thog mar zug sa lug hril po dang / lcags sprel zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la lha gdan nas khams la btegs pa'i skabs/ zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bdun la brag dkar lha chur ma sleb par khyon zla ba nyi shu'i ring la pal cher gnas lam du song zhing / zhib cha brtsis na zla ba bcu drug la song nges pa lags/ /chags med zhen med gtad med nges med gnas/ /rang 'khris med pas gdul bya ris med la/ /phan byed 'gro don rgyal khams phyogs med byed/ /gnas skor rab kyi rnam par thar pa'o/ /dam pa phyogs med sel med bsten pa dang / /dam chos ris med 'gal med zhu ba dang / /sgrub gnas phyogs med 'dzin med tshogs bsags pa/ /'di yang gnas skor rab kyi rnam thar ro/ /rten gsum kun la dad pas ngal dub la/ /mi skyo dben gnas dgon sde thams cad du/ /'gras med sun med dag snang tshogs gsog byed/ /gnas skor 'bring gi rnam par thar pa'o/ /dang po khas len sa steng bskor ba bsam bar du 497

gyen re mthong na gnas re gzhag/tha ma byas lo song lo'i ngang du thal/ /gnas skor mdo don med pa'i ngang tshul gcig /dge 'dun yon tan mi mthong skyon de mthong / /lha sku gsung rab mi mjal rgyang bltas byas/mthong na slong zhing ma mthong rku ba de/ /gnas skor sdig skor song ba'i ngang tshul gnyis/ /dka' chad byung dus gnas la log lta byas/ /lha khang da lta mjal ba da lta brjed/ /gnas skor lam du khong khro dpa' ru brtsi/ /gnas skor ngal ba 'bras med ngang tshul lo/ /bdag ni mgyogs par 'dod kyang dal bar song / /gnas skor yin 'dod dkor rdzas sdud pa la/ /ched du song 'dras mi mgo rang mgo 'khor/ /bla chen bla chung min pa'i skor lugs byas/ /'phags pa'i zhing khams bod chos ldan/ /dam pa'i skyes bu dngos sbas kyis/ /du ma bzhugs pas dad gus kyis/ /phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs smon lam 'debs/ /phyogs med thub bstan rin chen kyang / /nyams med gnas pa'i smon pa yis/ /bdag gi dge rtsa ci mchis kun/ /ljongs 'dir bstan pa gnas phyir bsngo/ /de ltar yul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i tshul/ /chags sdang min cing sgro skur yang min par/ rang gi mthong ba ji bzhin brjod pa 'di/ /rang gi mi brjed gtam gyi gling gzhir ro/ /thos bsam klog pa'i 'khor lor mkhas pa dgyes pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa 498

dkon/ /spang ba bsam gtan 'khor lor gong ma'i brgyud pa zin pa'i nyams len dkon/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lor kha na ma tho bral ba'i shugs 'byung dkon/ /da ni ma 'khyams dben pa'i ri la rang shes lhag bsam dkar ngang nyol/ /klog pa mkhas 'dod snga mo'i mkhas dang 'gal/ /sgom pa byed 'dod kha hob 'brel med tsam/ /rten bzhengs dka' las che yang 'grub rgyu chung / /dus ngan 'bras rtags lags phyir bshung du'ang med/ /thos bsam rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sgom pas rang rgyud thul ba'i thabs mchog dang / /rten bzhengs lhag bsam rnam dag shugs 'byung re/ /rang la 'ong na gzhan la khur thang med/ / sarba maṅga lo dza ga lta/ / zhes pa'ang mdo khams kuḥthog pa si tu chos kyi rgya mtshos spel ba dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /499

dku/ /dri med padma rgyas pa'i zhal bzang gi /mtshar sdug srid na mdzes kun bsags pa lta'i/ /ngo mtshar dpal gyis yid kyi gdung sel ba/ /mtsho skyes bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bor mchod/ /las rlung 'tshub pa'i shugs drag pos/ /dus mtha'i skye bo'i rkang bskul te/ /nges med yul gyi phreng ba mang / /gtol med bgrod pa'i tshul 'di'o/ /gzhan don bya ba'i nus mthu med/ /rang ni rnyed tshol kyang ma ngoms/ /de lta na'ang gzhan don bsdus/ /rnye la skam pa nga 'dra'i lugs/ /rnam dkar dge rtsa nyi ma re re tsam/ sdig to can gyi grib dang dkor nag la/ /'dzim med snyigs dus 'gro 'dren sprul sku'i gsob/ /thob dang rang gi nyon mongs las kyi nyes/ /rab byung bco lnga pa'i khrag phyugs zhes pa chu phag lor dpal kuX thog nas nub smad drang por/ 'bri klung gi 'bab chu dzam thog gru las brgal/ sde dge kuḥthog gi seng gnam brag 'di/ sngon rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / phyis rje bla ma 'jam mgon mkhyen kong mchog gsum/ mnga' bdag yab sras bee ro'i dus kyi mdzad pa'i mtha' zab mo gter gyi bya ba/ gnas zhal gsar du snang bas/ chos pa mchog gsang sngags sgrub pa po la nyams rtogs bskyed pa/ chos mdzad phal pa rtsa gsum lha dang 'brel ba'i sna zin pa/ chos med skye bo phal pa la/501

sngon dus o rgyan rje'i sgrub gnas su zhen pas phyag skor gyis/ 6rgyan rdo rje 'chang gi gdul byar rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mkhas su gtan la phab pa yin/ brag rong nas/ dgon g.yon der/ rdo nyil gyi steng /brag 'phrang las 'dzegs na gu ru'i sgrub phug mthong yang / lus bde yang dgos so/ /der gnas 'dzul kyang yod/ dgon du bdud 'dul lha khang gog nas cig pa tsam lhag mar lus/ g.yas su bee ro'i sgrub phug chen por phyin no/ /skor lam ngos gzar nas gyen la gshin rje'i sgrub phug yod skad/ 'dung ring nas la 'dzegs/ kha chas lam dkar nas dbu rtser/ bdag nyid chen po padma yab yum gyi sgrub phug zhal lho nub gzigs pa mjal nas byung / gnas 'brel kyang byas/ gdong lnga gyen du mchong 'dra'i rdo ba brtsegs/ /thang shing lha mi gar byed 'dra ba'i gnas/ /mdo khams yang rdzogs gnyis pa'i sgrub gnas zhes/ /dus dgra'i dbang po'i pho brang chen por grub/ /de nas rong sum dang / nya gshis sogs nas go 'jo gzhung brgyud 'ong ba/ a nag shing tshang du'ang gnas phran re yod pa 'dug la/ a dkar phur thang dang / ngom mdo'i jo bo khang gnyis bsam yas mtha' 'dul la bzhengs pa'i lha khang yin cing / bdag nyid chen po bai ro tsa 502

nas rab tu gnas pa/ phyis 'brug gnyen rgod ston pas zhig gsos byas pa/ de nas kyang phyis rim pas zhig gsos su btags pa 'dra mang du byas pa zhig go/nub dgon ni go 'jo rdzong nye bar/ rgyab brag g.yab la nye ba/lung pa zhig tu/ brag ri shing star bu'i nags can/ bye ma dkar po'i sked par bla brang / steng na 6rgyan gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgrub phug cer rdo rje 'chang dang mi la'i sku rang byon/ a sogs yig 'bru rang byon mang / mdor yi ge drug ma'i rang byon/ phar kur spang la āḥrang byon gsal ba bcas/ u rgyan rin po che'i sgrub gnas khams dam tshung rang byi/ // grags la/ rje kun dga' bstan 'dzin sku snga phyi'i phrin las de nas go 'jo rdzong gram ri bo'i sked la/ 'gro 'dren dgon/dag snang rgya can lung byang ltar/ gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor du grags kyang da lta 'byung pos bzung ngam snyam/ri rtse brag dkar 'gul na phyogs kyi mtha'/ /kun gsal phyag rgya che la ngang gis gnas/ /bsam gtan sgom na yang dag snying po'i don/ /rang babs shugs kyis 'byung ba snyam du byed/ /go 'jo mdo drug phur/ a dbang ru ba sdod sa dis skya jo /sdu

grags pa/ mtsho la jo bo'i sprul pa rang byon du 'khrungs sa yod do/ /de ni oṃ ma ṇi padme rgyu sgyuḥyi ge drug ma ri rtser gsal ba dang / mtshams ni brag g.yab bu dgon gyi lung pa'i khar byang thang yangs par/ byang nas lho nub gzigs pa'i rigs gsum gyi dbus dar yol 'dra ba'i rir jo bo'i ye ge bdun ma/ mgo la phar tshur 'dom lnga/ yoyar mar brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe lnga ma ṇi 'dom nyis brgya/ padme rdu trīḥdaper na pa yi phra sbom 'dom lnga/ mgo bo la 'dom phyed bcu bzhi/ gyen thur 'dom brgya dang lnga bcu tsam pa de 'dra ba 'di/ bod rje 'phagasapa srong btsan gyi btsun mo rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma nyid kyi sprul pa/rgya bza' kong jo ste lha gcig chu yi padma ru grags pa'i phyag lcags kyis rdzu 'phrul du bris/ pha ri'i gdan khri'i steng nas phyag bris gnang /g.yas su dung dkar brag la de mtshungs oṃ wa gi shā mu/ g.yon du oṃ badzra pā ṇi snye che tsam/ gtso bo las bzhi cha tsam chung ba/ g.yon du klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po gnas pa'i chu mig dkar po/ chu gtsang che ba dwangs pa yan lag brgyad ldan yin snyam byed pa dang / gdol pa lag mang chu shin tu gnyan po dang / jo bo'i ri gong du/ g.yas rdza lung gzi 'dra ba'i ljang ser dang / khams smug sogs rdo mi 'dra ba sna tshogs don pa dang / tshe chu dang /rgyab ngos go 'jo ngam nang / ya rang nang du 504

phyag zhabs rjes sogs mang / bzang rdor gyi gnas yig kyang yod/yum gsang ba le shes gnas/ yang yid bzhin nang zhes/ brag g.yab bdud ri phyogs der/ sras nor bu 'dzin pa'i gnas kyang yod do/ /mtshams gzhung rgya mtsho lte ba sa dpyad legs/ smar khams sa yi lte ba/ klu mi mgon dkar po dang / 'jog po'i pho brang g.yu mtsho dang /mtsho me long ma sogs mtsho mang du yod do/ /dbyar dus chu skyes rgod pa'i ze'u 'bru'i phreng / /'chi med na chung 'dzum la phrag dogs ltar/ /bzang po'i dri ldan khyod kyis chags mi bskyed/ /jo bo yi ge drug ma mchod pas 'phags/ /lug gdol pas lnga lam btang ba'i shang / kha zas dang rgyab la gos kyi khur/ dgra rlung lhag gis sngo nag byas gyur pas/ /steng lha yang dogs pa skye ba'i yul/ /jo bo khyod ni go brag srin po'i pha/ /khyed kyi gur khyim thang du 'do rkyang ste/ /yi dwags phyag tsha bzung ba ji lta bar/ /ston kha'i bshas lug thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /nga 'dra'i bla ma sha khrag zas la srid/ /mgon po khyed kyi snying rje ma bskyed na/ /byang chub sems rtsa rgyang ni song gyur pas/ /yi ge drug ma mjal yang don ma shes/ /'chal gtam mthol lo cham ṇi padme rgyu/ /de nas rgyal sras dgon dang nye ba rta ra gzhung / ri padma/505

gtsang gshis rdo rje gro lod/ 'bam lha mdun rnam par snang mdzad/ gha sto'am sga mgo rnam par snang mdzad/ lkorang tshe dpag med mjal/gnas chen kha ba dkar po'i mdun 'jol mda' mchod rten dkar chung ni/ rgyal po mya ngan med kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten bye ba'i gral nas gcig yin par gsungs/ 'di dang 'dra ba gcig g.yu 'brug dgon rgyal rang sgang gi dgon 'og der yang yod/ 'di dag gi / // 'og nas yar 'ong ba'i lam du bris pa'o/ /('bri rgyu grub mi nyi nag rong / 'jang khra 'bu dgon/ 'ba' long ngam bha lung dgon/ kye ka rang phyogs/ ru rdo rang du ru sde dgon/de nas rdo nga rang nas la brgal/ sa the li shi dgon/ phun tshogs dgon rnams mjal kyang shing legs po btsugs pa dang li dang rdo yi spos phor chen po yod pa sogs/ lha khang las chos rwa dang / sgo khang gi bkod pa legs pa las nang du dus gsum sangs rgyas sam/thub sku sman 'dam re dang / skar sku tsam dang / bka' 'gyur tsam las rten ye med pas/ zhib par ma bris/nag rtsis kyi lo rgan drug cu'i mgo shing byi lo sa the kha ba dkar po'i nye zhol li shi lo sar pa'i de dang nye bar 'jang rgyal po bsod nams 506

rab brtan pas bzhengs/ dbus jo bo kha sar pa ṇi byon gtsang /skor khang ni mtha' zur bzhi logs brgyad de/ khyim bcu gnyis la ling tshe bcu gnyis/ gdung ma/ zhag sum brgya dang drug cu ltar sum brgya drug cu'i nang du gnas brtan ngos ris shin tu legs/ sgor rdo yi rdzab yin pa'i spos phor 'dom gang ba yod/ sa the khram na rdo yi sgo ngo mtshar ba sa ji rgyal po'i rdo sgo yod/ 'di nas sa the mdar/ ji'i ga phyan yī zer ba/ thang dbus de'u chung nags tshal can dbus/ dgon pa nyams dga' ba/ phyag stong spyan stong thog sleb/ bla brgyud kyis bskor ba/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa shin tu legs/ ngos bris/ gshin rje gshed kyang bris snang / gnas brtan bco brgyad/ de'i zhug tu 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsum/ sgo khar hwa shang rgyal chen sde bzhi ngos bris legs/ mi phug sa the pa yin pa/ hwa shang bsam gtan pa/'khrun kyi'i zer ba/ dge slong bzhi/ dge tshul gnyis/ dge bsnyen kha shas bcas/ lha khang 'di hwa shang gis dang po bzhengs nas lo brgyad tsam song zer/ lha bzo gli bu gcig yin par snang / de nas hwa shang gi mchin gshag sī dang cha hwa sī zhes pa'i lha khang du mjal ba'i ri brag dkar po'i brgyud sa li khri'i mdog ri ngos brag phug 'og do skas can lha khang du/ rgya yi sgrol ma rgya yi bud med pang du bu bzung ba/ yang rdo 507

skas mgor rgya yi dus gsum sangs rgyas/ g.yas su rta mo tsu 'chi ste pha dam pa/ g.yon du rgya mi khro bo gcig g.yon ngos lha khang du rgya yi dzo bha la dang ngo mi shes pa/ steng brag phug tu ge sar/ sbug tu brag yongs rdzong brag phug che ba lta bu la/ gnas 'dzul mkhan mang / nang du chu yod/ 'di u rgyan gyi sgrub gnas zhig yin par snang / 'og ngos su lha khang du thub pa'i dbang po/ hwa shang gnyis/ phyi rol du chu mig shin tu chen po gnyis/ na ba rang dgun lo sar me tog dkar po legs par skye ba'i sa nyams skyid/ 'di skor rgya yul gyi sa shin tu thang che/ bde yangs/ nags thams cad thang gi steng skyes/ khang pa legs po shin tu mang / shing gi me tog ser po/ thal wa mang du skyes pa sogs dang /rdo sgo bzang po/ ri mo mang po brkos tshon snag pa snang / hwa mchin nyi grong khyer che/ mi khyim khri phrag nye ba yod zer lcags ri rgyab ngos thad nas 'ong ba'i lam khar dmyal ba lha khang / sbug 'phags pa mo'u gal gyi bu/ de nas gshin rje'i rgyal po/ dmyal ba ris so drug dran pa nye bzhag las gsungs pa tsho yin pa 'dra/ sgo chags brgyas brgal ba 'jigs su rung ba snang / lcags ri'i phyi rol slob dpon padmas dang po phyag mkhar btsugs nas/ hwa zen mtshor gyur pas 'og tu bsdus pa'i rdzing bu snang / hwa tshen chu dong chu lha sa ltar ro/ lcags ri'ang / spyan 508

ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong thog so zhal gcig pa'i lha khang / dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi lha khang du gnas brtan mi che tshad tsam de rang gi dkar yol lha ji lta ba/ pha dam pa/ spyan ras gzigs brag ri ma sogs lha khang du nged rang zhag gcig 'dug ming nyo'u kyo'u si nub sgo nye ba byang stod du/ 'od dpag med dbu rgyan can/ spyan gzigs phyag rdor gnyis kyang gtso bo dang che chung 'dra/ khri rgyab yol shin tu legs/ rā mi tshugs can lha khang / lu'i tsu tan sbug ngos rnam rgyal ma 'dra ba'i lha/ 'og nas nub gzigs la/ brag phug slob dpon padma gzan gyis dbu btum nyams sgeg kha spu can/ g.yas su mkhar bsil bsnams pa/ g.yon 'og mtsho nang mi gcig gis 'brug thag pas btags pa snang / gong rdzing bu yod pa de yang / slob dpon padma'i sku/ khro mo zhal gsum phyag drug dang po gnyis rdor dril/ bar ma gnyis nyi zla/ tha ma g.yas mdung rtse gsum can/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan/ thod phreng / dor ma/ gzig sham can gcig 'dug yang dag he ru ka 'dra/ lha gnyer la dris kyang mi shes 'dug gzhan lha khang mang po mjal kyang lha ngo mi 'phrod la/ phal cher rgya yi 'jig rten pa'i lhar snang ngo / /las sdig la spyod pa'i nag po'i rgya/ /'bu zas su za ba'i rdo ṭwāṃ

rnams/ /nya bre la 'jal ba'i dmyal ba pa/ /skad mi go ba yi sa cha na/ /'dod ngoms pa med pa'i las ngan pa/ /tshong sdig sdug khur du nyo ba las/ /mi su zhig 'ong snyam snang ba skyo/ /zas sha khrag za yang mi nyung la/ /yul chung bas srog gcod grangs nyung zhing / /bod gdol ba'i sa 'di chos dang ldan/ /don de'ang spyan ras gzigs kyi drin/ /skye bo mang la rig pa bzo sna mang / /dgun yang me tog shing los rab mdzes la/ /skad brda 'phrod na ci yang byar yod cing / /ras rkyang tsam gyi gos kyis dro bas skyid/ /yul khams che ba zas sna mang / /a ru skyu ru sman sna mang / /blta rgyu nyan rgyu go rgyu mang / /byed rgyu mang po 'khyams pa mang / /'bras zhing / ma nye/ rdo zam/ rdo sgo sogs bzo bkod mang / bar 'dir zo chu 'khyud mos chu gyen la 'dren pa/ ras thags su 'thags pa dang / bu ram bzo ba dang / kha bzang la dkar steng / bya dang mi ri dwags sogs mtshon sna cung zad dang / bar bar sprin dang / pa tra/ rgya nag lcags ri spos rgya/ thang rtse thel ma sogs snag bris snag mdangs/ ram bris ram mdangs ram bcad sogs bkod pa mtshar/ rdza g.yab mchu la me tog 'dab brgyad/ steng thang rtse sna sogs/ dang du spang mtsho/ mu le bram shing / shing thil ba/ skyu ru ra mi lang tsam/ na ga ge bar thog gnyis/ a ru ra thog gsum tsam 510

pa/ 'di 'dra zhing mthar yod pa bso shing 'bras bu zos na dug yod pa sogs dang / thang shing dang sgron shing sogs mang / bar 'dir rdza rtsi btang ba'i grong pa dang / spung kwa zhes par zla ba bdun pa'i nang tshogs 'dus chen po 'ong ba dang / kyang yul du lung pa dogs por/khro blugs thabs khang pa spud pa chu 'khor sogs 'jigs su rung ba rnams yod/ kyang yul thang yan si dang / lu g.yan si zer ba lha khang lnga re tsam yod pa tsho gnyis yod kyang / rgya yi chos bon 'jig rten pa'i lha gsum bsres yod pas mjal snying ye med/ gshen rab kyi dam zhwa rus sbal khog pa lta bu gyon pa'i rgya rgan kha spu ag tshom can/ lag pas lag pa 'ju ba/ ngo dmar zhig 'khor mang /khang rtswa hu ste/ kong tse 'phrul rgyal seṅge zhon pa/ gong ma'i chas can sogs yod/ tshangs pa zhwa leb mu tig bcu tshar lta bu 'phyang ba'i rgya rgan/ nyi ma zla ba de gnyis lag tu bzung ba'i rgya rgan sogs/ gong du bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'das mdun du bzhag pa sogs/ bzhu ston blun po'i lugs dang / do'u si'i lugs sogs mu stegs pa dang 'dra/kyang yul nas mar rgyang ring nas ri spang nags yod pa/ bya rkang rgyab ri mjal/ bya yi sder mo ltar sum zur/ gcig kyang yul/ gcig tā la'i/ gcig thang ling sa tham sdong phyogs la zugachu 'bri chu la 'a/ gro 511

bas sa the hwa ching lung pa gcig de nas kyang yul dang bya rkang bcas lung pa gcig 'di rnams 'bri srub lung pa yin/ tā la'i ni zla chu khar bstan lung pa yin/ thal dkar rdo rje yod pa'i thang nas lcags zam steng nas hang kya ni/ grong pa chung 'di 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ byams mgon khyi mo'i tshul dang / de nas byams pa gzigs nas byams mgon phrag la thogs nas bskor kyang rgan mos khyi ror mthong ba de 'di yin zer/ pha tshud du lcags rdo'i pha bong 'dom do tsam yod pa/ sprul ba'i mis ras kyis 'phyis te khab bzo ba'i brdas sgrub pa la bskul ba'i pha bong yin zhes bshad/ grong ltag der ri ngos sgrol ma'i lha khang gnyis yod pa'i byin ldan brag khud der/ brag phug tu sman 'dam brag ri'i gur/ mtsho pad sdong steng dbus sgrol ma gzan sngo/ phyag g.yas thugs kur skyabs sbyin/ zhabs g.yas rta bab skyil krung /g.yon sems skyis pus steng rgya yin snyam/ brag ri g.yas g.yon 'brug gzugs steng spos phor/ me rtog dam be/ g.yas glang po'i steng sgrol ma yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bsnams pa/ g.yon seng sngon mgo bo g.yon bstan steng / phyag na yig dril gos che dor dril lta bu bsnams pa/ mdun g.yas nor bu thogs pa'i mo btsun 'greng ba/mdun g.yon rgya'i bu thal sbyar lang ba/ rgyab ngos padma chu ris/ dbu 512

la 'ja' gor me 'bar re/ g.yas ngos bris dharma ta stag zhon/ g.yon 'brug zhon/ steng nyi zla sogs bris snang / 'di rgyas bu med pa rnams bu slong ba'i byin can du brtsi/ steng brag mthor steng lha de 'phur 'ong ba red zer kyang / sangs rgyas sku 'dam sku zhig pa gcig red/ sgang gcig don nas/ rtsa chu shing 'dzoms pa'i sa skyid po nas phyin pa'i lung pa gcig nang dud tshang kha shas yod pa tshan cha shas/ sgang 'di nas le bar te rgyang grags lnga 'das pa na this ra'am/ kun tsi ste tshong 'dus chung du yod/de nas ri bo bya rkang zhal shar gzigs/ shar nas nub tu/ lung pa gcig nang gyen la 'dzegs phyin pa'i nang / brag mchod rten gyi dbyibs shin tu legs po mang po/ sman a ru ra/ sgyu ru ra/ mkhal ma zho sha na ga ge sar/ sgyug ma/ sgron shing sogs kyis gang bas lo sar zla ba dang por yang / ri la me rtog stong ldan sogs skye ba'i sa phyogs dud kha shas/ ltag ngos der/ dā dung zhes pa 'phags pa thogs med kyi sgrub phug co zi'i gdugs rgyal mtshan 'phan/ ka ba/ rdo rnga rdo ting sogs yod pa/ 'brug seng ge sogs gsal bar dod pa/ brag phug shin du nang yangs pa/ sgo der lha khang zhig shul/ rgyas pa tshwa skos pa/ sgo nye ba'i g.yas der/ sgo dogs la nang yangs pa'i sgrub phug 513

chung ngu de thogs med bzhugs gnas yin snyam/ brag yongs nga gu ru'i gsang phug dang mtshungs/ phug chen zhug na gnas 'dzul yangs la ring ba rdo rgyang gsum tshad lhag de nas phyi rol yar lung pa phug tu shing nang nas phyin pas/ shi'i hwa dung ste/ sgrol ma gsung 'byon/ brag phug nang dong gting mi mngon pa byin ldan/ de nas yar lung phug zad nye ste/ thogs med gnas nas le bar lnga na/ ri rtsa yod kyi ngos dong 'dra ba'i phug pa'i nas/ thur du phyin pas/ phug pa nang yangs pa'i sgo zhig na/ mtsho 'dom bzhi tsam/ 'di la shi'i dung ste 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sgrub phug dang / klu yu la du byon pa dang / sher phyin gdan drang ba'i gnas su grags/ gnas gsum yod pa'i lung pa'i mdor phyin nas lhor le bar bco lnga zer yang le bar ram rgyang grags bcu drug ste/ dpag tshad gnyis tsha 'bogs lam du phyin nas lung pa de zad/sgang lam steng nags nang nas yar la rim par phyin pas/ sgang steng bod rnams nas mchod rten go ma sa la garnyo/ rgya yis thang phan sīr bod pa'i mchong rten/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras bzhengs/ 'phags pa kun 'ga' thos rab gnas mdzad pa/ phyis 'jang sa the rgyal pos zhig gsos/ rdo yi myang 'das mchod rten thog so lnga tshad/ sa 'dzin 'dom brgyad mtho do re/ bum pa la la sha stag yod pa/ glang seng rta rma bya 514

gnyis gnyis dang / rgyal chen sde bzhi sgo la bskos pa/ sa the rgyal po'i lha khang du/ gug na de bzhin gshegs pa/ spyan gzigs phyag stong spyan stong bzhugs pa/ mgon po phyag bzhi/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ pha dam pa rgya gar rnams yod pa/ sgo'i g.yon rgyab/ li dril chen po 'dom do dang gru gang tsam/ lha khang 'dir shing byi zla1tshes15nub gza' 'dzin ril sgrib mthong / lha khang 'di sa skyid/ de nas pha rir phyin nas/ sa the rgyal po'i dgon pa gshig gshi'i the sī/ sgo khar rgya yi king gang lag na gdu bu thogs pa/ de nas yar 'od dpag med longs sku/ rdo ra dbus gong ma bzhugs khang / de'i g.yas pha dam pa thog sleb/ lha khang g.yon du ber nag can lha khang / rdo skas steng sgo sum bsgrigs/ g.yas g.yon du gnyis gnyis/ rgyal chen sde bzhi shin tu nyams ldan thog sleb 'jim sku/ khro las grub pa'i thub dbang grong khyer ma tā ming nyams ldan gru gang / spos phor 'dom gang pa/ rdo gcal nas yar phug tu khro las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa thog gnyis/ mdun du dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gran zla med pa'i lha bzos bris pa/ phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi byang sems bdun bdun/ gnas brtan bco brgyad rnams go hri legs/ 'od dpag med sku khro li tā ming ma'i tshugs mda' gang tsam pa drug phug tu phyag rdor legs/ lha khang mtho/ bka' 515

'gyur mi tshang ba dang / bstan bcos khyen rgya yig mgo chems nyis brgya tsam dang / lha khang rnying pa spus dag go/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya yod pa'i lha khang 'di/ deng dus kyang shu g.yang dru'i sku 'khrungs sa/ gong ma nang shu dang yi ge mnyam sbyangs shu wan tā hwa shang gis/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i me rta lo tsam gang shu tis bzhengs/ lha bzo la 'bul ba rkyang pa/ tā lo ye stong phrag gcig dang lnga brgya phul/ klu'u shan sau zhes pa/ dgra bcom lnga brgya'i lha khang nged rang zangs mdog dpal ri'i 'og khang mtho dman ji lta ba rtsa bar logs rer 'dom bcu lhag dbus khri me tog khra khra shing lo pa tra ljang mdun der g.yeng ku'i kyis sbyin rdo ka ma ru pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das sku 'dom phyed tsam/ zur bzhi logs brgyad steng padma brtsegs pa dmar po dkar chod can steng / thub dbang gser shog can ozugs nar g.yung drung / sku rgyab shing lo ljang / me ri pa tra dmar/thog gnyis g.yas kun dga' bo bzhengs/ g.yon nye bar 'khor bgres gnyis bzhengs/ thog re lhag mdun 'od srung bgres mnyam gzhagadagra bcom lnga brgya gru gang tsam pa/ nam mkhar sprin gseb na phyogs bzhi kur phyi nang kun tu rgyab sprad dgra bcom sum brgya lha khang dngos kyi jig ngos nas tshur kha nang gyu brag ri bya 'brug seng gzugs/ brag phug 516

tu nyis brgya ste khyon lnga brgya/ thub pa'i lha khang bskos phun tshogs rgyab dngos su/ spyan ras gzigs phyag nas 'od rgyun can bzhengs pa'i 'khor brag ri/ nang gnas brtan bcas/ nyams 'gyur tshad med bgres/ gzhon/ bar ma/ sdug mi sdug bzhugs stangs/ rdzu 'phrul bkod pa sna tshogs ngo mtshar ba tshon bcas/ lha khang ltag ngos su lha khang thog zhabs dus gsum sangs rgyas mi tsam re dang / bka' bstan 'gyur gong ma shan thang dus pe cing nas spar ba pod stong phrag bdun dang lnga brgya zhe dgu re re nas dpe leb can mgo tshems ldeb chags ma legs/ dpe sgam dbyig can nag po mtshan yig bcas/ nged rang tshod lta byas na pon stong phrag tsam snang / spyir lan kyin su'u na'ang bka' bstan spar yod/ kyang ru su'u na'ang spar yod zer/ 'og tu chos 'chad pa'i lha khang sogs yod/dgra bcom lnga brgya/ hwa shang dang / si khron lha bzo mkhas pa yin/ lha khang gsar pa spus shin tu dag 'di na dge slong bzhi bcu tsam dge tshul dge bsnyen sogs brgya lhag tsam/yang hri krang sri ni/ kha ba dkar po nam mkha' chos kyi rgya mtshos zhig gsos mdzad pa'i rten gtso gu ru rgya gar ma/ dam gtsang byams pa gsumakaḥthog dang 'dra ba nyams can/ dus gsum sangs rgyas dang tshe 517

lha rnam gsum nye sras brgyad sogs bod bzos ji bzhin pa/ 'du khang brag ngos gnas brtan bcu drug rgya gar grub chen dang 'dra ba'i lha mang sbyang/ /sdo / rgya'i rgyal chen bzhi sogs rnying ma'i kuḥ thog dgon pa zhig shu tha'i gong ma myang 'das lha khang rnying / de na dus gsum sangs rgyas thog gnyis re bzo bkod phun sum tshogs/ khri shing brkos legs/ tshangs pa/ brgya byin rgya khrab can gnyis/ sgo khar rgyal chen sde bzhi che/ gtso bo'i sku'i rgyab sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das sku chen po/brag ri'i nang lha mang bcas/nags nang dwa dri ngan na phyag 'tshal ba'i rdo steng kurma pa chos dbyings rdo rje 'dra ba'i phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis rjes/ nang du khro yi dus gsum sangs rgyas longs sku dang / sprul sku 'dom gang ba cha gnyis/ rgyab yol 'brug sngon legs pa gnyis ram gyis bris pa dang /snag tshas bris legs/ pha dam pa cha gnyis/ mgon po phyag drug pa'am khro bo phyag drug pa chil lan sa su sa/kyi'i lung nga zhes par sangs rgyas thub dbang khro zangs sku sprul sku/ mar me mdzad byams pa gnyis longs spyod rdzogs sku/ pha dam pa bcas 'dom gang sar gser shog gsol ba/ khro bo phyag drug pa/518

gnas brtan 'dom gang re bco brgyad rnam 'gyur shin tu mtshar/yang gshan yi si ste kon sar du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dom do zangs gser/ padma rnams dmar/ mchog zung shin tu legs/gzhi mtshal dang dug dbyis bsres pa brgyab/ de steng gser shog bzang po brgyab/ gser mdangs mtsher/ khri sku khang bcas lha khang mtho legs/ pha dam pa de tsam/ yang khro bo gcigami g.yo ba 'dra/wang shu kwang du/ zangs gser gong ltar gyis dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dom gang pa cha gnyis/ yang thub sku 'dom gang gcig bka' 'gyur tā ming ma cha tshang sgam brgya dang nyi shu yod/ glang chen steng kun tu bzang po/ seng ge'i steng 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ lha khang skyid/ rgyal chen bzhis btegs pa'i sder ma pad kha'am steng spyan ras gzigs khru gang / khro bo phyag drug pa'o/ /lo hwan si na sman 'jim dus gsum sangs rgyas thog phyed gnyis mchog zung bcas/ngu ga/ga le hring ngan dus gsum sangs rgyas khru gang tsam/ lha khang chung tā kyo si ni/ gong ma'i tā ming rgyal po'i dus bzhings/ lo lnga brgya song zer/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ri min shog dpe'i 'od dpag 519

med ltar/ tā ming sku tshugs pad spungs/ khri zur bzhi logs brgyad/rgyab yol rgyan drug 'brug dgu me ru bcas/ thog gnyis re longs spyod rdzogs/ pha dam pa/ 'od dpag med bzhengs pa gtso 'khor gsum 'dom gang dman/ pha dam pa 'dom gang / mi g.yo ba thog sleb/mgon po ber nag 'dom gang / bzhugs khri shing brkos 'gran zla bral/ lha khang 'di'i bzo bkod 'gran zla bral/ mkhar pa'i rdza rnga chen po yod/ dge bsnyen btsun da/ rgya'i bu gcer bu smad sham can/g.yon sangs rgyas 'dzub btsug g.yas rgya yig mdun du 'brug can mtshan yig sgo khang du sangs rgyas so lnga khru gang / sgo khang brkos 'gran med/ 'di nas arga zhal ba dkar po dag yol ba 'drab/kyi kwang si/ rgya'i mchod khri 'dom gang / yang nar khri 'dom phyed/ yang khri zur bzhi logs brgyad/ pad spungs bcas 'dom gang /sangs rgyas dpa' bo rab bdun 'dom do pa zangs gser rgyab yol rgyan drug rgyal chen bzhi khru gang / kun bzang / 'jam dbyangs de ltar/ g.yas su 'od srung / g.yon du kun dga' bo 'dom gang pa/phyag rdor rgyan drug 'dom do tsam pa/ rnam snang mi tsam/ lha khang rnying pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ma dang cha bkod pa 'dra/ 'di rnams nags tshal nang phar 'gro tshur 'gro/ kyi kwang si na tshogs zangs chen po 520

spus dag 'gran zla bral ba snang / sgang kha nas yar gyen la rim par chags pa yin/ ring du song nas de'i nub ri bo'i mgul du bsdad/zla ba dang po'i tshes bdun la ri bo'i rtse phyogs su phyin pas/kya sha ti steng 'od srung lha khang nang / tā ming gi tshugs 'jim sku 'od srung chen po thog gnyis/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma mi tshad tsam sku 'dra bdun brgyad spus shin tu dag rdo khar bde chen zhing bkod dma rnyi'am na nyi'i bris spar legs/ri bo'i rtser brag ngos sa the rgyal po'i lcags thag yod pa nas yar phyin/ kyin ting si na/ 'phags pa 'od srung chen po'i sku mi tsam shel sgo nang bzhugs/ lha khang ka bzhi 'di gong ma rgyal pos bzhengs/ li ka ba li leb kyis ngos byas pa'o/ /rdo ka ma ru pa ras dkar chen po kha gang tsam pa'i rdo gcal/ sgo la 'brug thang bcu gnyis la 'brug yod pa'i li yi gnam gcan yod/ sgor spos phor 'dom do pa gong mas bzhings/de ku'i rgyab nas yar phyin pas dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dom gang pa re yod pa'i lha khang du pha dam pa/ tshe dpag med/ mi g.yo ba bcas lha khang thog gnyis thog gcig byas pa/ rgyab phyogs nas yar/ cin phran shan dang / kyang yul/ hwa tshan ri mgor/ lhor tā li ma/ ༵nga

gangs ri/ tā la'i shan dang byu tan/ shar du si si/ kun shan/byang du g.yung be nas si khron o mi shan/ mthong ba'i sa snang g.yer can yod/ lha khang 'di yi mchod rten tā tes zer/ 'di snga mo rgyal po ma skyes dgras bzhengs/ mchod rten shin tu chen po yod kyang rgya yul dpon chen gdug pa can zhig gis bshig pa yin/'di nas mar 'ong la mjal ba'i rdo skas las babs te/ tis tsang dar na 'od srung mnyam bzhag mdzad pa yod kyang ja khang lta bu nag por byas snang /sa dam lcags thag nas sked la phar song bas brag skas su dgra bcom 'od sung chen po'i sku gdung sgo 'dom bzhi lhag re/ rtsa skyes pa'i mtshams can/ rgyal ba byams pas 'gyed par 'gyur ba/ mdun du li rag lha khang lcags kyi ka ba can/ thang snu rkyen/ nang du 'od srung sku 'dra bzhugs byin can kyang yod/ 'di nas shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i nang po ta la nas 'ong ba'i dge slong / kya yan/ los tsong gnyis dang dī/da/ 'dir rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i spyan chab yin zer ba'i chu mig thu hwa dan du 'od srung chen po 'dom do pa/ dge slong gnyis/pha ༵/ pa/ mgon po phyag drug pa bcas/ ho'i ting ban na de bzhin

gshegs pa gtso 'khor gsum 'dom gang re/ pha dam pa de 'dra/ lha khro bo phyag drug pa/yang mar 'ong bas thag ring po tsam na/ hwa yan si na/ chos ra'i dbus dgun me tog skag mdog legs po shar ba'i lha khang nang tā ming gi lugs rnam snang / rin 'byung snang mtha' gsum bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa 'dom bzhi re/ khri pad sogs/ 'od dpag med mi tsam gsum/ ston mchog mi tsam gnyis/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med thog sleb/ pha dam pa/ khro bo mi g.yo ba thog sleb shin tu mtshar/thur du nags nang ri sgang las ring tsam babs pas/ lu gyin si/ lha khang gsar pa na rten rnying de bzhin gshegs pa grong khyer ma'i 'dom gang / g.yas su 'jam dbyangs/ g.yon tu spyan ras gzigs/ pha dam pa rgya gar/ mi g.yo ba bcas/ba ko rnga na/ lha khang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ phyag g.yas ral gri'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas su tshe dpag med/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs 'dom gang pa/ glang po'i steng kun tu bzang /g.yas su seng ge'i steng 'jam dpal dbyangs/ rgyab tu g.yas su pha dam pa/ g.yon du khro bo gshin rje gdong drug 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/bya si na/ khri zur bzhi logs brgyad/ pa tra shing lo me rtog 523

mdog sna tshogs pa/ bya 'brug seng gsum pad spung ljang gu'i steng /zangs gser pa tra me tog sprin ris bcas/ kha dkris 'di la'ang shing lo ris yod/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad tā ming ma khro las blugs pa 'dom bzhi khri 'dom gang / mchod 'dom gser shog dug dbyig bkyes/ mchog zung gnyis 'dom do pa/ g.yas g.yon du rgya yi brtsam chos pod brgya tsam/ sman bla/ 'od dpag med thub sku mi tshad re/ pha dam pa dang / mi g.yo ba thog sleb bcas/ lha khang phyi rol skyed tshal phyi nang rim pa bzhi yod spus gtsang yod/'di yi bar sgang la/ 'gro mi thub pa'i phyogs/ tā sa ko dang /kyang yul 'gro phyogs/ yi'i kyang dang / rdo yi nga na bcas lhag song ngo //yang dbu rtse'i rgyab ngos brag phug chen por sangs rgyas sku yod pa'i gnas khyad 'phags yod kyang / da lta rgya dpon ngo log pa'i jag pa bzhi brgya tsam yod pas su'ang mi 'gro'o/ /thub dbang dpal gyi mgul nas rgyud kyi rgyal/ /bstod pa glu blangs seng ge'i sgra sgrogs gnas/ /rgyal tshab 'od srung chen po zhi ba'i dbyings/ /snyoms par bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog 'dzam gling gi/ shing rta chen po gnyis dang padma 'byung / /dam pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan pa'i gnas/ /da lta ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phrag thogs nas/ /rgya ban tshul khrims dpal 'od mang 524

bsten pas/ /'phrang pa dgyes pa'i ri ngogs 'di lta bu/ /spros dang dad pa'i yid kyi mkhar ba la/ /'chel nas rkang sen utpal dal gyis 'jogs/ /da lta'i dus 'dir kyang lan du sku 'khrungs pa shu sbon tā hwa shang zhes pa sku btsun pa/ mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegs pa la mkhas pa/ gong ma nang shu dang yi ge mnyam sbyang de/ yu lan gyi phyogs 'dir rgyal bstan spel ba la smon lam gyi mthu grub pa zhig yin par snang ste/krung hwa ming go'i gong mar ngo log skabs/ zhag bdun zas mi dgos pa sogs grub rtags mang pos phyogs 'di'i skye bo spyi khyab dad pas bstan pa la dpon po ngan pa dag gis gnod ma nus pa dang / khri dngul nyi shu lhag gis ri bya rkang du dgra bcom lnga brgya'i lha khang bzhengs/ rgya nag nas bka' bstan pod stong lhag gdan drangs pa dang / grwa brgya tsam btsugs/ yu lan sing de bas che ba'i dgon pa da lta btab pa'i skabs su snang ngo / /de'i sku tshab tā hwa shang bgres po da lta ri bya rkang du bzhugs pa dang mjal/ 'dul 'dzin bsam gtan pa chen po zhig snang ngo / /'di nas tā la'i mtsho bskor nas/ tā la'i sgrol ma lha khang du slebs/ de ni lha khang rwa ba rdo gcal yangs pa'i dbus su/ rje btsun sgrol ma bud med kyi gzugs su sprul nas/ rdo pha bong chen po 'dom skor bzhi tsam pa bsnams 'ong ba'i gnas der slebs pa dang /525

rdo de la thim song ba yin/ de'i mthar mtsho yis bskor nas steng du rdo zam/ dkyil du rdo khang shin tu legs po'i nang / rje btsun sgrol ma phyag g.yas thugs mar skyabs sbyin/ g.yon pus steng skyabs sbyin can/ yang mdun der rgya lugs sgrol ma/ mthar rdo ra'i 'gram phug tu gnas brtan bco brgyad thog so rer slebs pa'i 'jim sku nyams ldan/ yar sbug rje btsun sgrol ma rgan mo'i rnam pa chos gos can mi tshad/ sgo nas ngor de dang rgyab sprad du/ sgrol ma nyer gcig brag ri ma mtshar/ yang rdo ra'i sbug nas yar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dom gsum gsum yod pa/ bzhugs khri 'dom phyed do can/ pha dam pa khro rgyal mi g.yo ba bcas yod/ g.yas rgya'i lha khang de/ mgo dkar nag 'khrugs skabs rgya yi dmag dpon sdig rgan gcig red zer/'di nas yar tā la'i rgya grong chen po nas/ yar rgyang tsam na dmag khang phyi gling lugs byas pa gru bzhi'i thong der rgyal po ma skyes dgras bzhings/ thub dbang / nyan thos chen po gnyis/ 'od srung rnams gdung rten yin zer kyang /mchod rten rgya nag gi lugs su snang /mchod rten kha dbu ma'i ngos su rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas sku re snang ngo //lar tā la'i bya kun dang / bya kwang ste mtsho mgo mjug gi chu srub ngos rkyang par grong tsho sum brgya dang drug cu yod pa'i nang / mi khyim 'bum 526

ther gcig dang stong tsho brgyad yod zer/ don nyin lam ring po gnyis kyi sa der/ grong zhing spel mas gang nas 'dug da rung this ra'am tshong 'dus grong khyer chen po/ kho rang gnyis mi brtsi/ ta la'i grong du trī /lo khri phrag lhag pa dang / bya kwan la'ang de tsam yod shas che bar de nas yar can phran phyogs brgyud de/ sa the du slar sleb pas sa the 'jang ri smug po ri bo lhun sdug pa sul mang po/ nags tshal rnams ri rkang gi nags ltar shing chen po sna tshogs/ dgun yang me tog sna tshogs/ shing las skyes pa'i mgul/ smug po dgo spus dag dang /klad der spro bde bkra shis sgang zhes der si tu chos 'byung gis gnas sgo gsar du phyes pa'i sgrub phug bag dro ba/ gu ru nyi ma 'od zer gyi sgrub gnas yin ces pa/ sa the sgrub pa dkar po'i gnas yig tu bris snang la/ 'og tu 'jang dgon khag bcu gsum gyi sgrub yon bcu gsum rgyun du yod pa'i sgrub khang spus dag la byin chags bag dro ba/ bsgrigs kyang dpal spungs sgrub khang ji lta bar snang ngo / /dpal spungs sgrub khang las tshugs snga la/ 'di'i nang nas kyang bla ma rtogs ldan nyams len can mang du byung ba 'jang gi sa chos med kyi yul/ 'dir yang sgrub sde 'di ni shin tu legs pa chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi thugs bskyed byin 527

mthus yin ces grags so/ /'di'i rgyab dbyar shwa lud snar rang byung zangs sa le sbram mang po don par snang / sa the kha ba dkar po ni ri shin tu brjid chags pa khyad par can sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi gnas yin ces grags kyang da lta gnas sgo ma bye bar snang / de'i rgyab ngos rgyal thang chu 'jug 'bri chu phar khar/ rnyi ṭa sngo log ces bon po 'jang ston pas dmar mchod byed pa'i sa gang de ri zhig kyang rgyang nas mthong ba ni ri mi sdug pa zhig go/'jang gi rgyal po'i mi khyim 'bum bcu gsum/ /rda rko sa the mi khyim khri gnyis lhag /'ba' long de tsam 'jol dang rgyal thang sogs/ /rnam dag bkod pa'i chu mjug mi nor klu'i/ /bar du 'jang gi las nang gsos li tsi/ /mgo log gli bu la sogs glo'i nang tshan/ /'bum ther lhag pa 'jang bcas mtha' 'khob ste/ /dam chos nyi 'od ches cher gsal ma rna95/ /'bri chu'i 'gram nas yar ring du 'ong bas/ bla bang ni/ ri che mtho brjid pa/ nags tshal mang po 'jang ri smug po ri bya rkang sogs skudang cha 'dra ba la/ khams dwangs ba'i gnas/ ri bo'i rtser sgrub khang rnying pa g.yas sku gdung dkar po gcig yod pa'i sgrub phug der/ dam pa sangs rgyas sgrub phug yin/ de'ang skyes mchog rgya gar pa phu la ha ri 528

nas/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon nas/ ri bya rkang la byon/ de nas rgya gar la byon par bzhed pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gnas 'dir byon par bskul te/ 'dir byams pa nas 'og gi a shwa lar/ rgya gar grub thob nag po spyod pa dang zhal 'dzoms/ gnas 'dir lo shas bzhugs/ gnas 'di stag mo lus sbyin gyi sa'ang yin/ bdud ri rngam pa sgra sgrogs kyang yin zhes bshad/ sgrub byed la shing thog a ma/ bya ka liṅka yod pa yin par bris kyang brjod pa tsam las ma nges snyam ste/'jang yul phal cher du de gnyis yod pas so/ /gnas snga ma ni bal yul dang / phyi ma ni kong por yang yod mod/ dngos mang po yod na'ang mi 'gal/ mchod rten dkar po ni dam pa sangs rgyas kyi dbu zhwa/ sgom thag na bza' sogs kyi mchod rten dang / chu ba ni nag po spyod chung gi gdung yin zhes bshad/ don du gnas khyad par 'phags pa/ sa mtho/ snang ba dwangs/ nyams skyid pa dang / gnas sked 'bri gong pa dang / gza dgon bcas yod/ 'dir zla chung mda' 'jug mda' nas smyug bring la don cing / sa rang nyams nga ba brgyud/ de nas shing byi lo yi zla pa'i tshes25la shar glegs bam du la chen po khug pa brgyad cu pa brgal nas slebs/ brag gis glegs bam gzugs dang /rgyal ba kurma pa rang byung rdo rjes gnas sgo phyes pa'i dus/ zhabs 529

rjes/ kha ba dkar po'i lde mig rta rjes sogs rang byon mang / lha khang chung ngu phyis bzhengs pa yod/ chos 'byung thang shin tu nyams dga'/g.yas su ri rtser sangs rgyas sman bla'i gnas/ chu dag gam shu dag nag po yod pa'i na ba tshwa rtsa can/ zla ba lnga ba drug par thar ba'i mtsho mjal yod/ sman btsun mo zhes/ kha ba dkar po'i btsun mo yin skad pa'i gangs ri phu na yod/ la khra'i shing thang shing rigs gsum dang / sgyug ma'i shing / shing tsha/ seng ldeng tsandan/ shing sngon/ shing rgod sogs shing mi gcig pa'i nags tshal ches thug pa'i lung pa phur/ skabs der mkhar rnga dang dung rol gling rnga thos rgyu 'ong ba'i dgon gab yod pa'i gangs rdza nags brag de'u/ tshur kur slob dpon padma'i sgrub phugaring du phyin pas tshe la bar chad med par chu shin tu che ba dang / bar chad yod par chu mi 'ong ba/ brag las chu rba 'phyar ngo mtshar ba/ smad sgrub phug nas mar ring tsam na/ bde mchog yum sku dbyibs phyogs mtshon mjal du yod pa'i mkha' 'gro'i gnas gsar bcas chos 'byung thang du lha khang gsar pa 'di ni 'jol bde chen gling pas sa bdag la bzhengs pa'o/ /glegs bam grong stod phur/ kha ba dkar po'i mda' rar grags pa'i shing tshal nags chen dbus thang yangs pa nyams skyid kyang / srin 'bu 'ba' zhig mang po yod/ thang / phan tshun dag 530

tu grub thob bka' brgyad/ sman sgrub dang / sbyin bsregs 'bum ther byas/ la brgal khug brgya dang drug cu yod pa'i thur brgyud shing gtam lung dang / yongs rdzogs lung mdar/ rba bkyogs rdo rje phag mo'i gnas rang byon mang bar yod/ lha khang du gu ru mtshan brgyad mi tsam pa legs/ 'di bde chen rdo rje zhes pa gter ston zhig gis bzhengs/brag phag gi rna ba 'dra ba'i nang gu ru'i sgrub phug de'i 'og der bee ro'i sgrub phug za chu'i nang rdo rje phag mo'i bla mtsho/ chu dwangs dus rdo yi dar lam dkar po lta bu rje btsun sgrol ma'i dar lam/ de nas brag steng phag mo'i dkyil 'khor dbyibs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi sku rjes yin zer ba rdo steng padma 'dab brgyad gsal ba rta mgrin dkyil 'khor/ zhabs rjes mang du yod/ de nas yongs rdzogs la brgal 'phred lam nas byin/ kha ba dkar po'i lte ba me long lung gi nang nas yar nag nang / bskyung sde'i sbas sde yod zer ba skad pa/ dgon stod smad gnyis/ stod mar tshes bcu lha khang gu ru'i sku sogs/ bla ma gsum rab nas bzhengs/ sman 'jim/ thub sku chen po zhal tho gsum pa byon legs nye sras mi tshad re dang gnas brtan/ nyung bshags mtshan brgyad brag ri ma sogs yod pa/ ber dag can lha khang yod/yi dam gu drag ye shes rab 'bar bsten/ rgyab rir phag mo'i gnas 531

sgrub phug gangs 'gul du sbas pa'i mtsho yod par grags/ gnas 'jigs zil che/ sngar seng ge grags skad yod/ dgon smad du sngo phu tshang lha khang na/ bcu gcig zhal phyag stong spyan stong nye sras thub dbang sogs yod pa dang / rgyab ngos su lha khang steng / kai tshang kurma'i sku rab/ dkar lugs bde mchog lha lnga'i gling bslang dkyil 'khor sogs/ rgyab ngos dur khrod nas phar kha ba dkar po'i bla mtsho yin zer ba'i chu rdzing khar nags gseb dbyar sbrul 'dom phyed do dpung po tsam yod pa mthong du 'ong ba legs zer ba sogs so/ /lar kha ba dkar po'i gnas zhal 'byed pa po dngos ni chos rje kuḥthog pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho dpal bzang po nyid yin te/ des thog mar jo bo nam mkha' bkri shis bzhengs/ shing cha rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis ded nas la la gyen du drangs pa'i lo rgyus yod pa ltar bzhengs/ sba phyogs phag mo gnas kyi sgo phyes/ de nas dgon stod bzhengs pa sogs yin par 'dug go/ deng sang ni phyogs 'dir maḥthog snga rabs pa'i ma mgon mgar gsum 'don mkhan shin tu mang yang / kha ba dkar po nam mkha' rgya mtsho dang drung pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho gnyis gcig yin par 'khrul mkhan sha stag go/ kha ba dkar po'i dbus me long / shar me long bam/ lho bya rog gdong can nam 'od gsal/ nub rgya zhing /532

byang mtsho dkar rnams su grags pa las/ klong gsal rgyal sras yosargyan bstan 'phel gyis/ tsha ru breng khar dgon/(1)bla ma gsung rab kyis me long dgon/(2)stod/ bstan 'phel gyis brag nag dang /(3)lung phu lha khang dang (4)lha khang ra ba dang /(5)nag lcogs su klong gsal spar shing mang ba dang / bka' brgyad sku byin ldan yod/(6) gzhan lha khang mang du yod/ brag nag lha khang tsha ba dar rgyas dgon pas bdag kyang bstan 'phel yin skad/ bstan 'phel gyi lung phu lha khang dang /(7)rgya zhing ni bla ma chos nyid lha khang yin pas khra 'bu tshang bdag chu khar sman ri nas yar gzom ku lung sgang bstan 'phel lha khang /(8) rmog she steng bstan 'phel lha khang /(9)kha ba dkar por 'og tu tsha ru kha/ glang gru lung / glang rgyas nas rdo skas la/ zla chu'i srib la glegs bam/shing gtam yongs rdzogs/ me long / sri 'jang / sngo ru/ chu kha/rgyab rgyal mo dngul chu'i khar/ lung pa de dag gi rgyab de 'dra re yod do/ /brag ri dang gangs ri rnams shin tu brjid/ nags tshal du thang shing 'dom lnga bcu pa yod la/ grong rnams su dug sbyor mkhan mang ngo //'di las sri lung phug tu dmag dpon dgra 'dul dbang phyug yod pa 'bri ra phug byang mtsho dkar chu lnga ni/ shwa chu khar 'ong ba sngo ru yar rgyab/ sman ri'i mdun 'ong ngo / rgyal mo dngul chu la rdo skas la rgyab 533

nas/ rtsa gso thang / bya rong gdong nas glegs bam rgyab la chu nag thang / 'di'i zhug la sbas sde yod/ glegs bam grong stod thang rgyab lha khang rwa ba zhes pa'i lung pa brgal/ chu ru sgrub phug na brag nag lha khang /shing gtam thad tsam na lung phu yod/ yongs rdzogs thang na nag lcogs yod/ me long thang na rgya zhing yod/ da lta kha ba dkar po'i gnas la rgyab ngos lung pa dgu/ mdun ngos lung pa dgu yod/shel dkar rab brjid spungs lta'i kha ba dkar/ /stag ma rong btsan 'khor 'das srung rten gnas/ /zhing skyong dpa' bo ṭākki'i pho brang du/ /rab brtan chos nyid cog bzhag sgom na spro/ /rgya dang bod kyi sa mtshams rong chen du/ /mtha' 'khob klo shas che ba 'jang gi sde/ /dad pas brtan kyang shes rig btul ba 'di/ /'dod chags bya sha gti mug phag shas lan/ /phal cher tsa ri tra dang chos mtshungs shing / /phal dag gnas bskor rgyu yang gnas rgyus med/ /gnas su rtag par sdod kyang gnas chen gyi/ /mtshan nyid mi shes mi des gnas ma mjal/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /so/ /stag tshang rdo rje gro lod/ ri bar ma song gnas yod pas ma bris shog dril las bshus pa/ rgya rtsis lo rgan drug cu'i lo mgo shing byi 534

lor zla ba dang po'i nang si tu pa rgya nag yu nan ri bo bya rkang du song thos/ naḥthog si tu chu phag lor/ zla12ba'i tshes 8 la rgyang rang sgong tho la nas/ lcang rdo steng lhag dgra mdar rig bha rdus a kwa par lhag gzi ling sar 'bras zhing tu lhag ya kri 'bang kwa sar nag khra 'bu la rig khra 'bu 'bang kwa la nag bha lo chu mdar rtag ba rtsi la rig ru la nag 'ba' lung dgon nag 'ba' 'phags la naga.a sa to la brgal/ li rdos dgon du zhag ko sham si tu chos 'byung bzhugs khri sa zhag ko dhas nas bu zi ṭa la zhag kan ci steng zhag tshe me la dgu gtor btang zhag rdo rnga rong nas li shi la rked rgya che la rtag lo sar/ li shi dgon du zhag phun tshogs dgon du zhus sa the mda' seng ge la'am ka ko la rtsar rtag zo chun 'khyud mo 'khor lo mthong /ci ṭha pa tsi thu ste spang chung yod pa'i grang mdun zhag sgol min la mjal nas/ hwa chi ka yan si ste spyan ras gzigs lha khang du zhus saṃ sked la 535

rtsa'am hwa tshan bod gra bsags pa/ g.yi ri zhes pa 'dug ma ran kyang lhag sung ki spang steng rtag kyang yul 'gram bha kha ste skyu ru ra'i nags tshal yod par dug la sman du 'khrul nas zos kyang dkon mchog thugs rjes ma skyon pas rtag 'dug ma ran kyang dpon po jag pa yod pas ma 'gro zer/kyang yul 'a/ga 'phags pa thogs med kyis byams mgon mjal sa'i brag hwang kyang bi sgang rgyab rtswa 'jam pa skyid po la zhag sgrol ma'i phug mjal/ klu thogs sdig tsā dung 'gro rig mchod rten go ma sa la ga ra lhag dgra bcom lnga brgya'i lha khang sogs dgon kta/ mjal/ri bya rkang mgul thu hu tan 'go der rtag la rtser song / la smad nye bar dgon khrug mjal/ hang yan si la rtag dgun mjal/ bad ka khu na mtsho chung ngu shing gis bskor ba'i sa skyid po rtag la gcig rgyab bar ta bas mtsho thang lha rgyab/ yang 'bras zhing chu mtsho lta bu nas la 536

rgyab/ twa li mtsho khar twe lta la bsdad nas/ ni gi thus rtag tā li bya kwan la nag de nas chu drar song yang thas lam li ra gnyis tsam rgya gar la 'gro sham byas rtag de nas tā li'i kun yi thang ste sgrol ma lha khang du rtag de nas tā li'i khrom chen dang rgya tshong pa/ byan g.yer dang la lhag bsdad/ tshong mang po brgyab/ rgya mang po 'tshogs/ dgra bcom lnga brgya'i sku spar la btab/ de nas tā li'i mchod rten rnams mjal nas yar/ dbad khyo la nag mtsho mgor gtor ma bsngos nas de nas g.yung ko la rtag myang zas la tshwa chu khar rtag tan 'u la mchod rten sgang du rtag spyi'i 'u la thang stong rtag de nas phun tshogs dgon la ba skor ba tshar nas sleb bo/ /tā li'i bya kwan dang / bya rkang ste mtsho mgo mjug bar nyin lam gnyis la/ grong tsho sum brgya dang drug cu yod/ de na gus du yod na tshong 'dus gnyis ma brtsis pa mi khyim 'bum phrag gcig dang stong tsho brgyad ces rgya dpon gyis zer zhes bshad/537

ri bo bya rkang gnas skor lam rgya yi yul mi 'dra ba du ma 'grim na sngar sa the tu yin kyang da lta/ 'ba' lung gshan/ sa the gshan/ hwa chin gshad/ sing kun gshan dngos la 'gro mi dkon kyang de'i sa/ ri bo bya rkang dang de'i nye char thams cad yin/ drang kru'i gshan/ tā la'i bya kwan thar ru nas khrom chen dang bya rkang bar tā la gshan/ krung po/ yung po/ ding kun gshan/ spung nas lan kho gshan/ mtsho chen yod pa dang / can phran gshan la'ang mtsho yod/ de nas yar sa the li shi la rtsa ma sleb bar grong mang / thang chen/ li shi la rtsa la ba ha cha mtsho ljang gu yod pa 'di mya mchan la rked der sleb pa yin/ li shi la mtsho yod/ can phran yar nang kyi'i pus nas nag chog dang / mda' mo chung la 'gro sa yod/ de nas yar 'ba' lung la nye lam yod kyang /zlo/ rang tsho gla ming du 'ong dgos khyad kyis slar rdo rnga rong du don pa zla 2ba'i tshes 5la 'jang ri smug po'i dgon du lhag ri khrod spro bde bkra shis sgang du sgrub khang bar na ro chos drug bton/ tshes 10la phun tshogs dgon nas phyir li shi'i mtsho mgo snga mo phun tshogs dgon chags sa yin kyang sa nor zhes pa nag de nas rdo rnga rong du/ de nas 538

kun tsi steng / de nas bu zi ra/ de nas ko dos dgon du rtag de nas mu khu mdor ko dros phyag mdzod khyim du lhag de nas klu yon skang spyi so'i lha khang du lhag de nas rgya la po steng zhal ngo sar/ gla ming 'bri khung dgon/ ri bo'i rtser gnas nang rtag karma dgon du rtag zur chen po la babs/ gla thang 'di ri sa skyid la chu 'gram/ rgya mo khug thang skyid po 'di grong pas nged la phul/ bla ma dge legs la byin yod/ de nas tha chu a kwa sar rtag rdo sgang sa skyid sar rtag g.ya' thang du nag la brgal thur gzar la babs/ 'ba' lung phe the nang / 'og shri'i lha/'ba' lung dgon du/ ar rdos te dpal spungs dbon sprul dbang gi rdo rje 'khrungs sar lhag rgya nag a kwa lhar/ slar byu ru la rtag kag dag la nag rab 'byor gong rig khra 'bu/ a kwa par/ khra 'bu dgon/ ya gri 'bang ku'i khyim du sleb der zhag shas/ (phyag bris dngos las zhal bshus so/ /)'bru srub kyi lung pa/ mgo nub byang nas/ lho ru sogs shar du 'ong ba 'gu shod la/ smar khams sgang dang /539

phu lag bcas chab 'dus sar/ rje tsong kha pa'i bla ma dbu ma pa'i gdung rten yod/ mgo phu lag la/ mjug shor du song ba 'bam lha mdun/ de yi byang du byang shar nas 'bri chu bab pa 'bam mtsho kha dang 'bam steng pa kyi lung pa yod/ lha mdun thang nags tshal byang rong 'dres pa/ sa skyid/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che'i dus kyi rdzong ni 'gu shod rgya bkag rdzong / rgya bkag dgon ni lha mdun phu na yod/lha mdun du rgya du nyams nyes dang / phyag phreng gis nyams nyes 'ga' byung yang da lta zhig gsos tshong khang sbug bod rje chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan gyi btsun mo lha cig kong jo'i rdzu 'phrul gyis bskrun pa rdo nag pad spungs steng / rnam par snang mdzad mnyam bzhag lhung bzed 'dzin pa gangs can mtsho 'dom byed do tsam pa dang / 'jim sku nye ba'i sras chen brgyad snga ma'i dus kyi mi chen po'i tshad/ mtha' 'dul lha khang rnams su yod pa'i brjid ldan de 'dra/ phyis bzhengs khro bo gnyis bcas yod steng der dge ldan brag ram ri khrod/ de'i grwa tshang rgyab ngos nyin phyed 'bam steng / rgya sne stong pa sogs/ gnas mgo tshong khang zhing sogs yod/ de yi chu dang 'gu shod chu sogs bsdong nas/ rdzong sngon gshis su 'ong / der sga mgo na kong jos bskos pa'i rnam snang mi che tshad dang / byang sems gnyis/ ze'u dgon pas lha khang ri khrod 540

btab pa dang / gong tsam na lung rong du de'i gral tshe dpag med dang /mar sa khug gnyis song ba na/ rgya bza' kong jo'i sras mo'i mchod rten bskor bas phan pa dang / rong shin tu ngan pa nas chu sum mdor/ gong chu nub nas shar rgyu la/ lho tsha leb nas gnyal smad dge ri bcas lung pa byang du bstan pa'i mtha' byang shar nas g.yag ra nas 'bri chur 'jug pa'o/ /ko spyan ras gzigs/ lha thang mdzod/ rdzi dkar leb logs chu dang / khams sgar gyi chu dang / bee ru/ gru gu lha brag chu do lo mdor babs/ de nas gyen du cung phyin pas lung pa spang dang dgas tshal can na/ rgya bza' kong jo'i dus/ dang por brag la nyi ma'i gzugs rang byon du byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon padma yang byon/ nam mkha'i rgyal po spyan ras gzigs su byin gyis brlabs/ yon dge mi 'gyur rdo rjes sa bsal/ gnas sgo phyes/ khams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gnas yig kyang yod/ brag pha bong che ngos/ phyag stong spyan stong shin tu gsal ba rdo la rdo dkar gyis rtsa phyag 'khor phyag ri mo sgros/ dar shams/ rin chen rgyan phreng sogs ri mo bris pa cha 'tshungs/ zhag bcu gcig la gser byug ris su bris pa'o/ /sku tshang ma 'dom gang dang rtse khru gang tsam/ gnas yig tu/ thugs shar riḥbacas/ dbu gtsug tu cho 541

'gro 'dul phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas g.yon sgrol ma dkar ljang mtshon tsam re/ rgyab ngos mar me mdzad/ rtse mor ston pa/ mdun g.yas byams mgon/ 'og tu yig drug rim par gsal 'gyur mtha' bskor rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan sogs yod ces 'dug ba mdo tshang gi 'du khang /ka ring bzhi pa/ thub dbang / rigs lnga sgrol ljang / tshe lha gsum/rje yab sras gsum/ nye sras brgyad sogs 'jim sku thog dma' ba re mjal du yod do/ /rig 'dzin sprul ba'i gter ston gyis zhal phyes/ /ring nas zhwa ser lugs 'gas bkur ba'i zhus/ /'phags pa'i thugs rje rang byung sku brnyan gyi/ /gtsug lag khang mchog phrin las mi zad mthu/ dge'o/ /yang shing glang zla ba dang po'i nang chab mdor bod rje gzhung pa'i chab srid rim 'gro la 'ong ba'i skabs/ chab mdo'i skyo mda'i nang rten mjal ba la/ hor se chen rgyal pos 'phags pa rin po cher phul ba'i sangs rgyas thub pa'i ring bsrel dngul snod/ rang byung zangs snod sogs/ sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' rin po che/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi phyi ma 'di sde dge dza thog dang / skyob mda' gnyis/ bla bskos bsod nams rgya mtshos skyob mda' dza thog gnyis ska'i chos rje mdzad nas rdza thog tu gdan sa yin/ bsod nams rgya 542

mtsho'i sprul sku de ma thag pa/ skyob mda' sprul sku rab 'byams dkon mchog chos 'phel/ dbu thod ring bsrel dgus brgyan pa/ rkang sbub tu mgon po phyag drug pa/ kṣe tra ri la/ dzi na mi tra rang byon shin tu gsal ba/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i phyag dril rgya gar ma/ skyo mda'i mkhan byams pa rin po che rnam rgyal mtshed gdung thung ngu ngo mtshar ba/yon dge mi 'gyur ba'i gter khri rgyal ba lnga pa chen po'i dbu paṇa rnams mjal/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i thang zhus dmar po gser rigs rtags brgyad yod pa/ chab mdo dgon dang rten lhag mang / ru tsha mkhan chung pa nas sa skya 'jam dbyangs bzang pos gnang ba sa skya'i rten/ kha che paṇḍi ta chen po'i thugs dam rgya gar nub li 'gran bral thub pa/ chab mdo'i nang rten/ rgyal ngo/ srong btsan sgam po'i tshems bzhugs khang mchod rten bcas/ chab mdo'i gdan rabs gnyis pa zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i zhun jig la spyan ras gzigs byon pa/ klu sgrub phyag nas mi'i thub sku li gar bu ngo ma/ shang paṇa sbrul du bzhes pa'i wags pa'i 'bagayab tshang ma sa nas/ bsam yas nang rten/ nyang gter gu ru/drag dmar lha khri dmar po 'gran zla med pa mthong ma myong ba lta bu/gsang 'dus grwa tshang khang na/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i sku li 543

khra 'gran zla bral ba rnams mjal/thang ka la zhi lha bla brang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis dgu thang / padma bka' thang bcu gnyis bsam lhun bcas/lha bzo kun dga' nas bris pa sgrol ma'i dgu thang 'ja' shar ba lta bu kha thum gser las gang sham byas pa/ bla brang gzhung 'phags pa lha yi mdun nas/ mi tra dzo zhi'i rnam thar 'gran zla med pa bcu thang /spyi chen khang nas gnas brtan thang ka nyer gsum/ rnam sras legs po/ 'di rnams dgon pa bsregs skabs ma lus pa/yab tshang ma nas g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i rnam thar sman bla mched bcas dgu thang / skyo mda' nas snga mo'i lha bzos lam 'bras brgyud thang bcu drug bcas mjal/ sa paṇa rnam thar gos chen ser por bris pa bdun thang mjal zhes dge'o/ /544

rtsom sgrig 'gan khur ba/ dbyangs can lha mo/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ bsam gtan/ka thog si tu'i dbus gtsang gnas yigasi tu chos kyi rgya mtshos brtsams/si khron mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis bskrun nas bkram/si khron zhing chen zhin hwa dpe tshong khang gis brgyud tshong byas/si yon me tha'i sa gshes ri mo bzo ba'i par 'debs bzo grwas dpar/dpe rtags/152 7—5409—2149——870 2017rin sgor/19 80
